quests.name: 10th Coldain Ring Quest
steps: Obtaining the Orders:
You say, 'You can count on my help.'

He hands you a Declaration of War . Take the Declaration of War to Sentry Badain who is located in a guard tower in the Great Divide, at -1080, +140. Hand Sentry Badain the Declaration of War and your Ring 9 Coldain Hero's Insignia Ring to start the "WAR". He will return your Ring 9

WARNING: There is apparently a 30 minute time limit between the handin to Sentry Badain, and the handin to Zrelik. If you start the script with the Sentry Badain handin, and fail to turn in the appropriate item to Zrelik within 30 minutes, the event WILL FAIL.
WARNING: Be careful not to give your ring to anyone else (eg. Garadain Glacierbane).
He and the other Coldain despawn. He reappears shortly.
Follow him to a circle of dwarves that are in the middle of a conversation, they are sitting in a circle close to Thurgadin:
Sentry Badain then walks off towards Thurgadin and despawns.
Give Seneschal Aldikar your ring 9 Coldain Hero's Insignia Ring . He gives it back along with an item called Orders of engagement.
The Orders read:
OFFICIAL COLDAIN ORDERS OF ENGAGEMENT:
To call Garadain's men: "Garadain to my side!"
To call Dobbin and his men: "Dobbin assist me!"
To summon Churn's troops: "Churn protect me!"
To call upon Corbin's team: "Corbin, attack!"
Call all available troops: "For the Dain, attack!"

You should make hotkeys to turn off attack, target Zrelik and /say one of those commands to Zrelik the Scout. You only really need the last command "For the Dain, Attack!" as this rallies all the troops. Zrelik runs after you and as long as he is moving the host of dwarf soldiers should be running after him. But don't hesitate to spam the command whenever to ensure they keep up. Once Zrelik stands still the troops will start moving toward their spawn location after about 5 seconds. So you need to say the command every 5 seconds to keep them around. Be careful if you have people helping you wi…
Triggering the War:
Give the Orders of engagement to Zrelik (Not The One In Thurgadin)

WARNING: There is apparently a 30 minute time limit between the handin to Sentry Badain, and the handin to Zrelik. If you start the script with the Sentry Badain handin, and fail to turn in the Order of Engagement to Zrelik within 30 minutes, the event WILL FAIL.
This begins the war. You'll see:
Commands to Zrelik:
These are the commands you can give to Zrelik the Scout:
You say, 'For the Dain, attack!'
You say, 'Churn protect me!'
You say, 'Corbin, attack!'
You say, 'Dobbin assist me!' (this seems wrong)
In the Event of a Loss:
If any giant gets past you to the Thurgadin entrance, you lose. You'll know this has happened if you see that Zrelik is missing and the giants are lined up on both sides of the river to Thurgadin.

All of Thurgadin dies in the event of a loss. You'll see dead Coldain throughout the zone: A Gutted Guard, A Gored Guard, A Butchered Butcher, A Murdered Merchant, A Bludgeoned Banker, A Conquered Coldain, A Punctured Priestess, and A Perforated Priest.
The War:
Detailed Ring War Breakdown
Once Seneschal Aldikar shouts for troops to take their positions, the battle begins.

The war can be split up into three rounds. Each round consists of seven waves of giants attacking Thurgadin. Each round and wave get progressively harder. Once wave seven of round three is done Narandi the Wretched spawns. He is a fairly simple tank and spank boss. Kill him loot his head. Be absolutely certain to keep the dwarf army you have been controlling far away from Narandi. If they get aggro they will attack him and you will not be able to stop them. If they get the killing blow Narandi's corpse will poof and you get no ring 10 and no loot. The war is a timed event that is scripted. Th…
Round 1 Mobs
Kromrif Spearman
Kromrif Captain
Kromrif Recruit
Cleric of Zek
Round 2 Mobs
Kromrif General
Kromrif Warrior
Priest of Zek
Round 3 Mobs
Kromrif Warlord
Kromrif Veteran
High Priest of Zek
Once Narandi is dead:
Note: Mobs despawn when the war starts, and will all respawn 30 minutes after the war is won.
Turn-In for the 10th Ring:

Once you have won, turn in ring 9 Coldain Hero's Insignia Ring and Narandi's head to Seneschal Aldikar to receive the 10th Coldain ring Ring of Dain Frostreaver IV. He is standing in a circle with the other named Coldain close to Thurgadin
You receive the 10th ring Ring of Dain Frostreaver IV and the Shorn Head of Narandi.

quests.name: Aegis of Life Quest
steps: NOTE: THIS QUEST REQUIRES WARMLY FACTION WITH CAMLEND SERBOLD TO DO TURN IN. IF YOU ARE NOT WARMLY FACTION YOU WILL LOSE YOUR ITEMS. DON'T WASTE HOURS OF CAMPING.

Notes on faction: Do not despair! Acquiring the appropriate faction is easy and straightforward! If by the end of camping Grimrot you haven't hit warmly by killing the putrid skellies, there is a simple quest to do. Turn in 2g at a time to Lashun Novashine in the Qeynos newbie yard. It took me 450 turn-ins to go from apprehensive to warmly, but as long as you aren't KOS it is possible. The 450 turn-ins took maybe an hour to do... Just grab 1000 gold and it should be enough.
"It took my Dwarf Cleric 1750 gold (approximately 875 turn ins) to go from Apprehensive to Warmly." "2274 gold to get from dubious to warmly on my Human Innoruuk Cleric".
This quest begins with Capt Linarius in North Karana (on the bridge to South Karana). He asks you to speak with Camlend Serbold in Qeynos.
Go to Southern Karana. Not far from the end of the bridge is an undead camp. Lord Grimrot's placeholder is the only putrid skeleton that is standing.
The Respawn timer is exactly 3 hours, 12 minutes (192 minutes). Confirmed 6/22/14.
The live version drops two Pestilence Scythes. The Pestilence Scythe with the proc is the one you need to turn-in. The undead version drops the Decaying Heart.
Turn in both the Scythe and the Heart to Camlend Serbold to receive the Aegis of Life.
Note: A common misconception is that the Undead Grimrot only spawns during the Night, and the live version during the day. This is NOT true.
You Can turn in both the Decaying Heart and Pestilence Scythe at the same time.

quests.name: Armor of Ro Quests
steps: General Information:

The Armor of Ro is a set of Paladin specific armor quested from The Temple of Solusek Ro and the paladins encamped in Rathe Mountains. Each piece of the Armor of Ro is created by combining a quested Mold of Ro and a crafted Bar of Ronium in a NON-CULTURAL forge. The molds are NO DROP but the Bar of Ronium is tradeable, as are the completed armor pieces. The armor is only usable by paladins, but can be quested by any character able to get their faction with the quest NPCs to Amiable. Each mold requires Amiable with a separate faction.
Molds of Ro Armor:

To get the molds, you must go to the Rathe Mountains paladin camp (+2930, -800). Each mold must be quested from a different NPC in the camp, and each NPC is on a different faction. If the NPC does not con at least Amiable to you, he or she will refer you to their guild instead of giving you the quest.
Mold of Ro Boots
Mold of Ro Bracer
Mold of Ro Breastplate
Mold of Ro Gauntlets
Mold of Ro Greaves
Mold of Ro Helm
Mold of Ro Vambrace
Mold of Ro Boots:
You must have Amiable faction with Clerics of Underfoot to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail Nicholas'
You say, 'I seek the Boots of Ro'
Kilij Plans drop from Sandgiant Husam in South Ro.
Give Nicholas the Kilij Plans and receive the Mold of Ro Boots.
Mold of Ro Bracer:
You must have Amiable faction with Deepwater Knights to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail, David'
You say, 'I seek the Bracers of Ro'
Deepwater Goblin Nets drop from a goblin net master in Lake Rathe.
Give David 2 Deepwater Goblin Nets and receive the Mold of Ro Bracer.
Mold of Ro Breastplate:
You must have Amiable faction with Clerics of Tunare to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail, Abigail'
You say, 'I seek the Breastplate of Ro'
A Dark Cauldron drops from an ancille cook in Mistmoore Castle.
Give Abigail 2 A Dark Cauldrons and receive the Mold of Ro Breastplate.
Mold of Ro Gauntlets:
You must have Amiable faction with Priests of Marr to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Joanna'
You say, 'I seek the Gauntlets of Ro'
A Locket drops from Sentry Alechin or a werewolf in Southern Karana.

Note: Killing Sentry Alechin damages your Knights of Truth and Priests of Marr faction. Waiting until nightfall and killing the werewolf that he becomes does not. As you will be in South Karana for a while camping the helm drops, you might as well wait until he changes to kill him.
Give Sentry Joanna A Locket and receive the Mold of Ro Gauntlets.
Mold of Ro Greaves:
You must have Amiable faction with Knights of Truth to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail, Elisabeth'
You say, 'I seek the Greaves of Ro'
Nightfall Giant's Head drops from a nightfall giant in West Commonlands.
Give Elisabeth Nightfall Giant's Head and receive Mold of Ro Greaves.
Mold of Ro Helm:
You must have Amiable faction with Knights of Thunder to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail, Thomas'
You say 'I seek the sacred molds'
You say, 'I seek the Helm of Ro'

Cyclops Skulls drop from An undead cyclops in Southern Karana, The undead cyclops roams the area between Splitpaw and the Aviak city and share the spawn with a regular cyclops, lions and bull elephants.
Give Thomas two Cyclops Skulls and receive the Mold of Ro Helm.
Mold of Ro Vambrace:
You must have Amiable faction with Priests of Life to complete this step.
You say, 'Hail, Marianna'
You say, 'I seek the Vambraces of Ro'

Rotten Shark Meat drops from a plague shark in Erud's Crossing. There is a static plague shark spawn off the southern shore of the island which paths east to west across the length of the island. 2 hour spawn and the meat is a somewhat rare drop.
Give Marianna 2 Rotten Shark Meat and receive the Mold of Ro Vambrace.
Bars of Ronium:

Once you have the mold for an item, you need to talk to Lord Searfire, the Dwarven Smith in The Temple of Solusek Ro. He must consider you Amiably before he will deal with you. You will need an empty main inventory slot to use the Sol Cauldron he gives you.
Bar of Ronium (crafted in a Sol Cauldron)
You say, 'Hail, Lord Searfire'
You say, 'Do you have ronium?'

Bracers of the Reverent:
Bracers of the Reverent
Turn the following in to Gavel the Temperant
2x Enchanted Platinum Bar
Ingot of the Reverent (drops off of Regis the Reverent in North Karana.)
Icon of the Reverent (Give Lianna's Flute to Lianna in the Rathe Mountains (3989.64, 1477.37 ) in order to receive the Icon of the Reverent.)

Turning in the Flute to Lianna is only for the Icon of the Reverent. IMPORTANT: DO NOT turn in the Enchanted Platinum Bars, and both ingots to Lianna! She will give you the Icon and eat the rest of the items. Take the Icon and turn it in with the other items to Gavel the Temperant.

quests.name: Armor Size
steps: There are two dwarven smiths at the inn next to Befallen who offer to resize Crafted Armor for you.
Timtok Tonsmith will resize Gauntlets, Vambraces, Helm and Boots.
Ranvigoz Tonsmith will resize Bracers, Pauldron, Brestplate and Greaves.
This reduces the size to small and the weight of the armor as follows:
Gauntlets were 5.0 now 3.7 wt.
Vambraces were 6.5 now 4.8 wt.
Bracers were 4.0 now 3.0 wt each.
Helm was 6.0 now 4.5 wt.
Pauldron was 4.5 now 3.3 wt.
Breastplate was 10.0 now 7.5 wt.
Greaves were 7.5 now 5.6 wt.
Plate boots were 6.5 now 4.8 wt.
You may need to be amiable to them to get the quest. I definitely wouldn't go handing them your armor if they haven't responded to your hails and given you the quest.
-When conned indifferent they responded to hails but would not complete quest.

quests.name: Assist the Great Xelha
steps: Note: This quest made MQable on the 2/13/13 patch.

Even though Xelha doesn't talk to you at dubious, or apprehensive, she will accept the Bone Chips. She WILL NOT accept fire beetle eyes or spiderling silk until faction is more suitable (Xelha is Dismal Rage).
You say, 'Hail, Xelha Nevagon'
You say, 'I will assist the great Xelha.'
Give her 4 x Bone Chips. (Can be stacked and can be multiple turn-ins as long as its in multiples of 4)
You receive 1 gold from Xelha Nevagon.
Experience from Turn-ins:
10%-11% xp at Level 2 (Troll Shaman Innoruuk)
4% at Level 3 (Troll Shaman Innoruuk)
2.15% at level 4 (Ogre Shadow Knight)
1.1% at level 5 (Ogre Shadow Knight)
At amiable to Dismal Rage, Xelha would talk to me and accept both fire beetle eyes and spiderling silk. I did not try at indifferent.
edit : At indifferent, she actually offer the 3 quest. you can start with fire beetle and silk.
edit : I can confirm she offered the 3 quests but did not accept fire beetle and silk until amiable.
You say, 'I will assist the great Xelha.'
Give her 4 x Fire Beetle Eye.
Bah!! I shall reward you for this small, very small, deed!! I pass on to you the knowledge of summoning. The more you serve, the more your faith in Innoruuk grows.'
You receive 5 silver from Xelha Nevagon.
You receive either Spell: Cavorting Bones or Spell: Reclaim Energy.
Give her 4 x Spiderling Silk.
You receive 3 silver from Xelha Nevagon.
You receive Xelha's Sparkler

quests.name: Aviak Chicks
steps: Bumle Reminjar is located at 1382, 132, 39 in the dining hall of the Paladin guild. You must have Amiable faction to complete this quest Completed with indifferent faction, even though Bumle will not give all of the quest details when spoken to. Required amiable as agnostic half-elf bard as of May 2023. Required amiable as Tunare Wood Elf Druid as of July 2023.
You say, 'Hail, Bumle Reminjar'
You say, 'What birdmen'
You say, 'I will destroy the krag chicks'
Upon the death of a Krag Chick or an aviak chick
Hand Bumle Reminjar 4 Aviak Chick Talons, randomly looted from a Krag Chick or an aviak chick roaming throughout the Butcherblock Mountains
You receive 1 random piece of Small Patchwork armor

quests.name: Aviak Talons
steps: This is a continuation of the Aviak Chicks quest which Bumle Reminjar, located at 1382, 132, 39 in the dining hall of the Paladin guild, will offer at Kindly faction following the turn in of the Aviak Chick Talons.

Hand Bumle Reminjar 4 Aviak Talons, randomly looted from a krag elder, primarly located in the southern region of the Butcherblock Mountains between the Greater Faydark and Dagnor's Cauldron zone lines.
You receive 2 platinum, 5 gold, 4 silver pieces.

quests.name: Azraxs' Legacy
steps: Ernax the Scholar can be found on the first floor of the Athenaeum Necromantia in Paineel at (1136, 899).
You say, 'Hail, Ernax the Scholar'
You say, 'I wish to speak to you on a matter of the soul'
You receive A Tattered Book.
Which reads:
Another fool doth step upon this path to power. Another fool most assuredly will die. It is of no consequence
if you succeed or fail, the outcome is yours to decide. What is needed from you is to stalk the land as the
dark master you wish to be, and obtain the following components through stealth, guile, and deceit: An
assassins Bloody mantle, a druid of renown's pure heart, and a crystal of capturing. When done, place them
within the enchanted soul trap and incant upon them that they may be combined. If you have not failed
miserably, take the resulting Soul Trap to the soul you wish to manipulate.
Return the Tattered Book to Ernax to receive a Soul Trap (4 slot container).
You say, 'What is a crystal of capturing?'
Seek out the necessary components as instructed:
a Bloody Mantle which drops from a Dark Assassin, a level 50 mob that can spawn in Everfrost Peaks and The Feerrott
the Heart of the Pure Druid which drops from Alania Peaceheart in Greater Faydark (1042, 1175)
an Empty Crystal Sphere, made by Jalen Goldsinger in Toxxulia Forest (Mini quest, see below)
Obtaining the Crystal of Capturing:
Step 1
Jalen Goldsinger can be found in Toxxulia Forest at (1525, -837). You need at least dubious faction with Gate Callers to speak with her. Or bring a 40+ enchanter to charm.
You say, 'Hail, Jalen Goldsinger'
You say, 'How do I create a crystal of capturing?'
You say, 'Where can I find a potion of sorrow?'
Step 2

Travel to Halas and find Gorth Bearsoul inside The Golden Torc at (128, 390). You need at least dubious faction with Wolves of the North to speak with him and turn-in. Or bring a 40+ enchanter to charm.
You say, 'Hail, Gorth Bearsoul'
You say, 'Can you make me a Potion of Sorrow?'
You say, 'How much money do you require?'
Give Gorth 500 GP to obtain the Potion of Sorrow.
Step 3
Return to Toxxulia Forest and Jalen Goldsinger. You need at least dubious faction with Gate Callers to turn-in with her. Or bring a 40+ enchanter to charm.
Give her the Potion of Sorrow and 1000 GP.
You receive an Empty Crystal Sphere .
Final Combine

quests.name: Bard Mail
steps: Felwithe to Kelethin:
Time:5-8 min
This quest takes place mostly in Greater Faydark and involves running a message from Tascar Tissleplay, in Felwithe, to Jakum Webdancer, in Kelethin.
(Tascar Tissleplay loc:-89, -322) (Jakum Webdancer loc: -232, 259)

The idea is to run back and forth doing this delivery repeatedly. Time wise, running this quest can be comparable to killing the bats and wolves that inhabit the area. Especially at times when the zone is crowded with new players, or when SoW is Available. On this point: Its recommended to find a druid using "/who druid" ( Sow is a level 14 spell), as having SoW will about double your rate of experience gain while doing this quest. (If there is any, offer to meet them or donate for Sow at the "PoD Lift")
Walkthrough
Video Guide: https://youtu.be/YtDvKTydd28
This quest is doable by any of the good races, starting at level 1.
Head to Felwithe in the South East corner of Greater Faydark.

You can follow the path from Kelethin if you started there. You will go around some corners, do not turn at any junctions you pass. Eventually the path stops in a T intersection. Turn left at this T intersection and you should see the front gate of Felwithe loading in immediately in front of you. (Felwithe Entrance loc: -1980, -2308)

Inside the city, head across the bridge and into the tunnel on the right. Just through this tunnel, you will see Tascar Tissleplay standing to the left of the Entrance to Faydark's Bane. (Number 7 on the Felwithe Map)
Hail Tascar and say
what mail
followed by
I am interested
and then
I will deliver to Kelethin
(On all subsequent trips back to Tascar you can simply target him and say "i will deliver to Kelethin" to receive a new letter.)
Once you have the letter it is time to head to Kelethin.

After Leaving Felwithe veer right, across the grass, and follow the path back to Kelethin. (Do not turn at the junction you pass) After some turns, the path ends at the 1st lift of Kelethin (loc 52, -148) Take the lift up, then take the bridge to the right to the next platform. From this platform there will be a bridge on the left leading to the Bard's Guildhall. Inside the guildhall, in the first room on the right will be Jakum Webdancer. (Bards guild is number 14 on the Kelethin Map)
Hand the letter to him to receive XP and a random amount of gold, 1-16 pieces.
You will also Receive the following Faction Changes:
League of Antonican Bards got Better +5
Guards of Qeynos got Better +1
Knights of Truth got Better +1
Ring of Scale got Worse -1
Mayong Mistmoore got Worse -1
After the turn in, take the lift you took up into the city back down. The path makes a right turn, just past the lift and your on your way back to Felwithe!
Other Information:
1) One run from Tascar to the bard's guild and back to Tascar, on the path:
Without Sow: 7.5min
With Sow: 4.5 min

2) It is best to sick to the path if you don't know the way (Sense Heading anyone?), and keep your eyes on the road, as the aggressive orcs and black wolves can be lethal at these levels. Times will vary based on load time at Felwithe and how much of the path you need to follow.

3) From Felwithe to Kelethin you can run straight north west across the zone and to the newbie lift. From The Bard guild in Kelethin, back to Felwithe, its harder to tell what direction you are facing, and thus the path becomes the fastest route.
4) You can make a social Macro that is "/say i will deliver to Kelethin" and put it on your hot bar to prevent misspellings and speed up the process.
5) At level 5 (wood elf druid) the quest turn in gives 1/2 a yellow per completion.
Nektulos Forest to North Freeport:

Classes with gate can repeat this quest fairly quickly, especially after obtaining SoW and Clarity from the nearby EC tunnel entrance. As a human enchanter with the default bind point in East Freeport, one quest loop took a hair over three minutes. This loop used two gate casts: One after each NPC interaction. A bit more time could be saved if one were to get a bind inside the bard guild. Clarity is important because untwinked characters will likely run out of mana, especially using the two-gate loop.
At level 9, this was a safe and reliable source of experience, though not spectacular.
--Trappindotcom (talk) 08:06, 5 April 2016 (UTC)

quests.name: Beguile Plants Quest
steps: This quest can be done at a bare minimum with one partner at level 29, or solo at level 34 ... if you are skilled/lucky enough. However, the mobs are level 32+, and many are casters (which can be difficult to solo), so having more people or being higher level is recommended. Keep in mind though that the spell is only useful for a limited range of levels, so don't wait too long to get it or it won't be of any use to you.
This spell was added with EQ's first expansion Ruins of Kunark, and therefore the entire quest is done in Kunark. The zones involved zones are circled in red on the map above.
Step 1:
Go to Lake of Ill Omen and head to the Sarnak Fort at -2000, +2000. Any sarnak can spawn A Sarnak revealer, thats who you need to kill for Farsight Crystal.

NOTE - Sarnak Fort is a heavily camped location. It is very likely one of these Crystals is rotting on a corpse near one of the groups. Do a camp check, and if anyone is at the Sarnak fort ask them if you could sit nearby and loot a Crystal if one drops. It has no other use than this quest, so chances are they will have no problem with you grabbing it.
Step 2:

Go to either of the marked spots on the map in Frontier Mountains. Kill Sarnaks until A sarnak partisan Spawns. Kill the Partisans for Pouch of Dust. It does not drop every time, so keep killing them until you get it. Be aware that Sarnak Partisans cast blind. One has enough mana to cast it 5-6 times.
EDIT: The position marked as 1 (on map) DOES NOT spawn the "a sarnak partisan" at all. The other spot with no number is the correct one.
EDIT 2: another location to get the Pouch of Dust is a static spawn just north of the Overthere Outpost. Other sarknak types can also spawn there, but I confirm I got a Pouch of Dust from that mob.
Step 3:
Go to Firiona Vie and kill Froglok Tsu Shamans for Tsu Shaman Powder drop.
Step 4:
Go to Kaesora, Droga or Nurga and kill strathbone spiders for Strathbone Silk.

Tip: Take the first left from the entrance of Kaesora and go into the hole there. There is a door on the other side of the hall. Hop over the pit and wait for roamers to come by. Be aware that the spiders are casters.
Step 5:
Find Shrub Marwood in the eastern hideout of the Firiona Vie outpost.

Turn these four items in to Shrub Marwood and receive "Fertile Crop." Scribe this spell into your spellbook and its name will change to Beguile Plants. NOTE: the scroll is no drop so can't be traded or sold.

quests.name: Blackburrow Brewers
steps: After you turn in Gnasher's head to Larsk Juton, he will sometimes say that he requires your services to [assist in the extermination of the gnoll brewers]. Note: You do not have to complete Gnasher's Head turn in to begin this quest. You say, 'I will assist in the extermination of the gnoll brewers.'

Larsk Juton says, 'Within the bowels of Blackburrow, our scouts have reported seeing the gnoll brewers. You will go and brave the lair of the dogs and slay these brewers in order to cease the flow of Blackburrow Stout. During your mission, should you find any Blackburrow casks, you must return them to me. When you have recovered three of these casks, I shall award you the [Cloak of Jaggedpine].'
You say, 'What is the Cloak of Jaggedpine?'

Larsk Juton says, 'The Cloak of Jaggedpine was made for those loyal to the ways of the forest. It is enchanted to increase one's dexterity. It is awarded to those who have aided in our cause to rid the land of those vile dogs called the Sabertooths. Should you earn one, be sure to hold onto it- you never know when we may alter the enchantments placed upon the cloak.'

You can find Blackburrow Cask on a gnoll brewer or Master Brewer on level three of Blackburrow. The Master Brewer spawns within the barrels next to the water underneath the Gnoll Sharpshooter ledge. The spawn time is fast (~5-10 minutes) and the Master Brewer always spawns. The brewer spawns next to the Master Brewer. The cask is a very rare drop from the gnoll brewer, but a guaranteed drop from the Master Brewer.
Upon turning in your third Blackburrow Cask...

Larsk Juton says, 'You have done well and served the people of the forest through this brave and noble deed. I now bestow upon you our friendship and reward you with the Cloak of Jaggedpine. Wear it as a mark of your allegiance.'

quests.name: Blackburrow Stout Delivery
steps: Note: Warmly faction required.
No Faction Hit Option:

Talk to Commander Kane at the Shrine of Bertoxxulus in Qeynos Aqueducts and he will ask you to deliver Blackburrow Stout (NO DROP version) to Barn Bloodstone who is located outside the Golden Rooster in Highpass. If Commander Kane doesn't talk to you at first, just Hail him and say, "The disease is spreading." Your faction with Barn needs to be at least indifferent. To raise it you can do the Note for Janam and/or Note for Rebby quests in the East Freeport.
Faction Hit Option:
If you don't care about faction you can kill Mutt Rootlit, who stands next to Barn Bloodstone, and she will drop the Bayle List I.
Doing this will give a serious faction hit for

quests.name: Blackburrow Stout Quest
steps: Find Rueppy Kutpurse at (-86.66, -204.61, 2.19) in Rivervale, in the back on the ground floor of the Fool's Gold.
Lead-In
You say, 'Hail, Rueppy Kutpurse'
You say, 'what drink?'

Unfortunately, Short Beer is not sold in Rivervale (it is sold in Runnyeye so that should be a hint as to the character of this lady in case her name wasn't enough). Visit Burtle Barrelbelly upstairs for the ingredients and make one, then give it to Rueppy Kutpurse.
You say, 'what blackburrow stout?'
You say, 'I can smuggle'
Main Quest
You have to go to the ruins on the other side of the great wall in Misty Thicket, find Gunrich, and tell him that "Dark Rivers Flow East":
The ruins are the undead hill just past the tunnel, to the north.
You say, 'Dark Rivers Flow East'
He gives you a Case of Blackburrow Stout. Take the case back to Rueppy Kutpurse and give it to her:
You receive 4 silver, 4 copper pieces.

quests.name: Blackburrow Stout Shipment
steps: Inside Fish's Ale:
Your Location is -243.82, -261.48, 3.28
You say, 'Hail, McNeal Jocub'
You say, 'Running low on what?'
You say, 'I will pick up the shipment.'
You receive "A tattered note" (identifies as "To Branick"). It reads:
Branick Notai Here is the lackey I sent to retrieve this month's shipment. I have informed The Circle of your needs and they will provide you with them at a later date. McJ
Gnasher Furgutt sometimes wanders around the Qeynos Hills (/loc?).
You say, 'Hail, Gnasher Furgutt'
Give Gnasher the note.
You receive a Case of Blackburrow Stout (NO TRADE version). Bring it back to McNeal Jocub.
You receive 3 silver, 12 copper pieces from McNeal Jocub.

quests.name: Bladed Weapons
steps: Requires amiably faction or better.
The Heartwood Master is located at -637, 213, 77 in the Soldiers of Tunare (Druid) Guild Hall.
You say, 'Hail, Heartwood Master'
You say, 'What errands'
Hand The Heartwood Master a Rusty Short Sword, Rusty Long Sword, Rusty Broad Sword, and Rusty Bastard Sword.
You receive 6 gold pieces.

quests.name: Blank Scrolls
steps: Kazlo Naedra patrols South Qeynos from Wrin Liltin near the Mermaid's Lure, to the area outside the warrior guild, to the area by Fish's Ale.
You say, 'Hail, Kazlo Naedra'
You say, 'What supplies?'
You say, 'What blank scroll sheets?'
You can purchase Blank Scroll Sheets from Sequea Erthinon in the Jaggedpine Treefolk store in Surefall Glades.
(You can also purchase the sheets from Den Magason in South Qeynos for 2gp.)
Your Location is -154.95, -292.89, 3.14
Sequea Erthinon tells you, 'That'll be 1 silver 5 copper for the Blank Scroll Sheets.'
Give the sheets to Kazlo.
You receive 1 silver 5 copper from Kazlo Naedra.
You can get the same faction hits with the following mini-quest:
You say, 'Hail, Den Magason'
You say, 'What shipments?'
You say, 'Who is Rohand?'
You say, 'What merchants?'
You say, 'What is Odus?'
If you hang out near Den long enough he will whisper to you that he is selling Blank scrolls for 2gp each.
Give him 2 gold.

quests.name: Blessed Oil
steps: Brother Estle may be found in Western Karana on the road as you enter the plains from the Qeynos Hills.
You say, 'Hail, Brother Estle'
You say, 'What Prime Healer?'
You say, 'What mass?'
You say, 'What blessed oil?'
You say, 'What is the Temple of Life?'
Now journey to North Qeynos and find the Temple of Life (looks like a flying saucer hovering above a pond). Priestess Jahnda is inside.
You say, 'Hail, Priestess Jahnda'
You say, 'Brother Estle needs the blessed oil.'
Nomsoe Jusagta is standing outside against the wall. Saying what Priestess Jahnda told you to say doesn't get you anywhere, but following his quest dialogue does:
You say, 'Hail, Nomsoe Jusagta'
You say, 'I am a new disciple of life.'
You say, 'I will deliver a flask.'
You receive a Blessed Oil Flask, which identifies as "Blessed Oil of Life." Take this back to Brother Estle.
You receive 1 silver from Brother Estle.
You receive PrayerBeads (no space in name), which identifies as "Hayle's Prayer Beads." Take the beads back to Jahnda.

You receive a Temple Summons, which identifies as "Summons For Hayle." The text of the summons is, "Brother Hayle, I command your presence in the Temple of Life. Abandon all current missions and return at once. This is the will of the Prime Healer. Priestess Jahnda."
You say, 'Who is Hayle Mool?'
Priestess Jahnda doesn't respond to either phrase, so head over to Splitpaw Lair and find Brother Hayle in the jail there. Give him the summons.
You receive a key named T.O.L. 2020, which identifies as "Strongbox Key 2020." Hayle despawns and immediately respawns.
Return to North Qeynos and find the temple shop. You'll have to wait until daytime to find Tyokan Mekase. At night, Whysia Flock takes his place.
You say, 'Hail, Whysia Flock'
You say, 'What scroll strongbox?'
You say, 'Who is Tyokan?'
Once Tyokan is up, hail him.
You say, 'Hail, Tyokan Mekase'
You say, 'What scroll strongboxes?'
He doesn't respond to any text involving "Whysia," so give him the key.
The reward is a random cleric spell.
