quests.name: Blizzent's Fang Quest
steps: Head to the Iceshard house in Kael and speak to Reivaj. You must be Amiable to him before he will give you the quest/reward.
Note: Dialogue is reported broken as of December 2014.
You say, 'Hail, Reivaj the Battlerager'
You say, 'I am here with a purpose.'
You say, 'What is a battlerager?'
You say, 'I worship Rallos Zek'
You say, 'What is the great warlord's plan?'
You say, 'Who is Blizzent?'

The wurm Reivaj speaks of is Blizzent, a 45th level wurm in the Great Divide. It wanders in the Southern portion of the Great Divide, near the Young shard wurms and the Coldain Miner Cave. It's the Valley south of the Giant Fort. Find it and kill it, and loot Blizzent's Fang.
Hand the Fang in to Reivaj:
He does not give any dialogue but gives the Vehement Sword of Reivaj as a reward

quests.name: Blood Ink
steps: War Historian Kobl in the Warrior guild.
'Hail, War Historian Kobl'
He gives this info when hailed:
When asked about unique writing materials he says:
On blood ink:
Need all dialogues (these are badly copied transcriptions), current faction hits, quest mobs and their /locs, quest items, rewards if any.

quests.name: Bloodboil Quest
steps: This quest is no longer active.
You say, 'Hail Talisyn Stormwing'
You say, 'What about your inhospitable mood?'
You say, 'What about the mutilation and corruption?'
You say, 'What about the greater evil?'
You say, 'What furthered the corruption?'
You say, 'What about the beings that were closest to Tunare's grace?'
You say, 'What is the greatest loss?'
You say, 'what about these tasks?'
You say, 'I will assist you'
You say, 'I am sure'
You say, 'What about the frightlings?'
You say, 'What about the undead sprites?'

Talisyn wants you to obtain a wing dropped by an undead sprite named Bloodboil. Bloodboil spawns in the middle of the mushrooms. The wing is an uncommon drop. If you bring back the wing, you will get your reward.

quests.name: Blurred Map Quest
steps: This quest follows Kobold Killing, given by Tabure Ahendle, located at 65, -507, 5 in the South Qeynos Steel Warriors Arena. You must have Amiable faction to complete this quest.
You say, 'What dangerous task'
Hand Tabure Ahendle a Blurred Map; randomly looted from a zombie sailor in Erud's Crossing.

Tabure Ahendle says, 'The map!! It is all blurred. The ink has run. I shall never be able to decipher it now. Still, I owe you for completion of your mission. May these be of assistance. It is always good for a warrior to be well supplied.'
You receive 10 silver pieces.

quests.name: Blyle Bundin's Head
steps: Hogunk Ventille is located at 142, 306, 4 in the spectator stands of the Kaladim Warrior's Guild arena.
You say, 'Hail, Hogunk Ventille'
You say, 'I am a warrior of the Stormguard'

Blyle Bundin paths between four locations in the Butcherblock Mountains: 1272, 2039, 0 near the entrance to the Butcherblock docks, 17, 2441, 0 near the guardpost he abandoned, 115, 1765, 0 overlooking the dwarven bandit camp where Peg Leg resides, and 120, 2042, 0 halfway between the guardpost and bandit camp.
Loot Blyle Bundin's corpse for his head and rusty "Stormguard" axe.
Return to Hogunk Ventille and hand him the Dwarf Head and Rusty Axe.
You receive 6 gold pieces.

quests.name: Bone Chips (Kaladim)
steps: Gunlok Jure is located at 1315, 158, 39 in the Paladin guild. You must have Indifferent faction to complete this quest.
You say, 'Hail, Gunlok Jure'
You say, 'I have the courage to battle the undead'
Hand Gunlok Jure 4 Bone Chips, unstacked.
You receive 15 silver, 6 copper pieces.

quests.name: Bone Chips Felwithe
steps: Yeolarn Bronzeleaf is located at 13, -434, 0 in the Cleric Guild.
You say, 'Hail Yeolarn Bronzeleaf'
You say, 'I will help protect the Mother'
Hand Yeolarn Bronzeleaf 4 Bone Chips, unstacked.

quests.name: Bone Chips Field of Bone
steps: Trooper Mozo can be found at -2555, +3565, guarding the zone-in to East Cabilis.
You say, 'Hail, Trooper Mozo'
You say, 'I can kill the decaying skeletons.'
Hand in four Bone Chips, unstacked.
You receive ~7 silver from Trooper Mozo.

quests.name: Bone Chips Grobb
steps: Indifferent is too low for this quest
Hukulk is in the Shadowknight guild in Grobb.
You say, 'Hail, Hukulk'
You say, 'I want join Nightkeep'
Hand in four Bone Chips.
Level 1 - 8%
Level 2 - 1-2%
Level 3 -
(Negligible) (1% @ Level 4)
You receive a Rusty Two Handed Sword.

quests.name: Bone Chips Qeynos
steps: Note that you can do both the Bone Chips and 2GP quests at dubious, confirmed as of April 2024.
Lashun Novashine can be found in North Qeynos wandering from the temple to the front gate, and back. One location at which he stops is -158, -350.
You say, 'Hail, Lashun Novashine'
Turn in two Bone Chips.
About 0.5% at level 4.
Lashun Novashine begins to cast a spell. You feel a little better. You have been healed for 14 points.
Hand Lashun Novashine 2 Gold. (Depending on his inventory of personal gold, copper pieces may work at times)

quests.name: Bone Granite Powder Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Jondin'
You say, 'What is the simple mission?'
You say, 'I will gather bone chips.'
Combine 1x Pile of Granite Pebbles, 2x Bone Chips, and 1x Forging Hammer in a Forge (Trivial: 21) to produce 1x Bone Granite Powder.
Note that the Bone Granite Powder is Lore, and so if you create a 2nd, you will simply get a failure message.
Give 1x Bone Granite Powder to Jondin.
Note: Gained 13% experience as a level 5 Iksar Shaman.

quests.name: Bonethunder Staff Quest
steps: Runethar Hamest in the Temple of Thunder is investigating corruption among the guards of Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Runethar Hamest'
You say, 'I am already a follower of Karana'
You say, 'I wish to assist Lord Bayle'
You say, 'I will retrieve the Bayle list'
You can find Frenway Marthank in Surefall.
You say, 'Hail, Frenway Marthank'
You say, 'What bad news?'

If you can find and slay Mammoth, you will get the Bayle List II. If you do not want to kill the bear, you can give Mammoth the Regurgitonic (which can be obtained from The Regurgitonic quest) and he will cough the list up for you.
You can return Mammoth's Hide to Frenway to get back faction lost slaying Mammoth.
Take the Thunder_Staff (from Drosco the Zombie (good)) and the Bayle List II back to Runethar Hamest.
You receive Bonethunder Staff!

quests.name: Book of Turmoil Quest
steps: Find Lokar To`Biath in the library of the 3rd Gate at +895, -1245.
At the end of the quest "Bottle of Red Wine"...
You say, 'who is innoruuk?'
You say, 'what vow?'
Hand 70gp to Lokar.
You receive a Note. It is written in Teir'dal and says...
Rysva, I urge you to break your vow of silence and renounce the dead D'al! Join those who follow Innoruuk, and do his will!
Innoruuk shall crush those who do not follow him, but if you aid this person and give him that which he seeks, I am sure you will be forgiven and might then join me!
- your brother, Lokar
Rysva To'Biath is a female barkeep in the Blind Fish Tavern in Neriak Commons. Give her the note from her brother.
She gives you another Note, also written in Teir'dal, that says..
I will not break my vow of silence, so I give you this note that you might read it.
I will give you that which you seek, the Book of Turmoil, but first you must slay my brother, for he has revealed who I truly am.
I will never follow Innoruuk, and am forever a Scribe of D'al. Bring me the head of my brother and return to me this note.
In return, I shall give you the book of Turmoil, one of the books in the Tome of Ages.
If you need any other of these books restored, I will do so for 1000 platinum
She wishes you to return to Lokar and slay him.
You have slain Lokar To`Biath!
Loot Dark Elf Decapitated Head. Hand the Head and the Note to Rysva.
You receive Book of Turmoil, one of the books in the Tome of Ages.
The Oracle of K`Arnon is searching for this book.
The Oracle may be found on top of a mountain at -15, -6730, -200 in the Ocean of Tears.
You say, 'Hail, Oracle of K`Arnon'
You say, 'What about knowledge?'
You say, 'What do you seek?'
You say, 'What is the Tome of Ages?'
You say, 'What about the Dal?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Ages?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Turmoil?'
You receive a Glowing Torch.

quests.name: Bottle of Red Wine
steps: Must be Apprehensive to Dark Bargainers
Find Lokar To`Biath in the library of the 3rd Gate at +895, -1245. Responded to hails as an indifferent agnostic DE enchanter.
You say, 'Hail, Lokar To`Biath.'
You say, 'Are you a Scribe of Dal?'
You say, 'Why are they Dead?'
Give him a Red Wine (up to 4 unstacked). It can be from anywhere, not just the Blind Fish. The nearest bar might be the Cuisine Excelsior, which is also conveniently devoid of hostile patrons.

Note: This is one of the best quests to gain faction with the Dark Bargainers (Neriak Residents) and with Dreadguard Outer and Dreadguard Inner as it boosts the factions without giving you faction loss with anyone else. 151 turn-ins will take an Iksar Necromancer or Shadow Knight from scowling to dubious with the Neriak guards. It took between 401 and 460 turn-ins to get an Iksar Monk to dubious, without any other faction work.

quests.name: Boysenberry Pie Quest
steps: This quest was mentioned when they posted about info for broken quests on the [http://boards.station.sony.com/ubb/everquest/Forum1/HTML/000358.html Developers Boards]. Absor said that the quest had never been implemented and the NPCs hadn't said anything about pie for a LONG time. They later realised some versions of the NPCs still did say something, so now they have removed the references.
You say, 'Hail Sentry Emil'
You say, 'I wish to prove them."
Head down to the kitchen.
You say, 'Hail Grudash the Baker'
You say, 'I would like a boysenberry pie.'
You say, 'hail Ruru the Cook'

quests.name: Bozinite Pestle Quest
steps: Speak with Larkon Theardor:
Larkon Theardor is at location 1032.02, -974.80 in Ak'Anon.
After completing the Minotaur Horns quest You are supposed to be able to pick up at this final statement from Larkon Theardor
You say, 'I will go to Kaladim'

Larkon Theardor says 'We need someone to venture to the dwarven kingdom of Kaladim and speak with Myre of Miner's Guild 628. She has a delivery of special pestles made from bozinite. If you feel up to it, go to her and tell her you are from the Eldritch Collective and desire the bozinite pestles. Return them to me.'
Go to North Kaladim to Speak with Myre:
Go to find Myre. She is at location 565.09, 218.12 in North Kaladim.
You say, 'Hail, Myre'
Myre says 'I am not here to chitchat dear. If you need some gear, I can help. If you want to talk, go find a tavern.'
You say, 'I am from the Eldritch Collective and desire the bozinite pestles.'

Myre says 'So you came to get the bozinite pestles, eh? Well, dearie, we have no bozinite pestles. We don't have enough bozinite to spare. One of those wondrous clockwork creatures from Ak'Anon has gone and found a home amongst us dwarves. He is sucking up what little bozinite we have mined. You go and find that little bugger and bring me some of the bozinite he slurped up and I will make you one bozinite pestle. Good luck. He is one quick hunk of metal.'
Go Kill Cleaner VII:

Cleaner VII spawns in North Kaladim on the mining bridge at 762.16, 294.86. Cleaner VII has several rat placeholders and has about a 10% chance of spawning. It is on a six minute spawn cycle so keep killing placeholders until Cleaner VII spawns, then kill, kill, kill. Set up at 762.58, 395.85 to be able to be positioned to easily pick them off. Cleaner VII does not always drop the pestle. He will also drop scrap metal, and blackbox fragment for other quests.
When you kill Cleaner VII
Cleaner VII says 'Wizzzz... Click. Tick...' You have slain Cleaner VII!
You have looted a Bozinite Pestle
Even though Myre asked for the bozinite, she will not accept it. Hand the Bozinite Pestle to Larkon Theardor back in Ak'Anon.
Take the Bozinite Pestle to Larkon Theardor in Ak'Anon:
Return to Ak'Anon
Upon turn in of the Bozinite Pestle to Larkon Theardor

Larkon Theardor says 'The Eldritch Collective thanks you. You have done a great service. We need these special bozinite pestles for use with our eldritch mortars. Here is a scroll from our library. Study it and use it wisely.'
Receive Coin; faction Eldritch Collective positive, Gem Choppers positive, King Ak'Anon positive, Dark Reflection negative, The Dead negative; XP; and a random mage spell

quests.name: Bracers of Erollisi Quest
steps: Styria Fearnon walks around the top of the hill next to the dock on the island with the Sisters of Erollisi.
You say, 'Hail, Styria Fearnon'
You say, 'Who are the Pirates of Gunthak?'
You say, 'I will hunt the pirates!'
Capt Surestout is on the Isle of the Seafoam Cyclops, two islands to the west.
Give the Bracers of Erollisi to Styria Fearnon.

quests.name: Brain Bite (Evil)
steps: Dyth X`Teria (+3138, +2253) resides in The Overthere. He is in the separate building to the North, in the OT outpost. Give him a Peridot, an Onyx and a Star Rose Quartz. In exchange, you will receive three bottles of entrapment. They each look like a royal jelly jar and must be identified to figure out which is which. They identify as Hampton, Mardon and Ryla. Each needs to be given to a particular version of a human skeleton to receive a Bottle of Swirling Smoke. Return to Dyth X`Teria and hand him the three bottles of smoke to receive the spell Brain Bite.

quests.name: Brain Bite (Good)
steps: Despondo resides in Firiona Vie.
You say, 'Hail, Despondo'
You say, 'Whats wrong?'
You say, 'I will rescue their souls.'
You say, 'Where are the three bottles of entrapment?'
You say, 'What is Brain Bite?'

Give him a Peridot, an Onyx and a Star Rose Quartz one at a time. In exchange, you will receive three bottles of entrapment. They each look like a royal jelly jar and must be identified to figure out which is which. They identify as Hampton (Onyx), Ryla (Star Rose Quartz), and Mardon (Peridot).
Each needs to be given to a particular version of a human skeleton to receive a Bottle of Swirling Smoke.

Hampton, a human skeleton, is located along the zone wall of Trakanon's Teeth location . Hand him the correct bottle to receive a Bottle of Swirling Smoke, which identifies as Hampton's Soul. He is friendly and you can do this hand-in by yourself.

Ryla, a human skeleton, is located in a jail cell in Karnor's Castle just south of the "hand" room. Loc is . Give the correct bottle to the skeleton to receive a Bottle of Swirling Smoke, which identifies as Ryla's Soul. He is KoS and you will need an enchanter or necromancer to charm him before you can do the turn-in.

Mardon, a human skeleton, is located in the City of Mist at location . Give the correct bottle to the skeleton to receive a Bottle of Swirling Smoke, which identifies as Mardon's Soul. He is KoS and you will need an enchanter or necromancer to charm him before you can do the turn-in.
Return to Despondo and hand him the three bottles to receive the spell Brain Bite.

quests.name: Brell Serilis Symbol Quests
steps: Initiate Symbol of Brell Serilis:
Bronlor Lightblade is located at -88, 416, 3 in a back room within the Kaladim Warrior's Guild Hall.
You say, 'Hail, Bronlor Lightblade'
You say, 'I am a priest'
You say, 'What green rascals'
You say, 'I will help slay the goblins'

Now head out to ButcherBlock and find location -300, +1100. This is a cove between the goblin warrior camp and the yellow skeleton tower near the Crossroads region. Three enraged goblins spawn there. They always drop an Enraged Goblin Beads and appear to be on the same spawn timer as everything else in the zone. and are on a 15 minute respawn timer.
Hand Bronlor Lightblade 4 Enraged Goblin Beads.
You receive an Initiate Symbol of Brell Serilis.
Disciple Symbol of Brell Serilis:
After completing the Initiate Symbol of Brell quest:
You say, 'What about my next task?'
You say, 'I will deliver the note.'
You receive a Note to Taldrik.
You say, 'What drinks?'
Gather the following drinks, all of which can be purchased in East Freeport:
Elven Wine and Dwarven ale, from Gregor Nasin at Seafarer's Roost
Freeport stout, from Jaleel Hoglomp at Grub n Grog Tavern
Travel to the Oasis of Marr where Taldrik can be found in the very southwest part of the zone (-1788, 1346).
You say, 'Hail, Taldrik Stumpystout'
Give him the Freeport Stout, Elven Wine, Dwarven Ale, and the Note to Taldrik.
You say, 'What recipe?'
You say, 'I will seek out the components.'
You say, 'What specific kind of cask?'
You receive a Holy Cask.
As instructed, procure the following:
Preserved hops, dropped from an undead barkeep and An Undead Brewer in Unrest
Battleworn canteen, dropped from Torklar Battlemaster in Unrest
Forest Barley, purchased from Clomen Walker in Kithicor Forest
Summoned: Globe of Water, from the Summon Drink spell

Combine the above items in the Holy Cask to craft a Keg of Brells Blessed Stout. Return to Taldrik and give him the Keg, a Rat Sandwich (Baking, Trivial: 26), and your Initiate Symbol of Brell Serilis.
You receive a Disciple Symbol of Brell Serilis.

quests.name: Broken Lute
steps: Cassius Messus may be found in the bard guild (520, -140).
You say, 'Hail, Cassius Messus'
You say, 'Who is Lisera?'
You say, 'I am interested in the job.'
You receive Lisera Lute.
Head to South Karana and find Vhalen Nostrolo at -60, -120. Give him the lute.
You receive a Note to Cassius, which reads:
Cassius, Sorry for the mishap. I shall repair and tune your lute and return it to you when I return to Qeynos in a week. Valen Nostrolo
Give the note to Cassius Messus.
You receive 3 copper from Cassius Messus.
You receive 6 silver from Cassius Messus.
You receive 6 gold from Cassius Messus.
You receive Song: Hymn of Restoration.

quests.name: Broom Of Trilon Quest
steps: Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85.
You say, 'Hail, Vira'
You say, 'What is elemental summoning?'
You say, 'What of the Broom of Trilon?'
You say, 'I am interested in the broom.'
She wants the following four items:
A Star Ruby may be purchased from a jewelry merchant
Griffon Feathers drop from various griffins around the world.
A Broom (identifies as "Broom of Air") drops from magicians in Najena or alligators in Cazic_Thule_(Zone) or Lake Rathetear.
Cyclops Toes drop from various cyclops around the world.
Hand in all four items
You receive the Broom of Trilon.

quests.name: Brother Trintle (Quest)
steps: Tell Suuspa Clanim in the Temple of Life in North Qeynos about Brother Trintle attacking Brother Estle and she is shocked and expresses the thought that Trintle must have been swayed by the words of Bertoxxulous.
You Say: Brother Trintle Attacked Brother Estle.
If you kill Brother Trintle in West Karanas you discover that indeed he is now a follower of Bertoxxulous.
Turn in Busted Prayer Beads to Suuspa
She is referring to her Rat Shaped Rings quest.
You receive 7 copper pieces.

quests.name: Bug Collection
steps: Blixkin Entopop roams the inside of the wall and has an unusual hobby. He collects bug parts, and you are just the halfling to help him out. Hail him to make him stop walking, then say the following:
You Say 'Hail, Blixkin Entopop'
You say, 'I don't have a bug collection box'
The six bug parts for this quest are:
1. Spiderling Eye
2. Spiderling Silk
3. Fire Beetle Eye
4. Giant Scarab Egg Sack
5. Giant Fire Beetle Leg
6. Giant Wasp Wing

After collecting the items, hit combine and give the box back to him, along with the list he gave you, for your reward. Make sure to hand them both in at the same time or he won't give you a reward or experience. I forgot to ask for a list, handed him the box and he ate it. I then asked for a list and handed it to him and still got nothing.

quests.name: Bugglegupp (Quest)
steps: Tergon Brenclog is located at 1082, -1034, 31 in a room on the east side of the Library Mechanamagica. This quest requires at least amiable faction.
You say, 'Hail, Tergon Brenclog'
If you say, 'I am too superior'
You say, 'I will help Tergon'
Upon the death of Bugglegupp
Loot an Iron Pellet from the corpse of Bugglegupp and return it to Tergon Brenclog.

quests.name: Bulthar Trunks
steps: This quest begins at Chief Kalan in Cobalt Scar (location -330, -1218 on the beach just north by northwest of the druid portal). You must be at least indifferent for the reward. At apprehensive, he will respond to quest dialogue but eat the trunks.
You say, 'Hail, Chief Kalan'
You say, 'I will aid the warriors defending the beaches?'
You say, 'Who are the bulthar?'
For turning in 2 x regular Bulthar Trunk (no special identification):
You receive a random trinket or gem.
For turning in 1 x Special Bulthar Trunk (identifies as "Herd Leaders Trunk"), dropped by the occasionally spawning a bulthar herdleader:
You receive a Runed Othmir Spear.

quests.name: Burnished Wooden Staff Quest
steps: Can be performed at apprehensive faction, as of 2022-05-12.
Ssolet Dnaas may be found at +4015, +390 on a small island in Warsliks Woods. He is aggro to non-Iksar, so you may have to charm him to do this.
You say, 'Hail, Ssolet Dnaas'
You say, 'What search?'
A Burnished Wooden Stave is a random drop from sarnak mobs (reanimated mobs, after the revamp) in Chardok. Give one to Ssolet.
--You receive a Piece of a medallion .--

quests.name: Burynai Bundt Cake
steps: Ask Glinya Sweetpie about Treekill.
Ask her 'what is a burynai bunt cake'
Ask Treekill about the cake and he is, quite obviously very anxious to get his hands on one to win the ladies hand.
He promises to reward you with a helm he got from a bard if you bring him a "Burynai Bunt Cake" (may be foraged?).
It has been confirmed that this is not a quest at this time, but is simply a storyline. Thus, there is no reward available.
Need all dialogues, /loc of quest mobs.

quests.name: Bvellos' Bounty
steps: Note that although it is possible to charm Bvellos, this will not yield you faction adjustments.
This quest begins with Captain Bvellos in Kael Drakkel (roams from the arena to the bank to the palace area). Captain Bvellos is on Kromzek faction.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Bvellos'
You say, 'I will keep Kael safe.'
You say, 'What about mercenaries?'

quests.name: Cabilis Pale Ale (Cabilis)
steps: In the Tink 'N Babble at night there is an NPC named Grype. He spawns in the same place as Clerk Doval. If you hail him, he'll just be finishing his ale. Go buy four Cabilis Pale Ales and give them to him.
You'll be rewarded with a loud burp and 1 copper (no faction or exp).
When you ask, "Who are the Blue Talons?"

quests.name: Cabilis Pale Ale (Firiona Vie)
steps: You say, 'Hail, Lenka Stoutheart'
Lenka Stoutheart sips on her ale, 'Look what we have here, Bronto! A would be hero!
Bronto Thudfoot puts his head over your head as if measuring you. 'Heh!! Going to have to grow up before the General lets him out to play in Kunark!'
You say,'I want to see something interesting.'

Lenka Stoutheart takes a jagged scimitar out of a wrap and lets you hold it. You feel as though it is linked to the spirit world. Lenka grabs it back. 'No, no! You cant keep it. But I can tell you there are plenty more weopons and armor like this. Just have to do a little dragon slaying.'
You say, 'What is Cabby Pale Ale?'

Bronto Thudfoot takes a bottle from his pack and shows you. 'This is Cabby Pale Ale. CPA for short or, as they say in lizardtown, Cabilis Pale Ale. I got it off a drunken dwarf. He said he bought it off a dark elf. Where he really got it, I am not sure.'
You say, 'What is lizardtown?'
You can buy this Ale from vendors in the Field of Bones, Cabilis and Neriak, but giving it to them does not get anything.
Lenka Stoutheart location: -2978.18, 3000.16, -77.65
Bronto Thudfoot location: -2953.36, 2996.79, -77.65

quests.name: Caduceus of Sacrament Quest
steps: Find Gavel the Temperant in the Temple of Solusek Ro.
He needs an Ingot and Icon of Sacrament and two Magnetized Platinum Bars. (give enchanted platinum to Ostorm for this).
The Icon of Sacrament is a ground spawn found in the jail in Mistmoore Castle (-68, 280)

The Ingot of Sacrament is dropped by a Giant Skeleton in the ruins in (#24 on map) Rathe Mountains (-600, -1600). This skeleton is a darker color than the ones that normally spawn at the ruins. No faction hits.
Need all dialogues, /loc of quest mobs, current faction hits if any.
Caduceus of Sacrament:
Caduceus of Sacrament
Turn the following in to Gavel the Temperant
2x Magnetized Platinum Bars. (give enchanted platinum to Ostorm for this)
Icon of Sacrament (ground spawn found in the jail in Mistmoore Castle (-68, 280))
Ingot of Sacrament

quests.name: Call of Flame Quest
steps: Find the Ashwood siblings in Greater Faydark.
You say, 'Hail, Devin Ashwood'
You say, 'Hail, Lily Ashwood'
You say, 'I am a ranger'
You say, 'Who is Ganelorn Oast?'
You say, 'How do I call upon the flames?'
You say, 'I want to learn'
You say, 'I will take him the letter' (If you are not a level 50+ Ranger, she says "I'm sorry, I don't trust you with such a task" and you cannot proceed with the quest)
Receive a sealed love letter. You'll now need to locate Ganelorn Oast in East Karana.
You say, 'Hail, Ganelorn Oast'
You say, 'Will you teach me the call of flames?'
Give Ganelorn Oast the sealed love letter.
Receive Albino Rattlesnake Eggs, which you'll need to take to the Ranger guildmaster in the forest named after himself, Kithicor.
Give Kithicor the Albino Rattlesnake Eggs:
Receive a Symbol of Achievement. Bring this symbol back to Ganelorn:
Receive a note of credit who you'll need to give to Aanina Rockfinder in North Kaladim.
Receive a Gift. Before heading back to East Karana, you'll need to collect a few items:
A Burnt Sash, from imp protectors in Nagafen's Lair
An Adamantite Band, from a reanimated hand in Lower Guk
An Electrum-Bladed Wakizashi, from the Vampire Teeth subquest
Bring these items and the gift back to Ganelorn: (You must turn them in all at once, you cannot MQ the pieces or turn them in individually)
Ganelorn speaks of Vance Bearstalker, who you'll need to track down and kill.
Loot a Poacher's Head and give it to Ganelorn:
Receive Spell: Call of Flame.

quests.name: Cannibalize II (Evil)
steps: Get Strange Ochre Clay off an army behemoth in City of Mist
Get Yun Shaman Powder from froglok yun shaman in Trakanon's Teeth
Get Greyish Bone Chips from skeletal warlord in Karnor's Castle
Get Crushed Diamonds as ground spawn at -8850, -6040 in Timorous Deep or see other method below
Give all four items to The Great Oowomp in Timorous Deep

quests.name: Cannibalize II (Good)
steps: Note that there is an identical quest for evil races: Cannibalize II (Evil).
You say, 'Hail Marlyn McMerin'
You say, 'What rare alchemy components?'
Marlyn McMerin wants the following:
1. Strange Ochre Clay. Comes from an army behemoth in the City of Mist - Called Strange Ochre Clay, and identifies as "Clay of Ghiosk."
2. Crushed Diamonds. There are two ways to get this.
The easy way: Ground spawn in the Timorous Deep on the Golra island at -8850, -6040; just use invisibility and levitation to walk on to the island and pick it up.

The hard way: Go get a dufrenite (you can buy this at several cities). In the Dreadlands, in the area with all the wizard spires, there is a MOB called gem cutter skeleton. He is inside one of the pyramids (there's an entrance on the ground), and is KOS to everyone. An Enchanter, Necro, or Bard is required to charm him so that you can hail him, and he talks about sparklies. Ask him "what dread diamond," and he offers to trade a dufrenite for one. Give him a dufrenite (while he's charmed) and he gives you a Dread Diamond (not crushed), and says how they are very valuable but more so in the cru…

3. Yun Shaman Powder. Come from a froglok yun shaman in Trakanon's Teeth. It is droppable, black and called Yun Shaman Powder. Identifies as "Powder of Yun.". It does not appear to drop in FV at all. A powder that looks similar but identifies differently drops in FV only. The real Yun Shaman is in Trakanons Teeth only and he is lev41 so make sure you are prepared for a tough fight.

4. Greyish Bone Chips. Bone chips from the bones of one who has touched the Bath of Obulus. These are called Greyish Bone Chips, and come from skeletal warlords (named mob) in Karnor's Castle. People will often let you loot these from their kill. They identify as "Obulus Bone Chips."
Return all 4 items to Marlyn.
You receive McMerin's Feast.

quests.name: Captain Nalot's Triple Strength Rum
steps: Locked Rum Box:
Collect two Barracuda Liver from a coldwater barracuda in Cobalt Scar.
Forage Fresh Tree Sap in Wakening Lands.
Give the Dissolving Liquid to the gnomish deserter in the Great Divide to get the locked case.
Rum Box Key:
Collect four Fresh Chunk of Wooly Rhino from A Wooly Rhino in Eastern Wastes.
Collect a High Quality Dire Wolf Fur from any Velious-found dire wolf.
Give Sojan both the chain and key in exchange for a Rum Box Key.
Rough Silver Chain:
Give both the Rum Box Key and Locked Rum Box to Captain Nalot for a bottle of Capt. Nalot's Triple Strength Rum.
Give the rum to Nelet Durzit at the docks for Rough Silver Chain.

quests.name: Captain Nealith's Brother
steps: During the Drolvarg Teeth quest, Captain Nealith mentions his siblings...
You say, 'What about your sibling?'
At +1510, -1395, there are two tents with a fixed spawn of three drolvargs. Keep clearing these drolvargs until a drolvarg scavenger spawns.
Kill it.
a drolvarg scavenger's corpse yips and falls to the ground. A tattered note appears to be tucked into his armor.
Loot a Bloodsoaked Note, which reads:
Dear, brother, I fear that my soul has been overtaken by a great evil. My sanity barely hangs on by a thread.
My dreams of the sweet red blood of others are soon to drive me mad. The howls in the night call to me.
It is best for me to leave. I pray that I can deliver this note before I go mad.
Please understand that it is better that I am never seen again.
Goodbye. Keep up the fight for the forest folk.
Give the note to Captain Nealith.
You receive some gold, and the Glaive of Marltek.

quests.name: Cat Courier
steps: Antus Shelbra can be found on the third floor of the Abattoir at (762, 829) in Paineel.
You say, 'Hail, Antus Shelbra'
You say, 'I am an experienced heretic.'
--You receive A Smelly Sealed Bag.--
Travel to Kerra Island to find Kirran Mirrah at location (389, -652) in the first hut to the left of the entrance. Placeholder is a kerran awrat and respawn time is ~18 minutes.
You say, 'Hail, Kirran Mirrah'
Hand Kirran the A Smelly Sealed Bag.
--You receive Karran's Head. Note that you receive it from the hand-in; you don't actually have to kill Kirran, even if he attacks you.--
Return to Antus and give him Karran's Head.
You receive 2 platinum, 8 silver, 2 copper pieces.

quests.name: Catfish Croak Sandwich Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Klok Foob'
You say, 'What is your munch break favorite?'

Klok Foob rubs his tummy. 'Oh!! Catfish croak sandwich is my favorite, it is. Can only eats on my break. I haves one and one is what the Haggle Baron says to Foob. Only thing is Foob gets way tired from standing. Foob needs some broodling to [fetch the catfish croak sandwich] for him.'
You say, 'I will fetch the catfish croak sandwich.'
You say, 'How do I make the sandwich?'
Klok Foob wants you to fetch him two sandwiches. In order to make these, you need Thin Sliced Froglok Meat, Shrub Lettuce, Honey Mush Bread, and Sewer Catfish.
To get the Thin Sliced Froglok Meat, talk to Klok Ephmir in East Cabilis.
You say, 'Hail, Klok Ephmir'
You say, 'I need thinly sliced froglok.'
You say, 'I can sharpen the dull cutting disk.'
You receive a Dull Cutting Disk. Combine it with a sharpening stone in a forge to create a Sharp Cutting Disk (trivial 26). Give the Sharp Cutting Disk to Klok Ephmir.
You receive 4 Thin Sliced Froglok Meat.
Next:
Shrub Lettuce is dropped off Man Eating Shrubs in Swamp of No Hope.
Honey Mush Bread can be purchased off Klok Bygle, a merchant in the left building when leaving Cabilis into the swamp.
Sewer Catfish are fishable in Cabilis and Firiona Vie.
The four items may be combined into a Catfish Croak Sandwich, and Klok Foob accepts the results.

quests.name: Catfish Tail
steps: Vynon Estaliun is at location -750, -120 in Erudin outside of the Peace Keeper guild.
You say, 'Hail, Vynon Estaliun'
You say, 'I desire to face fear.'
a catfisher wanders the east side of Kerra Island, west of the river.
Hand in Fishy Cat Tail to Vynon Estaliun.

quests.name: Catman Alliance
steps: Aderius Rhenar can be found in the prison area of The Warrens (270.79, -1110.29, -95.65).
You say, 'Hail, Aderius Rhenar'
You say, 'I am planning to return to Erudin'
You receive a Rolled Up Strip of Cloth. .
Bring the Rolled Up Strip of Cloth to Leraena Shelyrak in the Temple of Divine Light in Erudin (-649.03, -91.10, 67.10).
You say, 'Hail, Leraena Shelyrak'
Upon turn-in:
You receive 9 copper from Leraena Shelyrak.

quests.name: Cazic Thule Symbol Quests
steps: Initiate Symbol of Cazic Thule:
If you dare, approach Sern Adolia in the Tabernacle of Terror in Paineel.
You say, 'Hail, Sern Adolia'
You say, 'I seek the knowledge.'

Kill An undead rat in the Paineel newbie area or an infected rat in Toxxulia Forest to get four Infected Rat Livers. Pack rats are the placeholders for the undead rat. Infected rats can be commonly found along the beach in Toxxulia.
Upon handing a fourth liver to Sern:
You receive 5 silver, 8 copper pieces.
You receive Initiate Symbol of Cazic Thule.
The dialogue of this quest dovetails into The Summoning of Fright, though it is not technically required as a prerequisite.
Disciple Symbol of Cazic Thule:
Atdehim Sqonci is also located in the Tabernacle of Terror, across from Sern Adolia.
You say, 'Hail, Atdehim Sqonci'
You say, 'What rituals of fear?'
Turn in the following to Atdehim Sqonci:
A Kerran Doll (from A kerran awrat on Kerra Island;
alternatively, from Lomarc, a level 3 rogue in South Qeynos)
A Giant Snake Fang (from any large snake, commonly found in many starting zones)
An Initiate Symbol of Cazic Thule (from the previous symbol quest)
An ichor (from giant wooly spiders in Everfrost Peaks)
You receive Disciple Symbol of Cazic Thule.

quests.name: Chalice of Conquest Quest
steps: Checklist Items:
Soil of Underfoot
Foot of Candlestick
Stem of Candlestick
Candle of Bravery
Honeycomb
Klunga's Bracelet
Abandoned Orc Shovel
Blood Stained Note (Klunga's Blood)
Chalice of Conquest
Cape of Underfoot
Holy Partisan of Underfoot

quests.name: Cheslin's Illusion Cards
steps: Chesgard Sydwen may be found at -270, -500.
You say, 'Hail, Chesgard Sydwen'
You say, 'I am a visitor.'
You say, 'Who is Cheslin?'
Guard Cheslin may be found in a guard tower in the Qeynos Hills at +1035, -875. If he is not there, he is out on patrol and will be back shortly.
You say, 'Hail, Guard Cheslin'
You say, 'Your father sent me.'
Wait until you see:
He sets off on patrol. If a monster gets too close, you must keep him alive. Soon you will see:

Loot the Illusion card off the ground. Note: The cards he drops are random and he may not drop all four separately on a single escort. I had to escort Guard Cheslin twice, with most cards dropped being not lootable (lore, I already carried them) until at last he dropped fourth distinct card.
You say, 'You dropped an Illusion card.'
You say, 'Illusion?'
As he follows his patrol route, he drops four different cards: Chrono Cyclone, Diamond Vale, Ebon Lotus, and Library of Erudin. The locations are +1780, -170; +3400, -940; +4880, +640; +1070, -740.
Hand in one:
If you hand in all four:
You receive 2 gold from Guard Cheslin.
You receive A Sealed Letter (identifies as "Letter From Cheslin") which reads:
Dear Father, I thank you for your concerns, but I am fine. You endangered the life of this brave adventurer.
Luckily, I was there to keep him from harm's way. We Qeynos Guards are a strong lot. You have nothing to worry about.
Qeynos is safe as long as we, the Qeynos Guards, are on watch. All Hail Antonius Bayle!! - Guard Cheslin
Return this to Chesgard Sydwen.
You receive a piece of Raw Hide armor

quests.name: Cindl's Polar Bear Collection
steps: Can be done with dubious faction
Cindl may be found at +300, -160, inside Mac's Kilts.
You say, 'Hail, Cindl'
You say, 'What extra hides?'
Turn in a Polar Bear Skin:
Large Patchwork Boots
Large Patchwork Cloak
Large Patchwork Pants
Large Patchwork Sleeves
Large Patchwork Tunic
Large Raw-hide Leggings
Large Tattered Belt
Large Tattered Gloves
Large Tattered Gorget
Large Tattered Mask
Large Tattered Shoulderpads
Large Tattered Skullcap
Large Tattered Wristbands

quests.name: Cindl's Wristband Collection
steps: Find Cindl inside Mac's Kilts, at +300, -160. At the end of the previous quest, Cindl mentioned a [second job].
You say, 'What second job?'
Wrath Orc Wristbands drop from a snow orc trooper and a snow orc shaman in Everfrost Peaks. Hand in two.

quests.name: Circlet of Mist Quest
steps: A Globe of Mist (from A Festering Hag in The Estate of Unrest).
A Water Ring (from Aqua goblin tidal lord in Dagnor's Cauldron).
A Ring of Evoluoy ( from An alligator in Cazic Thule)
A Sapphire, bought from jewelry merchants for as little as 105pp.
Bring these items to Joyce for your Circlet of Mist.

quests.name: Clay Bracelet Quest
steps: Rune of Clay (Top) - From Findlegrob in Rathe Mountains
Rune of Clay (Right) - From Bindlegrob in Rathe Mountains
Rune of Clay (Left) - From Sindlegrob in Rathe Mountains
Rune of Clay (Bottom) - From A Goblin Headmaster in Ocean of Tears

quests.name: Cleaner Clockwork
steps: This quest immediately follows Rat Pelts given by Beno Targnarle, located at 84, 404, 15 in the north turret of the Kaladim Warrior's Guild.
You say, 'What metal rat'
Hand Beno Targnarle the Scrap Metal, looted from Cleaner VII, a clockwork rat that shares a spawn with a Giant Rat in the mines under the North Kaladim bank.

quests.name: Cleanse the Ocean
steps: Laoni Reista is located at -1109, -399, 51 on the first floor of the Deepwater Knights (Paladin) Guild Hall. This quest can be completed at Apprehensive faction.
You say, 'Hail, Laoni Reista'
You say, 'I am a new knight'
You say, 'I will assist with the cleansing of the ocean'

There are various NPCs swimming in Erudin Bay, including: Cenn Lostin, Lenya Wisk, Megan Tiglin, Taler Bilge, and Zip Fendil (And quite possibly Genna Lostin). They have two routes, spawning far out into the ocean, eventually swimming to the wall either north or south of the dock, and then despawning.
Grendin Maze (level 9) or Buzzlin Bornahm (level 25) spawns on the rocks to the right of the dock at loc -470, -630. Kill anyone (besides Buzzlin Bornahm to loot A Nicked Coin (uncommon drop).
Upon the death of Lenya Wisk:
Hand Laoni Reista A Nicked Coin.
You receive 9 copper pieces.
You receive a random piece of Patchwork Armor.

quests.name: Clear Water Quest
steps: Agryn Moonfield is at location +735, +835 in the Bank of Erudin (Erudin Palace).
You say, 'Hail, Agryn Moonfield'
You say, 'Do you have Vasty Deep water?'
You say, 'What guild coin?'
Leraena Shelyrak is at location -655, -80 in The Temple of Divine Light in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Leraena Shelyrak'
You say, 'I need a guild coin.'
Receive Peacekeeper Token. Return to Agryn Moonfield and hand it in.

quests.name: Cleric Epic Quest
steps: Orb of Frozen Water
Loot Lord Bergurgle's Crown from Lord Bergurgle in Lake Rathetear
Kill Shmendrik Lavawalker to spawn A Spirit of Flame
Orb of Clear Water
Loot Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring from Lord Gimblox in Solusek's Eye
Loot Singed Scroll from Overking Bathezid in Chardok
Orb of Vapor (Classic)
Give Message to Natasha (Received when spawning Ixiblat Fer) to Natasha Whitewater in Timorous Deep –- receive Shimmering Pearl* (This does not despawn Natasha)
Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh
Give all three orbs (Frozen Water / Clear Water / Vapor) to Jhassad Oceanson in Timorous Deep -- receive Orb of Triumvirate (This spawns the Avatar of Water in the lake)

quests.name: Cleric Kael Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Vylleam Vyaeltor in Kael Drakkal.
Templar's Crown
Templar's Chestplate
Templar's Vambraces
Templar's Bracer
Templar's Gauntlets
Templar's Leggings
Templar's Boots

quests.name: Cleric Skyshrine Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Fardonad Fe`Dhar in Skyshrine.
Akkirus' Crown of the Risen
Akkirus' Chestplate of the Risen
Akkirus' Vambraces of the Risen
Akkirus' Bracelet of the Risen
Akkirus' Gauntlets of the Risen
Akkirus' Greaves of the Risen
Akkirus' Boots of the Risen

quests.name: Cleric Spells (Evil)
steps: Brinaa Darkpact may be found at +2790, +2330. She wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Death Pact
Reckoning
Upheaval
Yaulp IV
The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls.

quests.name: Cleric Spells (Good)
steps: Frist Furtun may be found at -3550, 3055. He wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Death Pact
Reckoning
Upheaval
Yaulp IV
The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls.

quests.name: Cleric Supplies
steps: NOTES: *Iksar Shammy was KOS with these after reaching non-KOS with all others, wolf form made it possible to turn in, after hitting dubious I was able to turn in no problem.
Beek Guinders is located at -216, -380 in Rivervale.
You say, 'Hail, Beek Guinders'
You say, 'What help?'
You say, 'I will gather some things.'
Obtain:
Turn in the items to Beek...
You receive 13 Silver, 23 Copper from Beek Guinders.
You receive a random low-level cleric spell.

quests.name: Cleric Thurgadin Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Loremaster Dorinan in Thurgadin.
Crown of Forbidden Rites
Breastplate of Forbidden Rites
Vambraces of Forbidden Rites
Bracers of Forbidden Rites
Gauntlets of Forbidden Rites
Greaves of Forbidden Rites
Boots of Forbidden Rites

quests.name: Clurg's New Creation
steps: Clurg the bartender has a new task available.

quests.name: Clurg's Revenge
steps: Clurg the bartender doesn't like that someone in Neriak is imitating his drinks, and wants you to deal with her.

Her name is Pungla and you can finder her standing at the bar in the PVP area in the foreign quarter of Neriak. She hits a LOT harder then her level indicates. At 18 she is blue, however, she is very fast and hits hard.
If you ask her about the "Flaming Pungla" she acts scared.

WARNING: This quest SERIOUSLY lowers your faction with the Dark Bargainers in Neriak. Also, Clurg won't give you the quest until you have raised your faction with the Craknek Warriors and Green Blood Knights, and with Chef Dooga. (See Lizard Meat, Lizard Meat No 2, Lizard Tails, and Lizard Tails No 2 quests).

quests.name: Coin of Tash (Tashania)
steps: Get Coin Pouch from Romar Sunto in The Temple of Solusek Ro
Collect the coins from cities across the world:
Azia - Ak'anon - Near great wheel (not in water) (+1990, -260, -125). It's on the West side of the water wheel, then North a bit right at the Star light thing.
Beza - Erudin Palace - In the Caster's Guild zone (Erudin Palace), go one level up from the zone-in teleporter. It's in the fountain with rocks in it. (+703, +740, +44).
Caza - Northern Felwithe - in the fishing pond (-110, -790, -50).
Dena - West Freeport - In the pool under the Academy of Arcane Science (Caster Guild) (129, -750, -80).
Ena - Grobb - in pool near bar #6 on map. When you enter the zone and go across the first bridge the small pool on the right. (+197, -261).
Fana - Halas - in lake in front of city. If you're facing the city, it's to the left near the far dock, underwater on a raised ledge (-138, +179).
Geza - South Kaladim - Pool by warrior's guild (+75, +360, -5).
Heda - Neriak Commons - Pass the Constructed Potential to the big bridge. Jump off to the left, it's in the water next to the glass windows. (0, -795, -70).
Izah - Oggok - in lake near warrior guild at the north end (+103, +108).
Jaka - North Qeynos - under Temple of Life "UFO" in the Koalindl Fish Pool (-90, -445, -10).
Combine the 10 coins and combine them in the coin pouch to get a Coin of Tash.
Give Coin of Tash to Tarn Visilin in the High Keep library at +75, -220 and receive the Glowing Coin of Tash.
Give Glowing Coin of Tash to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak 3rd Gate library to receive the Gleaming Coin of Tash.
Give Gleaming Coin of Tash to Raine Beteria in Erudin library to receive the Radiant Coin of Tash.
Give Radiant Coin of Tash to Romar Sunto in The Temple of Solusek Ro to receive Spell: Tashania.
Warning DO NOT do turn-ins while invisible, though you can use Sneak

quests.name: Cold Iron
steps: To Royal Guard Sheltuin, you say, 'I wish an audience with the Overlord'
You say, 'I am interested.'
You say, 'What fool?'
Loot the Large Empty Crate found on Smithy Rrarrgin in the Warrens (it doesn't always drop) and return it to Sheltuin.
Royal Guard Sheltuin gives you experience and a Envelope with dust sample. Take the sample to Keletha Nightweaver.
Keletha gives you experience and Heretic's Report to take back to Sheltuin.

Royal Guard Sheltuin's eyes redden with intense anger after reading the report. When he speaks, his voice is surprisingly calm and measured. He says, 'Listen close Erudite. When you leave this building, you will find the courier who is bringing the ore. You will kill him, and collect his head and a box of the ore. You will then find the supplier, and collect his head and any other information you find on him. Bring me these four things and you will be rewarded. Do not fail.'

Head over to Qeynos Hills and seek out the erudite traveler by the lake. If you kill him, he drops Courier's Head, Crate full of Ore, and Note from Eichvul that leads you to Eichvul, a dark elf in a tower in Everfrost near the entrance to Permafrost. Kill Eichvul to obtain a Supplier's Head and Sealed Letter. Lastly, return to Royal Guard Sheltuin in Paineel and turn in the Courier's Head, Crate full of Ore, Supplier's Head, and Sealed Letter for your reward.

quests.name: Coldain Books of Tactics
steps: You say, 'hail Gkrean Prophet of Tallon'
You say, 'will you teach me?'
You say, 'I will serve the temple of tatics'
There seem to be several books of tactics that drop randomly from Coldains. It may be that each gives a set of rewards, or that the rewards are from a random table for any given book.
Here are the ones I know:
Brell's Divine Strategy - resulted in the Bracelet of Sacrifice , Gauntlets of Iron Tactics , Book of Tactics or Circlet of Tallon
War Tactics of the Frostreavers gets you a Book of Tactics and faction.
Need all dialogues (these are transcripts), faction hits, items that work and list of corresponding rewards.

quests.name: Coldain Military Wristguard Quest
steps: This quest NO LONGER REQUIRES War Wolf Choker as of 1/3/2016. The wolf tamer eats the War Wolf Choker.
You must have at least dubious faction to the Coldain and to the Kromrif/Kromzek. (Sneak works.)
See A frost giant wolf tamer in Kael and say "I am looking for more work".
He is being sarcastic... Erdarf is not really a friend and the Karsin acid will poison him.
A Bottle of Karsin Acid is no drop, and is dropped by orcs and geonids in Crystal Caverns. About 1 out of 15 drops a bottle.
If your faction is good with both giant and dwarf, then give the karsin bottle to Erdarf in The Holy Harbinger in Thurgadin.
Erdaf "gives" you a Gem of Persuasion in return. (The gem of persuasion can also be used for the Kromrif Military Leggings quest.)

Go back to giant wolf tamer and give him Gem of Persuasion. He gives you a Giant's Gem of Persuasion. Hand him back the Giant's Gem of Persuasion. (Note, he also asks for a wolf harness. Disregard this, just hand him the gem he just gave you). He gives you a Giants Harness of Control.

Go to The Great Divide and make sure Korf Brokenhammer is up. He is in the Coldain mining caves in the southeast of the zone. If the broodmother is up he generally is too, as his normal version is level 55 and not commonly hunted.
Then give the Giants Control Harness to Shardwurm Broodmother. She can be found by making all lefts in the wurm cave from Thurgadin.
She takes off for the Coldain mines at a good clip. You will want SOW to keep up with her while also avoiding the other wurms.

When she gets near the mine, Korf Brokenhammer spawns at the entrance. This version is level 50. He runs south immediately; engage him and kill him. If he gets away, you lose. He has quite a few hitpoints. He had high fire resistance, resisting all fire spells even after having his FR debuffed with Ro's Fiery Sundering, but his magic resistance was average for a mob of his level.

While you are fighting Korf the broodmother goes to the mouth of the cave, where another dwarf has appeared, and kills that dwarf. (This is analogous to Fergul Frotsky running and Gralk Dwarfkiller getting killed by the broodmother in the leggings version of the quest. Maybe it is finally working as intended.) After killing the dwarf, the broodmother went and stood to the left/north of the cave entrance. A couple minutes later, she despawned.
Loot Coldain Military Wristguard from Korf's corpse.

quests.name: Coldain Prayer Shawl Quests
steps: Overview:
The Coldain prayer shawl quests are a series of progressively more difficult tradeskill quests to repeatedly upgrade a cloth shawl. All quests except the final can be completed solo.
Tradeskills:
The table below displays the tradeskill trivial levels for each level of the quest. The quests can be completed with lower skill levels, but the risk of combine failures increases.
Requirements Summary:

Below is a checklist of all skill levels and non-trivial items that you must acquire for this quest. Items given by NPCS as part of the quest, items which can be purchased from vendors, or items that can be crafted using items purchased from vendors (eg. Mixing Bowl or Pie Tin) are not listed.

NOTE: These requirements assume successes on all combines, but keep in mind that even with max skill there is always at least a 5% failure rate, so you may wind up needing multiple copies of some items if you are unlucky.
Tradeskilling
Tradeskills (see above)
Shawl 1
4x Kromrif Frost Giant Toes
Shawl 2
10x Kromrif Head
Shawl 3 and some Shawl 7
1x Tundra Kodiak Meat
2x Snow Bunny Meat
2x Ulthork Meat (don't forget to collect 1x Ulthork Tusks for Shal 7)
4x Snow Griffin Egg
Shawl 4 and some Shawl 7
3x Crystalline Silk
1x Small Brick of Velium (IMORTANT: pick up 2x. This means 1x for Shawl #4, 1x for Shawl #7)
2x Small Piece of Velium (IMORTANT: pick up 4x. This means 2x for Shawl #4, 2x for Shawl #7)
Shawl 5
75x Crystalline Silk Thread
5x Glowing Worm Bile
Shawl 6 (The most difficult shawl to make so it is wise to get enough of the items below to attempt at least 2 times)
2x Drakkel Wolf Whisker (Getting at least 4 would be wise, this is often the rarest drop to come by)
2x Manticore Mane

2x Siren Hair (Getting at least 4 would be wise, he Sirens are often the most difficult mobs to kill for this shawl and drops are not so common. Also keep an eye out for Sirens to drop Runed Sea Shell (Enduring Breath) for Shawl 7)
1x Woven Frost Giant Beard
Shawl 7
1x Runed Sea Shell (Enduring Breath) (Enduring Breath) (may have dropped when doing Shawl 6 siren kills)
1x Small Brick of Velium (best to have picked up when collecting for Shawl 4)
1x Ulthork Tusks (best to have picked up when collecting Shawl 3 ulthork meat)
1x Swordfish Tooth
1x Molkor Hide
1x Royal Kromrif Blood
3x Iceclad Cutlassfish (technically obtained from Fishing in and is not a drop)
2x Small Piece of Velium (best to have picked up when collecting for Shawl 4)
Quick XP and Collection Guide:
At/Around level 35 Group in:
Great Divide to get XP and drops:
2x Drakkel Wolf Whisker (Shawl 6 and painful to do when not able to get xp, so prioritize these 1st at level 35 and I highly recommend getting at least 4 as these are high fail combines)
4x Kromrif Frost Giant Toes (Shawl 1)
10x Kromrif Head (Shawl 2)
1x Woven Frost Giant Beard (Shawl 6)
At/Around level 45 Group in:
Great Divide to get XP and drops:
5x Glowing Worm Bile (Shawl 5)
Eastern Wastes to get XP and drops:
1x Tundra Kodiak Meat (Shawl 3)
2x Snow Bunny Meat (Shawl 3)
2x Ulthork Meat (Shawl 3)
1x Ulthork Tusks (Shawl 7)
4x Snow Griffin Egg (Shawl 3 - these will be very tough until about level 50 and soloable at 49 by good Enchanters and Necros)
2x Manticore Mane (Shawl 6)
1x Woven Frost Giant Beard (Shawl 6)
Crystal Caverns to get XP and drops:
3x Crystalline Silk (Shawl 4 - also pick up all the stacks you need for Tailoring trade skilling at this point)
2x Small Brick of Velium (Shawl 4 needs 1x, Shawl 7 needs 1x)

quests.name: Coldain Ring Quests
steps: Trivials Overview:
Tradeskill Trivial Levels
Tradeskill Success Chances
Chance to succeed tradeskill combine with various skill levels
41 Trivial: Tailoring / Smithing
41 Skill = 67%
51 Skill = 77%
61 Skill = 87%
70 Skill = 95% (max)
248 Trivial: Brewing
200 Skill = 67%
210 Skill = 74%
220 Skill = 84%
230 Skill = 95% (max)
Checklists:
Ring 1: Copper Coldain Insignia Ring
Craft a Coldain Hunting Blanket (2x HQ Cougar Skins and 2x HQ Tundra Kodiak Pelts)
Turn Blanket in to Garadain Glacierbane ( ) to receive Ring
Ring 2: Silver Coldain Insignia Ring
Say 'I will give assistance.' to Garadain Glacierbane to get Dull Bladed Axe
Turn in Axe to Boridain Glacierbane (-2450, +1550)
Escort and protect Boridain and kill Rabid Tundra Kodiak
Loot Rabid Kodiak Skin and immediately give to Boridain (to receive Broken Axe)
Hand in Broken Axe and Copper Coldain Insignia Ring to his uncle Garadain Glacierbane to receive Ring
Ring 3: Gold Coldain Insignia Ring
Smith a Coldain Hunting Knife (from a High Quality Walrus Hide, Skinning Rock, and a Wooly Rhino Horn)
Hand the Coldain Hunting Knife and your Silver Coldain Insignia Ring into Garadain Glacierbane to receive Ring
Ring 4: Platinum Coldain Insignia Ring
Say "I will help" to Tain Hammerfrost ( )and save him from giant ambush
Loot Frozen Elixir and give to Tain to receive Coldain Smithing Hammer
Hand the Coldain Smithing Hammer and your Gold Coldain Insignia Ring into Garadain Glacierbane
Ring 5: Obsidian Coldain Insignia Ring
Find and kill Ry'Gorr Messenger loot Ry'Gorr Invasion Plans
Hand Ry'Gorr Invasion Plans to a coldain lookout to start invasion
Kill Scarbrow Ga`Hruk and loot Head of Scarbrow
Hand the Head of Scarbrow and your Platinum Coldain Insignia Ring into Garadain Glacierbane
Ring 6: Mithril Coldain Insignia Ring
Find Korrigain (9PM - 6AM) and give him your Obsidian Coldain Insignia Ring, follow Icefang
Kill Poxbreath Yellowfang and loot Note from Kromrif
Find and kill Rodrick Tardok loot Rodrick's Head
Hand the Note from Kromrif , Rodrick's Head and your Obsidian Coldain Insignia Ring into Garadain Glacierbane
Ring 7: Adamantium Coldain Insignia Ring
Loot Shackle Key from Warden Bruke
Find Corbin Blackwell, Hand him the Shackle Key and your Mithril Coldain Insignia Ring
Escort him to safety. Wait for Corbin Blackwell to talk to Dobbin Crossaxe
Hand your Mithril Coldain Insignia Ring into Dobbin Crossaxe (Black Beard), receive Note from Corbin
Hand Note into Garadain Glacierbane
Ring 8: Velium Coldain Insignia Ring *CAN FAIL AND LOSE RING*
See [https://wiki.project1999.com/Ring_8_player_agreement Ring 8 Server Roll] for the Ring 8 Server Roll times.
Give Garadain Glacierbane your Adamantium Coldain Insignia Ring and receive Marching Orders
Hand Gloradin Coldheart the Marching Orders to start the war
Kill Chief Ry`Gorr and loot Chief Ry`Gorr's Head
Wait for Garadain Glacierbane to yell CHARGE!, then hand him Chief Ry`Gorr's Head
Ring 9: Coldain Hero's Insignia Ring
Wait until the Royal Court starts (around 8 AM) then say 'I will accept this task' to Seneschal Aldikar and receive a Traitor's Bane Box
Collect the Dirk of the Traitor: kill Rodrick Tardok (in a small tower in the northwest corner of the Ry`Gorr Keep in the Eastern Wastes)
Collect Murdrick's head: kill Murdrick Tardok in the Great Divide (-5900, +3700)
Collect Berradin's head: kill Captain Berradin in the Eastern Wastes after giving him a Tainted Avalanche Ale
Collect Peffin's head: kill Peffin Ambersnow in the giant fort in the Eastern Wastes
Collect Doldigun's head: kill Doldigun Steinwielder after spawning him in Iceshard Manor (in Kael Drakkel -850, +1150)

quests.name: Coldain Skulls
steps: Slaggak the Trainer can be found at #5 on the map of Kael Drakkel.
You say, 'Hail, Slaggak the Trainer'
You say, 'I will serve King Tormax'
You say, 'What Coldain?'
You say, 'What about their skulls?'
In return for 4 Coldain Head, the result is a random piece of Giant Scale Mail.

CLARIFICATION NEEDED: He says he wants to make FOUR dwarf-head talismans. Can anyone confirm whether the result is different if 4 heads are handed in at once? Handing in one at a time won't do anything until you hand in the 4th one (you don't get exp, faction or items), so it's the same as handing in 4 at once.

quests.name: Collect Drops of Shadow
steps: Ssynthi may be found at -55, 385, in the graveyard behind the mausoleum.
You say, 'A new breed of shadowed man walks Norrath. What can you tell me of the deathspeakers?'
You say, 'Could it concern the Burning Dead's plan to resurrect Marnek?'
You say, 'I will help you.'
You receive an 8-slot Cauldron of Shadow Essence. Go to each of the shadowed men camps (locations needed):
Innothule Swamp
Nektulos Forest
Lavastorm Mountains
Lesser Faydark
South Karana
Commonlands
Kithicor Forest
A rare drop at each camp is a Vial of Shadow. Each vial identifies differently:
Innothule Swamp - Shadow of the first Deathspeaker
Nektulos Forest - Shadow of the second Deathspeaker
Lavastorm Mountains - Shadow of the third Deathspeaker
Lesser Faydark - Shadow of the fourth Deathspeaker
South Karana - Shadow of the fifth Deathspeaker
Commonlands - Shadow of the sixth Deathspeaker
Kithicor Forest - Shadow of the seventh Deathspeaker
Find Ytyrs the Reborn in the Rathe Mountains at -750, -1580. Kill it to spawn Ytyrs Reborn, who spawns with several of "a minion of Ytyrs."
Kill Ytyrs Reborn for the eighth Vial of Shadow, which identifies as "Shadow of Ytyrs the Reborn."
Combine the eight vials in the cauldron to craft a Concoction of Shadow and give that to Ssynthi to receive a Penumbral Rod, an item with 3 charges of Shadow Burst.
(Closing dialogue?)

quests.name: Collier's Weapon Treatment
steps: As of 8/18/26 this quest is NOT able to be completed on EQL. Collier is nowhere to be found in Erudin.
Collier may be found at (-1170, -70, 83) in Erudin, on the top floor of the Vasty Deep Inn.
You say, 'Hail, Collier'
You say, 'What is the proposition?'
You say, 'What special weapon treatment?'
He wants:
Ancient Snake Fang - drops off Slyder the Ancient in Stonebrunt Mountains
Ancient Venom Sack - drops off Slyder the Ancient in Stonebrunt Mountains
Venomous Spikefish Poison Sac - extremely rare drop off Venomous Spikefish in Kerra Island
Necromancer Blood - drops off Heretic Invaders in Stonebrunt Mountains

Collier gives back a Thick Caustic Liquid which is tradeable, along with the text reply to the effect of: "There is the weapon treatment I promised you. Use it in a forge with any standard forged weapon. Choose your preferred weapon carefully as there is only enough of the substance for a single treatment."
(Collier then despawns)
The reward varies depending upon which weapon you use:
Forged Battle Axe yields Bloodclaw Battle Axe.
Forged Dagger yields Bloodclaw Dagger.
Forged Long Sword yields Bloodclaw Long Sword. (This is the best ratio)
Forged Mace yields Bloodclaw Mace - (The Mace is not a MAGIC item, and as a result, inferior to the others.)
Forged Rapier yields Bloodclaw Rapier.
Forged Scimitar yields Bloodclaw Scimitar. (Druid usable)
Weapons that do not work:
Forged Warhammer does not work.

quests.name: Corrupt Guards
steps: You say, 'Hail, Capt Linarius'
You say, 'What corrupt guards?'
A Guard Bracelet (identifies as "Corrupt Guard Bracelet") drops from Guard McCluskey and Guard Donlan in West Karana (-2913, -2043).
Give the bracelet to Capt Linarius. Required higher than dubious faction for turn in.
(About 48,000 exp per bracer - compared to the 97,000 exp you get from killing Guard McCluskey or 67,000 exp from killing Guard Donlan)
You receive 8 gold from Capt Linarius.

quests.name: Corrupt Guards (Cleric version)
steps: You say, 'Hail, Jemoz Lerkarson'
You say, 'I am devoted to truth.'
You say, 'Who is the fallen knight?'
You say, 'I will crush the Freeport Militia.'
Kill Militia guards in West Freeport and loot a Damaged Militia Helm. Return to Jemoz to turn in.
Experience gain is negligible (less than 1%) at level 6.
You feel a little better.

quests.name: Corrupt Guards (Paladin Version)
steps: Theron Rolius is a paladin guildmaster who may be found in the Hall of Truth in North Freeport at Location: (239, -142).
You say, 'Hail, Theron Rolius'
You say, 'I will join the crusade.'
The Freeport Militia house is located in East Freeport. Various named guards there drop a Damaged Militia Helm. Hand in ONE
at a time.
~5% at level 2, negligible (1% or less) at level 5, as a bard.
You receive 1 - 3 platinum from Theron Rolius.

quests.name: Cougarskin Boots Quest
steps: Ergrez will make you a pair of Cougarskin Boots if you bring him a Medium Quality Cougarskin and 2 Cutting Shells.
Upon turning in "Ergrez Shortpaw works with the fur for awhile by skinning it and sewing it."
No Faction Hits
The skin is a random drop from various snow cougars, including named, in the Eastern Wastes and Iceclad Ocean.
Cutting Shells are a ground spawn in the water in Cobalt Scar.

quests.name: Cougarskin Mask Quest
steps: Ergrez will make you a mask from the skins of your kills, but you need to bring him some food as well as the skins. Bring him a High Quality Cougarskin and 2 Mammoth Meat
Ergrez Shortpaw is located at 1075, 2415, 37(Iceclad Ocean). Standing in a hut next to Errgriz. There are Snowfang spearguards around the camp. They all con'd amiable to a barbarian shaman.
Walked up to him handed the High Quality Cougarskin and 2 Mammoth Meat (Seperate, not in a stack). I tried to hail him for dialogue but he said nothing.
need all dialogues, current faction hits if any.

quests.name: Crafted Armor Quests
steps: Talk to either Shakrn Meadowgreen (160, -2217) or Ulan Meadowgreen (126, -2177) in Southern Karana.
Shakrn: Vambraces, Boots, Gauntlets, Helmet
Ulan: Pauldron, Greaves, Bracer, Breastplate
For each armor piece you'll need to collect the following items.

quests.name: Crest of the Drixie Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Lord Prismwing'
You say, 'I am a friend of the court'

Head to Cobalt Scar and kill the dreaded Yvolcarn (52nd level warrior type, doesn't summon, is immune to changes in run speed). As a 60 Druid there was no difficulty pulling him down to the beach and running him in circles loaded up with Winged Death, Breath of Ro, and Drones of Doom. Some have expressed difficulty landing Breath of Ro and so Fiery Sundering may be useful. With a C2, PotG, Mask of the Hunter, and strategic sitting on a tick mana was nothing of an issue. Loot the Drixie Remains off him. Note that killing Yvolcarn carries a fairly large Claws of Veeshan and Yelinak faction hit.
Give the remains to Prismwing and receive a Crest of the Drixie.

quests.name: Crest of the Faerie Dragons Quest
quests.page: Crest of the Faerie Dragons Quest
steps: Lord Gossimerwind can typically be found near the geonid caves. It has a placeholder of A Faerie Dragon.
You say, 'Hail, Lord Gossimerwind'
You say, 'I wish to assist.'
Slay the A Storm Giant Foreman and loot his Kromzek Foreman Helm and bring it back for the Crest of the Faerie Dragons.
Upon handing in the helm:
Need /loc of quest mobs, minimum faction required to get quest.

quests.name: Crest of the Fauns Quest
steps: After getting the case for the crests (see the Friend of the Tunarean Court Quest), you can do this one to get the faun crest.
A Kromzek architect occasionally visits the building sites. Shamus desires to acquire his blueprints for the expansion of Kael.
Kill a storm giant architect and loot kromzek architect blueprints.

After turning in the Architect Blueprints : Shamus Aghllsews says 'You have my gratitude Jaeden . With these blueprints we can better prepare the forests defenses against the giant invaders. I have yet another favor to ask of you as well. Fill this empty bag with crystallized sulfur. When mixed with the crushed herbs in the other bag it will create an explosion strong enough to destroy stone. Take the two full bags into Kael Drakkel and plant it into a crate of the kromzeks building supplies.
You gain party experience!!
Received a 4 slot container for the crystalized sulfur.
Received a bag of crushed herbs (not a container).

I put one Crystallized Sulfur into each slot and combined and it became a bag of sulfur, no longer a container. Headed to Kael from Wakening. If you proceed past the first few guards and go up a hill you see 4 destroyed buildings(platforms with broken walls). Look on the floor of each and you will see two bags on the floor of one platform (Loc -560, +2500). If you take one of the bags (sulfur or herbs) and try to drop them on the floor where (you must click the directly onto the floor) the bags are, a trade screen will open up labeled a bag of (building?)supplies. NOTE: Your invis drops at th…
With a FR of 163 I resisted Pillar of Flame spell. With 65FR I took ~300 damage.
Took the Pile of Rubble back to Shamus and gave it to him.
Received a crest of the fauns.

quests.name: Crest of the Sifaye Quest
steps: Location of Countess Silveana is 1747, -65 in the center of the Sifaye Village (#2 on the map). She spawns in the middle of the camp and there can be either Knights or Chancellors as PHers. If she is not up you will need someone to kill the PHer or DoT them up and gate out before they die to avoid the faction hits.
You say, 'Hail, Countess Silveana'
You say, 'What tunarean court?'
You say, 'What giants?'
Here you hand her the Kromzek Surveyor Scope from the Storm Giant Surveyor.

quests.name: Crest of the Unicorn Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Lady Gelistial'
You say, 'I am a friend'
You say, 'Who is Lithiniath?'
You say, 'Who is prince thirneg?'
Go find the prince. He is located in the bottom of Tunare's Tree.
You say, 'Hail, Prince Thirneg'
You say, 'Lady Gelistial sent me'
You say, 'I seek a cure for the line of Lithiniath'

Lithiniath is found in the Plane of Mischief in a room off the right side of the dining hall. Kill him and loot his horn. Nearby is a white stallion. Give the white horse the horn and you'll receive a Crest of the Unicorn in exchange.

quests.name: Crest of the Wood Nymphs Quest
quests.page: Crest of the Wood Nymphs Quest
steps: After getting the case for the crests (see the Friend of the Tunarean Court Quest), you can do this one to get the Wood Nymph crest.
Eysa Florawhisper in the Wakening Land (-940, -1700) wants you to collect eight seeds for her to show that you are a friend of the Tunarean Court.
These seeds come from Kunark, Antonica, Faydwer, and Odus. She gives you an 8-slot seed pack to fill and combine.
You say, 'Hail, Eysa Florawhisper'
You say, 'I am a friend of the court.'
You say, 'I will gather seeds for you.'
You receive an Empty Seed Collection Bag.
The seeds and their forage locations:
Misty Acorn: foraged or picked up off ground in Misty Thicket
Emerald Orange: Emerald Jungle
Bag of Caynar Nuts: Toxxulia Forest
Vineclinger Berries: Butcherblock mountains (no drop)
Ripened Heartfruit: Greater Faydark (no drop)
Rathe Berries: Lake Rathe
Marr Cherries: Ocean Of Tears
Flarefire Seeds: Field of Bone (no drop)
Combine the 8 items within the Bag:
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Bag of Seeds.
Upon giving the bag to Eysa:
Receive: Crest of the Wood Nymphs

quests.name: Cromil's Remains
steps: This quest is sometimes given to you after you return 4 Bone Chips to Gunlok Jure in the paladin guild hall in North Kaladim, if you have a high enough faction (amiable). He will ask you to find the remains of his brother Cromil. Supposedly he is now undead and is with an undead army located somewhere in the Plains of Karana. You can find these remains in the Southern Karana.

Cromil is not actually a creature that is listed. It turns out that after you kill a dwarf skeleton (rare spawn) in the camp where Lord Grimrot hangs out, one of them might have a set of Dwarf Bones. These are in fact Cromil's remains. The spawn point is one of the skeletons, usually a putrid skeleton, very near the Gnoll mob that is in camp.

Be warned that the location is very dangerous, as many of the creatures there are well into the upper teens in level. Especially beware of the roaming cyclops and Lord Grimrot, who is in fact the subject of another quest.

While the above warning is true about the named wanderers, I fought there for hours and the camp itself was green to blue to me at 15. The non-agro mobs nearby were light blue to white. I will update the reward section when I get it finished, but if it is a level 15 spell as I suspect, you probably want to come here before 15.
Turning in the dwarf remains to Gunlok produced this interaction:
"Gunlok Jure says, Many thanks, my friend. Now my brother can rest in peace. Please take this spell. May it serve you well."

quests.name: Crude Stein Quest
steps: This quest begins with Lork in Oggok warrior guild. Faction hit amounts based on post on Allakhazam by DeathTemplar.
Lork looks upon you warmly -- what would you like your tombstone to say?
You say, 'Hail, Lork'
You say, 'I help Crakneks' (or 'I will help crakneks')
Kill a fat alligator in Innothule Swamp and loot an Ogre Arm. Bring this item to Lork:
You receive A Cracked Stein.
Lork looks upon you warmly -- what would you like your tombstone to say?
You say, 'Where is Uglan?'

You say, 'Hail, Uglan'

You receive a random item at this point (occasionally a bronze weapon).

He also often drops a dragoon dagger. Beware faction here... for killing K`ryn, you lose faction with Indigo Brotherh…
Kill Ambassador K`Ryn.
Loot his heart?
Lord Crushbone is Ambassador DVinn in Crushbone. Kill him and loot his Black Heart.
Return to Lork.
The reward varies and is often bad (patchwork armor, for example). You'll rarely get a Crude Stein or Gatorsmash Maul.

I will craft other materials as well when they are available.'

quests.name: Crystal Caverns' Ancient Artifacts
steps: High amiable/kindly faction required for Erdarf to talk to you.
You say, 'Hail, Erdarf Restil'
You say, 'What old one?'
You say, 'What haven't you done?'

Give him the Sceptre of the Coldain Ancients OR a Bottle of Karsin Acid, he will give you back a Gem of Persuasion, which has no stats and is lore and no drop. Bottle of Karsin Acid drops semi-rarely from any one of the orcs or geonids in Crystal Caverns. Sceptre of the Coldain Ancients drops from Queen Dracnia.
Erdarf despawns.
Now talk to Vores the Hunter in Great Divide (-6908, 513).
You say, 'Hail, Vores the Hunter'
You say, 'what wurms'
You say, 'what control'
You say, 'what theories'
He asks for a Blood Wolf Harness and the Gem of Persuasion.
Blood wolf harness is dropped by Drakkel Blood Wolf in Great Divide. (Note the Crested Blood Wolf Harness will not work).
Give him these two items, and Vores gives you a Harness of Control.
Turn in this harness to the Shardwurm Broodmother.

Note: Before turning in the harness, be sure that Fergul Frostsky and Gralk Dwarfkiller are spawned and not in combat, otherwise the quest will fail and you lose the harness. It is wise to announce to the zone (ooc) your intention to do the quest and specifically tell everyone not to engage or agro Fergul or Gralk. No one involved in the quest or nearby should be in wolf form but be sure to have a movement buff on, because the broodmother moves at a wurm's run speed.

The Broodmother then walks out of the cave and heads to the giant fort. At the giant fort, two of the named giants inside the fort, Gralk Dwarfkiller and Fergul Frostsky, repop outside. Gralk engages the Broodmother and Fergul repops (again, in the spot he stands) and immediately runs away.

While the Broodmother fights Gralk, chase down Fergul and kill him and then loot Kromrif Military Leggings off his body. The Broodmother will kill Gralk, in addition he drops nothing if killed by players.
DO NOT engage Fergul until he has repopped and started running away. Only the version of Fergul who is actively running away drops the pants.

After killing Gralk, the Broodmother seems to be somewhat buggy. She has been reported to have poofed, become pc's pet, become an npc's pet, or attacked the pc. It may be broken at this point. (In June 2019 she stood there for about 5 minutes after the giants died, then poofed.)

quests.name: Cure for Lempeck Hargrin
steps: This quest begins with Astaed Wemor in the Temple of Life of North Qeynos.
Condensed Walkthrough:
In Rivervale, complete the Honey Jum Quest and receive Honey Jum.
In North Qeynos, give the honey jum to Astaed Wemor and receive Prime Healer Potion [identifies as Potion of Disease Warding].

Note: you need good faction with Astaed Wemor or he will keep the honey jum and give nothing. (Warning: Amiable faction is required (wolf form seems to work). You will recieve dialogue for the quest down to apprehensive, but not dubious, but if you are indifferent or apprehensive, your Honey Jum will be eaten.)
In West Karana, give the potion to Lempeck Hargrin and receive a LORE/NODROP Rusty Scythe.
In North Qeynos, give the scythe to Astaed Wemor and receive Shining Star of Light.
Complete Walkthrough:
You say, 'Hail, Astaed Wemor'
You say, 'I am here to assist the temple'
You say, 'I will be traveling afar'
Find Kizzie Mintopp in Rivervale and tell her you're from the Temple of Life.
After you receive the Honey Jum, head back to Qeynos for the turn in:
You receive Prime Healer Potion
Travel to West Karana to a house near the river bank between the fields. In it, find Lempeck Hargrin.
You say, 'Hail, Lempeck Hargrin'
You receive a Special NODROP Rusty Scythe

NOTE: Sometimes he goes crazy and attacks you at this point. This is most likely related to the potion you give him. The potion that identifies as "Potion of Disease Warding" is the one you want. If it identifies as "Ochre Potion Disease Ward" or anything else, you'll get attacked.

quests.name: Cures
steps: Mystic Dovan spawns at night (in the same exact spot as Captain Nedar) at location 2644.81, 3029.77, 43.69.

Mystic Dovan shows the signs of a great mystic. You can feel the power resonating from his aura. 'Greetings and may the cursed blessings of Cazic-Thule be yours. What may I do for you this fine evening? Perhaps I can [cure disease] or [heal] you, perhaps even [purge toxins] from your system?'
You say, 'Cure disease.'

Mystic Dovan grabs from his beltpouch a fine dust and cakes the slimy blood sac with it. He then punctures the sac and smears the blood upon your chest. Your chest tingles. Your fill your lungs and exhale a bitter mist.
You say, 'Heal me.'

Mystic Dovan chants in an unknown tongue as he takes a dagger and slits your forearm. He then takes a tiny glowing vein worm from his beltpouch and forces it into the open wound. You feel the worm explode inside. The pain is unbearable, but then, a coolness courses through your body.
You say, 'Purge toxins.'
Mystic Dovan takes the skulls and holds them before your wounds. They shatter into a fine glowing powder and you feel your wounds beiing[sic] cauterized with no visible flame upon them.

quests.name: Deathfist Slashed Belts
steps: There are two versions of this quest, one for evil classes/races, and one for good classes/races.
Good Version:
This quest can be performed at dubious and higher faction with the quest giver.

Cain Darkmoore, who is located in the banquet room on the 2nd floor of the warrior guildhall. He now wants two Deathfist Slashed Belts at a time. When you give him two belts, you gain faction with the warriors and paladins, and you lose it with the militia. You also get 2 - 10 gp and some decent xp. Also, when you give Cain a belt, he'll thank and ask you for help with his "bigger problem." Asking about this sends you to the paladin guild where you learn about the Corrupt Guards quest.
You say, 'Hail, Cain Darkmoore'
You say, 'What is Clan Deathfist?'

Hand in two. Note: If you hand in four belts you will only be rewarded for two of them and the other two will be lost.
You receive 9 gold from Cain Darkmoore.
Asking about the "bigger problem" sends you to the paladin guild where you learn about the Corrupt Guards quest.
Evil Version (Freeport Militia):
Captain Hazran of the militia is located on the outside balcony of the militia HQ building in West Freeport. Give him one deathfist slashed belt at a time for a reward.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Hazran'
You say, 'What is Clan Deathfist?'
After handing in a Deathfist Slashed Belt (you can hand in 1, 2, 3, or 4 at a time):
Captain Hazran says, 'Good work warrior. Your are good Militia material. Beware though, there are some who dare to call us foe. You have performed so well.'
You receive 3 gold from Captain Hazran.

quests.name: Deck of Spontaneous Generation Quest
steps: Part 1: Acquiring the Deck:
This quest is given by Ferjeneror, but you can start in the Dining Room before moving on to the Hedge Maze.
King Cod Card:

There is a level 1 ogre named Dinner on the table of the Dining Room. Kill Dinner to loot the King Cod Card. Be cautious when going to loot the card as there are two level 55 wizards perma-rooted to the chandelier above him. They are scowling to everyone and like to chain ice comets together. They cannot be hit by melee attacks and will not chase when aggroed. It's wise to use Harmony or Calm before entering, or simply moving very quickly.
Colored Cod Cards:

Alternatively, you can fish in the castle moat for the four colored cod cards: Black Cod Card, Blue Cod Card, Red Cod Card, and White Cod Card. You can turn these four cards in instead of the King Cod Card.
Part 2: Using the Deck of Spontaneous Generation:
Throughout the Plane of Mischief, various Mobs drop playing cards. Collect these cards and combine them in the Deck of Spontaneous Generation, with each combination generating a different reward.
Armor of Distraction:
These armor pieces are used in two different ways (together) to create Plane of Mischief Armor.

First, they can be used in the The Gift Box quest (along with a Words of Wealth) to create gift boxes, which generate Plane of Mischief dolls. Second, those dolls can be combined with (still more) armor pieces in the Plane of Mischief Armor Quest to create Plane of Mischief Armor.

Note that every armor piece requires two thrones except the Vambraces of Distraction (which require only one). Because the gift boxes to generate the dolls require a minimum of two thrones to generate, every armor piece except the Vambraces of Distraction requires at least four throne cards ... and remember, gift boxes are random, so it could take many more unless you trade with other players or are very lucky.
Plane of Mischief Armor:
Flowers:
All flowers except the Red Flower of Functionality requires all four colors of a single type of card. The Red flower instead requires a White card of every type.
This means that most flowers do not require any thrones, but the Red Flower of Functionality requires one and the Blue Flower of Functionality requires four!
Wrist Items:
Every wrist item requires two thrones, a crown, and a knight.
Other (One Throne):
Each of these items requires a card of each type for a single color. There is a combination for every color except white (all white cards yields a flower; see above).
Other (Two Thrones):
Each of these items requires two thrones and two crowns.
