Dlammaz Stormslayer pats the huge axe at his side and drapes his shimmering cloak over his shoulders.
You say, 'What axe?'
You say, 'What cloak?'
Turning in the Greater Dragon's Head results in Frostbringer
Turning in the Great Dragon's Head results in Cloak of the Maelstrom

quests.name: Dragon Scales Quest
steps: Get a Peridot
Get Tektite (Item)
Turn in Peridot & Tektite (Item) to Lord Lyfyx of Burwood to receive Dragon Scales (Xyfyl)
Get Azdalin's Scales
Get Gylton's Scales
Turn in in all three Scales to Squire Fuzzmin to receive Wurmslayer

quests.name: Dreadscale Armor
steps: Note: There is no faction reward for doing these quests
Sirtha Scarscale:
You say, 'Hail, Sirtha Scarscale'
Sirtha Scarscale eyes you intently. 'So, yet another hatchling approaches us. I am known as Sirtha and that is Sarth. We are of [Rile's] children. Who do you call your father, broodling?'
You say, 'I am a child of Rile'

Sirtha Scarscale says, 'Very good. We are smiths for the Crusaders of the Greenmist and I shall make [armor] for you, provided you prove your worth. Fail these simple tasks, and you shall not be worthy to bear the title of crusader!'
You say, 'what armor'
Sirtha Scarscale says, 'I will make [helms], [gauntlets], [boots], and [vambraces]. My broodmate shall make the bracers, greaves, masks, and breastplate.'
==== Dreadscale Helm ====
You say, 'what helms'

Sirtha Scarscale says, 'The sarnak are a mockery of the Iksar. They are nothing more than beasts fit only to do our bidding! I require you to bring me the sword of one of their Order of Knights and the head of a sarnak berserker. These beasts have been attacking our patrols of late. I also require a stone called a ruby and a banded helm. Do this and I shall make a helm for you.'
Requires:
1x Sarnak Berserker Head - Dropped Overthere (Level 30-33)
1x Sarnak Knight's Sword - Dropped from a sarnak knight in Burning Wood (Level 33-37)
1x Ruby - Bought
1x Banded Helm - Crafted
Dreadscale Gauntlets:
You say, 'what gauntlets'

Sirtha Scarscale says, 'I currently have need of a complete skeletal hand, for the research I am conducting. I wish to study its properties and form so that I can make gauntlets befitting our station. I also require two rubies that holds stars within and some banded gauntlets to complete my ritual. Do that and the gauntlets are yours to keep.'
Requires:
1x Skeletal Hand - Dropped from charbone skeleton in Lake of Ill Omen (Level 23-27)
2x Star Ruby - Bought
1x Banded Gauntlets - Crafted
Dreadscale Boots:
You say, 'what boots'

Sirtha Scarscale says, 'Cactus quills can be very lethal. I seek to work them into my new boots. Find me these quills, a pair of skeletal feet, an emerald of fire, and some banded boots so that I may start working on them. Why are you still here?! Begone!'
Requires:
1x Cactus Quills - Dropped Overthere (Level 31-33)
1x Skeletal Feet - Dropped Kurn's Tower (Level 15, but to get to the mob you need a group/duo in upper teens)
1x Fire Emerald - Bought
1x Banded Boots - Crafted
Dreadscale Vambraces:
You say, 'what vambraces'

Sirtha Scarscale says, 'The hideous Golra are hardy creatures. The tales indicate their ferocity almost matches our own. I wish to gain a trophy of one of these beasts. Bring me the skin of one, two blue sapphires, and banded sleeves. Then I shall give you these fine vambraces.'
Requires:
1x Golra Skin - Dropped Timorous Deep (Level 34-35)
2x sapphire - Bought
1x Banded Sleeves - Crafted

quests.name: Drolvarg Teeth
steps: Captain Nealith may be found at -3900, +2600. He will respond to hails and give rewards at dubious faction.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Nealith'
You say, 'I will join the defense of the outpost.'
Collect A Canine (identifies as "Drolvarg Tooth") from drolvargs in various zones. Hand in all four:
Captain Nealith will say on a canine turn in one thru three "Good work, but you will have to slay more than this to earn your wages."
Upon Turning in your fourth a canine

Captain Nealith tosses the teeth into a very large cask full of similar teeth. 'Fine work, ______. I wish all my own troops showed the same tenacity. I salute you. This will keep you well fed during your long patrols. Use your wages to better equip yourself. Continue the fight!! The General is pleased.'

quests.name: Drosco the Zombie (evil)
steps: Kurne Rextula can be found in the Qeynos Catacombs, in the Bloodsabers Guild (Human worshippers of Bertoxxulous). Take the first right upon entering the Bloodsabers area (313, -425).
You say, 'Hail, Kurne Rextula'
You say, 'What pets?'
You say, 'Who is Drosco?'
You say, 'How does he compromise the shrine's location?'

Drosco or his placeholder, A Gelatinous Cube, spawns at (412, -24) then roams west to the nesting rat room (#7 on map), pauses, then continues on toward the shady mercenary room (#6) where it despawns.
Drosco says, 'Rele.. ase.. me.. from.. this.. tor.. ment.. ARGH! You will die for entering the domain of the Bloodsabers!! Karana.. help.. me?'
Drosco says, 'ARGH!!!!!.. Thank.. you..'
You have slain Drosco!
--You have looted a A Sealed Letter.--
It reads:
Dear Temple of Thunder, Thank you for the lovely retreat to the Shrine of Bertoxxulous.
I especially loved the bubbling hot baths, although I think I stayed in too long because all my flesh was
boiled clean off my body. Oh well, back to wandering the catacombs. Love, Drosco, agent of thunder.
P.S. I think the Shrine was not fooled.
Return to Kurne and turn in the letter.
You receive 3 silver from Kurne Rextula.
You receive a minor item (ex. Belt Pouch).

quests.name: Drosco the Zombie (good)
steps: This quest begins in South Qeynos with Wolten Grafe, the Keeper of the Medallions of the Order of Thunder. He is located at -189, -554, +3.
You say, 'Hail, Wolten Grafe'
You say, 'I wish to join the cause.'
You say, 'What dangerous mission?'
You receive a Tattered Note , which reads:
THE STORM IS NEAR !
Find Drosco in the Qeynos Catacombs, room 7.
You have slain Drosco!
Drosco's corpse says, 'ARGH!!!!!.. Thank.. you..'
Drosco will occasionally drop A Sealed Letter. Loot this and return to Wolten Grafe.
Upon turning in A Sealed Letter (had amiable faction while doing this quest):
Quest: Errand for Wolten
More rarely, Drosco will drop an Order of Thunder (this can be a long camp), which you need to take to Wolten Grafe who will give you your Thunder Staff.
Upon Turn in to Wolten Grafe:
You receive a Thunder Staff.

quests.name: Druid Epic Quest
steps: Acquire a Shiny Tin Bowl ( Warning : You must be ready to face Dark Elfs, by starting East Karana part, Nuien trigger Teloa, who trigger Dark Elfs )
Forage the Hardened Mixture
Make a Runecrested Bowl
Trade Stones for an Elaborate Scimitar
Cleanse Spirits
Acquire a Nature Walkers Scimitar!

quests.name: Duster Models
steps: This quest is one of two which follows Series C Black Boxes given by Drekon Vebnebber, located at 866, -475, -30 in the Gemchoppers (Warrior) Hall.
After giving Drekon Vebnebber a Daily Log (Log 5673172):

Duster V (or its placeholders Scrubber IV or Cleaner X) spawn every 4 minutes in the Palace at 788, -177, -30 where it will then walk near to the Steamfont Mountains entrance at -27, 20, -26. After a brief pause, it will proceed to walk to the loom located at 763, 165, -26. After yet another pause, it will then proceed to sprint back to its origin in the Palace where it will despawn. The placeholders are common and Scrubber IV is level 12.
Upon dispatching Duster V, loot a piece of Scrap Metal from its corpse.
You receive 17 copper.

Duster X spawns 1 min after handing Drekon Vebnebber a Daily Log on the wall above the Mines of Malfunction, east of the paddle wheel at 1916, -372, -124. It will immediately sprint south through the tunnel and to the right over the bridge to 1679, -226, -123. After a brief pause it will sprint south to the end of the pier at 1508, -302, -122 and pause again. At this point Duster X will reverse course, walking back to its midpoint location, then sprint from there back to its origin point. He will repeat this cycle until killed.
Upon dispatching Duster X, loot a piece of Scrap Metal from its corpse.
You receive 3 gold, 5 silver, and 8 copper.
Sanfyrd Featherhead is across the river, west of the Mines of Malfunction at 2020, -231, -194
You say, 'Hail, Sanfyrd Featherhead'
Hand Sanfyrd Featherhead the two pieces of Scrap Metal you looted from Duster V and Duster X.
You receive 7 silver pieces.

quests.name: Earthen Boots Quest
steps: Stone Marker from a glyphed guard in Mistmoore
Heart of Stone from a stone skeleton in Lake Rathe
Soiled Boots from a froglok tonta knight in Upper Guk
Cat's Eye Agate

quests.name: Emberfold Exchange

rewards.name: Chapter IV, Of Flame and Frost

steps: You say, 'Hail, Frosti Bramblebrew'
You say, 'What Emberfold Exchange'
You say, 'What ingredients'
You will need the following:
Frostbitten Hide from any mammoth in Everfrost Peaks
Emberberry Cluster from any goblins in Solusek's Eye
Dew of First Light from any willowisp.
Upon turning all three into Frosti Bramblebrew, he will say...
You receive Chapter IV, Of Flame and Frost and a Holiday Gift.

quests.name: Emerald Dragonscale Quest
steps: Qarrgy Scallopgobbler may be found at -805, -400, +76.
You say, 'Hail, Qarrgy Scallopgobbler'

Qarrgy Scallopgobbler sets down several large crustacean shells covered in foreign runes, then extends his large, coarse hands in a gesture of friendship. 'I am pleased to see friendly visitors to our villages. I am the head craftsman of the village. The crustacean shell armor worn by the warriors of our village was crafted by me and by my apprentices. I will craft other materials as well when they are available.'
You say, 'What other materials?'
You say, 'Emerald Dragon Scales.'

Emerald Dragon Scales drop from Wuoshi in the Wakening Land. (Not to be confused with Green Dragon Scales used in the Warrior Epic Quest). Ulthork Tusks drop from various ulthorks in Siren's Grotto and Eastern Wastes. The unstained Fine Plate Breastplate is crafted. Hand in the three items:
Qarrgy Scallopgobbler skillfully crafts the Emerald Dragon Scales into a tunic then hands it to ______ and claps enthusiastically.
You receive an Emerald Dragonscale Tunic.

quests.name: Emerald Warriors' Items
steps: Regren is located at 352, 269, 77 inside the Emerald Warriors Guild.
You say, 'Hail, Regren'
Hand Regren one each of a Ruined Wolf Pelt, Bat Fur, Bone Chips, and a Spiderling Eye.
You receive 2 silver, 2 copper pieces.

quests.name: Emil's Report
steps: Can be completed at dubious, but Emil will not give you the note without indifferent or better faction (sneak works). Note: Charm works to get the quest text and note, but you will get no faction on final turn in if Emil is charmed!
Sentry Emil can be found in Skyshrine at (194, -781), in the room across from Ziglark Whisperwing.
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Emil'
You say, 'I am interested in proving my worth'
You receive Note to Tunare's Court.
Seek out Eysa Florawhisper in The Wakening Land at (-962, -1697).
You say, 'Hail, Eysa Florawhisper'
Hand her the Note to Tunare's Court and ignore her prompt, which is for a different quest.

Eysa Florawhisper says, 'Ahh, why thank you, friend! We are greatful. I believe if we work together, those children of Zek can be driven back in time. Otherwise, survival hangs in the balance, for both of us. Take this token back to the sentry as a symbol of our acceptance.'
You receive Eysa's Token.
Return to Sentry Emil in Skyshrine and give him Eysa's Token.
You receive 1 platinum, 3 gold, 7 silver, 7 copper pieces.

quests.name: Enchant Bonethunder
steps: Note: This quest is pointless on this server, as both the quest item and reward are the same.
After receiving your Bonethunder Staff, Runethar Hamest tells you to go to Kasine Paegra to recharge your (non rechargeable) staff.
You say, 'Will you please enchant bonethunder?'
Kasine Paegra says, 'I am ordered to only enchant the spell when I have both Bonethunder and 500 gold coins.'
Upon turning in your staff and 500gp:
Kasine Paegra says, 'The Rainkeeper has bestowed this weapon with power once more. Take it and defend our temple.'
You will find yourself holding the same staff and 500 less gold coins.
Kasine Paegra
See also:
The Bayle List
Bonethunder Staff Quest

quests.name: Enchanter Epic Quest
steps: Note: It is possible to obtain Enchanters Sack from any of the four masters AND perform ANY of the combines. For example, a sack obtained from Nadia Starfeast CAN COMBINE the items requested by Polzin Mrid. Hand a master Jeb's Seal. They will return it. Then, say, "I need a sack"
Jeb's Seal:
Hail Stofo Olan in Erudin (Must be level 50)
Ink of the Dark
Mechanical Pen
White Paper
Give the Ink of the Dark, the Mechanical Pen, and the White Paper to Stofo Olan in Erudin to get a Copy of Notes.
Give the Copy of Notes to Jeb Lumsed (a sarnak imitator) in Burning Woods to get Jeb's Seal.
1st Piece of Staff -- Test of Illusion:
Kill Vessel Drozlin in Cabilis East and loot the Xolion Rod.
Kill Verina Tomb in Neriak and loot Innoruuk's Word.
Obtain the Chalice of Kings.
Obtain Snow Blossoms in Oggok.
Combine the Chalice of Kings, Xolion Rod, Snow Blossoms and Innoruuk's Word in an Enchanters Sack.
Give the combined sack to Modani Qu`Loni in The Overthere to get the 1st Piece of Staff.
2nd Piece of Staff -- Test of Enlightenment:
Kill Cazel in Oasis to get a Spoon
Pick up the The One Key in the Overthere.
Pick up the Lost Scroll in Dalnir.
Pick up the Book of Charm and Sacrifice in Plane of Sky.
Combine the Spoon, the One Key, the Lost Scroll and the Book of Charm and Sacrifice in an Enchanters Sack.
Give the combined sack to Mizzle Gepple (Clockwork VIIX) in Ak'Anon to get the 2nd Piece of Staff.
3rd Piece of Staff -- Test of Charm:
Obtain the four dull gems from Nadia Starfeast in Firiona Vie.
Charm a Spectral librarian in Kaesora. Give him the Dull Diamond to get the Enchanted Diamond.
Charm Felia Goldenwing in Skyfire. Give her the Dull Sapphire to get the Enchanted Sapphire.
Charm the Wraith of Jaxion in the City of Mist. Give him the Dull Ruby to get the Enchanted Ruby.
Charm Impaler Tzilug in the Overthere. Give him the Dull Emerald to get the Enchanted Emerald.
Combine the Enchanted Diamond, Enchanted Sapphire, Enchanted Ruby and Enchanted Emerald in an Enchanters Sack.
Give the combined sack to Nadia Starfeast in Firiona Vie to get the 3rd Piece of Staff.
4th Piece of Staff -- Test of the Phantasm:
Kill the Wraith of a Shissir in the Plane of Fear and loot Head of the Serpent.
Kill the Ghost of Kindle in The Hole and loot the Essence of a Ghost.
Kill a forsaken revenant in the Plane of Hate and loot the Essence of a Vampire.
Kill The Tangrin in the Field of Bone and loot the Sands of the Mystics.
Combine the Head of the Serpent, Essence of a Ghost, Essence of a Vampire and Sands of the Mystics in an Enchanters Sack.
Give the combined sack to Polzin Mrid in The Hole to get the 4th Piece of Staff.
The Hole: Any Elemental illusion + Collab will make you Dubious (I started apprehensive with this combo) with everything besides rats/undead if you haven't hunted there before.
Staff of the Serpent:
Combine the four pieces of staff in an Enchanters Sack to make a Bundle of Staves.
Give the Bundle of Staves to Jeb Lumsed (a sarnak imitator) in Burning Woods to get the Staff of the Serpent!

quests.name: Entalon's Quest
steps: Charm the dragon Entalon, then:
You say, 'Hail, Entalon'
You say, 'What is your master's quest?'

Hand in the Scribblings (they identify as "Sorcerer Scribblings"), which are dropped by the rare spawn wood elf version of "a pilgrim" in Firiona Vie, and a Stoneleer Emerald Plume, dropped by "a stoneleer cockatrice."
You are teleported to see Atheling Plague.
Need all dialogues, /loc of Entalon, /loc of Atheling Plague, faction hits if any, quest reward(s).

quests.name: Errand for Tonmerk
steps: This quest is given by Tonmerk Plorsin. He's located inside the Temple of Life in North Qeynos at -156, -693.
You say, 'Hail, Tonmerk Plorsin'
You say, 'Who is the Prime Healer?'
You say, 'What is the Academy of Arcane Science'
You say, 'I will pick up a regeant' [sic]
You receive a flask of Inert Potion.
You say, 'Who is Serna Tasknon?'
You say, ' What is shark powder?'
Travel to the Temple of Marr in North Freeport. Serna Tasknon is located at (50,352,59) (at the top of the tower). Give her the Inert Potion.
You receive Shark Powder.
Return to North Qeynos and give the Shark Powder to Tonmerk Plorsin.
You receive between 15 - 25 gold from Tonmerk Plorsin.
You receive Spell: Smite !

quests.name: Errand for Wolten
steps: You may have to do the Drosco the Zombie (good) first to get this. Wolten will give you a scroll to Give To Eestyana Naestra, who is in the Hall of Truth in West Freeport. The reward for this part of the quest is usually a nice item (sometimes a prayer bead necklace).
Upon handing in the item:
You receive 1 platinum from Eestyana Naestra.
Rewards include a Rusty Morning Star.
You say, 'What about the militia?'
Need missing dialogues, /loc of quest mobs, list of quest items, list of additional quest rewards.

quests.name: Erud's Tonic Quest
steps: Geoard BlueHawk is located at -1170, -315 in BlueHawk's in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Geoard BlueHawk'
You say, 'What about a Erud's Tonic?'
You say, 'Can I have some Erud's Tonic?'
You say, 'What about Vasty Deep Water?'
The "KISS" Phloatin mentioned is an Innoruuk's Kiss of Death. Purchase one from Geoard, then find Sinnkin Highbrow at -1045, -255 in the Erudin City Library.
You say, 'Hail, Sinnkin Highbrow'
You say, 'What about Erud's Tonic?'
Give her Innoruuk's Kiss of Death.

quests.name: Erudin Cures
steps: Cipse Tospyr is in the Temple of Divine Light.
You say, 'Hail, Cipse Tospyr'

Cipse Tospyr says, 'Hello, Erudito. I welcome you to the Temple of Divine Light. I am the resident healer. If you should ever require the power of Quellious to [bind wounds], [cure disease] or [cure poison], speak with me and I shall help you.'
You say, 'Bind wounds.'
Cipse Tospyr casts a heal on you.
You say, 'Cure disease.'
Cipse Tospyr casts Cure Disease on you.
You say, 'Cure Poison.'
Cipse Tospyr casts Cure Poison on you.

quests.name: Erudite Prisoners
steps: You say, 'hail an erudite prisoner'

an erudite prisoner angrily rattles his shackles and says 'Damned Kobolds!! Some day I will return and these filthy warrens will be littered with their dog faced corpses! You wouldnt happen to have a key for these shackles would you?' a captured erudite bats her eye lashes seductively. 'I would be immensely pleased if someone would free me from these shackles.'
Go and kill Jailer Mkrarrg and loot the Bronze Shackle Key and give it to the prisoner.
Give the erudite the key

quests.name: Essence Lens Quest
steps: Note: This is a quest that becomes available only AFTER Kerafyrm has been awoken.
Approach a dragon named Melalafen in the Western Wastes (indifferent by default, on the faction Disciples of Kerafyrm).
You say, 'What Prismatic Dragon Scale?"
Find yourself a Prismatic Dragon Scale in Sleeper's Tomb. If The Sleeper has been awakened, any mob in ST will drop it rarely. Handing over just the scale results in:
So hand in your Key, too: (NOTE he requires the actual Sleepers Key, NOT the talisman from the dragons)
The first reward is the Essence Lens.
The Lens can be traded for something else, and repeat that process until you find something to your liking.
From an old post on Allakhazam, it appears the order is: Lens -> Mace -> Sword -> Earring -> Ring -> Lens.

quests.name: Evil Research
steps: Smith Tv'ysa is in the camp in South Ro at loc pos100, pos500.
Note: Although this quest is meant for lvl 16+ casters looking to work on their Research skill, it gives great Neriak faction hits and no negative hits. Requires to be Indifferent or better.

quests.name: Exotic Drinks
steps: You need amiable or higher faction with Clurg. The most common way for non-ogres to attain this is to be a level 8+ Dark Elf Enchanter or level 12+ Enchanter of any race.
Get Kiola Nut
Go to Ocean of Tears. Turn into a Wood Elf and/or cast faction spell on Cleonae Kalen (located at "Sisters Island") to purchase a Kiola Nut
Get Honey Jum
Get 3 Honeycombs by killing Bixies of any kind (a Bixie) in Kithicor Forest or Misty Thicket. Kith seems to be better drop rate.
Go to Rivervale. Turn into a Gnome and/or cast faction spell on Kizzie Mintopp then give her the 3pp (or other denominations) and three Honeycombs, to receive the Honey Jum
Get Erud's Tonic
Purchase Innoruuk's Kiss of Death from vendors in Erudin (recommended and faster) or in Freeport. Cast Human or Erudite illusion and/or faction spell if needed to buy the item.
Go to Erudin. Turn into Human or Erudite and/or cast faction spell on Sinnkin Highbrow (3rd floor of library), give her the Innoruuk's Kiss of Death to receive Erud's Tonic
Get Koalindl Fish (the easy way while avoiding brutal Qeynos faction hits)
Do Frostbite's Fish to avoid faction hits and get many quickly.
If you don't mind Barbarian faction hits, you can kill Frostbite.
If you don't mind large Qeynos faction hits, you can kill A Koalindl in North Qeynos.
Get Barkeep Compendium

Go to Freeport. Turn into a Human and/or cast faction spell on Gregor Nasin (at East Freeport docks). Give Gregor Nasin the Kiola Nut, Honey Jum, Koalindl Fish, and Erud's Tonic all at the same time and receive the Barkeep Compendium
Get Stein of Moggok
Go to Oggok. Turn into a Dark Elf or Ogre and/or cast faction spell on Clurg (located around area 17 of the Oggok map). Give him the Barkeep Compendium to receive the Stein of Moggok
Enjoy your Stein!

quests.name: Experienced Courier
steps: Davorre Bloodthorn can be found in The Fell Blade (863, 444), Paineel's shadow knight guild.
You say, 'Hail, Davorre Bloodthorn'
You say, 'I am experienced.'
You say, 'I am willing to assist.'
You receive a Rolled up Note.
Seek out Veisha Fathomwalker, who is found patrolling in Toxxulia Forest between the hours of 8am-8pm gametime, and give her the Rolled up Note.
You receive Veisha's Engagement Ring.
You say, 'Who is Phaeril?'
You say, 'What position?'
Return to Davorre and give him Veisha's Engagement Ring.
Find Phaeril Nightshire in Toxxulia Forest. He shares a spawn cycle with Veisha and will patrol along her same route between 8pm-8am gametime. Kill him and loot his head.
You have slain Phaeril Nightshire!
--You have looted a Phaeril Nightshire's Head.--
Return to Davorre and give him Phaeril Nightshire's Head.
You receive A Locked Chest.
Travel to Toxxulia Forest one last time to give Veisha A Locked Chest.
You have slain Veisha Fathomwalker!
--You have looted a Veisha Fathomwalker's Head.--
Return to Davorre and give him Veisha Fathomwalker's Head.
You receive a Battle Worn Halberd.

quests.name: Explorer Survival Knives
steps: Speak with Trooper Vaurk in the Lake of Ill Omen, about halfway bewteen Cabilis and the lake shore, at loc 4575.60, -3095.45.
You say, 'Hail, Trooper Vaurk'
You say, 'i am here to assist'
Not far from Trooper Vaurk is a large yellow tower, which was previously uninhabited. It is now occupied with about 6 explorers and a lead explorer.
The explorers were extremely green to a level 51, had about 600 hit points.
You have slain an explorer!
The lead explorer was a paladin, LoHed himself, and took quite a bit more killing, although still a pushover for a 51 warrior.
You have slain a lead explorer!
The explorers dropped ringmail armor, food items, and the occasional Explorer Survival Knife (stackable). Give the knives to Trooper Vaurk:
Need required faction level and name required to get quest.

quests.name: Eye of Stormhammer
steps: The Note:
After finishing the Clockwork Cleaner quest, go to Beno Targnarle in Kaladim.
You say, 'what important stormguard matter?'
You say, 'what eye of stormhammer?'
He will give you a letter (A Sealed Note) to give to the Jail Clerk Maryl near the bank of High Keep.
Of course the prisoner has escaped but she does give Cracked Emerald (part of the eye of stormguard), as well as info that Bronin has the other part, the "Emerald Shard".
Slaythe:
Bronin Higginsbot is sometimes found in Rivervale and sometimes near the southern tower in Misty Thicket.
When you ask Bronin about the Emerald shard, he says he will give it to you if you do a small favor.
You say, 'Where is the emerald shard?'
You say, 'small favor'

Apparently a bounty hunter by the name of Slaythe is after him. He says if you return a piece of his body, he will give you the emerald. Slaythe is beyond the wall in Misty Thicket. He appears to be a Froglok (around level 21 or so)! He hops around between the Orc camp and the wall. You may have to talk to Bronin to get him to spawn. If you defeat him, you get a Froglok Leg (lore item), a few gold, and the following faction adjustments:
Hand Bronin the Froglok Leg:
You receive H.K. 106.
You say, 'What second piece of the gem?'
Strongbox 106:
Bank Clerk Jaylin is in the High Keep underground bank.
Hand Banker Jaylin the H.K. 106.
You receive ~4 gold, 4 silver, 59 copper pieces.
You receive Emerald Shard.
Elmion:
Well... following this clue brings you to Dagnor's Cauldron and Elmion Hendrys at the Fabulous Four NPC-camp there.
You say, 'Hail, Elmion Hendrys'
You say, 'where is faldor?'

He tells you that his brother is a thief (and only his half brother btw...) and that he has gone to Qeynos, probably to work for the thieves guild there. Faldor Hendrys is a rare spawn in north Qeynos, he can be found walking out the front gate, and along the road to the Qeynos Hills zone sometimes. He may also sometimes be found in Crows Tavern.
You have looted Emerald Shard.
Combine the two shards in the Cracked Emerald container to yield the Eye of Stormhammer (Item), which gives you +5 magic, cold and fire protection.
Return to Beno:
Turn in the Eye to Beno in Kaladim.
He then will give you the Dwarven Avenger Battle Axe, a very nice warrior only 2HS weapon. It is likely that you need to have a very high faction with him to get the axe.
Need missing dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of quest mobs.

quests.name: Fabian's Strings
steps: Fabian is located at (14, -749) in East Freeport inside the Grub 'n Grog Tavern.
You say, 'Hail, Fabian'
Give Fabian 2gp and he will say:

Note: If previous questers have over-given gold, you can give him 1cp and it will use up his cached gold, trigger his response and faction hit. (This does not seem to be the case in Legends, anything other than 2g trades does nothing.)
Note: You can stop here if your only goal is faction. The rest of the quest is for level 30+.
Head to Wind Spirits Song, the Bard guild in South Qeynos
You say, 'Hail, Sansa Nusk'
You say, 'Who is Fabian?'
You say, 'What special things?'
You say, 'Where do I get troll guts?'
You need a Bag of Troll Guts which drops off Zahal the Vile in North Karana. Hand them into Sansa.
Receive Lute Strings, hand them in to Fabian back in East Freeport.
You receive 20 silver, 10 gold, 1 platinum from Fabian.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Wings
steps: You say, 'Hail, a storm giant foreman'
You say, 'what task'
Upon turning in both:
Received: Holgresh Mojo Stick (Frost Shock)

quests.name: Fang Tooth (quest)
steps: Kill 2 Wharf Rats
Kill Fang Tooth
Deliver Fang Tooth's tooth

quests.name: Faren's Tacklebox
steps: You say, 'Hail, Guard Beren'
You say, 'What dwarf?'
You say, 'Who is Faren?'
Trumpy Irontoe periodically walks up to Faren.
Faren says 'Huh? What? My [tacklebox]!? You know I can't swim, you rotten [dwarf]!'
You say, 'Hail, Faren'
You say, 'What bait?'
You say, 'What happened to your tacklebox?'
Jump in the water, just on the right side of the dock. The tacklebox looks like a small bag.
You pick up the Wooden Fishing Tackle.
To Trumpy:
You say, 'Who is Skippy?'
Give Faren the tacklebox.
You receive 9 copper from Faren.
You receive Hurrieta's Tunic.

I believe the reward of this quest is a very old misplaced Item ID bug that existed from the beginning. The quest reward and the fact that Hurrieta's Tunic also drops from some fishermen in BBM leads me to think that the intended reward for this quest was a fishing pole but was never fixed. The tunic likely is a remnant of an unimplemented quest as you can see vague hints of it, but it has no real beginning.

quests.name: Feeding Dooga
steps: This is a sub-quest that takes place during the HEHE Meat quest. You can do this quest without going through the HEHE Meat one.
Find Chef Dooga at the "Meet and Drink Tew Bie" tavern in Oggok, at location +200, -240.
You say, 'Hail, Chef Dooga'
You say, 'What is HEHE meat?'

Chef Dooga will not take the more common and universally-dropped Human Parts, High Elf Parts, or Erudite Parts. She will, however, take Human Flesh or High Elf Flesh (Erudite Flesh does not seem to exist). These items drop from the named cycle in Innothule Swamp and the Rathe Mountains.
Upon handing in Human Flesh:
You receive (5 to 9) copper from Chef Dooga.
Upon handing in High Elf Flesh that drops from Jyle Windstorm:
You receive 5 silver pieces.

quests.name: Fern Flower Collection
steps: You say, 'Hail, Jondin'
You say, 'Who is the haggle baron?'
You say, 'What simple mission?'
You say, 'how do I collect fern flowers?'
Fern Flowers are a common drop from any of the "man-eating" plants found in Swamp of No Hope, collect four of them and combine them in the pouch to create a Full Fern Flower Pouch.
Collect 4 'Fern Flower' and combine them in Fern Flower Pouch (to create a Full Fern Flower Pouch).
Give the Full Fern Flower Pouch to Jondin.
Receive: Small amount of coin 1-9 gold, and a Frogskin Shield.

quests.name: Feskr's Supplies
steps: Kerran Fish Oil
Locate and Kill a venomous spikefish found near the beach
Fire Beetle Leg
Locate and Kill a fire beetle found near the zone tunnel
Backpack
Purchase a Backpack from Tiki near the zone tunnel

quests.name: Field Supplies Quest
steps: You say, 'hail Noble Helssen'
You say, 'I am looking for work'
You say, 'I am interested'
He gives you Field Supplies.
You get some cash and a faction adjustment for delivering the Field Supplies. The following is one example.
Barbarian:
a barbarian mercenary is found in Kael Drakkel near Korakaz. Give him the Field Supplies.
also found wandering through Wakening Lands closer to the central part of the zone
a barbarian mercenary says, 'It's about time, whelp. Take your payment and leave, you're scaring away my... clients.'
You receive 3 copper pieces.
You receive 5 silver pieces.
a barbarian mercenary despawns.
Human:
Human Mercenary is found in Wakening Lands wandering between the Kael entrance and the Portal ring. Give him the Field Supplies.
a human mercenary says, 'It's about time, whelp. Take your payment and leave, you're scaring away my... clients.'
You receive 3 copper pieces.
You receive 4 silver pieces.
Human Mercenary despawns.
Troll:
Male Troll mercenaries dont give +Tormax, Female ones do. This quest yields about 7 or 8 faction points for each turnin. Another example follows.
Troll Mercenary is found wandering in Wakening Land in the eastern parts. Give him the Field Supplies.
troll mercenary says, 'Ahh, thank you, Rums. I've been waiting for these supplies for ages.'
You receive 9 gold, 6 silver, 6 copper pieces.
Troll Mercenary despawns.
Ogre:
Ogre Mercenary can be found Wandering the jungle of Wakening Lands inbetween Kael ent and the Wakening Portal. Give him the Field Supplies
Ogre Mercenary says, 'It's about time, whelp. Take your payment and leave, you're scaring away my... clients.'
You receive some coin
Ogre Mercenary despawns
Tier'Dal (Dark Elf):
Teir`Dal Mercenary can be found Wandering the jungle of Wakening Lands inbetween Kael ent and the Wakening Portal. Give him the Field Supplies
Tier'Dal Mercenary says, 'It's about time, whelp. Take your payment and leave, you're scaring away my... clients.'
You receive some coin
Teir`Dal Mercenary despawns
Gnome:
Gnome Mercenary is found in Wakening Lands wandering around the central part of the zone. Give him the Field Supplies.
Gnome mercenary says, 'It's about time, whelp. Take your payment and leave, you're scaring away my... clients.'
You receive 3 copper pieces.
You receive 4 silver pieces.
Gnome Mercenary despawns.

quests.name: Find Lucie Elron
steps: A little girl named Lucie Elron has gone missing. Her father Guard Elron, in Qeynos North, wants someone to look for her. He has already hired some citizens to search for her. It turns out she was eaten by a small gelatinous cube named Cuburt in the Qeynos Aqueducts. All now that remains of her is the Small Tattered Dress. If you find this, you may return it to either Guard Elron himself, or one of his hired men, Zamel or Endric (both found in Qeynos South).
This quest can start with any of those three people. The quest dialogue of each of the three:
Guard Elron (Qeynos North)
You say, 'Hail, Guard Elron'
You say, 'Who is Lucie?'
Handing in the Small Tattered Dress to Guard Elron shows this:
You receive 3 silver from Guard Elron.
Reward: experience, money, Golden Locket.
Zamel (Qeynos South)
You say, 'Hail, Zamel'
You say, 'What aqueducts?'
You say, 'What beasts?'
You say, 'What child?'
Handing in the Small Tattered Dress to Zamel shows this:
Reward: experience, Hematite or rarely Golden Ear Stud.
Endric (Qeynos South)
You say, 'What aqueducts?'
You say, 'what beasts?'
You say, 'What child's fate?'
(No response from Endric)
Handing in the Small Tattered Dress to Endric shows this:
Reward: experience, Hematite or rarely Golden Ear Stud.

quests.name: Fire Beetle Eyes
steps: Noxhil V`Sek may be found at the top of the necromancers guild (1304, -1248).
You say, 'Hail, Noxhil V`Sek'
You say, 'What menial tasks?'
You say, 'Collecting fire beetle eyes?'
At apprehensive faction:
At amiable or better faction:
You receive an Empty Box.
Combine 10 x Fire Beetle Eyes in the crate to craft a Box of Beetle Eyes.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new!
Hand in the Box of Beetle Eyes to Noxhil V`Sek.
You receive 16 silver from Noxhil V`Sek.

quests.name: Fire Goblin Runner
steps: This quest requires amiable or better faction.
Narex T`Vem may be found in the warriors guild.
You say, 'Hail, Narex T`Vem'
You say, 'What duties?'
You say, 'I will accept the mission.'

Head to Lavastorm Mountains, kill a Goblin Runner and loot its Goblin Supply Pouch. The Goblin Runner paths through the goblin camp above Solusek over towards druid ring. *killed at loc (989,1165)*. Turn this in to Narex.
Need cut-off level to receive quest, minimum faction to receive quest

quests.name: First Test of Kejaar
steps: Emissary Head
Locate and Kill an Erudin Emissary
Return to Shazda Asad

quests.name: Fish Dinner
steps: Raw Darkwater Piranha
Locate and Kill a darkwater piranha roams entirety of the bay between Kerra Isle and Toxxulia Forest
Return Roary Fishpouncer

quests.name: Fisherman Convert
steps: Dleria Mausrel is located at -1070, -415 in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Dleria Mausrel'
You say, 'I am a new priest.'
You say, 'I will convert fishermen in Qeynos.'
Marlin Bizmite is located at 0, +55 in South Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Marlin Bizmite'
You say, 'Do you wish the Blessing of Prexus?'
You can enter the catacombs by diving into the aforementioned pond. Bait Masterson is located at +865, +90 in Qeynos Catacombs.
You say, 'Hail, Bait Masterson'
You say, 'Do you wish the Blessing of Prexus?'
Give him your Old Blue Tunic*, obtained by handing your starting "A tattered note" to your Deepwater guildmaster in Erudin, either Weligon Steelherder for Paladins or Gans Paust for Clerics
You receive a Snapped Pole. Return to Dleria Mausrel and hand in the Snapped Pole.
You receive 5 gold from Dleria Mausrel. You receive a minor item.
Need list of quest rewards; names, /locs, dialogues and faction hits for any other mobs that can be converted.

quests.name: Fleshy Orbs
steps: Priestess Caulria in the temple in North Qeynos (-132, -611), and requires you to look into the occurrence of rabid wolves in the area. Rabid wolves and bears are found in the Qeynos Hills and also in West Karana will occasionally drop Fleshy Orbs. Return one of the orbs to Caulria:
NOTE: You must con amiable or above to do this quest! (She will not return the orb if you attempt turn-in below amiable)

You will receive some gold and a returned Fleshy Orb (item lore: Odd Tumor returned), which you need to deliver to West Freeport. Lorme Tredore is at the top of Academy of Arcane Science and will reward you with a fine steel weapon, experience and some coin upon turning receiving the orb.

NOTE: You must con amiable or above to do this quest! -- You do not need to be amiable to do the Lorme Tredore (Freeport hand in) portion of the quest. I just did it at apprehensive and he gave me the positive faction hits. Not sure about the Caulria side as I was amiable to her.
You receive 5 gold, 12 silver pieces.
You receive a fine steel weapon.

quests.name: Fresh Baked Muffins (Kaladim)
steps: Gretta Mottle is located at 196, 298, 3 inside Irontoe's Eats during the hours of 6am to 8pm. During the overnight hours, Gretta despawns from Norrath and is replaced by her assistant, Buggle Palkin.
You say, 'Hail, Gretta Mottle'
You say, 'I will help to bake'
You say, 'I will help bake muffins'
You receive Muffin Crate
Fill the Muffin Crate with 10 unstacked Muffins that were baked and Combine them to receive a Full Muffin Crate
Hand the Full Muffin Crate back to Gretta (Or deliver it to a different town see Muffin Quests)
Gretta Mottle smells the aroma in the air and says, 'Mmm... Mmm... That sure smells good. You truly are a fine baker. Here, take this payment for such fine bakin.'
You receive 7 gold pieces.

quests.name: Fresh Baked Muffins (Qeynos)
steps: The current edition of the Qeynos newspaper suggested speaking with Qeynos Merchants and the Coalition of Tradefolk about how we can help in the current famine.
Speak to Karn or Voleen Tassan in Voleen's Bakery in South Qeynos.
The conversation with Karn:
You say, 'Hail, Karn Tassen'
You say, 'I am a baker.'
You say, 'What muffin supply?'
Take the Box and fill it with 10 UNSTACKED baked Muffins and combine. It becomes Full Muffin Crate. (Obviously, you need to baking skill for this).
Give the box back to Karn for some gold (I got 2gp and 4gp) and faction changes.

quests.name: Friend of the Kin
steps: You say, "Hail, Sentry Kale"
You say, "I wish to become a friend of the kin"
You must now travel to Kael Drakkel and find Wenglawks Kkeak located at #4 on the map.
Go inside the building with invisibility and give him Note to Wenglawks from Sentry Kale and 100 platinum to receive a Dispelling Device.
If you are brave enough, you can hand him the stuff in there with a lot of giants around -OR- You can wait outside since he does come out from the room and walk up the corridor.
Return to Skyshrine and give the Dispelling Device to Sentry Rotiart.

Prepare for a fight as Sentry Rotiart is in fact A krom zek spy! He is a belly caster, but otherwise not notably resistant to magic. Other NPCs in the room will not aggro him. Once you have killed him, he will drop a Spy Report. Loot and turn it in to Sentry Kale to receive faction and Dragon Tooth Choker.

quests.name: Friend of the Tunarean Court
steps: In the faun building that leads to the Plane of Growth, there is a named faun called Shamus Aghllsews.
You say, 'Hail, Shamus Aghllsews'
You say, 'I pledge friendship.'
Give him the 4 Kromrif Laborer Picks...
He gives you an Empty Crest Case, a size SMALL 6-slot container.

Go into the Wakening Lands and talk to the various subjects of Tunare that reside there. Each Crest requires a rather lengthy subquest to collect. Turn in mobs Countess Silveana, Lord Gossimerwind, and Lord Prismwing have PH that give negative tunare faction (which is needed) so you'll need someone else to take the hit. The 6 crests are:
Crest of the Wood Nymphs Quest
Tell Eysa Florawhisper in Wakening Land "I will gather seeds for you." to get a Empty Seed Collection Bag
Forage the following and combine them in the bag
Misty Acorn: foraged or picked up off ground in Misty Thicket
Emerald Orange: Emerald Jungle
Bag of Caynar Nuts: Toxxulia Forest
Vineclinger Berries: Butcherblock Mountains (no drop)
Ripened Heartfruit: Greater Faydark (no drop)
Rathe Berries: Lake Rathe
Marr Cherries: Ocean of Tears
Flarefire Seeds: Field of Bone (no drop)
Give the combined Bag of Seeds to Eysa Florawhisper
Crest of the Unicorn Quest
Kill Lithiniath in Plane of Mischief, give her horn to a white stallion (nearby)
Crest of the Sifaye Quest
Kill A storm giant surveyor in Wakening Lands and loot a Kromzek Surveyor Scope
Give the Kromzek Surveyor Scope to Countess Silveana in Wakening Lands
Crest of the Fauns Quest
Kill a storm giant architect and loot Kromzek Architect Blueprints.
Turn them in to Shamus Aghllsews and get an Empty Sulfur Collection Bag (4 slot container) and also a Bag of Crushed Herbs (not actually a container).
Fill the container with 4 Crystallized Sulfur and combine to make a Bag of Sulfur.

Go to Kael and "trade" those two bags with bags of supplies (found in ruined buildings in Kael). ** Note: This mob now comes up nameless, and has name ? in the trade screen. Upon turn-in, hit me for 197 and the rubble appeared as a 3rd bag groundspawn.
After the resulting explosion (may kill you) pick up Pile of Rubble and bring it back to Shamus Aghllsews
Crest of the Drixie Quest
Kill Yvolcarn in Cobalt Scar and loot Drixie Remains
Give the Drixie Remains to Lord Prismwing in Wakening Lands
Crest of the Faerie Dragons Quest
Slay A Storm Giant Foreman in Wakening Lands and loot the Kromzek Foreman Helm
Give the Kromzek Foreman Helm to Lord Gossimerwind in Wakening Lands (in Geonid Caves)

Follow the links for the subquests needed to obtain these. After getting all 6 crests, combine them in the empty case. This creates a Case of Tunarean Crests. Hand this back to Shamus for your reward.

quests.name: Froglock Tadpole Fleshies
steps: Talk to the Shaman Master, Zulort, and say "me Gonna Help!"
He'll give you a simple quest to get 4 Froglock Tadpole Fleshies. Requires Higher than Indifferent faction.
Hand him 4 Froglok Tadpole Flesh (stacked is fine, can also give any size stack as long as it divides evenly by 4)
You Receive Spell: Burst of Flame.

quests.name: Froglok Skin Mask Quest
steps: Treskar is found in the Shadowknights Guild in Grobb.
You say, 'Hail, Treskar'
You say, 'I sent by Hukulk'
You say, 'What secret mission?'
Hand in Huge Mushroom Head.

quests.name: Froglok Tad Tongues
steps: Captain Nedar can be found on a second floor balcony (2645, 3030) near Cabilis during daytime hours.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Nedar'
Hunt froglok tads in the area and collect 4 foglok tad tongues for Captain Nedar.
You receive 7 copper from Captain Nedar.

quests.name: Frostbite's Fish
steps: You must be amiable faction or higher with Enic Ruklin to do this quest.
Enic Ruklin may be found at the Temple of Life roaming around the pool.
You say, 'Hail, Enic Ruklin'
You say, 'What problem?'
You say, 'What about the Pool of Jahnda?'
You say, 'What are the Koalindl?'
You say, 'What about Frostbite?'

Frostbite can be found at the Barbarian fishing village in West Karana. Watch out! Ulrich McMannus is very fond of the mutt and will attack if he sees you harming Frostbite. Killing him causes severe faction drops with several barbarian factions. (Confirmed that Frostbite drops the fish on both Green and Blue)
Alternatives to killing:

There are two other ways to get the fish corpse. You can also complete this quest by killing Koalindl fish yourself or through a newbie mule character (which is the better method), taking the severe faction hit, getting killed by the guard, and turning in the fish corpse to Ruklin.
Regurg:
Or you can do The Regurgitonic quest in Ak'Anon and feed Frostbite the Regurgitonic, which will cause him to cough up the fish corpse with no loss of faction.

As of November 20th 2019 Frostbite does NOT cough up the fish every time. Out of 8 turn in's the fish was provided 5 of those times. Gnome Agnostic Enchanter doing turn in. (Note 6/17/21 - This is because sometimes Kimble gives you a 'Bad Regurgitonic'. Identify will tell you the item lore and let you know if you got a bad one.)
Frostbite spits something into your hand.
You receive a Koalindl Fish.
Turn-in:
The faction for this turn in massive. I went from a couple points into amiable to Kindly in 3 turn ins. 5 to get ally on an Iksar Monk. (11/2018)
As of March, 2025, from 1 point into Amiable, 6 turn-ins still leaves you at Kindly. The 7th turn-in takes you from Kindly into Warmly. It looks like the Priests of Life increase is 100.

quests.name: Fusibility Research
steps: Fusible Coral Ore - Phinigel Autropos in Kedge Keep
Fusible Earthen Ore - Master Yael in The Hole
Fusible Igneous Ore - Ground spawn by the large volcano in Skyfire Mountains around
Fusible Velium Ore - A large air elemental named Guardian Kozzalym in Western Wastes

quests.name: Garath's Weapons to Trade
steps: This simple quest provides a new one-handed sword with enhanced ratio for knights or a hand-to-hand weapon for monks in exchange for a primal or priceless weapon from Sleeper's Tomb.
You say, 'Hail, Garath the Trader'
You say, 'What weapons to trade?'
You say, 'What Monk?'
You say, 'What Knight?'
Upon turning in either Primal Velium Battlehammer, Priceless Velium Battlehammer, Primal Velium Warsword or Priceless Velium Warsword: --- Hammer = Fist Wraps and Swords = Knight Sword

quests.name: Gathering Grain
steps: Henina Miller may be found at -2855, -5840. Dubious faction is sufficient to complete the quest. A Troll Shaman of Cazic-thule is able to complete it.
You say, 'Hail, Henina Miller'
You say, 'What scarecrows?'
You say, 'Who is Cleet?'

Cleet Miller will periodically drop a Sack of Hay. If you see him standing still in one location for 30 seconds or so, you will get the message "Cleet Miller begins to gather hay." A Sack of Hay will spawn on the ground. One such location is -3280, -5460. The Sack of Hay rots pretty quickly, so grab it as soon as he drops it. Scarecrows also sometimes drop a sack of hay (as loot, not dropped on the ground) when killed.
Give the Sack of Hay to Henina Miller.
You receive 1 gold, 5 silver, 4 copper pieces.

quests.name: Gearheart (Quest)
steps: Baxok Curhunter is at location 851, -436 in Ak'Anon.
You say, 'Hail, Baxok Curhunter'
You say, 'I am a new recruit.'
You say, 'I will serve the Crown.'
Gearheart is a clockwork gnome found in Lesser Faydark
You have slain Gearheart!
--You have looted a Blackbox XIVD.--
You receive 4 silver from Baxok Curhunter.
You receive a random low-level item.

quests.name: Gem Inlaid Gauntlets Quest
steps: This quest begins with Umvera Dekash in North Qeynos. He can be found in Crow's Tavern.
You say, 'Hail, Umvera Dekash'
You say, 'I am interested in something other than spell scrolls'
You say, 'I have something to offer'
You say, 'I have the time to gather information for you'

Head to Southern Karana and collect four different Tanned Split Paw Skin (lore) scrolls. These are LORE items and look like rolled up scrolls. When you right click you can read the message written on them if you are fluent in gnoll. But even those unversed in gnoll can notice the number on the page. Collect scroll Volume 1, 2, 3, and 4, and return them to Umvera in Qeynos:
You receive Tesch Val Compilation (LORE, tradable)
Jheron Felkis is located in East Freeport in the building "Velith and Bardo's" (third floor). Hand him the Tesch Val Compilation.
You say, 'Hail, Jheron Felkis'
NOTE: his text is different that what is posted on ZAM, and he does not respond if you say 'what shipment of books?' Turn in the compliation you got from Umvera, no additional text is needed.
You receive the Pawbook. You can open it up and read it (8 pages of text).
Take Pawbook back to Umvera in Qeynos.
recieve a note
Durkis Battlemore is in the Butcherblock Mountains inside one of the guard buildings: location 2072, 400 (on the path leading from the dock, just before Kaladim).Give him the note.
You say, 'Hail, Durkis Battlemore'
You receive Gem Inlaid Gauntlets.

quests.name: Geozite Tool Quest
steps: Drill Master Vygan:
Drill Master Vygan may be found in Fortress Talishan.
You say, 'Hail, Drill Master Vygan'
You say, 'What militia pike?'
You say, 'What geozite tool?'
You say, 'I want a geozite tool.'
You receive a 2-slot Pincer Satchel. Kill a large scorpion in the center of the Field of Bone to loot a Large Scorpion Pincer. Combine 2 in the satchel:
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Full Pincer Satchel.
Bring this back to Drill Master Vygan.
You then receive a random Note to Iksar Lord to be delivered to one of three warlords.
Each warlord gives you a sub-quest to complete to receive your Geozite Tool. You only need to complete 1.
Warlord Hikyg in the Swamp of No Hope gives the quest to collect Busted Froglok Slave Shackles.
Warlord Zyzz in the Field of Bone gives the quest to collect charred bones.
Warlord Vyzer in Warslik Woods to collect stolen pages.
Their respective notes identify as "Note to Lord Hikyg," and "Note to Lord Vyzer," and "Note to Lord Zyzz."
You may turn in as many full pincer satchels as you'd like in order to receive your desired Warlord note.
Warlord Hikyg:
You say, 'Hail, Warlord Hikyg'
Give him the note.
You receive an 8-slot Slave Shackle Bag
You say, 'I am prepared to hunt escaped froglok slaves'
Fill the Slave Shackle Bag with 8 Busted Froglok Slave Shackles and combine to form a Filled Slave Shackle Bag.
Give the filled bag to Warlord Hikyg.
You receive 1 gold pieces.
You receive the Geozite Tool.
Warlord Zyzz:
Turn in the note to Warlord Zyzz
You receive a 4-slot Charred Bone Box.
Fill it with Charred Bone Shards and combine to form a Full Charred Bone Box.
Give this to Warlord Zyzz
You receive 1 gold pieces.
You receive the Geozite Tool.
Warlord Vyzer:
Warlord Vyzer may be found at -1852, -894, +307, on the balcony of building in Warsliks Woods, just outside West Cabilis.
You say, 'Hail, Warlord Vyzer'
Give him the note.

You receive a Book Binder, a 4-slot container (identifies as "Binder for Love Poem"). Kill a goblin thief who may be found mostly between the succor point (-1430, -465) and the goblin pond (-2180, 900).
11/04/24 -- a goblin scout also drops the pages and these are far more common than the theif mobs, easily farmable in a triangle pattern between Cabilis, pond, and zone wall.
Loot four different LORE versions of A Page of A Poem (they identify as "Page One of Love Poem," "Page Two of Love Poem," "Page Three of Love Poem," and "Page Four of Love Poem," respectively.
Combine the four pages in the binder: You have fashioned the items together to create something new: magically locked poem.
It identifies as "Love Poem by Lord Vyzer." Give it to Warlord Vyzer.
You receive the Geozite Tool.

quests.name: Gharin's Note (evil)
steps: Find Nomaria Doseniar located in the Qeynos Aqueducts at loc 347, -614 (Optional)
You say, 'Hail, Nomaria Doseniar' (even at Dubious she responded)
You say, 'I wish to serve.'
Find Gharin in South Qeynos hanging near the Bag n Barrel and sometimes wandering to his room on the third floor of the Lion's Mane Inn.
You say, 'Hail, Gharin'
You say, 'What job?'
You say, 'What is Jaggedpine?'
You say, 'What is Lion's Mane'
Hand Gharin 4 Crows Special Brew to receive the letter.

Note: There are two kinds of Crow's Special Brew in the game. Crow's Special Brew with an ' Apostrophe in the name that comes from Tattered Pouch quest will not be accepted by Gharin. The correct kind Crows Special Brew is purchased from Crow himself, but this is a limited supply item (20). Once he sells out, its all gone until the server is restarted or he respawns after being killed.
Update for EQL 2026-08-10: The above italics appear incorrect. i purchased Crow's Special Brew with the Apostrophe on a public layer, which was **NOT** quantity limited and Gharin took it.
You receive 1 - 2 silver
You receive A Sealed Letter
Return to Nomaria Doseniar and hand her the Sealed Letter
You receive 8 silver
You receive: Sealed Letter [Note To Jaggedpine - fake] which reads:

Te'Anara, I Regret to inform you that my city shall not impose the tax increase for bearskins as you requested. Furthermore, we shall not be arresting poachers for extradition to the Jaggedpine. Signed, Antonius Bayle
Go to Surefall Glade (aka Jaggedpine) and find Te`Anara at loc -209, -441 to hand her the Sealed Letter

quests.name: Gharin's Note (good)
steps: Gharin regards you indifferently -- You could probably win this fight. Your Location is 465.42, -316.99, 5.61
You say, 'Hail, Gharin'
You say, 'What job?'
You say, 'Where is the Jaggedpine?'
You say, 'What is the Lion's Mane?'

Note: There are two kinds of Crow's Special Brew in the game. Crow's Special Brew with an ' Apostrophe in the name that comes from Tattered Pouch quest will not be accepted by Gharin. The correct kind Crows Special Brew is purchased from Crow himself.
Give the four brews to Gharin.
You receive 1 silver from Gharin.
You receive A Sealed Letter (identifies as "Note To Jaggedpine"). It reads:
Te'Anara,
I have spoken to the merchants guild of Qeynos. We have agreed to increase the tax on all bearskins.
The Qeynos Guard shall also be apprehending all known poachers for extradition to the Jaggedpine.
Signed, Antonius Bayle
You have entered The Surefall Glade. Your Location is -209.08, -441.05, 6.36
You say, 'Hail, TeAnara'
Give her the letter.
You receive 2 gold from TeAnara.
This leads into the Plaguebringer Proof quest

quests.name: Giant Helmets
steps: (Worked with Dubious Faction)
Your Location is 693.97, 13.27, 69.41

(He is upstairs in the room before #12 on the Icewell Keep map. Walk the pathway over the ice. Open the portcullis and go inside. Take the second left or right hallway stairs leading up to another room. In that room, take either stairwell up again. He is to the north in the uppermost room with some other named Dwarves.
You say, 'Hail, Chamberlain Krystorf'
Dialogues?
Chamberlain Krystorf wants you to bring him four Giant Warrior Helmets. These are dropped by various Giants in Kael Drakkal. Hand in four:
You receive 20 platinum from Chamberlain Krystorf.
Note: 56 helms (14 turn ins) took a toon with 0 previous faction work from Apprehensive to Kindly with Coldain, and from Dubious to Amiable with Dain.
The experience gained is significant, at least at low levels: a level 15 halfling cleric got 10% per turn-in.

quests.name: Gindlin's Poison
steps: Gindlin Toxfodder can be found in a small hut next to some farmers at (-2986, -13398) in the Western Plains of Karana.
You say, 'Hail, Gindlin Toxfodder'
You say, 'What is death juice?'
Collect the following for Gindlin:
2 Spider Venom Sacs (common drop from giant spiders in the area)
1 Crows Special Brew (purchased from Crow in North Qeynos; limited quantity)
20 gold pieces (must be gold)
Upon turn-in:
You receive Spider Venom.

quests.name: Gleed's Bow
steps: At apprehensive con, he responds "You need to prove your dedication to our cause before I can discuss such matters with you." And will eat your tail. Indifferent faction achieved by sneaking behind him and turning in worked.
You say, 'hail Gleed Dragonhunter'
Gleed Dragonhunter sighs as he looks down at you. 'I grow tired of this city. I so long for the tundra and lands of the wild.'
You say, 'what tundra and lands of the wild?'
You say, 'what young dragons and elder wurms?'
You say, 'what bow?'

Gleed Dragonhunter unslings an intricately carved bow from his back and shows it to you. 'I crafted this bow myself. It was to be a great slayer of wurms and dragons and it was, for a time. Now it goes to waste in the city, far from the beasts I long to slay. Far from the hunt and the excitement.'
You say, 'what waste?'
You say, 'I will hunt the beasts'
Give Vluudeen's Tail to Gleed Dragonhunter.
Vluudeen is a wurm that can be found in the Great Divide who always drops the tail. Turning the tail in with indifferent faction or better yields Bow of the Huntsman.

quests.name: Gloves of Earthcrafting Quest
steps: (Must be level 46+ and must worship Tunare.)
You say, 'Hail, Tunarean Earthmelder' (He is at -447, -2484)
You say, 'What giants?'
You say, 'I am a preserver'
You need the heads off the following four giants:
Priest Grenk - roams in the Wakening Land. 24h Respawn
Priest Bjek - roams in the Wakening Land. 24h Respawn
Priest Delar - roams in the Wakening Land. 24h Respawn
Derakor the Vindicator - found behind the ice wall near Kael's temple. Bring a few friends..
Return the four heads for the Gloves of Earthcrafting.

quests.name: Gnasher's Head
steps: Larsk Juton is located at 244, -18 in Surefall Glade.
You say, 'Hail, Larsk Juton'
You say, 'What are Sabertooths?'
You say, 'What pact?'
You say, 'I will halt this meeting.'
Gnasher Furgutt may be found in Qeynos Hills pacing around outside of Blackburrow.
You say, 'Hail, Gnasher Furgutt'
Kill him to loot his Gnoll Head, which can be identified as "Gnasher's Head," and head back to Larsk. If a tattered note drops, loot it as well.
Upon turning in the Gnoll Head:
(Roughly 2% at level 12)
You receive gold, silver, and copper, and a random piece of low-level armor (Raw Hide Tunic).
Upon turning in a tattered note (#1):
You receive gold, silver, and copper from Larsk
You receive another note with the same name, flagged as a new note.

NOTE: On 7/12/2019, Larsk handed the note back but did not mention Captain Tillin. After a second turn-in with the handed-back note (tried because there was no dialogue), he eats the note. Tried with amiable faction, got new note March 29, 2020
Go to the South Qeynos Arena and turn in this other note to Captain Tillin.
Upon turning in a tattered note (#2):
You receive 6 platinum, 9 gold, and 1 silver from Captain Tillin.
You receive Medal of Merit (CHA +5), and an NPC called Executioner spawns.
Conclusion:
You say, 'executioner'
You say, 'Field Marshall Ralem'
You say, 'Hail, Executioner'
The Executioner kills McNeal Jocub
__NOTOC__

quests.name: Gnoll Bounty
steps: Note: Lysbith and the other warriors do NOT like wolf form. They will still be KOS.
Lysbith McNaff is one of the warrior guildmasters found in the Pit of Doom within Halas (/loc 566, -412). You say, 'Hail, Lysbith McNaff'
Lysbith McNaff says, 'Hail! Ye've come to [serve Halas], have ye not? We're the Wolves o' the North and it is our task to defend our city from harm.'
You say, 'I serve Halas.'
Response if you're a non-warrior class... (triggers for The Seax and Ice Goblin Necklace quests).
Lysbith McNaff says, 'Halas is surrounded by barren arctic tundra. We've many foes. Among them are the [orc troopers], [ice goblins] and the ever-present polar bears.'
Response if you're a warrior... (but you can still use the trigger phrase to get the gnoll bounty dialogue)
Lysbith McNaff says, 'The Wolves o' the North show ye no ill will, but there's much ye must do to earn our trust. Perhaps ye should inquire o' the [gnoll bounty].'
You say, 'What gnoll bounty?'
You'll receive 2-5 gold and a minor item as well.

quests.name: Gnoll Fur
steps: Start with Cappi McTarnigal who's on the second floor of the Halas bank (/loc 204, 172). You say, 'Hail, Cappi McTarnigal'
Cappi McTarnigal says, 'Hail there, ! If you are not a [member of the White Rose], then it be best that you stay on the lower level. This here floor is for honest ...ermm respectable rogues only.'
You say, 'member of the White Rose'
If your faction with the White Rose isn't high enough...
Cappi McTarnigal says, 'I will take these as a donation for I can only reward those who are 'respectable.
At "indifferent" (or better) faction...

Cappi McTarnigal says, 'I hope that you are indeed respectable, and loyal to Halas and the Rogues of the White Rose. To do otherwise would bring the wrath of the Six Hammers down on you. But enough with talk! Our caravan to the frigid north leaves in less than two days, and we are short on mammoth calf hides. Return four of them and you will be given items that show your loyalty to our Clan.'

Ysanna MacGibbon says, 'The mammoth calf hides are used to shield our beasts of burden from the icy wind. You are probably now asking what shields us Northmen from that same icy wind eh? Well, along with many other furs and leathers, we have come to find that [Gnoll Fur] of all things is a good insulator against the cold. Look at their tiny bodies and it's obvious their fur does something good.' Next, target Ysanna who's standing close by (/loc 184, 157)... You say, 'gnoll fur'

Ysanna MacGibbon says, 'You should not be asking where or what a gnoll is, but asking how I make use of that patch fur I find on their corpse. It is quite simple, take four pieces of gnoll fur and sew them together. Take the result and sew four of them together. And again with that product. In the end you will have a bundle of tailored gnoll fur. You can either return it to me or keep it for yourself.' Now, head out to Everfrost Peaks or Blackburrow to loot Patch of Gnoll Fur from various gnolls. Once you've collected at least 64 furs, you can begin the crafting process (via Tailoring) into d…
Tailoring Details:
You'll need Tailoring skill level of around 31 for consistent combines.
Combine 4 Patch of Gnoll Fur to yield 1 Gnoll Fur Patch.
Combine 4 Gnoll Fur Patch to yield 1 Gnoll Fur Patch Quarter.
Combine 4 Gnoll Fur Patch Quarter to yield 1 Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle.
Now, give Ysanna the Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle. Ysanna MacGibbon says, 'You have done well. Here is a small reward for your effort.'
You receive ~1 platinum, 3 silver from Ysanna MacGibbon.
Reward is: Fang of the Wolf

quests.name: Gnoll Paws
steps: /loc of Corun Finisc? Roams.
You say, 'Hail, Corun Finisc'
You say, 'Who are the inhabitants?'
You say, 'Who is Tunare?'
You say, 'Who is destroying them?'
You say, 'What gnolls?'
You say, 'Reward?'
On handing in Gnoll Paw to Corun Finisk.
You receive 8 copper from Corun Finisk.

You receive 2 gold from Corun Finisk.
Lynaria saved.

quests.name: Gnoll Scalp Collecting
steps: Captain Orben is found around the northern guard lookout/arch/bridge area, near the zoneline with Eastern Plains of Karana. He's often surrounded by gnolls.
Captain Orben collects Gnoll Scalps. He will give you some coins from 4sp up to 1pp and experience. You will raise faction with these groups:
You may turn in up to four at once.
This is a great way to improve faction with the shadier groups without losing any with the good groups.

quests.name: Gnomish Toy
steps: kerran tseq is located at +230, -150 on Kerra Isle.
You say, 'Hail, kerran tseq'
You say, 'What toy?'
OPTIONAL: Nilit Druzlit is a gnome found in Steamfont Mountains.
You say, 'Hail, Nilit Druzlit'
You say, 'What creation?'
Nilit's contraption wanders Steamfont Mountains. Kill it and loot a Gnome Tinkered Toy. Bring it back to the kerran tseq.
Reward: Kerran Toy

quests.name: Goblin Battlemasters
steps: Captain Keatar is located at -3440, 3320 in the Ranger guild building.

You get this after completing the goblin raider quest. The captain now wants you to hunt goblin battlemasters. They sometimes drop Goblin Bracers. Bring him 4 of these and you will receive a random piece of Faydark Ringmail Armor, which has the same AC as ringmail/chainmail, plus stat modifiers (+CHA).
Captain Keatar says, 'Good work!! Please accept this piece of armor. It was crafted in Felwithe for the swiftly moving rangers of this outpost.'
You get the following faction changes:
(Amount not noticeable at level 20.)

quests.name: Goblin Caster Necklace
steps: This quest is given to you by Shamus Felligan (he is outside the Shaman's guild). The activation sentence is "I will hunt the goblin casters".

Ice Goblin Casters spawn in one location in and are an uncommon spawn. They can be found by following the right side wall after leaving the one guard area. Eventually, you will come across two igloos. Casters and Scouts spawn here.
About 1 out of every 4 spawns is a caster, and about 1 in 10 drop the Shattered Caster Beads and 1 in 10 of those drop Caster Beads .

The items dropped can be either Shattered Caster Beads, or more rarely, Caster Beads. If you bring the Shattered Caster Beads to Shamus, you receive faction with the guild, experience, coin, and a minor item.

If you return the Caster Beads, you receive a Gavel of Justice. It might be worth considering that the weapon you can summon using the symbol granted by the Tribunal Initiate quest does not grant mana, but it is a better melee weapon.
If you return the Shattered Caster Beads:
Faction increase: Merchants of Halas, Shamen of Justice
Faction decrease: Hall of the Ebon Mask, Coalition of Tradefolk, Circle of Unseen Hands

quests.name: Goblin Raiders
steps: Captain Keatar may be found at -3440, 3320 in the Ranger guild building.

Captain Keatar tells you that the goblin raiders have been quite a nuisance to his trackers. Bring him proof that you have taken at least four of these beasts down and you will earn the respect of this outpost and insure your well being. The raiders and other goblins sometimes drop Red Headbands.
Captain Keatar says, 'Hail!! Beware of the [goblin raiders] roaming the plains outside of Firiona Vie. They have cause much trouble and continue to assault this outpost.'

Captain Keatar says, 'The goblin raiders have been quite a nuisance to my trackers. I implore you to aid my men and lessen the presence of the vile beasts. Bring me proof that you have taken at least four of these raiders down. You shall earn the respect of this outpost and insure your own well-being.'
Note: if you don't hand in all four headbands at once he will eat them.
Handing in the four Red Headbands gets you:

Captain Keatar says, 'You serve this outpost well. Here is a small reward. You should try and hunt down Goblin Battlemasters. I have very few resources to send into the plains to track them down. Perhaps you can help us.'
Need list of quest rewards.

quests.name: Going Postal
steps: This quest covers every town in Norrath, as well as some non-town areas. The reward varies (at whim) between 1gp and 15gp, with values in the middle more usual. With a couple of deliveries, low-level characters could get a few platinum easily. Bards with Selo's Accelerando are really in good shape, as some of these routes can be done in only a few minutes.
The quest is sponsored by the League of Antonican Bards. Faction hits are...
Note: if you are delivering several packages at once, make sure to hand them in one at a time, otherwise you will only get credit for one of them.

quests.name: Going Postal (Felwithe to Kelethin)
steps: Tacar Tissleplay is located at -90, -326, 3 outside Faydarks Bane.
You say, 'Hail, Tacar Tissleplay'
You say, 'What mail'
You say, 'I am interested'
You say, 'I will deliver mail to Kelethin'
You receive A Bardic Letter (Kelethin).
Jakum Webdancer is located at -229, 265, 77 in the Kelethin Bard Guild hall.
Hand Jakum Webdancer A Bardic Letter (Kelethin).
You receive (between 1 and 11) gold pieces.

quests.name: Going Postal (Kaladim to Kelethin)
steps: Kilam Oresinger is located at 105, 223, 3 outside Pub Kal.
You say, 'Hail, Kilam Oresinger'
You say, 'What mail'
You say, 'I am interested'
You say, 'I will deliver mail to Kelethin'
You receive A Bardic Letter (Kelethin).
Jakum Webdancer is located at -229, 265, 77 in the Kelethin Bard Guild hall.
Hand Jakum Webdancer A Bardic Letter (Kelethin).
You receive 8 gold pieces.

quests.name: Granite Pebbles
steps: You say, 'Hail, The Toilmaster'
You say, 'I need granite pebbles.'
Busted Froglok Slave Shackles drop from either an escaped froglok or escaped froglok slave in the Swamp of No Hope. Hand Toilmaster two Busted Shackles.

quests.name: Greenblood Shadowknight Tunic
steps: This quest is given by Bonlarg in the Greenblood Shadow Knight Guild.
He will give you a Black Shadow Tunic if you give him 3 Lizardman Scout Fife (found on Lizard Scouts in Feerrott) and your original guild tunic.
The tunic can be used for the Greenblood Tunics quest in Grobb or just worn as is.

quests.name: Greenblood Tunics
steps: Treskar is found in the Shadowknights Guild in Grobb.
You say, 'Hail, Treskar'
You say, 'I sent by Hukulk'
You say, 'What other weak shadowknights'

Now here is where the quest gets weird. The only way to get 3 Black Shadow Tunic is to do the Guild Summons - Murdunk's Palace quest on 3 different Ogres, and then follow that by completing the Greenblood Shadowknight Tunic 3 times.

quests.name: Gretta's Baking Supplies Quest
steps: NOTE: THIS QUEST IS NO LONGER IN GAME
Gretta Mottle is located at 196, 298, 3 inside Irontoe's Eats during the hours of 6am to 8pm. During the overnight hours, Gretta despawns from Norrath and is replaced by her assistant, Buggle Palkin.
You say, 'Hail, Gretta Mottle'
During the hours of 6am to 8pm, Buggle Palkin can be found pathing the road between Kaladim and the Butcherblock docks. Buggle will randomly drop Gretta's Baking Supplies on the road as he paths.
You say, 'Hail, Buggle Palkin'
Hand Gretta's Baking Supplies to Gretta Mottle back in South Kaladim when she returns to Irontoe's Eats.
You receive 7 gold pieces.

quests.name: Grim's Tiger Revenge
steps: Grim Oakfist can be found in the first Inn on the left of the path when entering Kithicor Forest from West Commonlands.
You say, 'Hail, Grim Oakfist'
You say, 'What mission in the woods?"
You say, 'I am a fellow monk'
Find the three tigers and collect their pelts for Grim:
Unusual Tiger Pelt, from Eenot - seen around -586, 877 before pathing
Peculiar Tiger Pelt, from Reggit - seen around -812, 1008 before pathing
Strange Tiger Pelt, from Kobb - seen around 1016, -618 before pathing
You receive a Collar of Neshika.

quests.name: Groflah Steadirt's Death
steps: Netuk Phenzon is located in East Freeport at loc (-73, -287). Found in the "evil" area of East Freeport, Netuk can be found just past the hidden entryway to the underground tunnels beneath the city.
You say, 'Hail, Netuk Phenzon'
You say, 'What mission?'
There are 2 versions of Groflah.
A higher level is located in North Freeport, in the second story of his store Groflah's Forger.
A lower level version has the chance to spawn at night (9-9pm) in the Seafarer's Roost in East Freeport.
Beware entering the Seafarer's Roost during the daytime. Lenka Stoutheart and Bronto Thudfoot do not take kindly to the type of people willingly taking on this quest.
Depending on the clientele in the tavern that night, it may be necessary to lubricate Groflah with some Tumpy Tonics. This will cause him to need to drain his dragon and walk out to the docks.
Kill Groflah and Loot the Tattered Flier from his tired corpse and hand it back to Netuk in East Freeport.
You receive 6 gold from Netuk Phenzon.
You receive the scroll Spell: Siphon Strength.

quests.name: Guard of Ik Quest
steps: Quest items:
You will find two Trooper Shields on the Captain of the Guard in the City of Mist (need to kill him twice)
The Scribbled Note (game typo) is found on A Pirate Cartographer in Fironia Vie.
You say, 'Hail, Gearin Gaxx'

Gearin Gaxx says, 'Welcome. friend! If armor is what you seek, let the house of Gaxx provide you with the finest. Our metalwork is second to none. Every now and again we may even create [rare armor] for the general public to purchase.'
You say, 'what rare armor'

Gearin Gaxx says, 'I have found many exotic materials in Kunark with which I can create rare armor. I currently am working on the [Guard of Ik] and the [Hate Tail Guard] shields. I have no armor as of yet. but I am experimenting with new designs.'
You say, 'what is the guard of ik'

Gearin Gaxx says, 'The Guards of Ik are made from shields found in the jungles. I would be selling them if it were not for the unfortunate fact that the shields are spectral and vanish overnight. Another bit of bad news is that the formula I was working on to stabilize the essence of the metal was stolen by local pirates. I need two more shields and my formula. Bring these to me and I shall not charge you.'
Hand in the two shields and the scribbled note.
Gearin Gaxx says, 'Hey?!! We had a deal!! I get two ik shields and my ik formula!!'
Gearin Gaxx places the formula in a box which appears to have similar copies in it. Thank you!! I can now reward you with this Guard of Ik shield I had lying around.
No visible experience gain at 40.
The reward is so mediocre, even by old world standards, that it seems like this must have been the first in a chain of quests, and was either never solved or was broken.

quests.name: Guard Shilster's Stout
steps: Step 1 - Go to a bank and exchange Platinum into as much Gold as you are willing to spend. If you are going from scowls KOS and want to completely repair this faciton I suggest starting with 500p > 5000 Gold which would be 1000 turn ins. Clear your bags and reduce your weight as much as possible. Being over encumbered for a long journey is still probably faster than making multiple trips to and from a bank in the Karanas.
Step 2 - Request SoW/Scale and STR and if necessary an Illusion if KOS consult Faction Tricks for assistance.

Find Guard Shilster who is often standing in the NorthEast corner of Northern Plains of Karana at loc 1380, -2764 . Occasionally he will wander to the South Karana bridge and stand there for a few minutes and then go back.
You say, 'Hail, Guard Shilster'
You say, 'Why is it considered contraband?'
Hand Guard Shilster 5gold pieces.
You receive Black Burrow Stout

Hand Hanns Krieghor your Napkin from Crow's

steps: Upon creating a Troll Warrior, you will have a tattered note in your inventory. The note reads as follows:

steps: Upon creating a Gnome Cleric of Bertoxxulous, you will have a Stained Note in your inventory. The note reads as follows:

quests.name: Halfling Raider Helms
steps: Faction hit amounts are from Allakhazam.
Indifferent required for hand-in.
Narex T`Vem, in the warrior's guild will announce that the Indigo Brotherhood is looking for someone to kill halfling raiders (located in various camps in Nektulos Forest).
You say, 'Hail, Narex T`Vem'
You say, 'What leatherfoot skullcap'

Narex T`Vem says, 'Where have you been? The halflings of Rivervale have an elite force of warriors. They are called the Leatherfoot Raiders. They have been infiltrating our glorious city of Neriak for quite some time. They must be exterminated! I must hire strong warriors who wish to [collect the bounty].'
You say, 'i will collect the bounty'
Narex T`Vem says, 'So you wish to collect the bounty on Leatherfoot Raiders? Then go into Nektulos and hunt them down. I shall pay a reward for no fewer than four Leatherfoot Raider skullcaps.'
Most Leatherfoot halflings in Nektulos occasionally drop a Leatherfoot Raider Skullcap (drop). Turn in four of these at a time to Narex T`Vem for experience, coin, and faction.

quests.name: Handy Shillelagh
steps: Find Shrub Marwood in the eastern hideout of the Firiona Vie outpost.
You say, 'Hail, Shrub Marwood'
Shrub Marwood brushes pollen off of his tunic. 'Aachoo!! Oh!! Hello. Please look around. Unless you are a [druid looking for work].'
You say, 'I am a druid looking for work'
The items he needs:
One Kromdul Stump (forest giants in Burning Woods or Firiona Vie)
One Kromdek Stump (forest giants in Frontier Mountains)
One Mantrap Root (erollisi mantrap in the Emerald Jungle, Weeping Mantrap in Swamp of No Hope)
Note: I was unable to get the Root off of the Mantraps in EJ, but got it on the first try in TT.
Give him those three items, and in exchange you will receive a Dark Oak Shillelagh, some faction, and some experience.

Shrub Marwood tosses the mantrap root out the window.. SPLASH!! 'I made a mistake. I didn't need that one. Here is the shillelagh I told you about. I found it in some burned out woods far from here. I cleaned it up and found it had a spark of mana so I had it enchanted with a few charges of my spell, [Fertile Crop]. Hope you like it.'
The fertile crop he mentions is the lead-in to the Beguile Plants quest.
