quests.name: Healing (Dismal Rage)
steps: You say, 'Hail, Vesagar Nekio'
Vesagar Nekio says, 'Welcome into our church of rage. I am Vesagar Nekio. servant of Innoruuk. If you should need me to [cure poison]. [cure disease]. or if you [require healing]. just let me know.'
You say, 'I require healing'
(If below Indifferent)
Vesagar Nekio says, 'Blasphemer!! You are no ally of the Dismal Rage. Run while you still have legs!!'
(If Indifferent or Above)
Vesagar Nekio says, 'If you wish me to lay my hands upon your wounds, you must first lay 10 gold coins upon my palm.'
Vesagar Nekio says, 'Your gold has proven your faith in our ways as well as having made my pockets a bit heavier. Let the power of the Prince of Hate bind your wounds.'
Vesagar Nekio begins to cast a spell. (Light Healing)

quests.name: Healing Quest
steps: Nultal Malfoot is at location 796.44, 153.87 in the cleric guild in North Kaladim.
You say, 'Hail, Nultal Malfoot'

Nultal Malfoot: says 'May the power of Underfoot be with you. Welcome. I am here to serve the will of the king as should you. If you [need healing], then speak. Or perhaps you are here to [return skunk glands]?'
You say, 'I need healing.'
Nultal Malfoot: says 'Before the power of Underfoot can attempt to bind your wounds you must pay tribute. Three gold coins!'
Hand Nultal 3 gold.
Nultal Malfoot: says 'May your body and soul be rejuvenated.'
Nultal Malfoot begins to cast a spell.
You feel better. You have been healed for 65 points.

quests.name: Healing Spells from Hendi
steps: Hendi Mrubble is located at -232, -347 in Rivervale.
You say, 'Hail, Hendi Mrubble'

Hendi Mrubble says 'Why, hello there!! Welcome to the Church of Mischief. I am Hendi Mrubble. The 'R' is silent. I am the resident healer of the church, so if you are in [need of healing], or want me to [cure poison] or [cure disease], let me know. If you've got a touch of the crazy brain, I can't do a thing for you.'
You say, 'I am in need of healing.'
Hendi Mrubble says 'Hmmm. I would love to help you with that, but you will have to make a donation to the temple. The Guardians asked me to charge one of the Rivervale piranha teeth.'
You have slain a large piranha!
--You have looted a Piranha Tooth.--
Hand Hendi Mrubble the Piranha Tooth.
Hendi Mrubble says 'May the swift and silent spirit of Fizzlethorpe Bristlebane smile upon your frail soul.'
Hendi Mrubble begins to cast a spell.
You feel better. You have been healed for 65 points.
You say, 'Cure Poison.'
Hendi Mrubble says 'Cure poison, eh? Before we do that, you must fetch me three bixie stingers.'
You have slain a bixie.
--You have looted a Bixie Stinger.--
Hand Hendi Mrubble three Bixie Stingers.
Hendi Mrubble says 'May the swift and silent spirit of Fizzlethorpe Bristlebane smile upon your frail soul.'
Hendi Mrubble begins to cast a spell.
You say, 'Cure Disease.'

Hendi Mrubble says 'Eeww!! Careful, don't touch Hendi. I figured there must have been something not quite right about you. Well, now, before we can cast the disease from your body you will have to make a little donation of one gold for the service and eight gold to disinfect this place. That would be 10 total!! Let's see it.'
Hand Hendi Mrubble 10 gold.
Hendi Mrubble says 'May the swift and silent spirit of Fizzlethorpe Bristlebane smile upon your frail soul.'
Hendi Mrubble begins to cast a spell.

quests.name: Health Potion
steps: Tiger Skin(s)
Locate and Kill a wild tiger found on the Southern Island of Kerra Isle near -514, -109, 5
Odd Kobold Paw(s)
Locate and Kill a kobold shaman found in Toxxulia Forest
Snake Fang(s)
Locate and Kill one of the various snakes in Toxxulia Forest

quests.name: HEHE Meat Quest
steps: Carver Cagrek is located at +378, -455 in Grobb, standing on a platform in the middle of the shaman spell vendors' area, just outside the bank.

Note: This is a simple quest, requiring only 3x HEHE Meat (purchased from Chef Dooga) and a Tattered Recipe dropped by Nerbilik (Level 20 troll) in the Ocean of Tears. Turn in those four items to Carver Cagrek for a Grobb Cleaver.
Below here are all the details, including the side quests that bring it all together.
You say, 'Hail, Carver Cagrek'
You say, 'HEHE meat'
Meanwhile, in Oggok, Chef Dooga is at +200, -240, in "Meet and Drink Tew Bie."
You say, 'Hail, Chef Dooga'
You say, 'What is HEHE meat?'

Chef Dooga will not take the more common and universally-dropped Human Parts, High Elf Parts, or Erudite Parts. She will, however, take Human Flesh or High Elf Flesh, which drops from the named cycle in Innothule and Rathe Mountains. Upon handing in Human Flesh (works at indifferent, not at dubious):
You receive ~7 copper from Chef Dooga.
Upon handing in High Elf Flesh:
You receive 4 silver from Chef Dooga.
Upon handing in Erudite Meat? (what?):
(Dialogues?)
You say, 'Who is the Gobbler?'
You receive a Preserved Leg.
Find the Gobbler in Neriak Foreign Quarter at location -325, -125.
You say, 'Hail, The Gobbler'
You say, 'What is HEHE meat?'
You say, 'What froggy legs?'
You say, 'Who is Chef Dooga?'
You say, 'I will pick up froglok legs.'
Upon turning in the Preserved Leg:
You receive 3 gold from The Gobbler.
You also receive Ogre Butcher Gloves.
You say, 'Who is Nerbilik?'
You say, 'I will deliver grub locker.'
You receive "Grub Locker".
Find Nerbilik in the Ocean of Tears at location +125, +9300.
You say, 'Hail, Nerbilik'
You say, 'What grub locker?'
Upon turning in the Grub Locker:
You receive 2 platinum from Nerbilik.
You say, 'Give me the wrapper.'
Attack and slay Nerbilik.
Nerbilik drops a Tattered Recipe. The text is as follows:
HEHE Recipe By Chef Dooga WUN - HUMAN FLESH WUN - ERUDITE FLESH WUN -
HIGH ELF FLESH BOILS WIT WUNFLAMING PUNGLA IN DA OVEN. EATS!!
Impoortent!! Must get flesh froms Innathoole
HEHE Meat can be purchased from Chef Dooga in Oggok. Give Carver Cagrek three of these, and the recipe from Nerbilik.
You receive 3 platinum from Carver Cagrek.

quests.name: Helm of the Tracker Quest
steps: Real True Notes: You can complete the quest and acquire this helm at level 46, due to the minimum level requirement to enter the Plane of Growth. A faction level of at least Indifferent is sufficient for the turn in. While the Growth quest items have specific race/class/diety requirements to equip them, there are no race/class/diety requirements for anyone doing the turn ins, MQ or otherwise; multiple MQs confirmed on a halfling rogue worshiping Bristlebane.
You say, 'Hail, Tunarean Earthmelder'
You say, 'What giants?'
You say, 'I am an outrider.'
He asks you to kill the Frostgiant Overseer, who spawns in front of Kael in the Wakening Lands. When you kill him, he says something about a giant named Kallis.
Kallis spawns in the arena nearby the Vindicator. There are also two Protectors of Zek with him (you need the protectors whose names are capitalized).
Kill all three and collect their heads. The heads are named:
Frostgiant Overseers Head
Kallis' Head (dropped by Kallis Stormcaller)
Smashed Protector of Zek's Head (dropped by a Protector of Zek)
Bloody Protector of Zek's Head (dropped by a Protector of Zek)
Bring all four heads back for your Helm of the Tracker.

quests.name: Helms of Giant Warriors
steps: Note: You can do turn-ins for this quest as low as dubious (he just won't talk to you). Currently Helmets are turned into Sentry Kcor for Claws of Veeshan and Yelinak faction.
Upon turning in a Giant Warrior Helmet (You can turn in one at a time or four at once):
The message you get seems to depend on your faction.

quests.name: Help Hergor Get Fatter
steps: Hergor is located at the first main crossroad in Grobb, a bit past merchant Ootok.
You say, 'Hail, Hergor'
You say, 'I help Hergor get fatter'
Carver Cagrek is located in front of the Shaman guild, at 375, -450.
You say, 'Hail, Carver Cagrek'
You say, 'Hergor wants his fungus dung pie'
Hand Carver Cagrek 4x A Spore Mushroom.
Carver Cagrek says, 'Gud werk!! Me already, err, founds, dung part of meal. Here we go. One Fungus Dung Pie!! Enjoys.'
Hand Fungus Dung Pie to Hergor.

quests.name: Herb Shop
steps: Yvonne Ani say, 'Welcome to my shop ______. Feel free to purchase whatever you need. I am sure that I can fill those needs, as [The seekers of Dark Truth] generally keep me stocked and on my toes.'

Yvonne Ani says, 'Ah, so you wish to know about the seekers. They are the guild of Necromancers here in Paineel. They are by far the most knowledgeable in the dark arts in all the known world. They frequently purchace a good many [herbs] from me.'
Yvonne Ani says, 'The herbs that the necromancers use, typically have properties that are useful in the preservation of dead flesh. Who knows what they use them for?'
I am told that this is just a story line and that there is no more to it than this.
Possible missing dialogues, faction hits, /loc of quest mobs, and list of additional quest rewards.

quests.name: Heretic Battle
steps: Markus Jaevins is located at +730, +915 on the top floor of the Tower of The Gate Callers in Erudin Palace.
You say, 'Hail, Markus Jaevins'
You say, 'Who are you?'
You say, 'What about the heretics?'
You say, 'What prisoner?'
You say, 'What do you mean, purged?'
You say, 'Where is Jail Master Lius?'
Warden Lius is located at +560, +850 inside the City Office in Erudin Palace.
You say, 'Hail, Warden Lius'
You say, 'What hollow men?'
You say, 'I need the heretic remains.'
You say, 'Hail, Markus Jaevins'
You say, 'The heretic has escaped.'
Elial Brook is located at -365, +330 in Toxxulia Forest. Kill him and loot his Bones.
You have slain Elial Brook!
Hand in the Bones.
The positive hit to Gate Callers is significant. Was warmly after ~20 turnins as a Dwarf.
Note: This quest can be done with dubious faction.
At level 6, each turn in resulted in 3% exp for an Erudite Magician.
At level 9, each turn in resulted in ~1.25% exp for an Erudite Magician.

quests.name: Heretic Heads
steps: You say, 'Hail, Shazda Kaekwon'
You say, 'What trying times?'
You say, 'What about the Heretics?'
Receive Burlap Satchel. Inside it, combine four Heretics Heads (Male/Female heads work). Then hand in the Satchel of Heretic Heads.
You receive 1pp, 5cp from Shazda Kaekwon.
You receive either the Kejekan Tribal Headband (common) or a Swiftclaw Sash (rare).
Drop Statistics
5 Turn ins: 4 Kejekan Tribal Headband, 1 Swiftclaw Sash
Tips:
Make use of different instances and difficulties to kill more heretics per hour.
Ensure you have plenty of carrying capacity as each head is quite heavy (WT 7.0)
Levitation or safe fall is highly recommended as the zone has many steep mountains.
Tracking is highly recommended

quests.name: Heretic Toy
steps: Heretics' Toy
Locate and Kill abandoned heretic pet

quests.name: Heretic's Toy
steps: Heretics' Toy
Locate and Kill abandoned heretic pet

quests.name: Hero Bracers Quest
steps: Note: need to verify what faction/consider the quest can be done, assuming amiable for now.
The hero bracers are a result of this quest. The name of the quest is 'The Escaped Catman'.

[1] Go to the basement of the arena in South Qeynos and talk to Grahan Rothkar. He will ask you if '...you have a report of the [escaped catman].' Ask him What escaped catman. He will give you the story and ask if you want to '...[retrieve key seven].' You can continue the quest anyway, but you will get nothing for it; no faction, no xp, no item, no nothing.

[2] Grahan will tell you to go to Wisp Isle (in Erud's Crossing) and kill the catman named Nomala. Yes, there is a catman named 'Monola' but that is the wrong catman. The correct catman is named 'Nomala'. He is not as high level as any of the other cats but tends to gather a mob. Best strategy to kill him is in Step 3.

[3] Go to Wisp Isle (the only one in Erud's Crossing). Nomala will spawn by the fire. Once killed, he will not spawn again for another hour or two, so figure on taking a while to do this. Be warned that you lose faction with Prexuz for killing these catmen. Anyway, he will stand there for a bit, then walk off toward the shore down by the dock. Milla is standing around close by, but if you wait about one minute, she will walk off and leave Nomala all alone. Kill him - but don't let him run, kill him quick. Best bet is to hit him once then run a few feet down shore away from their village. He d…
[4] Return the Key to Grahan and you get xp, faction, an item (along the lines of a bronze short sword), and a second quest.

[5] The 2nd Quest: He wants you to go hunt down '...a [second escaped gladiator]' Fine, sounds easy... nope. He wants you to return the shackles of the Minotaur Hero of the Steamfont Mountains. You do not need to do the 1st quest to complete this step.
Grahan Rothkar judges you amiably -- what would you like your tombstone to say?
You say, 'what second escaped gladiator?'

Grahan Rothkar sat, 'it appears our prize gladiator has escaped. He is a minotaur hero!! Trained by our best. He took down five of our greatest warriors during his escape. Rumor has it he fled to his homeland in the Steamfont Mountains. They say he is an outcast and does not live with his people. He appears during times of great need to champion the minotaurs. Return his shackles to me and glory is yours!!'

[6] The Minotaur Hero's trigger is any minotaur slaver in the minotaur cave. When they die, there is a chance that the Minotaur Hero will spawn. Loot the Minotaur Hero Shackles and take them back to Grahan Rothkar.
Grahan Rothkar says, 'You are a true Steel Warrior!! Now you shall wear my hero bracers. I designed them for my greatest gladiators and you have shown yourself mighty enough to wear them.'
You receive 2 platinum pieces.
This can be done if you are dubious. Just give item from Minotaur Hero and you will receive the Hero Bracers in return.
Lore Item Note
Because the Hero Bracers are lore, if you hand in the Minotaur Hero Shackles while in possession of Hero Bracers, you may lose the shackles and not receive additional Hero Bracers.

quests.name: High Guard Battlestaff
steps: Lumi Stergnon is located at -640, -90 in the Temple of Divine Light.
You say, 'What important missions?'
Lumi Stergnon regards you indifferently -- what would you like your tombstone to say?
You say, 'I will track down the staff'
At an unknown, presumably higher faction level:
You say, 'I will track down the staff'
Tallus Holton is located at 1530, -655 in East Karana.
You have slain Tallus Holton!
From Tallus, loot H.K. 401 and a Staff Segment (Lore: Staff Segment A). Then see Bank Clerk Jaylin at -40, -340 in High Keep.
You say, 'Hail, Bank Clerk Jaylin'
Hand her H.K. 401.
You receive 7 gold from Assistant Kiolna.
Receive Staff Segment.
Lady McCabe is located at 25, -85 in High Keep.
You say, 'Hail, Lady McCabe'
You say, 'Tell me about the staff segments'
You may be able to combine them in a container and return the result to Lumi to get a High Guard Battlestaff. (Eru/Pal/Clr only, 5/33, +10 cha?) (This quest may be bugged at this point.)

quests.name: Hogcaller's Inn
steps: In the Steel Warrior's Guild, you are given a quest to investigate the Hog Caller's Inn. Apparantly, someone is leaking information to the dark elves concerning the city defenses.
You say, 'Hail, Plagus Ladeson'
You say, 'I am a new warrior.'
You say, 'I seek deeds'

Elves to the Hog Caller's Inn, here in Freeport. Go speak with Lady Shae. Tell her, the [Steel Warriors sent you]. We cannot rely on the Freeport Militia to look into such matters. They are probably involved. Bring me any clues.'
Your contact, Lady Shae, is on the second floor of the Hog Caller's Inn. Tell her who sent you and she will give you some information and ask for a glass of White Wine.
You say, 'The Steel Warriors sent me.'
Go buy her a White Wine from Swin Blackeye downstairs. Return and give her the wine.
If you head back downstairs to Swin:
You say, 'I need the mail for room two'

The middle room on the right on the second floor you may see Shintl Lowbrew. She may leave to get her mail from the Innkeeper, if you wait until after she has her mail, she will drop both the sealed letter and the key.
You have slain Shintl Lowbrew!
Loot the Hog Key No 2. Return to Swin and give him the key. She may also have a Sealed Letter which is lore, you will not receive another one when you hand the key to Swin, and a Halfling Head.
Return the letter to Toala Nehron on the top floor of the arena.
Toala will give you a Toala's Box for heads. Place Shintl's head in the box, and go kill the dark elf courier Hollish Tnoops, also in Freeport, just outside the gates.
You have slain Hollish Tnoops!
Combine the heads in the box to get a Box with Two Heads. Return this to Toala.
You receive 2 gold, 10 silver pieces.

quests.name: Hollow Skull Quest
requiredItems: Hollow Skull (Skull of the Tower Cook)

quests.name: Holy Armor Buff Quest
steps: Daedet Losaren in the Temple of Thunder can provide the Holy Armor spell for faithful followers of Karana.
You say, 'Hail, Daedet Losaren'
You say, 'I wish the blessing of Holy Armor.'
When you give him the 10g:
You feel the favor of the gods upon you.

quests.name: Holy Armor Scroll
steps: Note: This quest requires indifferent or better faction.
Daedet Losaren in the Temple of Thunder can provide the Holy Armor spell for faithful followers of Karana.
You say, 'Hail, Daedet Losaren'
You say, 'I wish the blessing of Holy Armor.'
You say, 'What components?'
You say, 'I will gather the required items.'
You say, 'What are Kerra Isle Beetles?'

He provides you with an 8-slot Beetle Eye Chest. The trick to it is to have ONE Kerra Isle Beetle eye in each of the 4 slots left after the Fire Beetle Eyes go in. Combine the box, and hand it in to Daedet.

quests.name: Honey Jum Quest
steps: Gather 3 Honeycombs by looting bixies or finding them on merchants if other players have sold them.
Bixie in Misty Thicket:
600, -50 (on top of the north wall-tower)
400, -1250 (next to the road)
-385, 675 (next to tree)
There are also at least 2 roaming bixies, one on either side of the wall.
Bixies are more readily found in Kithicor Forest, but make sure you are there during the day!
Give 3 honeycombs and 30 gold pieces (or 3 platinum pieces) to Kizzie Mintopp Location: (-229, -217 #11 on Map) to receive Honey Jum.

quests.name: Honey Mead for Trumpy
steps: Trumpy Irontoe may be found inside the Fish's Ale at (loc -309.10, -260.72) but he also wanders to and from the Docks at (loc -161, 119). He stops at the end of Docks for a moment and also stops once on his way there and back, near the archway at (loc -224, -132)
You say, 'Hail, Trumpy Irontoe'
You say, 'What drinks?'
You say, 'What is honey mead?'
Give him 4 x Honey Mead.
Note: This is not Multi-Questable. You must hand in 4 Honey Mead at a time. If you hand in only 1 at a time, on the 4th you will not get the reward unlike other quests.
Additional Dialogue
You say, 'Who is Kane?'
You say, 'Who is Sragg?'

quests.name: Honeybugger Assassin
steps: This starts in the Rogue Guild...

Pazin Punox wants Lil Honeybugger dead and promises a "king's reward" for her head. She lives in Misty Thicket in the Halfling territory just outside of town. Unfortunately, she rooms with her big brother Joogl Honeybugger who never seems to leave her side, and he is probably around level 10 or so. Since you need to be below this level to get the quest, you had better get some help in killing her.

When you kill Lil, she drops a Halfling Head (which is what you're supposed to bring back to Paziu Puno for your "kings reward"), a Bandage (so you can reverse the faction hit you take from killing Lil by giving it to Joogl later), and a Case of Jumjum Juice (lore item) (which I guess you can give to the treant).

quests.name: Hopeless Love, Part 1
steps: Plagus Ladeson of the Steel Warriors in Freeport (he can be found in the courtyard behind the Steel Warriors building) talks to you about his hopeless love affairs with both [Milea] and [Toala].
You say, 'Hail'
How do you know to ask about Milea?
You say, 'Milea'
You say, 'Milea is in East Karana'.

You receive A Sealed Note that reads, "Dearest Milea, This is your love, Plagus Ladeson. I know we never had a chance, but perhaps we could try. I am a guild master in Freeport and plan on purchasing a nice cottage in the Commonlands. I will await your visit. Love Plagus"
Milea Clothspinner can be found at the end of the gorge that runs next to the ramp to Highhold in East Karana.
You hand Milea A Sealed Note
You receive 2 gold pieces.
You receive a minor reward (such as a Grizzly Hide Cloak)

quests.name: Hopeless Love, Part 2
steps: Plagus Ladeson of the Steel Warriors in Freeport (he can be found in the courtyard behind the Steel Warriors building) talks to you about his hopeless love affairs with both [Milea] and [Toala].
If you ask him about Toala, he will tell you that she is in love with Cain Darkmoore.

She won't respond to Plagus's name (I have been told she might respond now), but will respond to Cain Darkmoore's name, and will tell you that he is in love with Opal Darkbriar. Quite the triangle. I am told that this is not a quest, but merely a story line.
You say, 'Who is Cain Darkmoore?'
Need all dialogues, steps, quest items, rewards, additional zones, quest mobs, faction hits if any.

quests.name: How the Goblins Stole Frostmas
steps: You say, 'Hail, Merry Snowgleam'
You say, 'Who stole it?'
You say, 'I will help recover it.'
Collect three Frostmas Baubles from goblins in Runnyeye Citadel and turn them in to Merry Snowgleam
You receive a Gnome Shaped Cookie and a Holiday Gift.

quests.name: Hsagra's Wrath Quest
steps: Kill A Kromzek Spy and loot Head of a Kromzek Spy
Kill Noble Helssen and loot Scale of Hsagra
Obtain Jualicn's Token and Lexicon of Relinar from Jualicn
Obtain Rune of Revenge from Ionat by giving Jualicn's Token
Obtain Rune of Eradication from Entariz by giving Jualicn's Token
Obtain Rune of Concentration from Draazak by giving Jualicn's Token
Obtain Rune of Bleve from Derasinal by giving Jualicn's Token (NOTE: Do this turn in last, you don't get the token back)
Create Teachings of Relinar by combining the runes of Revenge, Eradication, Concentration, and Bleve in Lexicon of Relinar
Hand Lawyla the Head of a Kromzek Spy, the Scale of Hsagra, and the Teachings of Relinar

quests.name: Hukulk's Love
steps: Be forewarned that this quest invovles killing an NPC in Neriak that will lower your faction with the dark bargainers and Dread Guard Inner/Outer (DE Merchants and Guards).
(Optional)
Go to Grobb and Find Hukulk in the back of the zone, in ShadowKnights of Night Keep.
If your faction is high enough
You say, 'Hail, Hukulk'
You say, 'Me no make fun - me want Helm of Hukulk'
You say, 'Yas Meez make deal with Hukulk'
You say, 'Me sad yooz loose da Happy Love Bracers'
(Optional)
Find Lynuga roaming through Innothule Swamp.
You say, 'Hail, Lynuga'
You say, 'what yooz collecting?'
You say, 'What yooz do wit Happy Love Bracers ?'
Travel to Neriak in the Neriak Foreign Quarter find Guard Lumpin
You can talk to him to find out about the Happy Love Bracer or just Kill him and loot his Troll Head
You say, 'Hail, Guard Lumpin'
You say, 'where are the happy love bracers?'
You say, 'Ratraz'
Guard Lumpin says, 'Ratraz is dumb troll who werk in dark elf bar. Him tink he smart because dark elves raise him. Tink he know everyting. Him just as stewpid as all us trolls is!'
Slay Guard Lumpin and loot his Troll Head
Travel to Neriak Third Gate and find Ratraz

Ratraz is a bouncer in the Maiden's Fury in Neriak. You have to kill Ratraz. If he runs while your fighting him, and you're a troll or ogre, be aware that you may have to duck while chasing him through some of the lower arches in Neriak, so you will have to reclick your autoattack. I haven't had anyone jump in on that battle yet and I've let him run pretty far before. From him you will get the happy love bracers (AC 1 bracers, I'd use them just for the name alone if they weren't so lousy), his head, and a warclub.

Watch out! DO NOT give Ratraz's head to Hukulk! You can identify each head if you get confused. Lumpkin was the one who stole Lyguna from Hulkulk, not Ratraz! Either put his head in a separate container or destroy it. The warclub is a decent non-magic blunt weapon that you can sell for quite a few plat. Ratraz is about 19th level.
Travel back to Grobb to deliver final pieces to Hukulk
Give Hukulk the Guard Lumpin's Troll Head and Happy Love Bracers to receive your reward.

The Helm of Hukulk AC5 +3 strength +3 agility, wearable by evil races only helmet and some money (even up to some plat!), experience, and Faction. Note about factions: if your standing is too low with shadowknights you will get nothing for turning in the quest items to Hukulk.
Imagine being gifted clothing with 'Love' in the name , only to find out it was made your Ex's Ex's Ex's Ex
Reward:
Helm of Hukulk

quests.name: Hungry Deputy
steps: Daleen Leafsway may be found in the garden at outside the Druid guild.
You must be amiable or better (with which faction?) to get this quest.
She will randomly blurt out the following dialogue:
You say, 'Who is starving?'
You say, 'I will take the turnips.'
You receive a Sack of Turnips. Deputy Eigon may be found in the . Give him the sack.
(minimal) 1% per turn in at level 6
You gain a random amount of coin ranging from a few 2 copper to a couple pieces of gold.

quests.name: Hurrieta's Tunic Quest
steps: After completing the Faren's Tacklebox quest, you receive Hurrieta's Tunic.
Hurrieta is the mother of the Ironforges in Qeynos. Ton Firepride despises the Ironforges. Take the tunic to him and receive faction, experience and coin.
You receive Hurrieta's Bloody Dress. Take Hurrieta's Bloody Dress and seek out Garuc Anehm in the Qeynos Aqueducts.
Hand the dress to him to get your reward: Experience, faction, money and a piece of Patchwork armor or Rat Shaped Ring.

quests.name: Ice Goblin Beads
steps: Josper Kenshed is located at +910, +740 in the Tower of The Crimson Hands in Erudin Palace.
You say, 'Hail, Josper Kenshed'
You say, 'I am a servant of wizardry.'
You say, 'I can collect components.'
Receive an Empty Bag (identifies as "Bag for Ice Necklaces"), a 6-slot container.
Head to Everfrost Peaks and kill ice goblins to loot Goblin Ice Necklaces. Ice goblins near Halas are lvls 1 - 3 and can drop these
Combine 6 Goblin Ice Necklaces in the Empty Bag to create a Bag of Ice Necklaces.
Hand Josper Kenshed the Bag of Ice Necklaces.
You receive 7 gold from Josper Kenshed.
You receive Servant's Staff.

quests.name: Ice Goblin Necklaces
steps: Lysbith McNaff is located (566, -410) in the Pit of Doom. Faction of indifferent required for quest - CAN be completed while sneaking.
You say, 'Hail, Lysbith McNaff'
You say, 'I serve Halas.'
You say, 'What ice goblins?'
You say, 'I will protect the pass.'

You receive a six-slot container called Empty Bag (identifies as "Bag for Ice Necklaces"). Kill ice goblin whelps or ice goblin scouts in Everfrost Peaks and loot Goblin Ice Necklace. They are found wandering throughout the canyon area. Combine six Goblin Ice Necklace in the bag to craft a Bag of Ice Necklaces. Hand this in to Lysbith.
You receive 3 gold from Lysbith McNaff.
Additionally you will randomly receive: ration, iron ration, torch, water flask, or small lantern.

quests.name: Icestar's Eve Snowdrift Feast
steps: You say, 'Hail, Quartermaster Nellian'
You say, 'What help?'
Collect the following:
Mammoth Meat drops from Mammoths in Eastern Wastes or Everfrost Peaks.
Snow Bunny Stew is a baking recipe (Trivial: 68).
Chilled Berries drops from a tundra yeti in Dreadlands.
Turn in the three ingredients,
You receive Aurillias' Winter Broth and a Holiday Gift.

quests.name: Iksar Prisoner Quest
steps: This quest article describes the "bad ending" of what begins as the Trooper Scale Bracers quest.
You give the note to Arch Duke Xog
You say, 'what strange iksar'
You say, 'what test'
Upon locating an Iksar prisoner on the second floor of the Crypt of Dalnir, you have 2 choices, you must listen to your heart:
Kill him for being a coward and return his Traitor's Heart.
Assist him in escaping his shackles and return with proof of your actions.
You say, 'Hail, an Iksar prisoner'
You say, 'how can I help you?'
Kill Coerced Dwarves until you get a rare drop of Serrated Wire, take that and give it to the prisoner. Must be indifferent faction or greater.
You receive a Greenmist Icon in your inventory and can head to the top floor of the Shaman and Shadowknight guild in East Cabilis.
[http://oldunsolvedquestsineverquest.yuku.com/topic/409 Old Thread on this quest being "Unsolved"]

quests.name: Ilanic's Scroll
steps: Josper Kenshed in the Wizard's Guild of Erudin mentions a [special matter]. Ask him about it and he will ask you to find the skeleton Ilanic and ask him [where is the scroll?].
You say, 'Hail, Josper Kenshed'
You say, 'i am a servant of wizardry'
You say, 'what special matter'

He sent his apprentice, Ilanic, to test his new spell icecapades but only gave him half the spell. Ilanic wanders Toxxulia Forest. He says when you bring the scroll half back to him he'll give the complete spell. Ilanic is a named skeleton that roams the Southern part of Toxxulia forest.
You say, 'Where is the scroll?'

It seems a A Kobold Caster has taken the spell half from the skeleton. The Kobold Caster is a rare spawn and drops the spell half you're looking for. Turn in Half of a Spell to Josper and receive Spell: Column of Frost, experience and faction.
You receive 7 silver pieces.
Receive Spell: Column of Frost

quests.name: Illegible Cantrip Quest
steps: Tara Neklene may found on the bottom level of the Academy of Arcane Sciences at 112, -720, -23 reachable by walking over the glimmering circles in the floor of the main chamber. A find will not locate her because of the teleportation involved.
You say, 'Hail, Tara Neklene'
You say, 'What are the Deathfist orcs?'
You say, 'I will assist with the research.'
Head to the orc camps in East Commonlands and kill an "orc apprentice" to loot an Illegible Cantrip. Bring this back to Tara.
You receive 15 silver from Tara Neklene.
You receive a minor item.
Edit: 2 x turn-ins (11 Enc) yielded:
For the most part, you get a Ration, an Iron Ration, a torch or a Cracked Staff
Oracle Scrolls:
You say, 'I will test the might of the orc oracles.'
This likely leads into a separate quest (details needed).

EDIT: I have done this with multiple characters with just amiable faction. Used cantrips to just barely cross from indifferent to amiable, and it worked with minimal Amiable (as a Halfling Cleric), but it no longer requires kindly. (as of 25 Feb 18)
At dubiously to amiable:
You say, 'I will test the might of the orc oracles'
Tara Neklene says, 'The word of mouth in the Academy of Arcane Science is that you are no foe, but you have yet to prove your worth to us. Perform more tasks for the great Tara Neklene.'
At kindly:
You say, 'I will test the might of the orc oracles'

Tara Neklene says, 'You have heightened your knowledge to the appropriate rank. You are ready to challenge the Deathfish oracles. Do so and return one oracle scroll which any of them may have. If I am in a good mood when you return, you shall soon be summoning elementals.'
Upon turning in an Illegible Scroll:

Tara Neklene says, 'Wonderful!! You have survived the might of an oracle. With this we can now continue with our experiments. Now you may continue your teaching and study the power to summon those of earth, air, water and fire.'
She gives you a random Level 4 Magician pet spell, Spell: Elementalkin: Air/Earth/Fire/Water

quests.name: Incandescent Armor Quests
steps: Incandescent gear is Enchanter specific quested items from The Temple of Solusek Ro. Talk to Sultin.
You say, 'Hail, Sultin'
You say, 'incandescent'
Incandescent Gloves:
Obtain the following for Sultin:
Glowing Gloves from a shadowed man
Radiant Gloves from Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule
Enchanted Gloves by giving 5 pp to Tizina in Lavastorm Mountains
Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin in Highpass Keep
You say, 'I am interested in the gloves'
Shadowed men can be found in many zones. Glowing Gloves drom randomly from any of them.
Kill Radiant in The Temple of Cazic-Thule and loot the Radiant Gloves.
Go to Lavastorm Mountains and give 5 platinum pieces to Tizina, and she gives you the Enchanted Gloves:
In Highpass Keep, get the Gleaming Gloves by giving a bloodstone to Tarn Visilin:
Take all 4 gloves back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give them to Sultin:
You receive the Incandescent Gloves.
Incandescent Mask:
Sultin needs four items:
Glowing Mask, found on a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk
Rune of Fortune (top), from Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore
Rune of Fortune (bottom) by giving 5 pp to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak City Library
Rune of Fortune (middle) by giving 5 pp to Madame Serena in South Qeynos
You say, 'I am interested in the mask'
Kill a froglok scryer or a skeleton monk in Upper Guk for the Glowing Mask.
Kill the Dark Elf Enynti in the Chasm below Mistmoore for the Rune of Fortune (top).
Hand 5 platinum pieces to Mizr N`Mar in the Neriak City Library:
Mizr N`Mar gives you the Rune of Fortune (bottom).
In South Qeynos, behind the Mermaid's Lure near the dock, hand 5 platinum pieces to Madame Serena:
Madame Serena give you the Rune of Fortune (middle).
Go back to The Temple of Solusek Ro and give the Glowing Mask and the three different Runes of Fortune to Sultin:
You receive the Incandescent Mask.
Incandescent Wand:
Sultin needs:
Pouch of Silver Dust from the a dusty werebat in The Estate of Unrest
Glowing Silver Wand from Raine Beteria
Blessed Silver Wand from Ezmirella (and 5 pp)
Silver Wand from a silvered guard in The Temple of Cazic-Thule (and 5 pp)
You say, 'I am interested in the wand'
In The Estate of Unrest, get the keys and go to the basement. Slay a a dusty werebat to get the Pouch of Silver Dust.
In The Temple of Cazic-Thule, find a silvered guard at the northwest pyramids, and kill it to get a Silver Wand.

Find Ezmirella in the gypsy camp in the Northern Plains of Karana. Hand her the Silver Wand and 50 gold coins (or 5 platinum). She will return a Blessed Silver Wand and instruct you to seek out Raine Beteria.
Hand Raine the Blessed Silver Wand and 50 gold coins (or 5 platinum) to receive the Glowing Silver Wand.
Take the Glowing Silver Wand and Pouch of Silver Dust back to Sultin. Hand him both.
You receive the Incandescent Wand.

quests.name: Inert Potion Quest
steps: Toresian Fhabel is at 727.01, 804.42, 35.13 in Erudin Palace. Requires amiable faction to start the quest.

You say, 'I wish to assist Toresian'
Receive Inert Potion.
Slansin:
Give Slansin the Inert Potion.

Slansin then despawns. If you are after the other version, Slansin Devin, like most people are, you will need to repeat this step until he spawns. You can try again by saying 'I will study enchantment' to Toresian Fhabel. It took around 20 hands in and took a level 1 to a level 2 and 2 yellows before he spawned
Slansin Denvin:
Works at dubious.
Give Slansin Denvin the Inert Potion.
Slansin Denvin does not despawn right away, meaning you can now repeat this part of the quest until he does. He stays up for at least 20 minutes.
Tips:

You can actually trigger Toresian from the bottom floor to get the potion with hotkeys if you stand in the right spot. Go into Erudin City Office to the right wall (there is a bench there). Toresian is above at (727, 805). It's actually the "I will study enchantment" dialogue that spawns Slansin, the second line only gets the NPC to give you the potion. Make hotkey macro with the following lines:
/target Toresian_Fhabel
/say I will study Enchantment
/pause 3
/say I wish to assist Toresian
Then just go straight across to Vials of Vitality, where Slansin is.

Snowflake may be found at +2020, -1160, near Bryndin McMill and Lish McMarrin.
You say, 'Hail, Snowflake'

Follow Snowflake east until he stops at the pillars of the tower at (+2045, +3835). Regardless of whether Megan is there or not, he will slowly walk back to the tree by Bryndin McMill. You can make him return to Megan's tower during the return trip by asking asking him again "Where is Megan?"

Megan OReilly stands outside the tower to the right of the pillars at (+2060, -3870) and will frequently walk to the bank of the frozen river at (+2025, -4240). Wandering orcs will sometimes attack her, so you might have to wait for her.
You say, 'Hail, Megan OReilly'
You say, 'Where are Ivan's remains?'
You say, 'I will dive for the remains.'
You receive a 4-slot Empty Box, which identifies as Box For Ivan's Remains.

Southeast of Megan's tower, there is a hole in the frozen river at +1375, -4585; grab an Enduring Breath from someone and go diving. Under the ice are various goblins ("goblin diver" and "ice goblin diver") who are KoS. Three of the pieces of the remains are ground spawns found on the river bottom and look like bags.
Barbarian Femur: +1405, -4570, -190
Barbarian Jaw: +1465, -4500, -230
Barbarian Skull: +1580, -4485, -245

The final item, Barbarian Rib, is dropped by a "goblin diver". There are two spawns between the Femur, and the Skull, and one more spawn slightly north of the Skull. The monsters that can spawn in these spots are: ice goblin scout, ice goblin diver, and a rare goblin diver. Kill the placeholders until the goblin diver spawns and kill it for the final item, a Barbarian Rib.
Some tips to accomplish this:
You don't actually need to have enduring breath. If you simply swim straight up, and continue to do so, after a couple seconds your breath will refill

All of the ice goblins flee when at low health. Unless you have a swimming skill of 100, or a high level speed buff, you will never catch them. Instead, fight them on the surface of the ice and you will not regret it
Combine the four items in the box to craft a Box of Remains . Head back to Halas and give Renth the Box of Remains.

Obtain the Sol Cauldron from Lord Searfire, the Dwarven smith, in The Temple of Solusek Ro. This container is used for the combine to make A Bar of Ronium. To raise faction with him, you can either hunt Shadowed Men or you can give gold, 30gp at a time, to Rathmana Allin in the Southern Desert of Ro until he cons Amiable to you (see the quest Rathmana's Traveling Offer). Once your faction is high enough, return to the Temple of Solusek Ro and hail Lord Searfire and then say "What Ronium" and then he will give you the sol cauldron, and…
The ingredients to make the Bar of Ronium are the following:

Melatite (Dropped by various CWG Model Clockworks in Solusek's Eye). Sometimes you can buy this from merchants in and around Solusek's Eye (Sol A) because many players sell them there. This will prevent you from taking any negative faction hits with Ak'Anon.
Two Enchanted Platinum Bars. Enchanters level 34 and higher can enchant Platinum Bars using the spell Enchant Platinum.

One Mistmoore Granite (found on flouting gargoyles, jeering gargoyles, and leering gargoyles in Castle Mistmoore). The granite is an uncommon drop from the Gargoyles outside of the castle, but is more common on the Gargoyles inside of the castle. Also note that you will need another Mistmoore Granite to turn in to Leaf Falldim with your Bar of Ronium, so make sure to get two of them before leaving.
One Sands of Ro (from various Sand Giants in the Northern/Southern Deserts of Ro or the Oasis of Marr)

One Soil of Underfoot (from the Priestess Ghalea in the North Kaladim Cleric's guild for four Fairy Dusts). You need at least Kindly faction for this, you can raise your faction with Priestess Ghalea by turning in skeleton bones to Gunlok Jure in the North Kaladim Paladin's guild (see the quest Bone Chips Kaladim). Also, try not to kill faeries because you will need good faction with them later to complete the Epic quest to Enchant your Trueshot longbow into the Raincaller. It is advised to buying the Fairy Dust or use an alt/ask another player to kill the fairies.

Once all of the above ingredients have been obtained, place them in the Sol Cauldron and hit the combine button and you will receive one Bar of Ronium. You do not need any blacksmithing skill to combine these.

quests.name: Journeyman's Boots Quest
steps: Hasten Bootstrutter is a gnome that wanders Rathe Mountains. (For a map, see the NPC page.)
He wants three items:
Ring of the Ancients from Ancient Cyclops
Shadowed Rapier
3250 Gold Pieces (must be Gold)

There is no minimum level, but it is only realistically soloable at level 30+, 42+ recommended. This quest is multi-quest-able, and players often sell the multi-quest as a service. Check the Ring of the Ancients page for current market prices.
The first item one should achieve is the Ring, chiefly because it is the most difficult piece to obtain, and the rapier is a temporary item that disappears when logged out for too long.

The ring drops from the Ancient Cyclops, a rare mob that can be found in four zones, although the two main areas to kill it in are Ocean of Tears and Southern Desert of Ro. It also exceptionally rarely can spawn in South Karana and East Karana, although the spawn mechanics for the Karanas are relatively unknown and highly debated, so the strategy for these zones will not be covered in this guide.

The first, and only realistic way of killing the ancient cyclops below level 41 or so, is the Southern Desert of Ro. The mob is a rare spawn that has a 10% chance of appearing every night at 9PM, anywhere in the desert portion of the zone. Do note that this spawn is usually contested by players trying to complete the quest as well as people farming the rings to sell multi-quests, so having Spirit of the Wolf and an instant-cast ability to engage the cyclops with is highly recommended. Playing at off-peak hours for less competition is also an advantage. If your class has tracking, this is yet…

The second, higher level method is to kill the ancient cyclops in the Ocean of Tears. This is a much more relaxed and arguably more consistent method of obtaining the ring. However, the spot is usually camped so be sure to do a camp check and ask to be put on the list for the camp if it's currently taken. The Ancient Cyclops resides on the island marked "8" on the Ocean of Tears map, and shares a placeholder with a pirate, Boog Mudtoe and a cyclops. There are two cyclops on the island, the one on the southern part of the island that does not move is the placeholder. The cyclops and its ancien…

Once the ring is obtained, then one must obtain the shadowed rapier by killing a shadowed man. They are in multiple zones and usually in groups, so be prepared to fight more than one at once. They run extremely fast, so don't expect to fight them without winning, as escaping is very difficult. It is be advisable to check if Hasten Bootstrutter is up before obtaining the rapier, as the rapier is no rent and will disappear if you happen to log out with it for over 30 minutes. (You CAN, however, die intentionally and leave it on your corpse, retrieving it when you're ready to hand in the quest).…

When you obtain all the items and have 3,250 gold pieces (it MUST be in gold, not platinum), hand all of them in to Hasten Bootstrutter who wanders on the east side of Rathe Mountains for your journeyman's boots!

Note: It is difficult to catch him with that much weight unless you have high strength or Spirit of Wolf. So you may have to wait along his route and target him with Hail, spamming to get him to stop. Turn in your items quickly or re-hail him frequently or he will run off. His round trip on his path is about 2m 40s.

steps: You'll need to talk to Jinkus Felligan, the Shaman Guildmaster, inside the Temple of the Tribunal (/loc 315, 444). You say, 'Hail, Jinkus Felligan'

Jinkus Felligan says, 'Then I welcome ye into our noble order. Ye'll serve us well or spend an eternity in the dungeons o' the Tribunal. Are ye ready to [contribute to yer church] or do ye [wish to meditate] within our walls?'
You say, 'contribute to yer church'

Jinkus Felligan says, 'Ye'll help all o' Halas by doing the bidding o' this church. Go to Holana. Tell her [Jinkus sent] ye to assist her. She'll have work fer ye. Perhaps, if ye're planning on passing near Qeynos, ye can [make a delivery] as well?'
Next, go find Holana Oleary in Ye Majik shop on the east side of Halas (/loc 134, -336). You say, 'Jinkus sent me'

Holana Oleary says, 'So, ye're the next to be tested, then, eh?! I pray ye're able to return. Ye'll need to take this note to Einhorst in Clan McMannus' fishing village in the Plains o' Karana. He'll hand ye the monthly Karana clover shipment to be returned to me. Just remember, dinnae stop running! Do ye [need directions to Clan McMannus]?' You receive A tattered note, and off to the McMannus Clan fishing village of Western Karana ye' go to deliver the note to Einhorst!
Traveling to West Karana and the fishing village:

To get to the village, go though Blackburrow to Qeynos Hills. Then follow the mountains south until you hit a path which leads to the West Karana zone line. In West Karana follow path until it splits turn right to head south, the fishing village is straight ahead and not far from here. Einhorst is in one of the small fishing huts (/loc -3807, -2096).

Hand over the note to Einhorst McMannus. Einhorst McMannus says, 'Yes. We almost forgot of the shipment of Karana clovers. Here you are, my friend. Back to the north with you. I am sure the Shamans of Justice will need this.'
You receive various amounts of coin and the Karana Clover Shipment to return to Holana.
Side Quest Opportunity:

Before you hurry back to Halas to delivery the clover shipment to Holana, speaking to Einhorst further will offer you up another delivery quest (Lion Meat Shipment Quest) that leads you back to Halas as well.

Hand over the shipment to Holana. Holana Oleary says, 'Good work. We Shamans o' Justice are like no other. We must remain in top physical form for we never know when justice must be served. I was commanded to give ye a reward. Take this. It was doing nothing more than collecting dust. Go, and serve justice well.'

When you give the shipment to Holana, you'll receive coin, experience, an item (gear or a 5th level shaman spell). On occasion you may even receive a polar bear cloak. (Confirmed for EQ Legends - Was awarded with three cloaks over the course of 32 turn ins.)

quests.name: Karana's Blessing
steps: This quest works with multiple mobs.
Gehna Solbenya can be found inside the Knights of Thunder building in South Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Gehna Solbenya'
You say, 'I desire to serve Karana's flock'
(On Aprehensive, her reply instead is: "[...]But this matter is of vital importance to us and we need more proof of your devotion to our cause." And the quest does not start. Dec/18/21, Green)
You say, 'I will deliver blessings to the flock'
Head to the Western Plains of Karana and find Minda. She's at a farm house along the southern boundary of the zone (#15 on map).
You say, 'Hail, Minda'
You say, 'Are you a follower of Karana?'
You say, 'Do you require Karana's blessings?'

quests.name: Keeper Rott's Pages
steps: A Goblin Soothsayer and Goblin Spirit Caller in Warsliks Woods randomly drop an Illegible Note. There are 4 types which identify as Notepage 1-4 of Rott. Hand in all four to Keeper Rott, who is located in the alcove near the West Cabilis arena. Note that you don't have to be a necromancer to complete the quest but you will need high amiable faction.

Warning: If you're are not high enough faction with Brood of Kotiz he will NOT return the 4 Illegible Notes after hand in. Also note that the mobs who drop the quest items, A Goblin Soothsayer and Goblin Spirit Caller, do NOT improve this faction.

quests.name: Kelorek's Scales
steps: This quest begins with Qarrgy Scallopgobbler on the beach of Cobalt Scar. He is an otter located at -800, -400.
Bring him the following items in exchange for a Sea Dragonscale Bracer:
Ornately Runed Shell Necklace (rare drop from neriad weavers in Siren's Grotto)
Sea Dragon Scales (dropped by Kelorek`Dar)
Fine Plate Bracer (168 trivial blacksmith combine)
You say, 'Hail, Qarrgy Scallopgobbler'
You say, 'What other materials?'
You say, 'Sea Dragon Scales'

quests.name: Kevlin Diggs' Debt
steps: Ace Slighthand may be found in the casino on the second floor of the rogues' guild (Fools Gold) in .
You say, 'Hail, Ace Slighthand'
You say, 'Who is Kevlin?'
You say, 'What gold?'
Do as he says and bring him Kevlin's Debt (-172.69, -248.29) . Mangler is a level 2 NPC, it's not recommended to kill him as it will give you negative faction hits.
You receive 10 copper from Ace Slighthand.
You receive 4 silver from Ace Slighthand.

quests.name: Key to Charasis Quest
steps: Dugroz may be found at , in the tunnel to Trakanon's Teeth by the froglok temple in the Swamp of No Hope. Once inside the cave, follow the right wall and you will find a tunnel leading to Dugroz halfway between the tunnel entrance and the large area with the iksar outcasts. The tunnel is slightly above ground level, and the loc of the entrance is (1193, -3696). Once inside the tunnel the path will fork, follow the left fork and you will find Dugroz.
You say, 'Hail, Dugroz'
You say, 'What work for them?'
You say, 'How did you escape?'
You say, 'What keys?'
You say, 'What small favor?'
Dugroz wants: * "a vampire's fang" -- a Xalgozian Fang, dropped by Xalgoz in the depths of Kaesora
"a jade weapon stained by the blood of a chokidai" -- a Jade Chokidai Prod, dropped by the Chancellor of Di`Zok at the back of the Sarnak fort, by the Lake of Ill Omen
Give these two items to Dugroz to receive the Key to Charasis (a.k.a. Howling Stones). Ensure you hand the items to Dugroz, and not Dugroz's Pet who sits very close Dugroz. This key is soulbound.

quests.name: Key to Cobalt Scar
steps: You say, 'Hail, Ziglark Whisperwing'
You say, 'What mundane trivial tasks'
You say, 'I am worthy.'
You receive a Message to Wenglawks.
Note: I couldn't trigger any text with any combination of mundane/trivial task dialogue but if you say "I am worthy" he'll hand you the scroll at dubious.
Travel to Kael Drakkel and find Wenglawks Kkeak in the back of the noble's house. Hand the Message to Wenglawks and 200 platinum pieces (no longer optional) to Wenglawks.
You receive a Message to Herald. Head back to Skyshrine and give it to Ziglark.
or alternatively (based on faction) he says:
You receive a Shrine Key.

quests.name: Key to Jaled Dar's Lair (Neb)
steps: You can perform this quest at dubious faction standing with the Paebala. (You can alternatively quest Jaled Dar's key through Zlandicar.) Neb can be found deep within the Paebala tunnels in Dragon Necropolis at p504, p751.
You say, 'Hail, Neb'
You say, 'Paebala'
You say, 'Chetari'
You say, 'Goo'
You say, 'Vaniki'

Vaniki's Heart, dropped off Vaniki in the Chetari tunnels
Zlandicar's Heart, dropped off Zlandicar

You say, 'I seek Jaled Dar'

quests.name: Key to Sleeper's Tomb
steps: Jaled Dar`s shade may be found at +1590, -120. The simple way to get into Jaled Dar's lair is to have a rogue with a 210+ skill in lockpicking to open the door. If simplicity isn't your thing, or you just want the key for yourself, you can obtain it one of two ways: Either a quest offered by Zlandicar or a quest offered by Neb.

You say, 'How can I aid you?'
You say, 'Who is The Sleeper?'

Sontalak's Talisman
Lendiniara's Talisman
Klandicar's Talisman
Yelinak's Talisman
Zlandicar's Talisman

There is a stun trap directly in front of Jaled, right next to the first step or on the first step. If you trigger the trap, you will be stunned and Jaled will kill you. Also if you're a small race and don't have levitate, you won't be able to get up the first step to turn in. Get levitate or go into an Illusion to get up the steps
How to get to Jaled Dar`s shade without lockpicking

steps: Tabure Ahendle is located at 65, -507, 5 in the South Qeynos Steel Warriors Arena. You must have Amiable faction to complete this quest. (60 wood elf druid of Tunare - I was able to turn in the hides as apprehensive and received faction/reward)

You say, 'I am a member of the Steel Warriors'
You say, 'I will assist you'
Hand Tabure Ahendle 4 Kobold Hides.
You receive 7 silver.

You say, 'Hail, Royal Guard Lilkus'

If not, then forget whatever business you may have had here. If you wish an audience, then go speak to Sheltiun below. He may be able to help you...if you help him.' Head to the Warrens and kill kobolds. Any kobold in the zone has a chance to drop a Kobold Molar.
Return to Royal Guard Lilkus in Paineel and turn in your Kobold Molars. You may turn them in one at a time.
For each Kobold Molar that is turned in you receive some gold, and have a small chance of receiving a random piece of ringmail armor, and faction.
Note: Royal Guard Lilkus refers to Guard Sheltiun as Sheltian but the name in game is Guard Sheltiun.
1 gold and a few silver and copper per turn in.
I received Ringmail Cape, Ringmail Coif, Ringmail Sleeves and nothing as item rewards. Out of 51 turn-ins, received 34 pieces of ringmail.
Pieces sold to Paineel merchants that I'm ambiable with:
Approximately 1/2 to 1/3rd of a blue bubble of experience at level 4. 80 molars will get you 10% of a level at level 15
At level 19 -- 12 turn-ins were not even 1% (Ogre SK Cazic-Thule)
Level 19 Iksar Shaman - 11 turn-ins resulted in 1% xp gain. June 26, 2022.

quests.name: Langseax Quest
steps: This is the quest to obtain the Langseax or the Langseax of the Wolves. You need at least Kindly with the Wolves of the North to start this quest.

Faction Note: This quest requires a secondary quest - Lion Meat Shipment Quest which can probably be done with much lower faction. You can also do this quest a bunch of times in one go by asking Misla for the lion meat multiple times. Take empty bags and do you can do the quest 50+ times in one trip, gaining +350 Wolves of the North faction. You can use this to boost your faction for the Langsaex quest and get plenty Lion Delight for Iceberg.
Quest Summary:
Complete the Lion Meat Shipment quest to get Lion Delight.
Run to Iceberg, give Lion Delight, receive shirt.
Run to Frostbite, give shirt, follow Frostbite to the criminal.
Kill the criminal.
Return criminal's head for Langseax.
Part 1: The Story:
Go through the following steps to learn the story behind this quest. However, it's unnecessary - you can skip it and go to Part 2.

Go to Renth McLanis in the tavern across from Mac's Kilts. Ask him "What dangerous matter?". He tells you of a crime. Agree to hunt the murderer. Renth then sends you to see Dok in Dok's Cigars. Find out all you can about the crime.

He tells you to go see the leader of Clan McMannus. This is the fishing village located in West Karanas. Speak to the leader. Then speak to Ulrich McMannus and he tells you Frostbite can track prey if he has a piece of sweaty clothing.

Return to Dok and ask him "Where is the sweaty shirt?". He then tells you he sold it to Tundra Jack. Find Tundra Jack on the tundra of Everfrost. He will tell you that Iceberg is using it for a collar and that you can distract Iceberg with his favorite meal, Lion Delight.

Short version: You need a Sweaty Shirt for Frostbite to track the murderer. The polar bear Iceberg, Tundra Jack's companion and very good boy, has the shirt. You need some Lion Delight to get the shirt.
Part 2: The Sweaty Shirt:
Go back to Halas and speak to Teria O`Danos. Do the Lion Meat Shipment Quest.

If you want to do this quest multiple times - either to merge multiple Langseax or to get Langseax of the Wolves you can do a bunch of the Lion meat quests in one go to save time. Simply ask Misla for the lion meat shipment a bunch of times.
WARNING: Once you have Lion Delight, be sure to bury it lower in your container than your normal food to prevent it being eaten by you.
Take the Lion Delight to Iceberg and receive the Sweaty Shirt and a faction adjustment.

Iceberg can be found roaming the tundra of Everfrost, usually west of the river. He spawns at Tundra Jack's tower (2050,-3800) and immediately runs off to find Tundra Jack. However, if you wait at the tower, the two of them return to the tower frequently.
You can often find him stuck in pathing in front of the tower if you hop into a difficulty instance no one else is using, like D2 or D3.

After giving him the meat, he immediately respawns at the tower, making it easy to hand in the meat over and over and over for faction and more shirts if you plan to complete the quest multiple times.
Part 3: The Murderers:
This step appears to be slightly broken on EQ Legends - giving Frostbite the shirt causes the murderer to spawn, but Frostbite will not track for you.
Return to the McMannus fishing village in West Karana and give the shirt to Frostbite.
If Frostbite responds to the shirt with "RUFF RUFF" something bugged and the murderer did not spawn. He should react to the shirt with "Frostbite takes a whiff of the sweaty shirt and barks".

The murderer will be either Paglan or Basil. Paglan is tougher to kill and probably in his low to mid 20's, Basil is around level 20. Since Frostbite won't track for you it is recommended you just a loadout that includes a class with tracking. You can try finding them on your own, they seem to spawn on the western side of the map, but then run up into the mountainous north/northeast area of the map. Typically they pass through the area north of the Ogre shaman camp (area 18 on the West Karana map). Run speed buffs are also recommended.

Give the head to Renth for faction, coin, and of course, the Langseax (if you have Basil's head) or the Langseax of the Wolves (if it is Paglan's head). I am not sure what triggers which criminal you get or even if you can just kill both and get both heads, but it seems that you wil normally get Basil.
Faction Adjustments:
When you complete the lion meat quest:
Shaman of Justice (+7)
Wolves of the North (+7)
Merchants of Halas (+10)
Rogues of the White Rose (+5)
When you trick Iceberg and get the Sweaty Shirt:
Shaman of Justice (+5)
Wolves of the North (+5)
Merchants of Halas (+5)
Steel Warriors (+5)
Rogues of the White Rose (+5)
When you kill Paglan or Basil:
Rogues of the White Rose (-5)
(Stuff after this is unconfirmed for EQL)
When you turn in Paglan's or Basil's head for your reward:
Faction adjustments overall:
Here are the quest completion texts, and the unquantified faction changes.
Basil's Head
Renth McLanis says, 'Nice work [YourName]! Basil has always been an outcast of sorts. I'm glad to see you were able to stop him. Here is a Langseax for your efforts.'
You receive 8 gold from Renth McLanis.
OR Paglan's head

Renth McLanis says, 'Incredible!! We'd heard Paglan was killed attempting to cross an ice floe!! It appears his escape was for naught. Ye've earned something greater than a mere Langseax. Ye've earned the Langseax o' the Wolves. Tis an enchanted weapon meant for a warrior's skill only. The Tribunal will watch over ye.'
You receive 4 platinum pieces from Renth McLanis.
You receive 8 gold from Renth McLanis.
Be warned that the Halas Banker is part of the Rogues of the White Rose, so you may lose banking privileges if you lose too much of that faction.
Need all dialogues, current faction hits, /loc of quest mobs, additional quest items, quest mobs, details to get both Langseax and Langseax of the Wolves.
