quests.name: Leuz's Task
steps: Talk to Commander Leuz say, "I will accept this task" to receive Scout Tools (requires warmly faction or higher. If you don't have amiable faction you cannot complete the quest and will agro and train Scout/Dragons to the others at turn-in).
Give Scout Tools to Scout Charisa (v1) (to spawn a Kromzek Captain, several giants, and Scout Charisa v2)
Loot Broken Disk from Kromzek Captain

Give Broken Disk to Charisa (either version) (to receive Scout Report & Robe of Benevolence) ***DO NOT DO THE TURN IN UNDER AN ILLUSION (WOLF FORM ETC) AS IT AFFECTS YOUR FACTION - VERIFY BEFORE YOU TURN IN THE DISK***
OPTIONAL: Return the Robe to Charisa (to receive Bracer of Benevolence)
OPTIONAL: Return the Bracer to Charisa (to receive Talisman of Benevolence)
OPTIONAL: Give Scout Report to Commander Leuz (to receive faction & experience)

quests.name: Library Book
steps: You cannot do this turn-in at Indifferent.
See Testament of Vanear Quest.
Rarnan Lapice is located at -725, -85 outside the Temple of Divine Light in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Rarnan Lapice'
You say, 'I am a cleric of Quellious.'
Illithi Nollith is located at -1075, -220 in the Erudin City Library in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Illithi Nollith'
Illithi Nollith says 'Shhhh... Greetings, ______. Welcome to the Library of Erudin. Please respect the other patrons and speak softly.'
You say, 'I need the Testament of Vanear.'
Tol Nicelot is located at -1095, -240 on the top floor of the library in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Tol Nicelot'
You say, 'Did you know Moodoro?'
Moodoro Finharn is located at +165, +325 outside Crows Pub & Casino in North Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Moodoro Finharn'
You say, 'What Testament of Vanear?'
Give him 2 gold.
You receive a container called Testament of Vanear.
You say, 'Who is Ran?'
Ran Flamespinner is located at -45, -345 in Highpass Keep.
You say, 'Hail, Ran Flamespinner'
You say, 'What Testament of Vanear?'
Dyllin Starsine is located at +10, +55 in Highpass Hold.
You say, 'Hail, Dyllin Starsine'
You say, 'What Testament of Vanear?'
You have slain Dyllin Starsine!
You have looted a Page 30 of a Book.
Return to Moodoro Finharn.
You say, 'I want page 34.'
Give him 4 gold and receive a card. You can receive one of several, but eventually you will get the Jester.
Give Moodoro the Jester.
Combine Page 30 of a Book and Page 34 of a Book in the Testament of Vanear container to craft a different Testament of Vanear. Return to Rarnan and give this to him.
You receive a spell scroll.

quests.name: Lion Meat Shipment Quest
steps: This quest is also a part of the Langseax Quest, but can be done on its own. A good idea is to combine this quest with the Karana Clovers quest since they both go to the same place.
You say, 'Hail, Teria O`Danos'
You say, 'what lion roast?'
You say, 'I will pick up your lion meat shipment.'
In West Karana, find Einhorst McMannus (-3800, -2100):
You say, 'Hail, Einhorst McMannus'
You say, 'I am here to pick up the lion meat shipment for Halas.'
In West Karana, find Misla McMannus (-4025, -2340):
You say, 'Hail, Misla McMannus'
You say, 'I am here to pick up the lion meat shipment for Halas.'
You receive the Lion Meat Shipment. Bring it back to Teria O`Danos.
You receive 3 gold from Teria O`Danos.
You receive Lion Delight.

quests.name: Lionskin Gloves Quest
steps: There is an NPC named Ged Twigborn who hangs around another NPC and they will wander the forest at times. I usually see them in one of two places: either along the same wall as the zone to the commonlands, or by turning on the path off the main road from the sign pointing towards Freeport.
Ged will make you some gloves for a price. The lionskin gloves cost 96 gold and a high quality lion skin.

In order to get the lionskin gloves, you need a high faction with Ged, which you can get by killing Shralok Orcs in the Forest. High Quality Lion Skins are dropped by Highland Lions in EK. I have been told that a tiger spawns some times in the south west corner of Kith forest near the orc spawn and gives a high quality skin as well.
Need missing dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of quest mobs.

quests.name: Living Dragons
steps: Kyenka appears to be on Kromzek faction. Warmly faction is required for this quest.

He is located in Tormax's throne room, in close proximity to Tormax's guards, who are on King Tormax (Faction). Be very careful if you are KOS to Tormax. The safest mob to check this faction is Dlammaz Stormslayer, who is visible from the landing before the bridge in the preceding area.
You say, 'Hail Kyenka'
You say, 'What about these dragons?'
You say, 'I will help you purge them'
You say, 'I will assist you'
Turning in the Greater Dragon's Head results in Barbed Dragonscale Pauldrons
Turning in the Great Dragon's Head results in Barbed Dragonscale Boots

quests.name: Living Granite
steps: Works at dubious.
You say, 'Hail, a storm giant architect'
You say, 'I can make myself useful'
Geonid shaman drop a Block of Living Granite. Hand in four:
You receive A Gigantic Kromzek Pick.

quests.name: Lizard Dolls
steps: Grevek doesn't like lizards. You can give Grevak in the Greenblood guild 2 lizardman Mystic Dolls for a minor item.
Grevak says, 'You no getting big head!! Me still bash you gud! You no longer peon....you BIG peon now! Har! Har!......ok den, here great reward.'
You receive 4 gold pieces.

quests.name: Lizard Meat No 2
steps: You can give Soonog in the Greenblood guild 4 lizard meat for a rusty two handed sword.
You say, 'Hail, Soonog'
You say, 'Me Greenblood'
You hand the four lizardmen tails to Soonog:
You Receive Rusty Two Handed Sword.
At Indiffrent, you cannot do this quest. Presumably, this is only doable by fledgling Shadow Knights.

quests.name: Lizard Meat Quest
steps: Talk to Kogna and he will reward you for giving him 4 pieces (at once, NOT stacked) of Lizard Meat with experience and an Rusty Two Handed Battle Axe.
You say,'Hail, Kogna'
You say, 'I am a real tuff craknek'
Hand him four (unstacked) pieces of Lizard Meat. They cannot be given one-at-a-time!
As a level 5 Troll Shaman, each turnin was worth rougly 0.12% of a level. The Axe vendors for 2g 7s 8c.

quests.name: Lizard Tails
steps: You say, 'Hail, Horgus'
You say, 'i craknek'

quests.name: Lizard Tails No 2
steps: Grevak doesn't like lizards. You can give Grevak in the Greenblood guild four Lizard Tails for a minor item.
You say, 'Hail, Grevak'
You say, 'I am a new peon'
You hand the four lizardmen tails to Grevak:
Receive: 6sp

quests.name: Lodizal Shell Shield Quest
steps: This quest is offered by Bungre Crawcrusher, an Othmir at location -800, -400 (in the hut closest to the Skyshrine zone).
You say, 'Hail, Bungre Crawcrusher'
You say, 'I am a half elf'
You say, 'What predators?'
You say, 'What about Lodizal?'
A Section of Lodizal's Shell drops from Lodizal in the Iceclad Ocean. Bring it back along with the 10,000 gold pieces.

quests.name: Long Iron Rod Quest
steps: Kill A coerced revenant and loot the Tattered Memo and Rod Segment 'I'.
The Memo states:

If you combine Rod Segment 'I' and Rod Segment 'II' (A Kly Imprecator) with the Forge Hammer of Dalnir (dropped by an undead blacksmith who can be found in the room w/ 3 decapitated Iksar statues on the same floor as the chapel) in the Always Works forge, you will get the Long Iron Rod.
The Long Iron Rods use is unknown.
Need missing dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of quest mobs, list of additional quest rewards.

quests.name: Lord Grimlot's Love
steps: This quest follows Trumpy's Skull.
You say, 'Who is Arlena?'
You say, 'what about Mistmoore Castle?'

This quest no longer results in the Electrum-Bladed Wakizashi. I am not sure what if anything you get for this. Lord Grimlot tells you about his poor, misguided beloved Arlena, who has run away from him to Mistmoore castle. Being the sentimental type, he wants you to track down the lass, kill her and return her either the lute of the gypsy or her bones.

quests.name: Lupine Claw Gauntlets Quest
steps: Karg IceBear wanders the tundra, often passing by the North Tower.
You say, 'Hail, Karg IceBear'
You say, 'I have slain a werewolf.'
You say, 'I have its claws.'
Hand in Werewolf Claws and 75 pp for your reward.
No faction hit. Karg despawns.

quests.name: Lydl Mastat
steps: Hemia Skemner is located on the top floor of the Academy of Arcane Science.
You say, 'Hail, Hemia Skemner'
You say, 'I am a fellow scientist.'
You say, 'Who is Lydl Mastat?'
You say, 'I will teach Lydl a lesson.'

Lydl Mastat can sometimes be found outside the gate in East Freeport near a couple of cacti, he may also be an NPC titled Lydl the Great, located at -770, -1190. He is level 4 and is invulnerable to non-magic weapons, so he needs to be killed with magic.
Killing Lydl Mastat results in these faction adjustments:
Loot Locked Book.
You receive these faction adjustments when returning the book:
Around 4% xp at level 3

quests.name: Lynuga's Gem Collection
steps: Speak to Lynuga, a wandering troll in Innothule Swamp (usually found near the entrance to Guk).
You say, 'Hail, Lynuga'
You say, 'Collecting what?'
You can buy a Ruby from most jewelry vendors for about 131pp. Upon giving her a Ruby:

You receive one of the three rewards at random - the Hoop is the (ultra)rarest of the rewards. All three rewards are lore, to receive substantial return on investment do not turn in multiple rubies at once or duplicate rewards will be lost. Note: The Hoop was made even more rare on the 9/10/11 patch due to balance issues..

quests.name: Madame Serena Quest
steps: Madame Serena, and NPC by the docks, will give a riddle if you say "I follow XXXXX" where x is any god in the game. I have no idea if they lead anywhere useful or are just nice background information. Here is what she will say based upon the religion you say you follow:
No One - To be agnostic now is your chosen path. Now power holds sway but home and hearth.
The Tribunal - You wish to bring the land of justice for all crimes which are unpaid. Start your mission in Freeport, where crime is unafraid.
Karana - You will be safe in this city of thunder. Travel to the catacombs for easy plunder.
Tunare - From mother of all elves you comfort and peace. Walk into the crops of Karana and all troubles will cease.
Veeshan - The mother of all wyrms has her blood running deep withingreat cities. Be aware that you are not alone in this town of no pity.
Brell Serilis - The place of true power is usually beneath your feet. Stay in this city and a rare enemy you just may meet.
Innoruuk - To hate is your way. Just as the father of the dark race. Go forth to Nekutulos is where you should go at good pace.
Prexus - He created the Kedge freaks which are now gone from this land. Go deep into the caves of Jaggedpine and someone will take your hand.
Rallos Zek - To die in battle is the true and only way. Go into Blackburrow and join the fray.
Bristlebane - To be like the king of thieves is the path in which you sway. Go to Crow's after sundown. It is better than in day.
Cazic Thule - You will find that a slight friend is elvish and dark. Be forewarned that in this city it is best not to bark.
Mithaniel Marr - As is your god you are one of true valor which you cannot part. Go forth into the catacombs and say hail Mister Bloodheart.
Erollisi Marr - To be strong in the way of love is truly the only way. Go into Karana's Paw and enjoy your day.
Solusek Ro - To step foot upon his land would set your body ablaze. Go far north of Freeport to find the eye in the day.
Bertoxxulous - The catacombs contain safe haven for you and I. It is our place to you I tell no lie (Sounds like Serena is a worshipper of the Plaguebringer??)
Rodcet Nife - Thepower of healing is brought forth in your mass. Go past the gates and tell Zutros you are from Highpass.
Quellious - The tranquility and peace of the child lies within your heart. By fighting the opal elves, you shall be doing your part.

quests.name: Magic Elixir for the Warriors
steps: Find Dargon McPherson in northeast Halas at +470, -440 Was able to start this quest at cons Indifferent
**Update 04/27/2022** Able to start quest at Apprehensive.
You say, 'Hail, Dargon McPherson'
You say, 'I am a warrior o' the Wolves.'
You say, 'I will deliver an elixir to young warriors.'
You receive a Full Bottle of Elixir.
Find Talin ODonal is at +3620, +670 in the tunnel just outside Halas in Everfrost, near the two female merchants.
You say, 'Hail, Talin ODonal'
Give him the elixir.
You receive back One Quarter of Elixir. Note: It is actually a 3/4 full bottle, but its name is erroneously called "One Quarter of Elixir"
Find Bryndin McMill go down the ramp, then east, next to a tree and Snowflake at +2040, -1150.
You say, 'Hail, Bryndin McMill'
Give him the elixir.
You receive back One Half of Elixir.
Find Arnis McLish who may be found wandering in the southwest corner of the zone near (Blackburrow zone line) at -1600, -170. If he isn't there, wait a bit and he'll come running back.
Keep your eyes open as the vengeful lyrist roams around this area as well and will end a low level character very quickly.
You say, 'Hail, Arnis McLish'
Give him the elixir.
You receive back One Quarter of Elixir
You say, 'Where is Megan?'
Head back again to the previous spot with Bryndin McMill and Snowflake +2020, -1160. (Optional?)
You say, 'Hail, Snowflake'
You say, 'Where is Megan?'
Follow Snowflake east across the tundra, ending up at the North Tower at +2060, -3890. If Megan is not there, wait for her return (from a patrol) or respawn (orcs attacked her).
You say, 'Hail, Megan OReilly'
Give Megan the elixir.
You receive an Empty Bottle of Elixir.
Return to Dargon McPherson in Halas and give him the empty bottle.
You receive 1-3 copper from Dargon McPherson.
You receive a random low-level item.

quests.name: Magician Epic Quest
steps: The Beginning (Optional):
Go find Rykas in Lake Rathetear. Receive Token of Mastery.
Take the Token to Jahsohn Aksot in West Commonlands.
Words of Magi'Kot:
Kill an enraged dread wolf in Kithicor Forest. Loot Torn Page of Magi`kot pg. 1.
Kill Tentacle Terrors in the Estate of Unrest. Loot Torn Page of Magi`kot pg. 2.
Kill a bloodthirsty ghoul in Lower Guk. Loot Torn Page of Magi`kot pg. 3.
Take them to Jahsohn Aksotin West Commonlands. Receive Words of Magi`kot.
Power of the Elements:
Kill a gypsy dancer in Mistmoore. Loot the Power of Wind.
Kill Lava elemental or Blazing Elemental in Solusek's Eye. Loot the Power of Fire.
Kill famished ravener/Hungered Ravener/Gorged Ravener in Kaesora. Loot the Power of Water.
Kill A Fairy Guard/a faerie guard in Lesser Faydark. Loot Power of Earth.
Give these to Walnan in the Butcherblock Mountains. (You can MQ this step). Receive the Power of the Elements.
Words of Mastery:
Kill A Magician and A Goblin Magician in Najena or an alligator in Cazic Thule until you have the:
Torn Page of Mastery Earth
Torn Page of Mastery Fire
Torn Page of Mastery Water
Torn Page of Mastery Wind.
Give the torn pages to Akksstaff in Najena. Receive the Words of Mastery.
Power of the Orb:
Go back to Rykas in Lake Rathetear. Give him the Words of Magi`kot, the Power of the Elements, and the Words of Mastery. Receive the Power of the Orb.
Element of Fire:
Kill Neh'Ashiir in the City of Mist. Loot the Torch of the Elements.
Kill (in order of difficulty) Gylton, Phurzikon, or Nezekezena in the Burning Woods until one drops a Burning Embers.
Kill Undertow in Kedge Keep. Loot the Blazing Wand.
Take Power of the Orb and these items to Jennus Lyklobar in Skyfire Mountains. Receive the Element of Fire.
Element of Earth:
Kill Magi P`Tasa in the Plane of Hate. Loot the Staff of Elemental Mastery: Earth.
Kill Slixin Klex in the Burning Wood. Loot Dirt of Underfoot.
Quest for Shovel of Ponz.
Quest for Broom of Trilon.
Bring these all to Tiblner Milnik in Firiona Vie. Receive Element of Earth.
Element of Water:
Kill Phinigel Autropos in Kedge Keep. Loot Staff of Elemental Mastery: Water.
Kill Captain Rottgrime in The Overthere. Loot Tears of Erollisi.
Kill Tarbul Earthstrider in East Karana. Loot Rain of Karana.
Takes the three items to Jinalis Andir in Dagnor's Cauldron and receive the Element of Water.
Element of Wind:
Kill mobs on the 7th island on the Plane of Sky. Loot the Crown of Elemental Mastery.
Kill mobs in the Hole. Loot the Elemental Binder.
Kill Quillmane in South Karana. Loot the Pegasus Feather Cloak.
Give these items to Kihun Solstin in the Plane of Air and receive the Element of Wind.
Spell Summon Orb:
Go to the Master of Elements and give him the four Elements. Receive Spell: Summon Orb.
Scribe your spell and summon the Orb of Mastery!

quests.name: Magician Kael Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Mjeldor Felstorm in Kael Drakkal.
Summoner's Circlet
Summoner's Robe
Summoner's Sleeves
Summoner's Warband
Summoner's Gloves
Summoner's Pantaloons
Summoner's Boots

quests.name: Magician Skyshrine Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Ocoenydd Fe`Dhar in Skyshrine.
Prestidigitator's Headband
Prestidigitator's Robe
Prestidigitator's Sleeves
Prestidigitator's Wristband
Prestidigitator's Gloves
Prestidigitator's Trousers
Prestidigitator's Boots

quests.name: Magician Spells (Evil Version)
steps: Slicia J`Singe may found in the caster circle, wearing magenta.
You say, 'Hail, Slicia J`Singe'
You say, 'Magical scrolls?'
You say, 'What something do you need?'
Hand in one of the scrolls mentioned.
The scroll you get in return is a random 50 plus level spell.

quests.name: Magician Spells (Evil)
steps: Slicia J`Singe may found in the caster circle, wearing magenta, at loc +2790, +2390. She wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Bristlebane's Bundle
Gift of Xev
Quiver of Marr
Scars of Sigil
The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls.

quests.name: Magician Spells (Good)
steps: Hiptal Frizzleboth may be found in Firiona Vie, in a building not far west of the bank. He wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Bristlebane's Bundle
Gift of Xev
Quiver of Marr
Scars of Sigil
The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls.

quests.name: Magician Thurgadin Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Kyla Frostbeard in Thurgadin.
Arch Mage's Crown
Arch Mage's Robe
Arch Mage's Sleeves
Arch Mage's Warband
Arch Mage's Gloves
Arch Mage's Pantaloons
Arch Mage's Boots

quests.name: Majik Power
steps: Requires at least amiable faction, was not able to turn in while indifferent. Ogres cannot normally complete it or the subsequent Orc Belt quest. Dark Elves usually can.
You say, 'Hail Kaglari'
You say, 'I wish majik power.'
Give Kaglari two Froglok Tadpole Flesh and two Bone Chips.

quests.name: Mammoth Calf Hides
steps: You say, 'hail Cappi McTarnigal'
You say, 'I am a member of the white rose.' (If your faction is too low, he responds with 'The Order of the White Rose does not trust you with such a task.')
Give Cappi McTarnigal 4 Mammoth Calf Hides.
Although he prompts the phrase "[gnoll fur]", he does not respond to it.

quests.name: Mammoth Tusks Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Noxhil V`Sek'
After completing the Fire Beetle Eyes quest:
You say, 'what other components?'
You receive an Empty Chest.
Wooly Mammoths are found in Everfrost and the Kerran Beetle Eyes are found in Erud's Crossing, so you will have to do some hiking to get him his stuff.
Hand in the combined Beetle Eye Chest and Mammoth Tusks:

When you give him the Mammoth tusk and the combined box of Kerra Island beetle eyes, you will get some experience and a reward. I received level 12 necro spells each of the three times I did the quest.
You receive Spell: Engulfing Darkness
He then tells you that you seem to be of sufficient level to assist [The Dead].
You say, "what about the dead?"
After some research, the end of the quest line involving "assisting The Dead" was not implemented until the Call of the Forsaken expansion.
Need list of additional quest rewards.

quests.name: Marauder Armor
steps: This quest is offered by Drill Master Dal in East Cabilis. He is found -250, -125, 32.
You say, 'Hail, Drill Master Dal'
You say, 'I am a legion soldier'
Hand in four Marauder Snout Ring 'MM' (dropped by iksar marauders in the zones surrounding Cabilis):
You also receive a small amount of coin and a random piece of Leech Husk armor.

quests.name: Marda's Secret Mission
steps: This quest begins with Marda in the Shaman guild hall of Oggok.
After completing the captain necklace turn-in with Emissary Glib in the quest, The Emissary, he says:

Emissary Glib says 'Oooh!! .. You have dispatched the slayer captain. It will take them time to reorganize the slayers. During this time the froglok foragers can gather more provisions for Guk. Please take this as a token of my people's appreciation. Your standing with my brethren has grown. As for Marda's information.. within Grobb lies my aide, Groak. He was captured. Tell him Glib sent you.'
The froglok he refers to is a prisoner who's found near the jewelry vendor in Grobb. Say to him, "Glib sent me".
You say, 'Hail, a prisoner'
You say, 'Glib sent me'

He tells you he doesn't believe you and to prove you are legitimate. To prove it to him, hand him the necklace of a Troll basher. This is the "Intestine Necklace" that drops from Basher guards in Grobb and in Innothule Swamp.
Upon handing in the necklace, he gives you an Empty Vial to be taken to Forager Grikk in Innothule Swamp. (you may also receive a Hopper Spear for this turn-in):

a prisoner .Groak.. So you are a friend to the froglok. ..Grooakk.. I am soon to die. My precious legs are a delicacy here. Before I go I must contact my brother Grikk. He is a froglok forager in Innothule. Give him this vial. He will know what it means.
You receive Empty Vial ["Groak's Empty Vial"].
Take the vial to Forager Grikk.
You say, 'Hail, Forager Grikk'
You receive "Ochre Liquid" which you need to take back to the prisoner
The prisoner will then give you one of two different possible notes (both have the same outcome).
Zimbittle
One possible note involves Zimbittle (a female troll in Innothule Swamp) and how she's teaching the Lizardman Mystics to fight Ogres. Take the note to Marda who will insist you kill Zimbittle:
You receive a low level spell at this point.
Return to her with Zimbittle's Pouch as proof of her death:
You receive another low level spell.
Dorn B`Dynn
The other possible note involves Dorn B`Dynn (a dark elf in North Ro).
You receive 'A Tattered Cloth Note' that reads:
Nothern Desert of Ro B'Dynn Dervish Camp near shore. MUKK
Upon handing this note to Marda:
You receive a low level spell at this point.
Take the note to Dorn B`Dynn in North Ro:
You say, ' I am here to attend to business'
You say, 'Zimbittle sent me'
You say, 'Mukk'
You receive a sealed note (called what?) that reads:
Dorn, it is imperative for Grobb to send a small detachment of Bashers to raid the ogre encampment in the Western Plains of Karana.
During the melee, an Ogre traitor shall retrieve the Crystal Shard from the stone and return it Neriak Foreign Quarter. Do so at once.
Let no one keep the traitor from his escape. Beware the Oggok Shaman Marda has dispatched an agent also.
Nezzka Tolax The Dead
You say, 'Who is Goonda?'
If you take this note to Marda, she'll tell you to kill Zimbittle and bring proof of her death. Upon turning in Zimbittle's Pouch to Marda:
NOTE: This isn't true. Marda does not accept the note, and this little side quest is broken here and on live.
You receive a low level spell.

quests.name: Marr Minnows for Palon
steps: Would not give jar with amiable faction. Requires you to prove your worth by doing more quests with Tara Neklene
OR you can also do Rat Ear Pie Quest for Rephas in Qeynos Hills even at amiable to boost Arcane Scientist faction'
Palon can be found on the 2nd floor of the Academy of Arcane Sciences in West Freeport. (loc +112, -771, 4)
You say, 'Hail, Palon Deskeb'
You say, 'What Marr Minnows?'
You say, 'I will get the minnow'
He hands you A Jar of Liquid

Head to North Freeport outside the Hall of Truth (loc +210, 0.0 ) To the left side is a river, with minnows and piranhas in it. Give the Jar of Liquid to a minnow. You'll either fail or the Jar will turn into Fish in a Jar.
a minnow darts into the jar, or just darted past it!! The Knights of Truth do not tolerate people attempting to catch these fish!!
You Receive Fish in a Jar
Once you have a Fish in a Jar, go back to the Academy and give it to Palon. You'll receive a minor item and some coin for your trouble.
You received a Ration !
You receive 10 silver, 6 copper pieces

quests.name: Mask of War Quest
steps: You say, 'I am looking for work'
You say, 'what proof?'
A Chetari Courier in Dragon Necropolis drops a Wurmscale Scroll, which identifies as "dragons letter to wenglawks".
Hand the scroll into Captain Bvellos.
The reward is the Mask of War. Indifferent is not enough faction for this turn in.

quests.name: McMannus Revenge
steps: Broon's Eye
Turn in Broon's Eye to Einhorst McMannus.

quests.name: Mechanical Net Delivery
steps: This quest is the third in a series of quests, following Toolset Delivery and Spear Delivery. Those preceding quests are optional.

The first steps of this quest, in Kael, are also optional, and may even be considered a separate and unsolved quest. If you only want the purse, you may begin in Cobalt Scar by collecting 3 excellent siren scales and handing them to the outcast siren.
Wenglawks Kkeak regards you indifferently -- You would probably win this fight..it's not certain though.
You say, 'What third client?'

Wenglawks Kkeak says, 'Are you sure you will be up to this journey? It will take a hardened person to survive the trip. Let alone find my client. Do you really [want to go] out into the dangerous lands in the west?'
You say, 'I want to go.'

Wenglawks Kkeak says, 'I'm not sure if I can [trust] you with this. If you die on the trip, I will be losing profit! The other deliveries were much simpler, I remind you. Can I really [trust] you as far as I can throw you? Wait, that's a bad example - I could probably throw you quite far.'
You say, 'You can trust me.'

Wenglawks Kkeak says, 'I will curse your immortal soul if you fail, Rums. In the depths of the icy waters of the cobalt scar lives an outcast siren who preys upon her own kind. We have a deal, I will provide her with an excellent hunting net and she will provide me with a giant cloak made of the scales of her kind. Take this voucher to Kellek and deliver the net. Do whatever it takes to get my cloak.'
You receive Voucher for Mechanical Net. Give it to Kellek Felhammer in the next room. Kellek is a merchant, and so will never con worse than dubious unless you attack him. Just hand him the voucher.
Kellek Felhammer says, 'It's hard to belive a Iksar like you is going to make a trip like this. I don't envy you little fool.'
You receive the Mechanical Net.
An outcast siren can be found in Cobalt Scar at /loc -1414 -937 -39 in the water off the southern cliff.
an outcast siren regards you indifferently -- it appears to be quite formidable.
You say, 'Hail, an outcast siren'
an outcast siren says, 'Leave me alone, beast! Or I will cut your belly open and feed your entrails to the sharks.'
Give the Mechanical Net to an outcast siren.

An outcast siren says, "So you are the servant of Wenglawks here to retrieve the cloak. I will need more scales to make the cloak in his size. I have already slaughtered a good thirty sirens and the cloak is nearly complete. Go forth and slaughter my kind and bring me the finest scales you can find. Let this idol be your protection from the wrath of E'ci. I will continue my work on the cloak.'

You receive Idol of Solusek Ro (Quest Version) (quest version is no drop with no stats, nothing like pottery created version). You must now find three Excellent Siren Scales (uncommon drops from A Siren Enticer or A Siren Seductress in CS and rare drops from any siren in Sirens Grotto).
Return the three scales to her and she will give you back a cloak.
(1-2 scales may be MQ'ed)
An outcast siren says, "You are an excellent hunter. Tell me, did you enjoy the screams of the sirens as they perished? I find the sound so wonderful."
You receive Giant Siren Scale Cloak. Return to Wenglawks in Kael. Give the Giant Siren Scale Cloak to Wenglawks Kkeak.

Wenglawks Kkeak says, 'It is truly a sight to behold. This is the most fashionable cloak I have yet to see. Even King Tormax will be green with envy. This old bag has served me well, I hope you will find it to your liking.'
You receive Wenglawks Manly Purse.
Note: Make sure you target him while turning it in. I had Noble helssen targeted by accident but was facing wenglawks when he ate my cloak. Had it do it all over again.

quests.name: Medallion of the Jarsath Quest
steps: Part of the Rune of Scale (Key to Veeshan's Peak)

This quest results in the Medallion of the Jarsath, which is one of three medallions needed for the Rune of Scale Quest Quest to get into Veeshan's Peak. Xiblin Fizzlebik may be found on the chessboard island.
You say, 'Hail, Xiblin Fizzlebik'
You say, 'What Jarsath tribe?'
You say, 'What are you looking for?'
You say, 'I will help you'
He wants the following three items:
Upper Portion: This is just laying around in the Swamp of No Hope at 52, 2935, -6. Stick close to the right wall from Cabilis or left from Firiona Vie and you should find it.
Middle Portion: In Firiona Vie, an Iksar monk skeleton wanders around called an ancient Jarsath. He's level 41 or 42. He drops the middle part of the medallion. (This spawn has a /list)
Bottom Portion: This is located on a bloodgill marauder, who guards the Sunken Temple of Veksar at the bottom of the Lake of Ill Omen. (This spawn has a /list)

Remember that there are three separate medallions in the game, each broken into three pieces that just say a piece of broken medallion when you find it. You need to identify the piece of medallion you find to determine which one it is. Also, all 3 items are at a spawn rate of 8 hours.

quests.name: Medallion of the Kylong Quest

You say, 'hail Professor Akabao'.
You say, 'i have come to learn of the ancient tribes of the iksar'.
You say, 'who are the kylong?'.
You say, 'where is the medallion'.

Upper Portion: Found via the Niblek's Gems quest in Chardok. (bring Niblek a Black Sapphire and a Ruby)
Middle Portion: Dropped by Verix Kyloxs Remains, found in the sewers of Karnor's Castle.
Bottom Portion]: Found sitting on the floor in the library in Kaesora.
This quest results in the Medallion of the Kylong, which is one of three medallions needed for the Rune of Scale Quest Quest to get into Veeshan's Peak.

Remember that there are three separate medallions in the game, each broken into three pieces that just say a piece of broken medallion when you find it. You need to identify the piece of medallion you find to determine which one it is.

quests.name: Medallion of the Obulus Quest
steps: Part of the Rune of Scale (Key to Veeshan's Peak)
Slixin Klex is located at -681.59, -1120.76, -559.74. He is a level 50 skeleton and is indifferent to both good and evil races. He wants three medallion pieces:
Ask him "what burning of the land?"
Ask him "what tribe?"
Ask him "what medallion?"
Ask him "what pieces?"

Remember that there are three separate medallions in the game, each broken into three peices that just say a piece of broken medallion when you find it. You need to identify the piece of medallion you find to determine which one it is.
Obtain the three pieces:
Upper Portion: Given to you by Ssolet Dnaas, who spawns in the island in Warsliks Woods. You must do the Burnished Wooden Staff Quest to get it.
Middle Portion: Drops off a rotting skeleton at approximately loc 2250, -5140 in the Dreadlands 6 minute 40 second respawn.
Bottom Portion: Dropped by the Pained Soul in Trakanon's Teeth, Near the entrance to Old Sebilis. 1% @ (-1834, -4368)
Return them to Slixin. (This turn-in may be MQable.)
You obtain the Medallion of the Obulus, which is one of three medallions needed for the Rune of Scale Quest Quest to get into Veeshan's Peak.

steps: Your Location is 138.96, -106.46, 3.75

Ronn Castekin has met an unfortunate fate as an undead skeleton in the Qeynos Catacombs, near the entrance from the pond next to the Silent Fist monk guild. (860.12, 43.46, -39.78). Kill him:
Loot a Torn Parchment (identifies as "Note to Merona"). It reads:
Dear Merona, I wont be returning to you. You see, I have found my true calling as a disciple of
Bertoxxulous. I have become one of the Bloodsabers. I have foolishly given them my flesh. I was a weakling
and cried while they stripped it from my bones. I only pray that you too will someday know the pain that I
now endure as one of the undead. Your pitiful and stupid dead brother, Ronn
Bring this back to Merona.
You receive a minor reward, possibly a Band of Tunare or Ring of Pine.

steps: Find Miranda in the Stonebrunt Mountains, located in the Kejekan camp.
You say, 'Hail, Miranda'

Miranda would like some Chocolate Marr Cherries, which are made from three Marr Cherries and one Winter Chocolate (126 trivial baking).

quests.name: Mirgon Dower's Head
requiredItems: Hollow Skull (Skull of the Tower Cook)
steps: Give A Glowing Skull (no rent item) to A skeletal cook, you'll be rewarded with The Skull of Torture.
Looting the Glowing Skull:
While waiting for A skeletal cook to pop, kill high level skeletons around:
greater scalebones
lesser charbone skeletons
lesser icebone skeletons
Those skeletons can drop A Glowing Skull.
If you want more skeletons to kill, head to the second and third floors into the tower.
The Hand-In:
Hand the Glowing Skull to A skeletal cook:
He doesn't despawn after the hand-in. No faction hits are awarded.
Building the Glowing Skull by yourself (Broken):
Attention: The following is part of the broken quest that was not fixed on Live until Oct 2003.
You say, 'Hail, a skeletal cook'

a skeletal cook says, 'Some cracked old bones, two zombie flesh, and a salt minnow make up the rest. Throw inside a skull and mix, and I would have a delightful dish. But with no eyes I have no sight to make Kurn's delicious delight. And if I could I would not eat without a tongue behind my teeth.'
The Cook wants you to gather a number of items:
Bone Chips
Two Zombie Flesh - dropped by Rotting Flesh Hunters in the Field of Bone
Salt Minnow (fished in Cabilis) - Fished in East Cabilis
Preserved Eye (Left) - Give Galdon Vok Nir the left A Dusty Sealed Canopic
Preserved Eye (Right) - Give Galdon Vok Nir the right A Dusty Sealed Canopic
Dried Tongue - Dropped by Burynai Forager
Hollow Skull (Skull of the Tower Cook) - dropped by an undead jester, north of the stables
The Jester also drops a Tattered Scroll related to the quest. It reads:
Within the tower lies the corpse of Mirgon Dower.
A faithful servant of Kurn's deadly tower.
He served Kurn and kept him very well fed.
Now it is time to replace his head.
His new head did glow once upon a time.
Now there are no eyes, no tongue, to taste the sweet crunchy flesh.
And so the years flow.
When all are back together the magic will once again glow.
Inside the Hollow Skull, combine: Bone Chips + Zombie Flesh x2 + Salt Minnow. This yields you a Kurn's Jerky Delight (edible, so make sure not to eat it).
The Hollow Skull is returned to you. Now combine the Kurn's Jerky Delight + Preserved Eyes + Dried Tongue in the same container. This yields you a Glowing Skull (which is TEMPORARY).
ADDITIONAL NOTES REGARDING THE FORAGER:
Once in a while a Burynai Forager will pop in the Stables area. When killed he either yields one of 2 LORE dusty sealed canopics or a dried tongue.

When identified they turn out to be the Left Eye of Torture, the Right Eye of Torture, and the Tongue of Torture. Seems we are on the right track, but the canopics will not fit inside the skull, since they are SMALL sized.

The trick is to get the canopics opened. Go to Galdon Vok Nir, an Iksar in the evil outpost in The Overthere, he can be found inside the compound next to its easternmost wall. Invisibility will get you by the guards so you can talk to him. I am not sure if he indifferent to everyone or just Iksar.
You say, 'Hail Galdon Vok Nir'
You say, 'what is the eye of torture?'
for you.
[ Give him one of the canopics ]

Galdon Vok Nir grasps the jar and begins to push and turn the lid. 'Ahhh!! Here you are, my friend. Unngh!! It appears to be a preserved eye. I do not think it would be wise to eat it. Perhaps you can use it for another purpose.
Where did you find this jar?'
[ Give him the other canopic ]

Galdon Vok Nir grasps the jar and begins to push and turn the lid. 'Ahhh!! Here you are, my friend. Unngh!! It appears to be a preserved eye. I do not think it would be wise to eat it. Perhaps you can use it for another purpose.
Where did you find this jar?'
You say, 'in kurns tower'
You say, 'what Kromdul?'
The two Eyes of Torture will now fit inside the skull along with the tongue.

quests.name: Monk Sash Quests
steps: Faction:
The sash quests require "high amiably" faction in order to do. Sneaking only gives indifferent faction, and while wolf form grants amiably faction, it is not "high amiably".

You can check if you have the require faction by saying "what white training sash" to Velan Torresk. If your faction is insufficient, he will say "I have been watching you, and appreciate the help you've given to the brothers and sisters of the Ashen Order, but I feel that such a vital matter should be left to one of our more trusted members.". If it is sufficient, he will give you details on how to obtain the quest items.

A Human Monk starting out can instantly gain the required faction by simply turning in their newbie note. An Iksar Monk must embark on a faction grind, which is most simply done by killing Deathfist orcs in the newbie area of Freeport, and in East/West Commonlands. If you wish, you can repeat the White Sash quest to gain even more faction, along with Knights of Truth and Silent Fist Clan (Qeynos Monks) faction. You can also complete a few select quests to gain faction, see Ashen Order. By far the easiest of these is the Note for Konem quest, which you can fill your backpack and do quickly 100…
White Training Sash:
Turn the following items in to Velan Torresk in West Freeport:
2 - Deathfist Pawn Scalp - from Deathfist Pawns wandering outside the west gate of Freeport. Do not zone out to east commons, as the "orc pawns" out there drop a different type of scalp.
1 - Snake Fang - From the level 1 snakes also just outside the west gate of Freeport.
1 - Bone Chips - Any skeleton in the game can drop these. The Decaying Skeletons in west freeport do just fine.
Yellow Sash of Order:
Turn the following items in to Velan Torresk in West Freeport:

1 - Deathfist Slashed Belt - The Deathfist Orcs can drop these. Only Centurions and stronger orcs have a chance to give you a belt, not pawns. There are two Deathfist orc camps in east commons (along the north wall, on either side of the "Hidden Inn") where you can hunt or ask to buy one of these belts.

1 - Giant Snake Rattle - These drop off the tougher snakes, darkweeds and above. Darkweed snakes in East Commons are the quickest way to go. Giant Rattlesnakes in North Ro are another option. Warning: snakes have powerful poison.
1 - Desert Tarantula Chitin - Dune Tarantulas in North Ro are where you'll find these. Make sure you loot the right item - "cracked" chitins are not useful for the quest.
1 - White Training Sash - From the prior Quest
Orange Sash of Order:
ATTENTION: DO NOT TURN INTO VELAN TORRESK!:
Turn the following items in to Reyia Beslin in West Freeport:

1 - Legionnaire's Bracer - These drop off the Legionnaires of the Deathfist and Crushbone orcs. They're rather rare if you try to hunt legos in the Commonlands, the quickest way to get your bracer is to go to Crushbone (from Greater Faydark). There, they seem to drop like candy.

1 - Greater Lightstone - Willowisp type mobs drop these. The GLS is semi-rare, but not too hard to get if you hunt the wisps for a half hour or so. Alternatively, just send out an auction in West Commons. There are always people buying and selling lightstones there for a few plat.
1 - Cutthroat Insignia Ring - Any Dervish Cutthroat has a chance to drop one of these. There are three derv camps in North Ro, several in South Ro, one in West Commons.
Yellow Sash of Order - From prior Quest
REMINDER: TO REYIA BESLIN
Red Sash of Order:
Turn the following items in to Reyia Beslin in West Freeport:

1 - Blackened Sapphire ("the Sapphire of Souls") - This can be found on Ekeros in the Najena dungeon. Ekeros is a somewhat rare spawn, you can find him in the room just outside Rathyl's room. Note: a key is needed to get to Ekeros' spawn point. You can either get the key from another player, or you'll have to go after them yourself. Najena has a sequence of keys that open up deeper and deeper parts of the dungeon to you. The Ogre guards drop Guard's Keyring, the first one you'll need. BoneCracker drops another key, The Guard Captain drops a third. These are the only keys you need to get into…

1 - Blackened Wand - This drops from Priest Amiaz on the bottom level of Befallen. (Found at -474, 90, -78. Doesn't have a placeholder anymore, since The Thaumaturgist has its own spawn point elsewhere in the zone.)
1 - Orange Sash of Order
Reyia Beslin may be found at -154, -1502, -137.
You say, 'Hail, Reyia Beslin'
You say, 'I think I am ready to earn the red sash.'
You say, 'What task?'

You say, 'What is the Sapphire of Souls?'
You say, 'Tell me the legend.'
You say, 'I would like you to tell me about Kenox.'
You say, 'Tell me what happened to Toran.'

Marnek's wand is the Blackened Wand (identifies as "Marnek's Wand"), dropped by Priest Amiaz in Befallen (-487.77, 89.39, -76.61). The Sapphire of Souls is the Blackened Sapphire (identifies as "Sapphire of Souls"), dropped by Ekeros in Najena (-161, -47, -22). Bring them back along with your Orange Sash of Order. You'll need to be at least kindly faction to Ashen Order to finish the quest.
You receive the Red Sash of Order

quests.name: Muffin Quests
steps: Description:

There are two different types of Muffin quests outlined below. The first two quests involve buying Vendor sold Muffins in infinite supply and handing them directly to NPC. The second kind involves Baking them and combining into a Muffin Crate.
Vendor purchased Muffin Hand-in:
Muffin for Pandos (Freeport, Pandos Flintside):
Wenbie's Muffins (Qeynos, Guard Wenbie):
Fresh Baked Muffins:
This type of quest requires using 'Baked Muffins' (and not bought) for the 'Fresh Baked Muffins' series of quest listed below.
You will need * Baking (Trivial: 135)
Yield: Muffin x6
In Oven:

Please Note: that baked Muffin will look exactly like the vendor sold kind. Even identify spell does not distinguish the two but one will combine in the muffin crate and the vendor sold kind will not. So they are in fact two different item IDs
To get a Muffin Crate See Gretta Mottle in South Kaladim:

Only Gretta Mottle in Kaladim will still respond to acquire Muffin Crate to initiate this quest, but the Full Muffin Crate can still be handed in to any of the Innkeepers related to the Bread Shipment quests listed below.
You say, 'Hail, Gretta Mottle'
You say, 'I will help to bake'
You say, 'bake muffins'
You receive Muffin Crate!

Fill this container with 10 unstacked Muffins that were baked and Combine into a Full Muffin Crate. You can hand this back to Gretta to complete Fresh Baked Muffins (Kaladim) or you can hand it into any of the other towns Innkeepers that are related to the bread Shipment quests listed below.
Kaladim - Fresh Baked Muffins:
Gretta Mottle (South Kaladim):
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Gretta Mottle (Kaladim):
Gretta Mottle smells the aroma in the air and says, 'Mmm... Mmm... That sure smells good. You truly are a fine baker. Here, take this payment for such fine bakin.'
You receive 8 gold.
Qeynos - Fresh Baked Muffins:
Karn Tassen (South Qeynos):
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Karn (Qeynos):
Karn Tassen says, 'Hey, thanks kid! You are one top notch baker! Here's some coin for your trouble.'
You receive 7 gold.
Voleen Tassen) (South Qeynos):
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Voleen (Qeynos):
Voleen Tassen says, 'Oh my! Smell those muffins, fresh from the oven and ready to serve! They look delicious dear. Here is some money for your trouble.'
You receive 6 gold.
North Karana - Fresh Baked Muffins:
Innkeep James:
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Innkeep James (Northern Karana):

Innkeep James says, 'Ah, praise Karana! These muffins look good enough to eat, har har har! Here is your payment and you have my deepest gratitude. We have to stick together in these times of turmoil you know.'
You receive 8 gold.
Freeport Fresh Baked Muffins:
Winda Lylil East Freeport:
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Winda (Freeport):
Winda Lylil says, 'Ah yes! This is exactly what I am looking for, dear. Let me put these on the shelf right away. Here is some coin for your trouble. Perhaps we can do business again sometime.'
Innkeep Paggie East Freeport:
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Innkeep Paggie (East Freeport):
Innkeep Paggie says, 'Ah yes! This is exactly what I am looking for, dear. Let me put these on the shelf right away. Here is some coin for your trouble. Perhaps we can do business again sometime.'
Innkeep Rastle North Freeport:
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Innkeep Rastle (Freeport):
Gern Tassel says, 'These are quality muffins! You are obviously quite a skilled baker. Here is your payment as promised. Now I can get back to business again.'
You receive 6 gold.
Innkeep Nasumi East Freeport:
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Innkeep Nasumi (Freeport):
Innkeep Nasumi says, 'Ah yes! This is exactly what I am looking for, dear. Let me put these on the shelf right away. Here is some coin for your trouble. Perhaps we can do business again sometime.'
You receive 6 gold.
Fresh Baked Muffins (North Freeport, Gern Tassel):
Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Gern Tassel (Freeport):
Gern Tassel says, 'These are quality muffins! You are obviously quite a skilled baker. Here is your payment as promised. Now I can get back to business again.'
You receive 6 gold.

Turning a Full Muffin Crate into Hetie McDonald (Halas):

You receive 7 gold.

quests.name: Necromancer Skullcap Quests
steps: Necromancer 1st Rank:

Ask Master Xydoz in the Tower of Death about the Apprentice Skullcap. He wants you to prove yourself by bringing him four Sarnak Hatchling Brain and he will reward you with Apprentice Skullcap - 1st Rank. A Sarnak Hatchling is found in the Lake of Ill Omen near the entrance to West Cabilis. The hatchlings also drop Torn Tapestry, and Ripped Tapestry, save these for the second skullcap.
Necromancer 2nd Rank:

Talk to Master Xydoz again and ask him about the Second Rank Skullcap. He tells you he wants a Mended Tapestry. You need to acquire two pieces of the now-destroyed tapestry and repair them. The pieces are Torn Tapestry and Ripped Tapestry, which you find off of A Sarnak Hatchling in the Lake of Ill Omen. Tailor the two pieces together (the result is a Mended Tapestry, not a faded one, and EQTraders lists the trivial for this at 23) and hand them in along with your Apprentice Skullcap - 1st Rank for your Apprentice Skullcap - 2nd Rank.(Hint: Klok Sargin in Lake of Ill Omen usually has both com…
Necromancer 3rd Rank:

Talk to Master Rixiz and ask about the Third Rank Skullcap. He tells you he wants the brain of a Sarnak Crypt Raider and hands you a glass canopic. In this you must place the brain of a Sarnak Crypt Raider and embalming fluid. This quest is going to take a little Smithing and Brewing to complete.
Bone Granite Powder TEMPORARY - Blacksmithing (Trivial: 21) in Forge:
Embalming Fluid (Item) - Brewing (Trivial: <=21) in Brewing Barrel:
Sarnak Raider Brain from Sarnak Crypt Raider in Lake of Ill Omen near "Explorer Tower" (#7 on the map).

Kill everything around the tower area and the Sarnak Crypt Raider will eventually spawn. You may find it safer to stick close to the shore of the lake, as you will likely get lots of wandering enemies as you fight things here. Place both of these items in the canopic and hit combine. Head back to Master Rixiz and turn in the combined canopic (no longer a container) and your Apprentice Skullcap - 2nd Rank for your new Apprentice Skullcap - 3rd Rank.
Necromancer 4th Rank:

Talk to Master Kyvix next. He tells you he needs some new components. These are a creeper cabbage, a heartsting telson with venom, brutling choppers and a scalebone femur. He then hands you a Brood Sack and sends you on your way.

Creeper Cabbage is dropped by Man eating creeper in the Swamp of No Hope. Most people seem to agree that the best place to hunt these are near the "Outcast Iksar Camp" (#3 on the map). This is a food item so make sure you have plenty of food so you don't accidentally eat it.
"Heartsting Venom" (called a Scorpion Telson) is dropped by A Heartsting Scorpion in the Field of Bone. The one you want has the charge of Poison Bolt.
Intact Brutling Choppers) from A Skulking Brutling in Warsliks Woods.
"Scalebone Femur" (called a A Cracked Femur) is dropped by Greater Scalebone in Lake of Ill Omen, Field of Bone, and Kurn's Tower. Kurn's is best bet

Combine all 4 of these in your Brood Sack and head back to Master Kyvix and hand in the combined result with your Apprentice Skullcap - 3rd Rank for your Dark Binder Skullcap. Note: the xp reward was about 2 blues at level 20.
Necromancer 5th Rank:
After you complete the fourth rank quest, Master Kyvix says something about the "true mission". When asked about this "true mission," he gives you a Spectacle and sends you to see someone named Ryx.

Ryx is in the Overthere at the Dark Elf Outpost. Bind yourself outside the Outpost if you feel you are in danger of dying during the hand-ins! (It's less annoying to rebind than it is to do a CR back to Overthere). Ryx is disguised as a skeleton worker on top of the westernmost boat (aka hammer hill) and cons indifferent. Levitate from the hillside into the boat to get up to him. Place yourself north-west of him to be as far away from the Skeletons who are on the ground. He doesn't reply anything to hails. Give him the spectacle first and he will say:
"I live to study and quench my thirst. I live to bash the faces of the Pariah and entangle myself in the ivy of evergreen. I live. I want to remember."
This translates into the following four items:
Spectacle (received from Master Kyvix)
Green Death Rum (bought in East Cabilis)
Forsaken Pariah Mask from an Iksar Pariah (Lake of Ill Omen, Warsliks Woods, Swamp of No Hope)
Evergreen Ivy Ringband from the Forest Giant Evergreens (Warsliks Woods)
Give him the remaining 3 items.

Once he has all these four items he gives you a metal key. Give the Metal Key to Tin Banker Assistant at the Overthere outpost. You have to wait till (Evening, Nighttime) the General who is in the bank leaves to check up on his troops. You have to be at least level 20** to finish this part. Giving the key to the banker will get you a tome (A Journal), 6 gold, 6 silver and 6 copper. Give the tome (A Journal) together with your 4th level "Dark Binder Skullcap" to Master Kyvix to receive the Occultist Skullcap, 5 gold pieces and 3 blues of experience @ level 20.
Necromancer 6th Rank:
High amiable faction with Brood of Kotiz is required to complete this portion of the quest.

Master Kyvix now wants you to track down an item called the Kor Sha Candlestick, which is in 2 pieces. He sends you to speak with Keeper Rott. The magic words are 'I am the chosen occultist'. Keeper Rott tells you he doesn't have the pieces but tells you where to find them...on Sarnak Revenants in the Lake of Ill Omen.

Although Keeper Rott tells you that both pieces of the Candlestick can be found on A sarnak revenant, this quest has been reverted to it's original form and the Revenants will only drop the first piece. The revenants also drop a note which makes reference to the candlestick, and indicates where to look for the other half.
Stem of Candlestick (identifies as: Stem of a Kor Sha Candlestick) from A sarnak revenant at the Sarnak Fort

Head to Firiona Vie. In the North East corner roughly at location +4000, -2200. Head south and you'll see an open field with mainly Drolvargs and Frogloks moving about, this is the general area you want to be at. To your east you'll see a hill with a small Giant fort and to your west the zone just continues onward with more Drolvargs and Frogloks (with the occasional Drachnid) keep in mind to Con everything you see, as some Drolvargs can see right through your invis.
Stein (identifies as: crafted in West Cabilis - GRYPE) from the a halfling swashbuckler, Most sites agree that he can be found roughly at +2200, -1700 so you'll want to check around there first.

Once you've gotten that stein, head back to East Cabilis and go to #2 on the map, just directly south-west of the Shaman/Shadow Knight guild. One the top floor of that building you'll find an iksar named Grype, who only spawns at night. Grype responds to the question "what candlestick?" and will tell you about the swashbuckler when asked. Give him the stein and in exchange he'll give you: Foot of Candlestick (identifies as: Foot of a Kor Sha Candlestick).
Take the pieces to Master Kyvix and hand them in along with your current Skullcap to receive your Revenant Skullcap.
Necromancer 7th Rank:
Kindly faction with Brood of Kotiz is required to be able to receive the Unfinished Scepter from Harbringer Glosk. Being in Skeletal form boosts this faction.

Time to talk to Harbinger Glosk. Hail him and say "I am the new revenant." He wants your help finishing a scepter for the Emperor. He hands you an Unfinished Scepter and tells you to find 4 gems and combine the gems and the scepter in the Forge of Dalnir.
First the gems. The gems you want are:
Eye of RokGus (dropped from a burynai slave in Mines of Nurga)
Gem of Yet to Come (dropped from A Sarnak gem oracle in Lake of Ill Omen)
Jewel of Ganak (dropped from Red Eye Jack in Firiona Vie)
Shiny Emerald (dropped from greater charbone in Emerald Jungle).

After you have the gems, the next step is to find the Forge of Dalnir (aka the "Always Works" forge). The forge is located on the third level of Dalnir (#10 on the map). In order to be able to use the forge, you need the
Forge Hammer of Dalnir from An Undead Blacksmith located on the third level of Dalnir (#9 on the map)
Combine the scepter, gems and hammer in the forge to receive the Scepter of Emperor Vekin. Return this to Harbinger Glosk and receive your shiny new Sorcerer Skullcap.
Necromancer 8th Rank:
I got the Yellow Whip on the west wall from a wulfware lonewolf. Seemed to path in like all the other Lycanthrope spawns. Posting in case we can ever do this quest.

Got the Yellow Whip from a decaying skeleton in nektulos forest.

quests.name: Necromancer Words - X`Ta Tempi
steps: You can get 12 words needed for high level Necromancer pet research from the three Sisters (X`Ta Tempi, Timpi, and Tompi) in Neriak Foreign Quarter (-10, -45).
You say, 'Hail, X`Ta Tempi'
You say, 'Who are the Sisters Dark?'
You say, 'What Necromancy?'
You say, 'Who are the Dead?'
You say, 'What Lore of Death?'
You say, 'How are the words hid?'
You say, 'What components?'
You say, 'What tasks?'
You say, 'What reward?'
You say, 'What about Words of Possession?'
She is asking for a Charred Dagger actually from Unrest, two Barbed Bone Chips, and a bloodstone.
You say, 'What about Words of Haunting?'
She is asking for two Dark Bone Chips, an Ebon Dagger actually from Unrest, and a jasper.
You say, 'What about Words of Collection?'
For Beza, she wants the globe of darkness which is a Sphere of Unrest, an Eye of Kor, and an amber.
For Caza, she wants a Globe of Fear, an Eye of Guk, and a jade.
If you ask about any of the other words:
Upon completing the turn-in for the Words of Haunting, the dialogue was:
Need all dialogues, current faction hits from other hand-ins.

quests.name: Necromancer Words - X`Ta Timpi
steps: You can get 12 words needed for high level Necromancer pet research from the 3 Sisters (X`Ta Tempi, Timpi, and Tompi) in Neriak Foreign Quarters (-10, -45). It is really easier to get them though randomly looting creatures than by doing the quests.
Timpi will give you the following words:
Words of Detachment:
2 x Dull Bone Chips (Unrest)
1 x Charred Dagger (Unrest) (Mistmoore)
1 x Bloodstone (Bought/Dropped)
Words of Rupturing:
1 x Festering Cloak (Unrest)
2 x Ebon Wand (Unrest)
1 x Jasper (Bought/Dropped)
Words of the Suffering:
1 x Globe of Fear (Feerrott/Oasis/TOFS from Spectres)
2 x Iced Bone Chips (Befallen)
1 x Star Rose Quartz (Bought)
Words of Requisition:
1 x Eye of Fright (Plane of Fear)
1 x Stone of the Wraith (Plane of Fear)
1 x Pearl (Bought/Dropped)
You say, 'Hail, X`Ta Timpi'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'We three are the [Sisters Dark] - [Necromancy] is our Art - Bonded dead, they serve our will - No beat of heart, yet faithful still.'
You say, 'Necromancy'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'Necromancy - Art of the Dead - Binding bones to serve your will - We research now the [Lore of Death] - Ancient spells with power still.'
You say, 'Lore of Death'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'The Lore of Death is shadow bound - Its [words] are [hid], yet shall be found - Through our research into the dark - Old hexes found and parchment marked.'
You say, 'words'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'The Words are hid in tomes of old - Their yielded lore worth more than gold - Though we search both 'fore and 'hind - [Components] we cannot yet find.'
You say, 'Components'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'We need components for research - These are things that you could find - In return for [tasks] that you perform - Words of [reward] we have in mind.'
You say, 'tasks'

X`Ta Timpi says, 'Bring us components for our research - We give [Word]s by tasks performed - [Possession], [Detachment], [Allure], [Haunting], [Rupturing], [Dark Paths], [Suffering], [Collection], [Obligation], [Requisition] and [Acquisition].'
Lead-in phrases appear to not work, items can still be handed in for the rewards however.
You say, 'I want words of requisition'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'From the Plane of Fear, bring an Eye of Fright and a Stone of the Wraith - From a merchant bring a pearl - Then Words of Requisition will to you be given.'
You say, 'I want words of detachment'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'From the Estate of Unrest, bring dull bone chips - From Castle Mistmoore, a dagger charred - From a merchant bring a stone of blood - Words of Detachment will be your reward.'
You say, 'I want words of rupturing'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'From the Estate of Unrest, bring a festering cloak - From Castle Mistmoore, ebon wands - From a merchant bring a jasper stone - Then Words of Rupturing will to you be given.'
You say, 'I want words of suffering'
X`Ta Timpi says, 'From Befallen, bring Iced Bone Chips - From spectres, bring a Globe of Fear - From a merchant bring a Star Rose Quartz - Then Words of Suffering will to you be given.'
Need all dialogues checked, current faction hits, /loc of quest mobs.

steps: You can get 12 words needed for high level Necromancer pet research from the 3 Sisters (X`Ta Tempi, Timpi, and Tompi) in Neriak Foreign Quarter (-10, -45). It is easier to get them though randomly looting creatures than by doing the quests.

Turmoil Warts (Plane of Fear)
Pearl (Bought/Dropped)
