quests.name: Neonate Cowardice
steps: Find Davorre Bloodthorn in Paineel's Shadow Knight guild, The Fell Blade @(863, 444). Minimum faction for this quest is not documented, but kindly is sufficient.
You say, 'Hail, Davorre Bloodthorn'
You say, 'I am a neonate.'
You say, 'I will make use of my pathetic cowardice.'
--You receive A Rolled Up Note.--
Give the note to Auhrik Siet`ka. You'll find him in The Abbatoir, Paineel's Necromancer guild @(762, 849).
You say, 'I understand common.'
--You receive a Small Sealable Bag.--
As instructed, gather the following items, all of which are obtainable from creatures found in the Paineel newbie yard, and combine them in the Small Sealable Bag, a 4-slot container:
Bat Wing
Rat Ears
Snake Egg
Fire Beetle Eye
--You receive a Small Sealed Bag.--
Return the Small Sealed Bag to Auhrik Siet`ka. Upon turn-in:
You receive 8 copper pieces.

quests.name: Nesiff's Statue
steps: Your Location is -122.39, -303.39, 3.28
You say, 'Hail, Vesteri Nomanoi'
You say, 'What favor?'
You receive a Claim Check (identifies as "Vesteri's Claim Check"), which reads:
CLAIM CHECK - NESIFF'S WOODEN WEAPONS - QEYNOS: ONE Custom STATUE - CUSTOMER: Vesteri Nomanoi
Head to South Qeynos, inside Nesiff's Wooden Weapons (loc 440.56, -243.45):
You say, 'Hail, Nesiff Tallaherd'
Give Nesiff the claim check.
You receive a Wooden Statue (identifies as "Statue of Tunare"). Take it back to Vesteri.
You receive 1 silver from Vesteri Nomanoi.

quests.name: Newbie Quest: Halfling Druid
steps: Upon creating a Halfling Druid, you will have a tattered note in your inventory. The note reads as follows:
You'll start directly in front of Hibbs Rootenpaw, but if you lose him, his location is -38.50, -424.75, -11.81.
Upon handing him the tattered note:
You also receive the Jumjum Sack Tunic. Good luck, druid!

quests.name: Newbie Quest: Troll Warrior
steps: Upon creating a Troll Warrior, you will have a tattered note in your inventory. The note reads as follows:
Ranjor's location is 308.29, -169.40, 27.00.
Upon handing him the tattered note:
You also receive the Mud Covered Tunic.

quests.name: Niblek's Gems
steps: Found deep in Chardok in the slave area is a small RatMan who cons indifferent named Niblek.

Once hailed, he is looking for some old jewellery. He wants a Black Sapphire and a Ruby. If you give these to him, you get some experience and a 'Piece of Medallion'. When Identified, it's the Top Shard of the Kylong Medallion, which is needed for the Medallion of Kylong Quest.

NOTE: If you spend enough time in Temple of Droga or Mines of Nurga (or, after the Chardok 2.0 revamp, if one turns in enough Green Goblin Skin or Mt. Death Mineral Salts) it is possible to raise your faction to the point where you can walk around Chardok without agroing any of the mobs there, which makes this quest very easy.
You say, "Hail, Niblek"
You say, "What treasures?"
You say, "What do you want?"
Hand Niblek a ruby and a black sapphire.

quests.name: Nillipuss the Brownie
steps: You say, 'Hail, Reebo Leafsway'
You say, 'What crops?'
You say, 'What about Nillipuss?'
You say, 'What lesson?'
Nillipus is approximately level 17 and likes to run around the main roundabout in town around Fool's Gold and down the passage by Meeka Diggs.
Attack him and kill him.

You will need to kill Nillipuss mutliple times to get four Jumjum Stalks. Many times he won't drop any jum jum. Make sure they identify as "Nillipus' Jumjum" as a merchant also sells Jum jum that won't work for the quest. Bring the four Jumjum Stalk to Reebo:
You receive 15 silver from Reebo Leafsway.
You may also randomly receive one of several items (listed above).

quests.name: Noble Hunters
steps: Guntrik is in the Oggok Warrior guild.
You say, 'Hail, Guntrik'
You say, 'Me wanna help Crakneks'
Time to hunt the hunters! Seek out the noble hunters in Innothule Swamp. They tend to hang out in front of Upper Guk and are around levels 14 - 17.
Bunk Odon
Gwynn Marthank
Hogus Durmas
Jars Legola
Rell Ostodl
Tann Cellus
Tal Godin
Zepin Winsle
NOTE: You receive negative faction hits with various good races for killing the nobles.
Upon turn-in of A Noble's Crest:
You receive a large bronze weapon. Experience gain is negligible at 15.
Additionally, nobles can sometimes drop a Tattered Parchment. Upon turn-in to Guntrik:
Travel to Rathe Mountains and look for the Inn operated by the Drinns (#13 on the map). Kill both Sven Drinn and Philicia Drinn and loot their Human Scalps. Return them to Guntrik in Oggok.
You receive an Ogre War Maul.

quests.name: Note for Janam
steps: Ale:

Harkin Duskfoot may be found at -326.57, -844.42, -110.68 in the Freeport Tunnels among the Dismal Rage guildmasters in the southwestern corner of East Freeport. Beur Tenlah is standing right next to him. (Under the Seafarer's Roost in the basement, look behind some crates and boxes for a fake wall that you can walk through. Go down the stairs and through the door. Take your first left and around the corner will be Harkin and Beur
You say, 'Hail, Harkin Duskfoot'
You say, 'Hail, Beur Tenlah'
Purchase some Dwarven Ale and give it to Beur.
Message to Janam:
You say, 'What message?'
You receive a Note to Janam.
Go to West Freeport and find Janam Rekish at outside the Ashen Order building, northwestern side.
You say, 'Hail, Janam Rekish'
Give him the note.
You receive a Note to Harkin. Head back to East Freeport and give Harkin the note.
You receive 6 copper pieces.

quests.name: Note for Konem
steps: Phin Esrinap is in the monk's guild in North Qeynos.
Tell Phin Esrinap, "Where is Konem?."
He will say he left somewhere and hasn't returned, and will give you a note to take to him.
You receive Message to Konem.
Konem Matse is in Qeynos Hills. He is always very close to one of the two paths and he is usually under a tree. Give the note to Konem.
You receive: Grathin's Invoice.
It reads:

Phin -- I am sorry to report that the wooden arms you ordered last week, have not yet arrived. I've sent my assistant to find out what happened to the last trade caravan. Probably bandits again. I'll let you know as soon as I find out anything. -- Grathin
Give it to Phin.
You receive a Water Flask.

quests.name: Note for Rebby
steps: Find Nestral TGaza at location -193, -835 in the East Freeport Tunnels , among the Dismal Rage in the southwestern corner of the zone. (Under the Seafarer's Roost in the basement, look behind some crates and boxes for a fake wall that you can walk through. Go down the stairs, open the door. Open the next door in front of you and find her on your left.)
You say, 'Hail, Nestral TGaza'
You say, 'I will help'
You say, 'I can run to Janam and Rebby's'
You receive: Message to Rebby. Find Rebby and Janam in West Freeport at location (-156, -720), In front of the Theater of the Tranquil, near Brownloe Bakery & the Ashen Order.
You say, 'Hail, Rebby Willend'
Hand in: Message to Rebby. This turn-in requires a certain faction level. (Reportedly completable with dubious faction)
You receive: Rebby's Rat Whiskers.
Return to Nestral TGaza in East Freeport. Hand in: Rebby's Rat Whiskers
Unlike many faction numbers on the wiki this one appears to be spot on.
You receive 7 copper pieces from Nestral TGaza.
Nestral TGaza says, 'Thank you _____, You have done well.'

quests.name: Note to Neclo Quest
steps: Talk to Daenor Casthopur, located behind the Temple of Magic in South Qeynos. Your Location is 281.38, -631.25, 2.14
You say, 'Hail, Daenor Casthopur'
(How do you know to say this?)
You say, 'Who is Neclo?'
You receive a Note to Neclo (identifies as "Daenor's Note to Neclo"). The note reads:
Greetings Neclo, I've sent one of our students to you for some training. Thanks, your friend, Daenor Casthopur.
Neclo Rheslar may be found in the Qeynos Hills wandering near the tower (1028, -843, 35). Give him the note.
You receive a low-level spell.
Need list of quest rewards:
Spell: Gate
Spell: Lesser Shielding

quests.name: Odd Items
steps: Hail Guard Frandan:
You say, 'what odd items'
Not sure where it goes from here, but you probably give him something. Upon giving him Kromdul Toothpick he says and returns nothing.

Edit: I don't actually think you give him anything. There are multiple examples in Firiona Vie of people talking about rumored items in Kunark. I think this was just stand in dialogue without actual quests attached.

quests.name: Odus Pearls
steps: Weligon Steelherder may be found in a small room in the back on the first floor of the Temple of Deepwater Knights, at -1040, -395.
You say, 'Hail, Weligon Steelherder'
You say, 'What Deepwater tasks?'
You say, 'What Peacekeeper battlestaff?'
You say, 'I will collect the Pearls of Odus.'

You receive an Empty Bag (strangely, identifies as "Zombie Flesh Bag"), a 4-slot size SMALL bag. Pearl of Odus are ground spawns underwater in the harbor of Erudin at -275, -460; -215, -475; +5, -485; +955, -620 (any other /locs?). They are guarded by level 8 a sand shark. Combine four in the bag.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new!
You have fashioned Full Bag of Pearls.
Give this to Weligon.
You receive 14 silver from Weligon Steelherder.
Known rewards: Patchwork Sleeves, Small Bag, Tattered Skullcap, Worn Great Staff

quests.name: Ogre Heads
steps: Please fill in the missing dialog that begins this quest. Unsure of a lead in from another quest. As a Wood Elf Ranger with Warmly faction, Byzar only offers the Runnyeye Warbeads (Kaladim Warrior) quest when hailed

After completing The Mudtoes the quest giver Furtog Ogrebane will give you the lead to start this quest. However, you might want to do this quest first, as these ogres are quite a bit lower level than the ones Furtog sends you after.
Byzar Bloodforge is located at -108, 381, 3 or -38, 400, 3 as he paths between two rooms in the Kaladim Warrior's Guild.
You say, 'What about Corflunk'
Upon the death of Corflunk
Upon the death of Zarchoomi
Zarchoomi says, 'Your destiny lies at the hands of the Greenbloods.'
Hand Byzar Bloodforge the Ogre Heads looted from Corflunk and Zarchoomi.

quests.name: Old Dreams
steps: You say, 'Hail, Dreamspeaker Lyssiara'
You say, 'What offering?'
You will need the following:
Goblin Ice Necklace - any goblin in Everfrost Peaks.
Fire Goblin Skin - any goblin in Solusek's Eye
Holiday Gift from any turn in. Must be unopened.
Hand Dreamspeaker Lyssiara the Goblin Ice Necklace, Fire Goblin Skin, and a Holiday Gift.
You receive Chapter VI, The First Frost and a Holiday Gift.

quests.name: Orc Belts
steps: Note: This can be turned in at Dubious. Watch out for Roaming Ela Foodcrafter, it seemed as an iksar I got to dubious with Guardians of the Vale long before Storm Reapers who were threatning, red con at 40 she had a large aggro radius and cast dispell.
Deputy Budo is located (-256, 561) in the first tower south of the opening in the wall.
You say, 'Hail, Deputy Budo'
Deputy Budo no longer responds to any further text, if you hand him a Deathfist Slashed Belt you receive:
You receive 1-8 copper from Deputy Budo.

quests.name: Orc Hatchets
steps: You must have Amiable faction to complete this quest.
Dill Fireshine is located at -434, 524, 118 in the Faydark's Champions (Ranger) Guild Hall.
You say, 'Hail, Dill Fireshine'
You say, 'What blue meanies'
You say, 'Who are the orc saboteurs'
You say, 'I will hunt the orc pawns'
Hand Dill Fireshine 2 Orc Hatchets, looted from orc hatchetmen and orc pawns roaming throughout the Greater Faydark.
You receive 12 copper pieces.

quests.name: Orc Pawn Picks
steps: Trizam N`Tan in the warrior guild gives the quest to return 4 Orc Pawn Picks to him for faction, money and occasionally an Item
Loc:
You say, 'Hail, Trizam N`Tan'
You say, 'What Deathfist Agendas?'
You say, 'I wish to collect pawn kills'
Hand in 4 Orc Pawn Picks...

quests.name: Orc Picks
steps: This quest is given by Guard Valon at the toll booth in the West Commonlands. (LOC: -4, +74) Dubious faction is sufficient.
You say, 'Hail, Guard Valon'
You say, 'dangers in the commonlands.'
You say, 'assist the freeport militia.'
Valon has a bounty on orc pawns and will take their Orc Pawn Picks from you four at a time in exchange for faction and a small amount of coin.
Tip: You can often find huge amounts of Orc Picks on merchants near the Freeport newbie area and in The Commonlands.
You receive 1 gold pieces.
Once your faction is at a high enough level, you can do the Cutthroat Rings quest as well (a requirement for the Reserve Militia quest).

quests.name: Orc Runner (Felwithe)
steps: General Jyleel is located at 18, -198, -19 downstairs in the Paladin Guild Hall. You must have Amiable faction to complete this quest.
You say, 'Hail, General Jyleel'
You say, 'I seek enlightenment'
You say, 'I follow Tunare'
You say, 'I will assist the defenders'
You say, 'What Crushbone runners'

The orc runner spawns every 23 minutes at -1121, -2843, 0 near the zone line into Greater Faydark where he will run west along the road until meeting his demise at the hands of, Guard Mandin and Guard Zyburr, the two dwarf guards at -968, 6, 0.
Loot the Runner Pouch and a Sealed Letter from the slain orc runner.
Hand General Jyleel the Runner Pouch.
You receive 1 gold, 7 silver, 6 copper pieces.
Hand General Jyleel a Sealed Letter.
You receive 1 gold, 7 silver, 6 copper pieces.

quests.name: Orc Runner (Kelethin)
steps: This quest follows Orc Hatchets given by Dill Fireshine, located at -434, 524, 118 in the Faydark's Champions (Ranger) Guild Hall.
You say, 'What Crushbone allies'
You say, 'I will intercept the Crushbone runners'

The orc runner spawns every 23 minutes at -1121, -2843, 0 near the zone line into Greater Faydark where he will run west along the road until meeting his demise at the hands of, Guard Mandin and Guard Zyburr, the two dwarf guards at -968, 6, 0.
Loot a Sealed Letter and the Runner Pouch from the slain orc runner.
Hand Dill Fireshine the Runner Pouch.
You receive 12 copper pieces.
(Another data point) You receive 4 gold, 4 silver, 9 copper pieces, and a Rusty Two Handed Sword.
Hand Dill Fireshine A Sealed Letter.
You receive 1 platinum, 15 silver pieces.

quests.name: Orc Scalp Collecting
steps: Captain Ashlan spawns in two different areas, both are in the pass itself not the keep. One is up the steps near the Kithicor Forest end above the orcs, the other is near the gnoll camp at the East Karana end, also above the pass. He tends to walk around a lot.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Ashlan'
You say, 'What job?'
You say, `What Volunteer Watch?'
You say, 'What orcs?'
Turn in an Orc Scalp (you may turn in up to four at once).
Fixed amount of coin per turn in.
Notes about Experience per Scalp

quests.name: Orc Vest
steps: The merchant Linadian is located at -142, -545, 161 in Kelethin, two platforms over from the Scouts of Tunare (Rogue) Guild - alternatively - in West Freeport at loc (56, -299). A certain faction level, presumably with Kelethin Merchants, is required for this quest in either case. Dubious is not high enough.
-Confirmed she is not on Faydark's Champions or Emerald Warriors faction.
You say, 'Hail, Linadian'
If your faction is insufficient (dubious is not high enough.)
You say, 'What banded orc vests'
If your faction is sufficient:
You say, 'What banded orc vests'
Hand Linadian 2 Crushbone Shoulderpads, a Crushbone Belt, and a Silk Swatch - alternatively - 2 Deathfist Shoulderpads, a Deathfist Slashed Belt, and 10 gold pieces.

quests.name: Order of Thunder (from Drosco)
steps: Kasine Paegra can be found at the Temple of Thunder in South Qeynos (-246, -477).
You say, 'Hail, Kasine Paegra'
You say, 'What is the Order of Thunder?'
The Order of Thunder rarely drops from Drosco in the Qeynos Aqueducts. Return it to Kasine.
Kasine Paegra begins to cast a spell.
You feel a little better.

quests.name: Ortallius' Cutthroat Rings
steps: Ortallius may be found at +1100, 1275.
In short, hand him 3 rings.
You say, 'Hail, Ortallius'
You say, 'What dervish cutthroats?'
You say, 'I wish to join the crusade.'
Ortallius grins enthusiastically. 'The scum rarely wander far from their camps. Hunt them down and I will reward you for every three insignia rings you bring as proof of their deaths.'
Search and destroy: kill dervish cutthroats until you obtain three Cutthroat Insignia Rings. Hand them to Ortallius.
Experience gains:
13 Ogre SK, one turn-in, 4% points
17 Halfling Druid, two turn-ins, 5% total points (about 2.5% each)

quests.name: Oven Mittens
steps: Carver Cagrek is located in the back of Grobb, near the bank and the Shaman Guild. He's holding an axe, and standing near a dismembered dwarf on a hook. Can't miss him, really.
You say, 'Hail, Carver Cagrek'
You say, 'What oven mittens?'
Hand three (unstacked) Froglok Meat and 10 gold to Carver Cagrek.

quests.name: Package from Lomarc
steps: This quest begins in the Qeynos rogue guild and is a low level quest. If you hang out in the main hall near guildleader Hanns and wait, eventually the female rogue guildmaster in the room with him, Renux Herkanor, will approach Hanns, and have the following conversation with him:

Hanns Krieghor says 'Lomarc is already back. He sent word that the guards are onto him, so he's laying low for a bit. He also said the cost for delivery just went up, because he had to pay off the owner of Mermaid's Lure.
Hail Renux and ask 'Who is Lomarc?'
You say, 'I will meet Lomarc'
She hands you a note called Lomarc's Payment or something like that. If you open and read it, it says something to the effect of "you screwed up".

Lomarc spawns at night only. His placeholder is Den Magason, an NPC who is involved in two other quests ('The Package' and 'Blank Scrolls'). They both walk the same route in South Qeynos at the docks. They stop at the merchant with the big fish next to him, and they walk down the set of stairs and stand on the shore. they also stand in the corner on the outside of the empty port authority building. Give the so-called 'payment' to Lomarc, and he says:
He then attacks you. Faction hits for killing him:

Lomarc drops a Kerran Doll. I am not sure if this is the same as the Kerran Doll required in the new Paineel cleric guild quest or not. Loot the Kerran Doll, and return it to Renux in the rogue guild. she will respond:
You gain the normal Qeynos rogue faction (opposite of when you kill Lomarc), and
Need /loc of quest mobs, quest rewards.

quests.name: Paladin Epic Quest
requiredItems: Cold Plate of Beef and Bread
steps: Fiery Avenger
Complete quest for The Fiery Avenger, which includes the quest for SoulFire and camping (or questing) Ghoulbane
Gleaming Crested Breastplate
Tainted Darksteel Breastplate - thought destroyer in Plane of Hate.

Do the Pure Crystal Quest or in other words Find Jark in North Kaladim. Tell him "I will get your dinner". Nella Stonebraids will spawn in the temple area, tell her "Do you have Jark's Dinner?" Receive: Cold Plate of Beef and Bread
Give Cold Plate of Beef and Bread to Jark Receive: Pure Crystal.
Give Tainted Darksteel Breastplate and Pure Crystal to Reklon Gnallen in Quellious Temple in Erudin for Gleaming Crested Breastplate.
Gleaming Crested Sword
Tainted Darksteel Sword - Keeper of the Tombs, the Hole.
Tell a peasant woman in West Freeport at -190, -725 "I will take it to him." Receive: Bucket of Water
Give the Bucket of Water to Joshua in West Freeport at -245, -710 in the back of the bakery. Receive: Bucket of Pure Water
Give the Tainted Darksteel Sword and Bucket of Pure Water to Reklon Gnallen in Quellious Temple in Erudin Recieve: Gleaming Crested Sword.
Gleaming Crested Shield
Tainted Darksteel Shield - Kirak Vil (56th level), Nektulous Forest.
Give to Elia the Pure, in Felwithe, for Gleaming Crested Shield.
Mark of Atonement
Turn in the three purified items (Gleaming Crested Shield, Gleaming Crested Breastplate, and Gleaming Crested Sword) to Reklon Gnallen for the Mark of Atonement.
Fiery Defender
Turn in Mark of Atonement and Fiery Avenger to Irak Altil, a wandering skeleton in Plane of Fear to receive your Fiery Defender.

quests.name: Paladin Hunting
steps: See the Shadow Knight guildmaster, Garuc Anehm, in the Qeynos Catacombs.
You say, 'Hail, Garuc Anehm'
You say, 'I am new to the shrine'
You say, 'I am a young shadowknight'
You say, 'I loathe paladins'
You say, 'Commander Kane?'
You say, 'What common goal?'
You say, 'Where is Commander Kane on duty?'
Your targets are paladins and priests in West Karana. The best place to hunt them is in the cut-away section of the hills leading to Qeynos Hills.
Gomo Limerin
Ronly Jogmill
Kobot Dellin
Lander Billkin
Parcil Vinder
Grebin Sneztop
Habastash Gikin
Kyle Rinlin
Quegin Hadder
Tolony Marle
NOTE: These mobs tend to be difficult for their levels. Some dual wield. All can cast Lay on Hands.
On the turn-in of the Order of Thunder (Not to be confused with Order of Thunder (Drosco), which Garuc will NOT accept):
You receive a Rusty Short Sword.
On the turn-in of Prayer Beads:
You receive a Wrist Pouch.
Warning!

quests.name: Paladin Kael Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Barlek Stonefist in Kael Drakkal.
Shining Helm
Shining Breastplate
Shining Vambraces
Shining Bracer
Shining Gauntlets
Shining Greaves
Shining Boots

quests.name: Paladin Message
steps: Theron Rolius is found in the Hall of Truth at (1100, -128).

Faction Note: I believe (will edit if I kill enough orcs or get there) this requires amiable faction with Knights of Truth otherwise you get the following from the milk bottle hand in: "Mojax Hikspin says, 'You have yet to earn my trust.'" All dialog works as apprehensive.
You say, 'Hail, Theron Rollius!'
You say, 'I will join the crusade.'
You say, 'How can I assist in other areas?'
You say, 'I will retrieve the message for you.'
Travel to West Commonlands to find the courier. Mojax Hikspin is located at 109, 2339
You say, 'Hail, Mojax Hikspin!'
You say, 'What is your job?'
You say, 'I am from the Hall of Truth.'
Give a Bottle of Milk to Mojax Hikspin.
Wait approximately one minute for Mojax to rest. He will then start walking toward the Toll Booth. At some point during the walk, Duggin Scumber will run up and steal the Note .
Duggin Scumber is a fast runner. If you cannot keep up with him, use root, snare, or a ranged weapon to stop him for battle.

Alternate way of getting the note: After some time, Mojax Hikspin will walk around the Commonlands. If you follow him, he will walk from the lake to the Stone Sign saying "Freeport <-", stop, then walk north again to his spot. He drops the note at (-560, 3174) at the Stone marker.
The note reads:
Eestyana Naestra
Let it be known that the Shrine of Bertoxxulous has discovered our agent which infiltrated their ranks.
It is now my belief that they will soon send word to Freeport and put your agent in jeopardy.
Beware. Renic Losaren High Priest of Thunder Qeynos
Once you have the Note, return to the Hall of Truth. Find Eestyana Naestra on the third floor at (186, -126) and give the note to her.
You receive ~1 silver from Eestyana Naestra.
You receive a random reward (see above).

quests.name: Parrying Pick Quest
steps: Note: This quest requires Friendly faction
Find Diggins located at 658, 304, -53 in the mining tunnels just outside the Kaladim bank. He does, on occasion, wander up to the bank.
This quest is the 2nd step after completing the Runnyeye Warbeads (Kaladim Rogue) quest~
You say, 'I want to earn a parrying pick'
(I think this quest dialogue is incorrect. He is responding for the 3rd quest for a Miner's Pick. Instead just ask him about doing a great favor)
You say, 'What great favor?'

Go loot 4 different bandit tongues that are No Drop. Three of them Barma Dunfire, Crytil Dunfire and Keldyn Dunfire are from the bandit camp in Butcherblock Mountains located at 280, 1648 (10 on the Map) not far from the three Goblin Warrior camp.
You have slain Crytil Dunfire!
--You have looted Crytil's Tongue.--
You have slain Keldyn Dunfire!
--You have looted Keldyn's Tongue.--
You have slain Barma Dunfire!
--You have looted Barma's Tongue.--
Find the fourth Bandit Rondo Dunfire located in Crushbone. This elusive blagard hides amongst the slaves in the Slaver Caves of Crushbone.

In the main room of the slaver cave there are two slaves next to eachother. His placeholder is the slave on the left - next to a wheelbarrow. (not the spot with Kelynn) This is rather bothersome as your options are either hoping to get an orc slaver to drop the correct Slave Keys its 1 out 7 and they are not a guaranteed drop. OR if you kill a slave you will take some bad faction hits. Better off having an evil friend or alt kill the slave PH for you.
Hand in the Brass Earring for the taskmaster quest to clear out dwarven slaves as well while improving faction instead of taking hits.
You have slain Rondo Dunfire!
--You have looted Rondo's Tongue.--
Return to Diggins and hand all 4 tongues in to him to receive your Parrying Pick 628 (a Magic weapon Dwarf Rogue only item).
You receive Parrying Pick 628 !
This leads into a 3rd quest Miners Pick from Mater

quests.name: Paw of Opolla Quest
steps: With room for a container in your inventory bring Vin Moltor a Rat Ear Pie and 3x Bottle of Kalish to get, or kill him until he drops, a Severed Paw
Camp Gynok Moltor (spawns just outside room 4 on the 3rd floor of Befallen until he drops the Platinum Ring , Gold Ring ,and Copper Ring
Swim to the bottom of the pit in Blackburrow for the Silver Ring (see map for location on 3rd floor (several razorgills surround it).
Combine the rings together in the Severed Paw

quests.name: Peacekeeper Staff Quest
steps: Info for EQL: if you are not at least indifferent to Emil Parsini he will not accept the letter! sneak behind is your friend here ;-)
Lumi Stergnon is located at -640, -90 in the Temple of Divine Light.
You say, 'Hail, Lumi Stergnon'
You say, 'I am a new acolyte of peace.'
You say, 'I will retrieve the Peacekeeper staffs.'
(You must have high Amiable faction with the PeaceKeepers to get this part)
You receive A Sealed Letter (identifies as "Note For Emil Parsin"). It reads:
Hail Emil Parsini, I have sent this new member of the Temple of Light to retrieve our delivery of the Peacekeeper Staff.
Please see that the staff is given to this member. Lumi Stergnon
Emil Parsini is located at 2119, 423 in Toxxulia Forest, in a hut just outside of Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Emil Parsini'
Hand him the letter.
You receive a Peacekeeper Staff, a 2-slot container.
Pearl of Odus are found as ground spawns underwater in the harbor of Erudin at (-275, -460); (-215, -475); and (+5, -485).
Each Pearl looks like a bag on the ground and is guarded by A sand shark that is about level 8. None of the KoS sharks in the water see invisibility.
Pearls can be collected before you make the trip to Qeynos to The Cobbler.
Gerault Takenmaul is located at -70, +10 in The Cobbler in North Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Gerault Takenmaul'
You say, 'I need treant wood.'
Rodgar the Tall is located at -80, -10 upstairs in The Cobbler in North Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Rodgar the Tall'
You say, 'I need treant wood.'
You say, 'What favor?'
Hand Rodgar 4 x Pearl of Odus.

(This step can be used to raise a few factions. It can be done at Apprehensive, possibly lower. You can fill your bags with Pearl of Odus and turn them all in, 4 at a time, for the stackable, not lore, Wooden Shards and return to Erudin with multiple shards)
You receive Wooden Shards. Return to Emil Parsini and hand it to him.

You receive Treant Resin. Combine the resin and a Pearl of Odus in the Peacekeeper Staff container to craft a non-container Peacekeeper Staff. You can return to Lumi Stergnon and hand this in for faction, some XP, some coin and a rusty weapon, or simply use the Staff.
You receive 11 silver, 12 copper from Lumi Stergnon.
You receive a random piece of Patchwork Armor

quests.name: Phosphorous Powder for Zok Zribb
steps: Zok Zribb may be found at (-2134, 306) in Rathe Mountains underneath a tent.
You say, 'Hail, Zok Zribb'
You say, 'supplies'
Give Zok Zribb 2 Phosphorous Powder,
You receive between 2 - 8 gold, 2 - 6 silver per turn-in.

quests.name: Pickled Frogloks
steps: There doesn't appear to be any intro text associated with this quest. Hailing Chef Dooga will give you dialogue options for the Preserved Meat Delivery quest. But it still works.
Chef Dooga is located at (201,-243) in Oggok.
Give Chef Dooga 3 x Pickled Froglok and 10 gp. (1 platinum also works.)
The Ogre Butcher Apron vendors to Chef Dooga for over 8gp, making this a cheap quest for repeating.

quests.name: Piranha Hunting
steps: A priest named Celsar Vestagon in the Temple of Marr is concerned with the danger to the Marr Minnow posed by the piranha. He wants you to go collect some for him and put them in a box. Go kill piranha in the pond by the Hall of Truth and fill the box. Combine it and return it to the priest for experience, copper, increased faction with Priests of Marr and sometimes an item.
Need all dialogues, /loc of quest mobs, current faction hits if any, list of quest rewards, missing quest items.
You say, 'Hail, Celsar Vestagon'
You say, 'What minnows of Marr?'
You say, 'I will eradicate the piranha!'
You receive an Empty Fish Sack.
For every a piranha you kill in North Freeport, you take the following faction adjustments:
(Fresh Piranha also drops off of piranha in Surefall Glade and you take no faction adjustments when you kill them.)
Put four Fresh Piranha in the sack and combine to create a Sack of Piranha. Give it to Celsar Vestagon
You receive some copper and occasionally a cleric spell or potion.

quests.name: Pirate Earrings
steps: Styria Fearnon may be found on Erollisi Isle (/loc?).
You say, 'Hail, Styria Fearnon'
You say, 'What Pirates of Gunthak?'
You say, 'I wish to hunt the pirates.'
The pirates can be found on Seafury island at about +780, -5440. Kill them until you get a Pirate's Earring, then turn it into Styria to get:
Random reward item.
0% xp at level 9.

quests.name: Pixie Dust (Kelethin Ranger)
steps: Ran Sunfire is located at -461, 496, 118 in the Faydark's Champions (Ranger) Guild Hall.
You say, 'Hail, Ran Sunfire'
You say, 'What pixie tricksters'
You say, 'I will exterminate the pixies'
You recieve an Empty Pouch, a six slot, tiny capacity container. Fill it with 6 unstacked Pixie Dusts, looted from a pixie trickster and combine it. Return the Pouch of Pixie Dust to Ran Sunfire.
You receive 6 copper pieces.

quests.name: Pixie Dust (Kelethin Rogue)
steps: Expin is located at -553, -157, 162 in the Scouts of Tunare (Rogue) Guild Hall.
You say, 'Hail, Expin'
You say, 'I am a new scout of Kelethin'
You recieve an Empty Pouch, a six slot, tiny capacity container. Fill it with 6 unstacked Pixie Dusts, looted from a pixie trickster and combine it. Return the Pouch of Pixie Dust to Expin.
You receive 6 silver, 3 copper pieces.

quests.name: Plaguebringer Proof
steps: Find Roesager Thusten in North Qeynos at loc -127.82, -115.97, 3.13 (Optional)
You say, 'Hail, Roesager Thusten'
You say, 'Who brings disease?'
You say, 'Who is Bertoxxulous?'
You say, 'What Plaguebringers?'
You say, 'What proof?'
This quest uses Gharin's Note (evil) or Gharin's Note (Good) as a sub-quest; you can either give Gharin's real or fake note.
Go to South Qeynos and find Gharin (at Dubious Guards of Qeynos, Gharin will NOT TALK to you, but he will still take the Brew).
You say, 'Hail, Gharin'
You say, 'What job?'
You say, 'Where is the Jaggedpine?'
You say, 'What is the Lion's Mane?'
Hand four Crows Special Brew to Gharin.

Note: There are two kinds of Crow's Special Brew in the game. Crow's Special Brew with an ' Apostrophe in the name that comes from Tattered Pouch quest will not be accepted by Gharin. The correct kind Crows Special Brew is purchased from Crow himself but this is a limited supply item (20). Once he sells out, its all gone until a server restart or respawned by killing him.
You receive 1 silver from Gharin.
You receive A Sealed Letter (identifies as "Note To Jaggedpine"). It reads:
Te'Anara, I have spoken to the merchants guild of Qeynos.
We have agreed to increase the tax on all bearskins.
The Qeynos Guard shall also be apprehending all known poachers for extradition to the Jaggedpine.
Signed, Antonius Bayle
Go to the Surefall Glade and find Te'Anara right next to the port-in spot (Optional)
Note: This step is no longer required to trigger Tovax Vmar who now spawns nightly
You say, 'Hail, TeAnara'
Give her the letter.
You receive 2 gold from TeAnara.

Go to Qeynos Hills at loc and wait until 9PM Norrath time for Tovax Vmar to spawn. He then wanders to a few spots, stands there for a short time and randomly or rarely will drop the letter on the ground (looks like small bag)

This Escort part is challenging because he wanders across the newbie area past 2 potential Qeynos Gaurds and another NPC. He is very low level and will get killed immediately by any of them, not to mention real players.

I suggest either killing the guards in Tovax's path or asking someone to kite them or root them far out of the way the entire night until until he drops it, as well as asking players in /ooc to avoid Tovax while you do the quest

(For me, I had to wait for Tovax to complete one of his pathing rotations and on the 2nd stop at the tree ( loc 200, -1000) at 4AM game time he dropped the Sealed Letter just before wandering off again)
If you don't pick up the note, it will despawn.
The note is called "A Sealed Letter" (identifies as "A Letter to Opal"). It reads:
Opal-- Things are moving ahead on schedule. The sewer complex is complete and we have begun to gather forces.
We are concerned about the Lifers' interference. Your assistance in this matter would be greatly appreciated.
--- S'ragg
Return to Roesager Thusten in North Qeynos:
You say, 'Hail, Roesager Thusten'
Give Tovax's note to Roesager. (Good version)
You receive 3 silver from Roesager Thusten.
You receive a minor item.
OR - (Evil Version)
Hand the Sealed Letter to Sragg Bloodheart in Qeynos Aqueducts
You receive 11 silver, 11 copper pieces
OR - (Evil Version Part 2)
Hand the Sealed Letter to Tovax Vmar in Qeynos Hills.
Tovax Vmar says, 'Oh yeah that's mine. Thanks chump... I mean chum. Here's a little something for you.'

quests.name: Plane of Mischief Armor Quest
steps: Talk to Bob the Painter and give him your Words of Wealth: you will get an Empty Pot of Gold (2 slot container).
In that container combine:
a Armor of Distraction piece (created via the Deck of Spontaneous Generation Quest)
a Plane of Mischief Doll (created via the The Gift Box quest)
to create the corresponding piece of Plane of Mischief Armor for the class indicated by the Plane of Mischief Doll.

quests.name: Plane of Mischief Faction Quest
steps: If you take Stomples's foot, he will no longer be able to stomp. This is one of the only things that will make the inhabitants of Plane of Mischief permanently angry at you. To correct this situation, bring it to Debbis the Fish.
You say, 'Hail, Debbis the Fish'
Give her the A Rabbit Foot.
Receive A Lucky Skunk Foot. Bring this to Vinny V. D`vicci, who is outside the castle on the wall.
You say, 'Hail, Vinny V. D`vicci'
Give him the foot.
Your faction should now be back to where it started before you killed Stomples.

quests.name: Plane of Sky Keys
steps: On the first island (Key Master/Thunder Spirits Island), he spawns once Thunder Spirit Princess dies. Hand him one Miniature Sword to get the Key of Swords (to island 1.5, Noble Dojorn Island, which is a one-way trip). Hand him one Lost Rabbit's Foot to get the Key of the Misplaced (to island 2, Azarack Island).
On the second island (Azarack Island), he spawns once the Protector of Sky dies. Hand him one Broken Mirror to get the Key of Misfortune (to Gorgalask Island).
On the third island (Gorgalosk Island), he spawns once Gorgalosk dies. Hand him one Animal Figurine to get the Key of Beasts (to Harvester Island).
On the fourth island (Harvester Island), he spawns once the Keeper of Souls dies. Hand him one Bird Whistle to get the Avian Key (to Spiroc Island).
On the fifth island (Spiroc Island), he spawns once the Spiroc Lord dies. Hand him one Noise Maker to get the Key of the Swarm (to Wasp Island).

On the sixth island (Wasp Island), he spawns once the Bazzt Zzzt dies. Hand him one Dull Dragon Scale to get the Key of Scale (to Drake Island). Telling him the phrase "Am I one with the wall" will make The Sister of the Spire spawn on Drake Island.
On the seventh island (Drake Island), he spawns once the Sister of the Spire dies. Hand him one Replica of the Wyrm Queen to get Veeshan's Key (to the eighth and final island, Butterfly Island).
There are no keys to be obtained on the eighth and final island.

quests.name: Poacher Leader
steps: After you hand the Poacher Head (it may take more than one) to Jras Solsier outside of the Temple of Divine Light in Erudin, he will ask you to find out who is leading the activities of the poachers.

This leader is Talym Shoontar, who is also wanted in Surefall Glades for his activities. Talym appears in Qeynos Hills, somewhere between the cottage, the road marker, and the Guard Tower. He appears by the WK zone border and heads down the road towards Qeynos. He is about lvl 15, and is roughly on par with Dorn B'Dynn, the scourge of the Northern Desert of Ro. Plus, if you attack him in Qeynos Hills, the guards will attack you. For a safer way to kill him, Shoontar also occasionally appears in Fish Tavern's back room, where you turn in the moonstones for gnoll stouts. This may only happen af…
He appears in Surefall as well. If you hand his Barbarian Head to Jras Solsier, he says, "It is done! Quellious will look favorably upon our church and we will look favorably upon you. Go in peace."
Need missing dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of quest mobs, list of additional quest rewards.

quests.name: Poacher's Head Quest (Erudin)
steps: CANNOT BE COMPLETED AT INDIFFERENT FACTION; MUST BE HIGHER.
Jras Solsier is located at -610, -135 outside the Temple of Divine Light in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Jras Solsier'
You say, 'I will protect the peace.'
You say, 'I will catch the poachers.'
Hand in a Poacher's Head to Jras. Note that the poacher's head doesn't have to be from one of the poachers in the Toxxulia Forest. The heads from the Surefall Glade poachers will also work.

quests.name: Poacher's Head Quest (Surefall Glade)
steps: You say, 'Hail, Gillarian Naelev' (179.39, -35.15)
You say, 'What about poaching?'
You say, 'I want to join the hunt.'
Poacher Spawns in Surefall Glade and Toxxulia Forest:
In Toxxulia Forest you will find 5 named poachers that drop Poacher's Head. Use track on a Ranger, Druid or Bard.

If you don't have Track, try near the Wizard spires, Middle of the zone a little ways from the water, and top of the zone near the left before the water. There are other places and they wander a little while after spawning.
Poachers have a 10 seconds spawn timer including their placeholders.
Poachers share placeholders
Poacher Dell and Poacher Willa share a timer with a widow hatchling. Spawn Location: Southern third of the zone, right side of the river.
Poacher Hill, Poacher Topi and Poacher Shelli share a timer with a large skunk and a widow hatchling. Spawn Location: Upper left side of the zone, right side of the river.

If you don't see any poachers, go find the hatchlings and large skunks and kill them. 10 seconds after ones dies, you should have a new Poacher, hatchling or skunk on track. If you don't, that wasn't one of the placeholders, go find a new placholder and try again.
I have not see a poacher in surefall glade in EQL, so I believe they have been removed. Information here on Surefall Glade in case it comes back.
# 1 Waterfall Cave (/loc 221,-179): shared spawn point for Poacher and Mammoth (named bear). Poacher drops a regular Poacher's Head for coin and faction rewards.

# 2 Hidden Cave (/loc 144,-415): behind the hidden wall cave entrance, and the shared spawn point for Gnoll Poacher, a poacher, and a bear cub. The Gnoll Poacher drops the Gnoll Head used for the Rough Elm Recurve Bow quest reward. A poacher drops a regular Poacher's Head that just nets you coin and faction rewards.

The spawn timer for either spot is approximately 2.5 minutes, but the mobs in both locations will start to wander around the tunnels shortly after spawning. The will path back to their spawn points if you don't want to go looking for them though. If you blindly sit on either spawn point, you could be waiting anywhere from 7.5 - 30 minutes for the spawns to cycle through.
Turn Ins:
Hand Gillarian Naelev a Gnoll Head (identifies as "Gnoll Poacher Head").
Rewards include 7 gold, a Rough Elm Recurve Bow.
Hand Gillarian Naelev a Poacher's Head.
The Poacher's Head does not have to be from one of the poachers in Surefall Glade. The poacher's heads from the poachers in the Toxxulia Forest will also work.
You receive 3-6 Gold.
Additional Dialog:
You say, 'What master poacher?'
This is an alternate lead into the quest for Talym Shoontar's Head.
What dialogs/faction hits/rewards do you receive from turning in other versions of Gnoll Head?
Need list of quest rewards.

quests.name: Poison Cures
steps: Waltor Felligan says, 'Hello, me friend! I'm the resident healer o' Halas. Please inform me when ye've a need fer me talents to [bind wounds], [cure disease] or [cure poison]. Might I add, if ye're a young shaman o' Halas, ye can also [assist in gathering fungus].'
You say, "Please curse disease."
Waltor Felligan says, 'I'll be needing mammoth steaks to feed the unfortunate. Then we'll drain the poison from yer veins.'
After you hand him Mammoth Steaks:
Waltor Felligan says, 'The scales have been balanced and the Tribunal has spoken. Yer body shall be saved.'
You feel much better.

quests.name: Poison Sales
steps: Conium Darkblade is located atop the island peak (-263, -826) in Dagnor's Cauldron.
You say, 'Hail, Conium Darkblade'
You say, 'What is wasp poison?'
Hand Conium 3 x Giant Wasp Venom Sacs and 30gp.

quests.name: Polar Bear Cloak Quest
steps: Karg IceBear outside the Permafrost gates and wanders in a big circle across the tundra area of Everfrost. You say, 'Hail, Karg IceBear'
Karg IceBear says, 'Hail, traveler! I am Karg of Clan IceBear, lone hunter of the Everfrost Peaks. Have you seen any polar bears about?'
You say, 'Yes.'
Karg IceBear says, 'I hunt polar bears and furnish cloaks from their pelts. They keep you warm in this cold weather.'
You say, 'Pelts?'

Karg IceBear says, 'Have you some polar bear pelts? You know I can furnish warm cloaks from them, and for you I will do it for the measly sum of 5 platinum pieces.' Give him a Polar Bear Skin and 5 pp to receive your reward. Karg IceBear says, 'Here is your polar bear cloak! It will serve you well and keep you warm in even the coldest conditions! Farewell, friend!' You receive a Polar Bear Cloak.

quests.name: Porlos' Fury Quest
steps: Get Giant Loyalist Token from The Dragon Sage in Western Wastes.
Take the coin to Tomekeeper Bjordnessin in Wakening Lands, receive Giant Scalebound Tome.
Take the tome back to the sage, receive Ornate Reagent Box.
Get Dragonbane Herb from Siren's Grotto.
Get Dragon Blood from Myga in WW.
Combine the herb and blood in the box, receive Sealed Reagent Box.
Give this box to the sage.

quests.name: Potential of the Void
quests.startZone: The Hole, Kedge Keep, Permafrost, Nagafen's Lair, Oasis of Marr, Feerrott
steps: Quest is to kill one of the Raid bosses listed above. Quest can be done once per boss, for a total of three quests and rewards each week.
After earning 3 void-touched potentials, you will have to wait until 8AM Tuesday PDT to earn more.
Note: If you have three Void-Touched Potential in your inventory already, this quest will not be given until at least one is used.

quests.name: Preserved Meat Delivery
steps: This is a sub-quest that takes place during the HEHE Meat Quest. You can do this quest without going through the HEHE Meat one.
Find Chef Dooga in the Oggok tavern "Meet and Drink Tew Bie" at location +200, -240.
You say, 'Hail, Chef Dooga'
You say, 'What is HEHE meat?'
You say, 'Who is the Gobbler?'
You receive a "Preserved Leg."
Find the Gobbler in Neriak Foreign Quarter at location -325, -125.
You say, 'Hail, The Gobbler'
You say, 'What is HEHE meat?'
You say, 'What froggy legs?'
You say, 'Who is Chef Dooga?'
You say, 'I will pick up froglok legs.'
Good news is, you already have the froglok leg he wants. Upon turning in the Preserved Leg:
You receive 1-5 gold from The Gobbler.
You receive one of the rewards at random.

quests.name: Princess Lenya (Quest)
steps: This quest begins with Tynkale in Northern Felwithe. It's fairly long and involved with several parts to it.
You WILL need high Indifferent faction with Clerics of Tunare to start the quest with Tynkale; and Amiable or better to get the follow up from Tolon.
You say, 'Hail, Tynkale'
You say, 'I can be of service to the Clerics of Tunare.'
You say, 'I am a veteran of the good fight.'
Jojongua is found in the aptly named "Jojongua's Tower." Loot the Very Large Pelt and take it back to Tynkale.
Head to Travelers Home Inn in North Felwithe. Inkeeper Freegraze is on the left when you enter the building.
You say, 'Hail, Inkeeper Freegraze'
You say, 'Where is Tolon Nurbyte?'
Head upstairs as directed.
You say, 'Hail, Tolon Nurbyte'
You say, 'The glory of the Mother shines bright.'
You say, 'I accept the mission.'
NOTE: Tolon Nurbyte's responses may be bugged. The quest does work, however.
If you say "I wish to leave", he attacks you.
You say, 'I wish to leave'
There are no known responses to "defend it" or "effort and struggles".
If you ask him about Princess Lenya:
You say, 'Who is Princess Lenya Thex?'
(The response seen here may be that of a faction level too low.)
At this point, do The Lottery Ticket quest to get the key to the royal suite, "Highkeep Royal Suite" and use it to open the door to Tearon Bleanix.
You say, 'Hail, Tearon Bleanix'
You say, 'Who is Princess Lenya Thex?'
You say, 'All is not bright above the clouds'
You receive Tearon's Bracer.
The Highpass Hussy Tearon referred to is Mistress Anna. You learn this by talking to most any NPC in highkeep (such as the guards) and asking them "Who is Mistress Anna?"
You say, 'Who is Mistress Anna?'
Find Mistress Anna.
You say, 'Hail, Mistress Anna'
You say, 'Who is Princess Lenya?'
You say, 'I was sent by someone else'
You say, 'I am working for Lady McCabe'
Find Tyrana Slil and attack.
Missing Dialog?
You have slain Tyrana Slil!
Loot Fish Food Vial (a container) and Torn Parchment (a note explaining how to create fish food using the fish food vial).
In the Fish Food Vial, place (unstacked) three "Fairy Dust" and one "Sand of Ro". Hit combine, to make "Fish food". (No-fail, non-tradeskill combine.)
Find Marlin Shirtov in Highpass Hold. Mistress Anna asked you to kill him but, you do not need to. He spawns at 9 PM game-time (using /time) and then despawns later in the day.
You say, 'Hail, Marlin Shirtov'
You say, 'Who is Mistress Anna?'
You say, 'Who is Princess Lenya Thex?'
Go to South Qeynos and buy Silk Evening Tunic from Iala Lenard.
Return to Highpass Hold and give Marlin Shirtov the Silk Evening Tunic:
You receive a Brass Key.
Find a royal fish in Lake Rathetear:
You say, 'Hail, a royal fish'
Give the Fish Food to "a royal fish":
a royal fish gladly gulps up your odd mixture and transforms into..!!
a royal fish changes into a beautiful princess!!
The princess spawns in place of the royal fish. The "a royal fish" also respawns nearby a few seconds later.
You say, 'Hail, Princess Lenya Thex'
You say, 'What proof of allegiance?'
You say, 'What dark shackles?'
You say, 'What Silent Watch?'
Give the princess the "Brass Key" and "Tearon's Bracer":
You receive a Royal Amulet of Thex.
Return to Highkeep and find Tearon Bleanix.

NOTE: You will be turning in the key used to open the door here, so you may want to step out into the hallway while the trade window is still open so that you are not stuck in the room once the turnin is complete.
Give him the Highkeep Royal Suite (key) and the Royal Amulet of Thex:
You receive a Silent Watch Shield.

quests.name: Protect the Shipyard
steps: Requires Dubious (or better) faction for turn-in of braids.
Can ask another to cast Invisibility Versus Undead on you when your trade window is open to get indifferent.
Captain Rottgrime is located in the outpost at +2465, +2150.
You say, 'Hail, Captain Rottgrime'

Captain Rottgrime has a multitude of cracks and holes in his skull from his many battles. 'Attention, marine!! You will go into battle and fear nothing! You shall prevail over one enemy and then you shall be sent back into battle! We [shall not allow those sarnak to overtake the Danak shipyards]! Is that clear, marine?!!'
You say, 'I shall not allow those sarnaks to overtake the Danak shipyards.'
Hand in 4 x A Sarnak War Braid, dropped by "a sarnak berzerker" which commonly inhabits the western and southern parts of The Overthere and possibly the western parts of Frontier Mountains [sic].
You receive 1-3 gold from Captain Rottgrime.
You receive a Guard of the Marines.

Note: It is important to destroy the Guard of the Marines if you intend to repeat this quest. When you possess a Guard of the Marines while completing the trade to Captain Rottgrime, you will lose the Sarnak War Braids, you will not receive the faction increase, and the message "You were unable to complete this quest because it would result in a Guard of the Marines, and you already have one." will appear.

quests.name: Putrid Skeletons
steps: Roesager Thusten is the Paladin Guildmaster in the building on the right when you enter the Temple of Life complex in North Qeynos found at (-123.51, -127.12, 2.19).
You say, 'Who is Niclaus Ressinn?'
You receive a Note to Niclaus.
Niclaus roams across Qeynos Hills zone. Give him the note.
You receive 4 copper.
Find and kill a putrid skeleton and loot a Putrid Rib Bone. Two putrid skeletons spawn in Qeynos Hills, one at 3300, 550 and the other at 2090, -850, and wander. Give the rib bone to Niclaus.
You receive 1 gold, 2 silver, 6 copper.
You receive a Pouch of Evidence. Give it to Priestess Jahnda in the Temple of Life in North Qeynos, found at (-64.93, -677.59, -11.81).
You receive 5 gold.
Rewards and recorded chances:
Potion of Light Healing - 15/24
Potion of Disease Warding - 7/24
Shield of Nife - 2/24
Skullcap of Rodcet Nife - 0/24

quests.name: Qeynos Badge Quests
steps: Checklists:
Are there faction requirements? *(I can get the dialog asking for help at Apprehensive to Antonius Bayle.)
-An iskar necromancer - RTA to Riley Shplots but ally to Good Qeynos Guards was unable to hand in any confession document. Lich form to turn threatening did not work. FD turn in did not work.
NOTE: many of the quest NPCs despawn on hand in, and take hours to respawn. When several people are doing the quest chain it may be better to wait a few hours to start the chain.
All of the dialogue is optional, and can be skipped or will continue automatically even if you do not say the key phrases (eg conversation with Theodore Exanthem).
Badge 1:
(OPTIONAL) Loot Cracked Corrupt Guard Helm from Guard Shilster.
(OPTIONAL) Turn in Helm to Vegalys Keldrane to receive Investigator's Briefing book.
(OPTIONAL) Turn in Briefing book to an investigator in South Qeynos.
Obtain a Confession Document from the Investigator (target the Investigator and /say "Hand me a Confession Document").
Hand the Confession Document to Riley Shplots in the Fireprides shop (yielding Riley's Confession).
Obtain a Confession Document from the Investigator (target the Investigator and /say "Hand me a Confession Document").
Hand the Confession Document to Willie Garrote in the PVP Arena Underground (yielding Willie's Confession).
Obtain a Confession Document from the Investigator (target the Investigator and /say "Hand me a Confession Document").
Hand the Confession Document to Donally Stultz at the Docks. Kill him when he attacks and loot Head of Donally Stultz.
Obtain a Confession Document from the Investigator (target the Investigator and /say "Hand me a Confession Document"). Used later in quest series.
Hand in Donally's Head, Willie's Confession, and Riley's Confession to an investigator (not Vegalys Keldrane) to receive the Investigator's Badge.
Badge 2:
Get another Confession Document before leaving qeynos!
Turn in Investigator's Badge to Vegalys Keldrane to receive Interrogator's Briefing.
Turn in Interrogator's Briefing to an interrogator in South Karana.
Escort interrogator to Hermit House.
"Interrogate" Theodore Exanthem.

After the correct phrase, punch Theodore 1 time. Use a weapon at your own risk: you might kill the old Theodore and be able to continue the quest but you are playing with fire here. A duplicate Theodore will spawn in his place. Do not attack this duplicate Theodore!
The phrase is "Why don't you hit him for a while. Maybe you will be more convincing then I have been.
NOTE: you can attack Theodore the moment he stops to talk, allowing you to skip the interrogation entirely.
Turn in Confession Document to Theodore to receive Theodore's Confession.
Target Theodore and /say "Take us to the location".
Escort Theodore to the abandoned druid ring.
Kill Morley Murrain, Markus Cachexia and their minions.
Loot Head of Morley Murrain & Head of Markus Cachexia.
Turn in Heads and Theodore's Confession to the Interrogator and receive the Interrogator's Badge.
Badge 3:
Turn in Interrogator's Badge to Velarte Selire (NOT Vegalys) to receive Research Briefing
Loot the Enchanted Jars from Oobnopterbevny Biddilets in West Karana (can be done before previous step)
Read Briefing book carefully
Turn in Researcher Briefing to Velarte to initiate the rat test
Cure all Diseased Rats by strategically trading the Jars to empty tiles
Once all are Healthy Rats, turn in Empty Jars to Velarte to receive the Researcher's Badge
Badge 4:
Turn in Researcher's Badge to Vegalys Keldrane to receive Seal of Vegalys
Give Seal to an investigator in Qeynos Sewers (to spawn Guard Helminth)
Give Seal to Guard Helminth and say 'I am ready to complete the mission'to spawn Corrupt Guard Helminth.
Kill Corrupt Helminth (to spawn Azibelle Spavin) NOTE: If you die on any part of this you can restart this as long as you have Seal of Vegalys.
Loot the Head of Azibelle Spavin from Azibelle
Hand in Azibelle's Head and the Seal to Vegalys to receive the Qeynos Badge of Honor
First Quest:
Investigator's Badge (Badge #1)
Vegalys dialogue:
You say, 'Hail, Vegalys Keldrane'
You say, 'Who is responsible?'
You say, 'What plan?'
You say, 'How were they careless?'
You say, 'What outside help?'
You say, 'How did it unravel?'
You say, 'Complain?'
You say, 'Who is Earron Huntlan?'
You say, 'What alarm?'
You say, 'What concerned citizens?'
You say, 'I am willing to help you'.

quests.name: Quellious Symbol Quests
steps: Initiate Symbol:
Speak to Leraena Shelyrak in the Temple of Peace (Quellious) in Erudin (continuation from the Kobold Shaman Paws quest).
You say, 'What more powerful shamen?'
You receive a Small Embroidered Sack.
Fill the sack with 8 Odd Bone Necklaces from lesser kobold shaman in The Warrens and combine it to create an Embroidered Bag of Bone Necklaces. Hand this back to Leraena.
Reward: Initiate Symbol of Quellious
Disciple Symbol:
After completing the Initiate Symbol of Quellious quest, ask Leraena about [greater kobold shaman]:
You say, 'What greater kobold shamen?'
You receive a Small Embroidered Sack.

In the sack, combine 8 Odd Bronze Necklaces from greater shaman in The Warrens and Stonebrunt Mountains to produce an Embroidered Bag of Bronze Symbols. Hand in this item and the Initiate Symbol of Quellious to Leraena.
Reward: Disciple Symbol of Quellious.
Regent Symbol:
After completing the Disciple Symbol of Quellious quest, inform Leraena you are [ready to advance]:
You say, 'I am ready to advance'
Hand her an Odd Cold Iron Necklace obtained from High Shaman Drogik in The Warrens or various kobolds in Stonebrunt Mountains.
You receive a Sealed Parchment and Odd Cold Iron Necklace.
Seek out Glyssa Sonshaw at the Academy of Arcane Science in West Freeport (-335, -795) and hand her the Sealed Parchment and Odd Cold Iron Necklace.
You receive a Sealed Parchment and Odd Cold Iron Necklace.
Travel to Ak'Anon and find Drigaz Grumblegrowl located at a bar (1245, -925) near the bank.
You say, 'Hail, Drigaz Grumblegrowl'
Hand in the Sealed Parchment and Odd Cold Iron Necklace.
You receive Hieroglyph Translations.
Find a kobold missionary in the area outside the minotaur caves in the Steamfont Mountains behind the massive broken cog. Kill it and loot an Encrypted Document.
Return to Erudin and hand in the Hieroglyph Translations, Encrypted Document, and your Disciple Symbol of Quellious to Leraena Shelyrak.
Reward: Regent Symbol of Quellious.

quests.name: Quench Lasen's Thirst
steps: Even when it rains, Guard Lasen is thirsty. Bring him a Water Flask and he'll give you some coin and faction.
You receive 4 copper pieces from Guard Lasen.

quests.name: Quest:Druid Spells
steps: Samitha Lightheart may be found in Firiona Vie (loc -3229, +2291).
You say, 'Hail, Samitha Lightheart'
You say, 'What wonderful powers?'
You say, 'I will help you.'
She wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Circle of Summer
Circle of Winter
Form of the Howler
Spirit of Scale
Hand in one of the scrolls.
You randomly receive one of the following:
Call of Karana,
Egress,
Glamour of Tunare, or
Upheaval

quests.name: Quest:Necromancer Spells
steps: Vaean the Night may be found in The Overthere. He wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Convergence
Defoliation
Splurt
Thrall of Bones
The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls.

quests.name: Rabid Grizzlies
steps: Priestess Caulria (-130, -600, -10) is in the Temple of Life in North Qeynos. This #12 on North Qeynos map, or -162, -288. Take the teleport up to the structure that resembles a UFO next to it. The initial coordinates for Priestess Caulria are after you teleport into the UFO.
You say, 'I serve the [Prime Healer]'
Missing Dialog
She requires you to look into the problem of rabid animals in the area. Kill A rabid grizzly and loot its putrid hide, they are found in the Qeynos Hills and West Karana.
Hand in a Putrid Bear Hide.
You receive Spell: Endure Disease.
Works at dubious faction (confirmed Nov 4, 2017), unlike Fleshy Orbs from the same NPC.

quests.name: Rabid Wolves
steps: Priestess Caulria in the North Qeynos Temple (Take a left at the Temple of Life and enter the purple rings above the pond at (-160,-470) next to Astaed Wemor) gives the quest, which requires you to look into the occurrence of rabid wolves in the area.
Return a Diseased Wolf Pelt.
Priestess Caulria will cast Cure Disease on you to remove Rabies and other diseases.
If you turn in the Pelts at the same time as someone else, you may not receive the Cure Disease cast.
Works at apprehensive / dubious, unlike Fleshy Orbs from the same NPC.
= Exp Gain =

quests.name: Rain Caller Quest
steps: The Toupee
Obtain Trueshot Longbow through prerequisite quests
Obtain Crate for Tonics from Sanfyrd Featherhead in Ak'Anon
Obtain 10x Fuzzlecutter Formula 5000 and combine in Crate (to yield Crate of Tonic)
Obtain A Wooden Heart
Loot from either a treant (Karanas),
OR Jyle Windshot (West Freeport Version) by handing him Small Lanterns (about ~10% chance to get the heart per lantern).
Turn in Tonic Crate to Sanfyrd (to receive Tattered Toupee)
The Pouch
Obtain 2x Clump of Gorilla Hair from A Hulking Gorilla in Cazic Thule
Obtain a Lock of Hair from A Golden Haired Mermaid in Kedge Keep
Turn in Toupee, Gorilla Hairs and a Mermaid Lock to Ping Fuzzlecutter (to receive Mane Attraction)
Turn in Mane to Sanfyrd (to receive A Glimmering Fairie Wing)
Turn in Glimmering Wing to Princess Joleena (to receive Pouch of Gold Dust)
The Kinool Reward
Turn in Gold Dust, Wooden Heart, Trueshot Longbow, and 3000 gold pieces to Kinool Goldsinger (to receive Rain Caller)

quests.name: Ralgyn's Promise
steps: You only need to do the steps listed here in this checklist. The Great Divide section below concerns post-Velious patches.

quests.name: Rallos Zek Symbol Quests
steps: Initiate Symbol:
After completing Froglock Tadpole Fleshies
You say, 'i bedder shaman'

These are both dropped by Lizardman mystics in both The Feerrott and Rathe Mountains and the dolls can be seen in their hands when they have them. Unsure if they are more common on the higher level mystics in the Feerrott or the ones in Rathe Mountains, but I have seen both drops come from even the low level mystics.
Bring Zulort three Mystic Dolls and a Allize Volew Medicine Bag to receive an Initiate Symbol of Rallos Zek.

quests.name: Ranger Epic Quest
steps: The Beginning:

First go to Telin Darkforest (Level 55) in Burning Woods. He roams near to the Skyfire zone and has been sighted at +3234, +2871. Ask him "what action" and he will give you a note. If he doesn't, then your faction is too low. Faction can be built up fast by doing the muffin-quest in Freeport. (Wolf form works if he con apprahensive it takes you up to amiably)

Next, find Faelin Bloodbriar in Greater Faydark. Faelin spawns at +1500, +500. The placeholder is a roaming orc pawn that spawns at 7 minute intervals. The best tactic is to roam around. Once you do find her, give her the note and you receive a ring. After giving her the note she despawns.

Giz X'Tin (Level 40) is found in Kithicor near the path from West Commons to Highpass Hold. Give him the ring and he gives you a dark metal coin. Giz roams along the path. After you hand him the ring a level 50 Teir`Dal Reaver spawns and attacks you. Be prepared and have Spirit of the Wolf cast on you so that you can run away.

Go back to Telin Darkforest and give him the Coin. He will give it back to you as worn metal coin. He tells you to find Althele. Find Althele in East Karanas. She can be found just north of the barbarian fishing village. (Make sure you are Amiable Faction or better) Give her the worn metal coin and receive a worn amulet. Give this amulet to Sionae (spawns -2300, -930)(She can be standing either on the East or West side of the farm located there, so check both sides), then to Nuien (spawns -3650, -300) and finally to Teloa (spawns -3800, -2860).

When you give the amulet to Teloa the Dark Elf Corruptor and two Dark Elf Reaver (All around level 50) spawn. You should have one of your druid friends stand on the hill east of the river (loc -1500, -1000)(it will take a minute or two before they spawn after turning in to Teloa, there will be a zone message from the Corruptor when they do). The Dark Elf Corruptor and 2x Dark Elf Reavers will stay spawned at the loc provided until you engage them. It is best to have your kill group stationed at the loc on the hill, you only need to kill the Corruptor and loot the tome (it is suggested to stan…
Give Althele the tome and he gives you an Earth Stained Note. Bring this to Ella Foodcrafter.

Ella Foodcrafter in Misty Thicket is this wanted women that wanders the zone. Give her the Earth Stained Note and she will tell you that she needs a mixture. She will give you her mixing bowl. It is a Container so you need a free slot in the Inventory. She also mentions some kind of ancient bowl that she needs.
The Hardened Mixture:
You must forage 4 items that you have to combine in Ella's mixing bowl:
Chilled Tundra Root from Everfrost Peaks
Sweetened Mudroot from Misty Thicket
Speckled Molded Mushroom from Innothule Swamp
Ripened Heartfruit from Greater Faydark

Go to these places and put the "Forage" button into your hotkey, find a nice safe space and hit forage continuously. This can take several hours so be prepared. When you get the items, combine them in the bowl and you get a Hardened Mixture.
The Runed Bowl:
Chess Island:

Now go to the Chess Island in Timorous Deep. The easiest way to do this is to take the barge from the Oasis docks to Timorous Deep, and then get on the boat to The Overthere. If you get off this boat just before it enters The Overthere you can easily run to Chess Island, especially if you cast Levitate and Spirit of Wolf before getting on it. You'll probably also want Camouflage, as there's a deadly Iksar on Chess Island, you'll want to avoid.

On Chess island run south. Run straight south. Use track to locate Alrik Farsight. He's at about -6500, 2000. Alternatively, Succor (Druid 57) and Evacuate (Wizard 57) both take you within 100 feet of Alrik.
Click off Camouflage, hail Alrik, then say "How do you make an ancient bowl?" and "I can take the artifact." He gives you a Crushed Pot and sends you to Felwithe.
You can use the teleportation firepots, which are south a ways from Chess Island, to get to Felwithe easily.
Felwithe:

Hail Farios Elianos in South Felwithe before you give him the crushed pot. Farios is in the merchant building near the caster's guild. When you enter South Felwithe, you'll see the entrance to the merchant straight ahead, whereas the entrance to the caster's guild is to the left.

If he doesn't respond to you then your faction with Keepers of the Art is too low. Do not give him the pot. Indifferent is not enough, you need amiable. You can build up faction fast with the batwing-quest in South Felwithe.

(This quest is simple and cheap but time-consuming. In EC, right near the zone to WC, there is a merchant south of Orc 2 camp, an Erudite. She sells bat wings, cheap. Select the wings from her list, hold down shift and click on Buy about 5-6 times. You'll have 5-6 stacks of wings. Head back to South Felwithe, run to the mage guild, and hand in wings, 4 per stack in all 4 give slots, to Niola Impholder, a trainer in the Felwithe Mage guild. It took me two full backpacks of wings to go from indifferent to amiable, and I am a Wood Elf follower of Tunare.)

Once Farios cons amiable and talks to you , give him the pot and you receive a grocery list. The dialogue with the NPCs for this segment is pretty funny. He will give you the receipt for the bowl if you do a job for him. Bring this grocery list to Merchant Nora in the Shop of All Halos in Felwithe north, which is near the cleric guild. She gives you in return a bag of Provisions. Bring it to Farios and he gives you the receipt for the ancient bowl. Head back to Alrik Farsight in Timorous Deep. He will give you an Ancient Pattern when you give him the receipt.
The pattern says that you have to combine it with a piece of enchanted clay and platinum speckled powder in a pottery wheel. No skill in pottery is required.
Platinum Speckled Powder:
Platinum Speckled Powder can be obtained through another sub quest.

Forage a Rose of Firiona in Firiona Vie and give it to Merdan Fleetfoot in Surefall Glades, a male ranger in the back of the zone, near the water. The old wooden painting that you receive has to be brought to the human skeleton (Level 40) spawns in Frontier Mountains at -261 -574, behind the giant fort, against the wall, on the mountain side.
Invis yourself to be left alone by the wandering mobs. Look for "A Human Skeleton" on track. Give it the painting and it will crumble, and you'll have a silver chained locket in your inventory.
Back to Surefall Glade. Give the locket to Niera Farbreeze, a human female in banded armor, also near the water but close to the druid guild building. She will hand you the platinum speckled powder.
Enchanted Clay:

Enchanted Clay can be obtained through Kinlo Strongarm in Kaladim's EverHot Forge. If you ask him "what mud" and "do it for me" he will tell you that he would like to have a colored axe for his service. He wants a Jade Reaver that can be found in the City of Mist off of A black reaver who is about level 52. This is not easy at all. The Reaver is a rare drop and the Black Reavers are a real pain to take down. You will need at least one full group of 50+ players if not two, and one must be a Rogue with high lock picking skills.
Making the Bowl:

Hand Kinlo the axe and you get the enchanted clay. If you hunted dwarf citizens in Butcher, invis yourself and head to the forge. The merchants, thankfully, are on a different faction table. Just go to the Everhot Forge and hand Kinlo a Jade Reaver to get the clay. Now combine the pattern, clay and powder in any pottery wheel to make the Runecrested Bowl.
The Stones:
Go Back to Misty Thicket and hand Ella Foodcrafter the hardened mixture and the rune crested bowl. She will make for you a softly glowing stone from it. Ella tells you to find one such as yourself.
Go to Karnor's Castle. Kill Venril Sathir for the Pulsing Green Stone.
Kill VS to spawn Venril Sathirs remains. If Venril Sathir has already been killed by another guild, the remains should already be up. If not it spawns every 20 hours +1/-1.

Cast the spell Dance of the Fireflies to Summon a Firefly Globe. Give the Firefly Globe to Venril Sathirs remains to spawn the Spirit of Venril Sathir. Give the scroll for the spell Resurrection to the Spirit of Venril Sathir to respawn Venril Sathir.
After you kill this respawned version of Venril Sathir two Pulsing Green Stone will drop.
Go to Firiona Vie. Give the Softly Glowing Stone and the Pulsing Green Stone to Foloal Stormforest to get the Warmly Glowing Stone.
Head back to Burning Woods and give Telin Darkforest the Warmly Glowing Stone to get the Ancient Longsword.
The Hammers:

Now head to The Hole which is a zone adjacent to Paineel. Find Jaeil the Wretched (level 50). Use Sneak and then go behind Jaeil and give him the Shiny Tin Bowl. Make sure you have a raid party in the room ready for battle. He will scream at himself and then Jaeil the Insane will spawn.
Now the raid party goes into action and kills Jaeil the Insane. Loots from Jaeil the Insane a Soulbound Hammer.
Go to Erudin and find Mairee. She is in the jewelry shop, by the bank. Give her the Soulbound Hammer and in return she will give you the Dwarven Smiths Hammer.
Now go to the Plane of Air and kill the Essence Tamer. He spawns on the fourth island and drops the Swirling Sphere of Color.
Take the Dwarven Smiths Hammer and the Swirling Sphere of Color and give them to Mairee. In return, she will give you the Hammer of the Ancients.
Go back to Kinlo Strongarm and give him the Hammer of the Ancients.
The Swords:
After you give Kinlo Strongarm and the Hammer of the Ancients. Usbak the Old will spawn and he will give you Small Bit of Mithril Ore.
Give Usbak the Old your Ancient Longsword and he will return to you the new and improved Refined Ancient Longsword.
Hand the Mithril Ore to Kinlo to get the Refined Mithril Blade.
Go back to the Burning Woods, to Telin and give him the Refined Ancient Sword. This causes Faelin Bloodbriar to spawn and Telin will give you back the Refined Ancient Sword.
Give the Refined Ancient Sword to Faelin and she will enchant it for you and return to you Swiftwind, the first epic weapon.
At this point she despawns after saying some stuff about how you have to kill Innoruuk to rebalance the world. That is exactly what you are going to do.

Go to the Plane of Hate and kill Innoruuk. His location is (-65, -196) and he spawns about once a week. He is a level 55 Wizard with approx. 32,000 hit points. He is a green looking man wearing clothes. Loot the Shattered Emerald of Corruption.
The End:

quests.name: Ranjor's Test
steps: Ranjor is located up a set of stairs, near the bridge leading to the Gunthak's Belch tavern.
You say, 'Hail, Ranjor'
You say, 'I willin ta test.' (Note: The phrase "I'm willing to test" also works if you feel like being all grammatically correct about it.)
Obtain Froglok Meat and two Froglok Tadpole Flesh. Give the items to Ranjor.
(Literally 1% at Level 2)
You receive a Rusty Two Handed Battle Axe.

quests.name: Rare Coins
steps: Assistant Buford can be found inside the Firiona Vie bank.
You say, 'Hail, Assistant Buford'
You say, 'What hobby?'
You say, 'I will collect rare coins'
You can purchase a Star of Odus for about 115pp in the jewel shop under the Erudin palace.
Give Star of Odus to Buford
You receive a Tin Box with 6 slots.
He asks for the following coins (all called Ancient Coin, although they can be identified to determine which is which):
"Torsis Ton" (foraged in the Emerald Jungle)
"Royal Crown of Dalnir" (dropped by A Kly Imprecator in Dalnir)
"Terraz Ton" (dropped by Failed crypt raider in Kaesora)
"Veksar Gran" (dropped by A Bloodgill Goblins in Lake of Ill Omen)
"Danak Gran" (dropped by a scorpikis scrounger in The Overthere)
"Ik Gran" (dropped by Captain of the Guard in the City of Mist)
Put these gems in the box, combine it, and return the result to Buford.
He will reward you with a Nostrolo Tambourine.

quests.name: Rat Ear Pie Quest
steps: Rephas is a crazed hermit who lives near the lake in the Qeynos Hills (northwest corner of the zone), with a penchant for rat ears...
You say, 'Hail, Rephas'
You say, 'Who is Karana?'

He doesn't have much to say about rat ears (he may if your faction is better), but if you give him the regular Rat Ears (common drop from rats) he'll give you an item called Grilled Rat Ears (edible and stackable).
If you give the Grilled Rat Ears back to him, you receive a Fish Scales, faction, and experience.

If you give him 3 Giant Rat Ears, you receive a experience, faction, and a recipe for Rat Ear Pie (Giant Rat Ear + Baking Spirits + Cup of Flour in a mixing bowl). The Rat Ear Pie is used in the Paw of Opolla Quest.

quests.name: Red V Clockwork
steps: This is sometimes given after the 27 C Blackbox quest. If you turn in a Daily Log reading 27C.566... to Drekon Vebnebber you will be told that the "rumors of Red V must be true".
You say, 'what about red 5?'

You need to get Red V's incomplete blackbox and give it to Manik Compolten. Red V is usually about level 4-6 and spawns in the southeasternmost room of the Mines of Malfunction (2026, -624, -181). Red 5 is on an 8 minute timer. The corridors leading to and the room in which Red 5 spawns are short, so only small and medium sized people can actually fight or cast in there, since you have to be standing to cast or attack.

The spawning point for Red 5 alternates between "obsolete model" and "Red 5" both of which will wander the mines. His PH are an armadillo-type "obsolete model" and a darker rust colored clockwork gnome "obsolete model". The brighter bronze colored clockwork obsolete models are not his PH. Red 5 is killable by solo lvl 7 or bunch of lvl 5's. When he gets low on hp, he will run off and often get killed by the guards outside the mines, so be ready to use root if you have it. If you kill him, his corpse will have an Incomplete Blackbox. To fix the blackbox you have to put 4 Blackbox Fragments in…

Note: You can skip the 27C Blackbox quest entirely and just go camp Red V. Complete his box and continue camping him and other Obsolete Models so you have a second full box, it lets you do two turn ins per run (hand in the complete lore box, then complete the second and hand that in).

Faction Note: If you are KOS to the necro guild, hug the right wall after opening the door. There is an obsolete model in the next area. Go further into the next room, do not take the first right towards Red V's room, instead go past this to the next hallway on your right. It's the hallway to the right, between 2 and 3 on the map, it's longer and straight. There are no necros here. You can use this same path back and forth to avoid the guildmasters so you don't die.
Faction Note 2: Need better reputation than indifferent to complete the turn in.
On hand-in:
The reward seems to be random and faction may not play a role, but you should try to have a high faction with the Gemchoppers before doing the quest.

Also, you should know that this quest lowers faction with the Dark Reflection, who happen to be the NPC's in the Mines. The item is often a piece of cloth armor (hardly worth the trouble), but sometimes you'll get a potion and sometimes you will get the Bullsmasher - a very nice weapon for any small class. You might also get an Iony's Absorber.
On hand-in:
Need missing dialogues, current faction hits if any.

steps: Part One

Give voucher to Kellek Felhammer. Receive Collar of the Storm OR
Give voucher to Wenglawks Kkeak. Receive Girdle of Reflection OR
Give voucher to Noble Helssen. Receive Helssen's Prismatic Trinket

(This is a bit of foreshadowing to the follow-up quest to this).

Guard Stald spawns at either the front gate, beside the Tiger's Roar, or beside Top of the World. He is about level 15 or so. When you bring him the badge, he gives you a note to return back to Qeynos
Returning the note results in a Black Leather Cloak.

steps: be a Rogue
Go to Sol Ro temple and find Lon the Redeemed in the back Say "I am a rogue in need of redemption" get a Sealed Note.

Hop on the boat to Freeport and buy Vasty Deep Ale at the first dock then run back to the boat ride a bit then jump off into the Ocean of Tears at loc -1611, +2924 and find The Oblong Bottle at the bottom the the ocean. Trek yonder to Bubar and buy Gator Gulp Ale then run to WC and buy A Sparkling Sapphire from Noresa Sparkle (it's NO DROP and costs between 500-550pp), and give Her the Sparkle purse, she will give you a Tiny Key. Do not kill her, she has only negative general Freeport faction hits.

Brew Ol'Tujim's Fierce Brew x2 - brewed in a brew barrel, trivial at 135: cask, barley, malt, yeast, hops. (You can just as easily brew this yourself in Rivervale at level 1, all the ingredients are on second floor of Fool's Gold)

You need 4 Blackburrow Gnoll Skins - they drop off Gnoll Elites and above not guardsmen or the brewers. After you get the Blackburrow Cask and 4 Skins, 2 pup scalps and 2 Ol'Tujim's Fierce Brew combine to make Blackburrow Swig. This can be the easiest or most time consuming step of this quest.
Go to Halas and buy a bottle of Frozen Toe Rum at McDaniel's Smokes & Spirits (when you enter the city turn right and you should find it).

Now you have Case of Spirits, give it back to Brian McGee and get the Gem of Stamina then head back to EC. (*beware if you are Dark Elf rogue you may need wolf form for faction)

Go to West Freeport and find Toxdil behind hidden wall and give him A Sparkling Sapphire, purchased from Noresa Sparkle, and he will give you a Tiny Key then go to East Freeport to Hallard's Resale have someone with 130 lock pick open the door at the bottom and get the Gem Case on the floor.
Go back to Bubar in EC and give him both keys and the gem case he will give you the Gem Of Righteousness (A Sparkling Sapphire).
Go to South Ro and find a Orc named Ortallius (right side of ent) give him both Gems and he will give you the Burning Rapier!

steps: Description:

This is the quest to get the keys to enter Old Sebilis and Veeshan's Peak. Not far south (just keep the wall on your right) from the Swamp of No Hope zone, there's a passage going into the wall. At the end of the passage, there's a huge room with a red throne, and the ghost-looking Iksar floating on top of it is Emperor Ganak. He is indifferent.
Key to Old Sebilis:
For the Trakanon Idol (key to Old Sebilis):
The Medallion of the Kunzar drops from the froglok forager in Trakanon's Teeth.
The Medallion of the Nathsar drops from the froglok hunter in Trakanon's Teeth.
These Mobs spawn one after another, so they are fairly easy to get.
Turn in these two medallions to Emperor Ganak and you should get the Trakanon Idol, which will get you into Old Sebilis, where you can find Trakanon.
Key to Veeshan's Peak:
You need to obtain three medallions (Jarsath, Obulus and Kylong) and Trakanon's Tooth, turn them in to Emperor Ganak in Trakanon's Teeth and you will get you the Key to Veeshan's Peak.
