quests.name: Second Test of Kejaar
steps: Indifferent faction is sufficient to receive the reward for this quest. You may use charm, or have an enchanter charm Shazda for you (however, the faction hits will be omitted in that case).
An Iksar monk at lvl 40 can do this quest by sneaking behind the quest giver and handing them the heads to get that juicy monk bracer very easily. The kerrans do not agro if you over level them.

After you complete the First Test of Kejaar, you will then be told to to kill their most hated foe, Sentinel Creot (approx level 10, possibly higher), a roaming guard in Tox Forest. If you kill him and return his head you will become a full Sejah warrior, and receive the reward of a Sejah Ghulam Bracer.

Sentinel Creot wanders but can located along the shore of Toxxulia Forest between the Wizard Hut and the Western Dock. He is a level 10 paladin on Erudin's guards faction. (Warning: Pretty heavy Eurdin faction hit.)
Attack and lay Sentinel Creot to waste.

quests.name: Sentry Xyrin Quest
steps: Somewhere in the Ocean of Tears there is an undead island (rough loc of -604.96, -7343.81). The island is populated by a few greater skeletons, gargoyles who kill the skeletons, and four specters at the top. This is where the female paladin named Sentry Xyrin is triggered to spawn by speaking to Styria Fearnon. Xyrin mentions that she was part of a [boat disaster] and that she is from the Temple of Marr in Freeport. She will ask you to get her a Potion of Marr from Serna Tasknon in the Temple of Marr in Freeport. With the potion she will be able to regain her strength and take on the undead.…

Head to the Sister's Island in the Ocean of Tears and find the small hut to the right with Styria Fearnon and say "Where is Sentry Xyrin?". Styria Fearnon will realize that Sentry Xyrin must have shipwrecked on a nearby island and ask you to find her. This will trigger Sentry Xyrin to spawn on the East coast of the Undead Island on top of a small ridge. Be aware that she will fight Gargoyles and Skeletons during her stay. She is slightly higher level than the Gargoyles but two at the same time can likely slay her. She does not cast root but she will heal herself.

Go to the undead island and hail to her. Don't leave yet it's just beginning. After getting the potion, she will feel invigorated and decide march up to the spectres on the island and sit there. If you wait for a while, she will despawn and the Deepwater Harpoon will be on the ground. If you invis vs. undead, you can avoid the spectres.
Need all dialogues, missing quest items, current /loc of guards (including zones), current faction hits if any.

requiredItems: Soul Leech, Dark Sword of Blood
steps: NOTE::When doing any sort of turn in/hand in for this epic quest, whether it be spawning Kyrenna or turning in the Dark Shroud etc... MAKE 100% CERTAIN that you are indifferent to the NPC you are doing the hand in with. You can do this by putting the item(s) in the trade window, and then using the Hide skill or have someone cast invis (or IVU for Glohnor). Again, make absolutely certain that the npc cons indifferent to you before you click trade or the item(s) will be gobbled up. The Letter to Duriek:

Kill Kurron Ni and Loot the Letter to Duriek

Give the Cough Elixir to Duriek

Kill An ashenbone drakes in Plane of Hate for a Decrepit Hide

Open trade window, click Hide and make sure you con INDIFFERENT STATUS (Hiding is not needed if you have better faction). SUPER IMPORTANT! DO NOT HAND IN ITEMS W/O indifferent status or better. Teydar in the evil guild area of the Qeynos Aqueducts
Give the Drake Spine, Decrepit Hide and Enchanted Platinum Bar to Teydar for a Decrepit Sheath

Go to Duriek. Open trade window, click Hide and make sure you con INDIFFERENT STATUS (Hiding is not needed if you have better faction). SUPER IMPORTANT! DO NOT HAND IN ITEMS W/O indifferent status or better. Give the Ghoulbane, the Soul Leech, Dark Sword of Blood, the Blade of Abrogation and the Decrepit Sheath to Duriek for the Corrupted Ghoulbane.
The Dark Shroud:
(Optional) Hail Lhranc in the City of Mist

(Optional) Hail Gerot Kastane in Paineel and give him the Seal of Kastane to get the Note to Marl
(Optional) Give the Note to Marl to Marl Kastane
Hail Knarthenne Skurl in Toxxulia Forest and say 'what heart of an innocent?' to get a Soulcase

Give the Cell Key to Caradon (You must be indifferent for this turn-in) - Use "Hide" Skill.
Kill Kyrenna NOT Caradon (if it can be avoided) and Loot Blood of Kyrenna and Heart of Kyrenna

Give the Blood of Kyrenna to Marl Kastane and receive the Dark Shroud DONT FEIGN DEATH FOR THIS TURN-IN You must be Indifferent for this turn in (use "Hide" skill). Make sure to be Hidden for this turn in.
Lhranc's Coin:
Give the Dark Shroud to the Ghost of Glohnor in the Hole (Make sure to con indiff w/ IVU!)

Give the Head of Glohnor to Gerot Kastane and receive the Head of the Valiant (Make sure to con indifferent w/ hide!)
Give the Glohnor wrappings to Marl Kastane and receive the Will of Innoruuk (Make sure to con indifferent w/ hide!)

Give the Corrupted Ghoulbane, the Heart of the Innocent, the Head of the Valiant and the Will of Innoruuk to Lhranc - Make sure you are indifferent to him before you do the hand in, have someone else cast IVU on you before you hit trade. Sources [https://thesafehouse.org/forums/forum/everquest-wing/quests-of-norrath/15022-fatestealer-epic-1-5-complete-walkthrough?s=479968c6419d6de51e4e47c1377fae0a&postcount=2#post291690] indicate that the quest was classically broken and remained unresolved until it was incorporated into the Rogue Epic 1.5 quest, very long after Velious. Although Dark Huntress may spawn in Castle Mistmoore, she reportedly does not drop the needed Water-Stained Ancient Tome, nor anything else.

quests.name: Shakey's Stuffing
steps: Obtain Sack of Hay from the Miller farm in West Karana
Obtain Blessed Oil Flask from Nomsoe Jusagta at the Temple of Life in Qeynos (say "I will deliver a flask")
Have Roror in the Feerrott curse the Sack of Hay to obtain Sack of Cursed Hay for the price of 66 gold
Combine the Sack of Cursed Hay and the Blessed Oil Flask in any non-cultural forge to create Sack of Writhing Hay
Give the Sack of Writhing Hay to Shakey Scarecrow to receive Wee Harvester or Belt of the River
At the Tagglefoot farm in Rivervale, hail Shakey Scarecrow and one of the Leafsway NPCs should comment that Shakey isn't himself lately.
'Hail, Shakey Scarecrow.'
Shakey Scarecrow rustles and looks up at you in acknowledgment.

It seems Shakey's stuffing is rather old, and his pumpkin head is beginning to crack. To fix his stuffing, you need magical hay. The hay that must be harvested can only be found on the Plains of West Karana. Cleet Miller will leave Sack of Hay behind here and there after he halts to survey his farm. The scarecrows who infest the fields also commonly drop the sacks of hay although magical weapons are required to strike them.
This hay is so far inert and not much use for a magical scarecrow, so to add the necessary hocuspocus seek out Roror, a High Priest of Cazic-Thule in the Feerrott.
First however, before you make this long trek, run over to the Qeynos Hills zoneline to have a chat with Brother Estle. He may be found wandering the road.
'Hail, Brother Estle.'
'What Prime Healer?'
'What mass?'
'What blessed oil?'
'What is the Temple of Life?'
Venture westward to Qeynos and visit Priestess Jahnda at the Temple of Life.
'Hail, Priestess Jahnda.'
'Brother Estle needs the blessed oil.'
Nomsoe is outside near the pond, hanging out with a group against a wall.
'Hail, Nomsoe Jusagta.'
'I am a new disciple of life.'
'I will deliver a flask.'

Nomsoe hands you a Blessed Oil Flask. Our minor deception of the credulous clergy of the Temple of Life notwithstanding, this oil is necessary to purify the hay of the undesirable effects of having Cazic-Thule curse the hay, which you should now set about doing by tracking down Roror, a lizardman who wanders the southwestern quadrant of the Feerrott. He claims to be the High Priest of Cazic-Thule and would be happy to establish his bonafides if you doubt him.
'Hail, Roror.'

Roror will ask you if you fear. If you respond affirmatively, he responds with 'That's great!'. If you respond in the negative, he sets about teaching you the meaning of fear with gusto. As he is a 49 shaman, this is usually accomplished with aplomb.
For our present purposes, we need to ask him to either [bless my hay] or [curse my hay]. Both lead to the same response.
Quickly hand him the Sack of Hay and 66 gold. He doesn't halt long for hails so you may need to engage his attention longer by saying something else, such as [I fear] or [bless my hay].
You receive a Sack of Cursed Hay (identifies as "Straw of Cazic-Thule").
Combine this Sack of Cursed Hay with the Blessed Oil Flask in any non-cultural forge (this is a no-fail combine).
The result is a Sack of Writhing Hay (identifies as "Scarecrow Stuffing").
Return to Rivervale and give this sack to Shakey.
Shakey Scarecrow shakes his head around and beams a smile at you.
You receive some money and either the Wee Harvester or Belt of the River.

quests.name: Shaman Epic Quest
steps: Begin quest by talking to a lesser spirit after killing one of the mobs in RM, OoT, BBM, or FoB, receive Tiny Gem from a Lesser Spirit (do not kill him).
Take gem to North Freeport and give the gem to Bondl Felligan who will lead you to the Jade Tiger and spawn Greater Spirits.
Talk to the proper Greater Spirit for your god until you get an Opaque Gem.
Test of Patience in Erud’s Crossing, receive a small gem from a Greater Spirit.
Turn gem into a wandering spirit in West Karana.
Kill Glaron the Wicked (drops Envy & Woe) and Tabien the Goodly (drops Marr's Promise) in Rathe Mountains.
Take Envy, Woe, and Marr’s Promise to the Wandering Spirit in West Karana (generally between Qeynos hills and bandit camp in the mountains,) receive Shield of Falsehood and gem in return.
Take gem to Spirit Sentinel in Emerald Jungle.
Kill Black Dire in Mistmoore (minimum level 5 to zone into Mistmoore), loot Black Dire Pelt.
Turn in pelt to Spirit Sentinel in Emerald Jungle (you need faction for this turn in) Receive Black Fur Boots! Get 6 slot booklet from the spirit.
Collect 6 reports from the City of Mist for booklet. (turn in is KINDLY or better)
Combine and turn in completed booklet to Spirit Sentinel in Emerald Jungle.
Kill Lord Ghiosk in the City of Mist and loot the 3 books.
Turn in books to Spirit (in lake) in Emerald Jungle.
Obtain Icon of the High Scale from the City of Mist (ground spawn in the temple).
Give Icon to High Scale Kirn in the Hole, kill him and loot his ring.
Give the ring to Neh`Ashiir in the City of Mist, kill her, loot her diary.
Turn in the diary to Spirit Sentinel in Emerald Jungle.
Go to Fear to kill the Iksar Broodling, loot Child's Tear (random spawn from killing Golems, slay either Dread, Fright, or Terror).
Give the tear to Lord Rak`Ashiir in City of Mist, kill him and loot his Iksar Scale. YOU NEED ALLY FACTION FOR THIS TURN IN -- JUST NOT MAXED ALLY
Take Scale to Spirit Sentinel wolf in Emerald Jungle IN THE POND to receive your epic! YOU NEED MAX ALLY, NOT JUST ALLY

quests.name: Shaman Kael Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Yeeldan Spiritcaller in Kael Drakkal.
Spirit Caller's Helm
Spirit Caller's Breastplate
Spirit Caller's Vambraces
Spirit Caller's Bracer

quests.name: Shaman Skull Quests
steps: Skull Quest No. 1:

After completing the Cursed Wafers Quest, Heirophant Oxyn mentions [lost skulls] and the [iron cudgel of the clairvoyant]. (Note: You do not actually need to complete the cursed wafers quest to begin the shaman skull quests. The completion dialogue in the cursed wafers quest just points you in the direction of the skull quests.)
You say, 'What Iron Cudgel of the Clairvoyant?'
You say, 'What lost skulls?'
The three skulls drop from an iksar outcast, found in the East Cabilis sewers or in the Swamp of No Hope.
Logrin Skull
Morgl Skull
Waz Skull

The iksar outcast in the Swamp of No Hope is much more difficult for a low-level character, so stick to the spawns in the Cabilis sewers. To get to the sewers, swim underneath the docks on the east side of the lake in East Cabilis (around +601, -409), and look for a tunnel going east, with a pygmy barracuda swimming along it. In the second air pocket that you come to (around +420, -731), face the north wall, look straight up, and hold forward until your character jumps up to the ledge (make sure you have your Max Frames Per Second set to 30 - 35). Once up there, follow the right-hand wall aro…
Note: From other sources, it seems that an iksar outcast *should* spawn in each of the three "air pocket" rooms, and as a rare spawn off the "in-room" mob.
To reach the Iksar in the sewers, watch the video found in Vessel Drozlin's wiki page.

Note 2: It may not be possible currently to jump up to the ledge because setting max frames to 30 no longer works. However, it is easy enough to aggro the outcast simply by swimming beneath him through the tunnel and fighting him in the water. Alternatively, you can use the pit in the shaman's guild to reach the area. At level 4 I was able to survive the fall from the pit, though barely, and it is possible to take no damage, though very difficult. There are two fake walls you must pass through after falling into the pit in order to reach the area of the catacombs the iksar outcast is in. If y…
Give all three skulls and your Iron Cudgel of the Petitioner to Heirophant Oxyn
You receive (minor coin reward) and Iron Cudgel of the Clairvoyant.
Skull Quest No. 2:
You say, 'What much larger problem?'
You say, 'I will assist in collecting the ancient skulls.'
For the first of these two skulls, you are looking for a rogue shaman in Warslik's Woods and Field of Bone

The rogue shaman in Warslik's Woods spawns at #4 on the map at (+2815,-2855),near Field of Bone. His placeholder can be an Iksar Brigand,or an Iksar Bandit. Kill him to get Jawless Skull and A Tattered Note. The tattered note tells you where to get the rest of the pieces...

Shaman, I have sent another of your ilk to retrieve the mandible which was taken from us. He will meet up with you at Bone Run around midnight. When you have them, find a way to get some Mendglow Clay and a wheel from Cabilis so we can mend this skull. I am enroute to find the Giant Barracuda who swallowed the other skull at the lake.

The rogue shaman in Field of Bone spawns northeast of Kurn's Tower, in a wide area around (+1100, +400). His placeholders are an iksar brigand and possibly an iksar marauder. Note: A scaled wolf tracker will attack and kill iksar and burynai in this area, and can easily kill the shaman before you get to him. When killed, this shaman will drop A Mandible.
Mendglow Clay can be foraged in Burning Wood. It is tradeable, so can be bought if you are unwilling to make the run (rather dangerous at low levels).

Combine the Jawless Skull, Mandible and Mendglow Clay on a potters wheel (the exact trivial is unknown, but it is trivial at skill 21). The combination will result in Skull with II. If you fail the combine, you will only be returned the Jawless Skull. It is advised you raise your skill higher than the estimated trivial level to reduce the possibility of failure.

Skull with I is found on a stuffed barracuda in Lake of Ill Omen, which swims over and around the dome in the center of the lake. Beware of a bloodgill goblin and Tainted barracuda, and stay near the surface of the water. You will need Enduring Breath at least for this step.
Give Hierophant Oxyn the Skull with I, Skull with II, and Iron Cudgel of the Clairvoyant.
(5% on a level 9 iksar shaman)
You receive (minor coin reward) and Iron Cudgel of the Seer.
Skull Quest No. 3:
You say, 'I am the chosen savior'

A Froglok Hex Doll drops from A Goblin Hextracer in Warslik's Woods. The hextracer spawns near the lake just south of the giant fort, around -2000, 1000. Likely placeholders include a goblin bonecaster, though they may include a goblin whelp as well. When the hextracer spawns, he usually runs back and forth along an east/west line.
Give A Froglok Hex Doll to Hierophant Zand.
You receive 5 platinum pieces.
Hierophant Zand gives you a note. Take that note to Crusader Quarg in Field of Bone. He wanders around the buildings near the Cabilis entrance.
Your faction with LegionofCabilis got better.
Crusader Quarg gives you A Skull Chest.

Go to Kurn's Tower and kill undead crusader. Keep killing him until you have collected one Iksar Skull with an 'X' (LORE, identifies as 'Leader of Bone Brethren') and five Iksar Skull with an 'X' (not lore, identifies as 'Caste of Bone Brethren'). Combine the six skulls in the skull chest. The combined chest becomes Full C.O.B.B. Chest.
Give the Full C.O.B.B. Chest and your Iron Cudgel of the Seer to Crusader Quarg.
You receive (minor coin reward) and Iron Cudgel of the Mystic.
Skull Quest No. 4:
You say, 'I will collect the crusaders of Rok Nilok'
You receive A Skull Chest.
Mystic Dovan spawns after 9pm on top of the building with Warlord Hikyg, in the Swamp of No Hope (2644, 3031). During the day, Captain Nedar stands in his place.
You say, 'Hail, Mystic Dovan'
You say, 'What of the crusaders of Rok Nilok?'
If you are interested, the story of the Crusaders of Rok Nilok can be found in a book called The Crusade of 1312 A.G., which can be purchased from War Historian Kobl in East Cabilis.

Go to Warslik's Woods and kill a goblin bloodtracer (placeholder a goblin battlemaster), at the ruins marked #2, #6, and #7 on the map. Bloodtracers can also be found wandering around near the #6 ruins, but this area is significantly more dangerous than the other two, with wandering giants and higher-level goblins. Keep killing until you have collected the six Tiny Glowing Skulls. You need 1 LORE skull (identifies as 'Skull of Rok Nolok') and 5 non-lore skulls (identifies as 'Crusader of Rok Nolok'). Combine the six skulls in the skull chest. The combined chest becomes Full C.O.R.N. Chest.
Give the Full C.O.R.N. Chest and your Iron Cudgel of the Mystic to Mystic Dovan.
You receive (minor coin reward) and Iron Cudgel of the Prophet.
Skull Quest No. 5:
Heirophant Zand has this small piece of information:
You say, 'What skulls of Di Nozok'
This quest requires two skulls.
The first is Iksar Skull Helm, which identifies as 'Skull of Die Nozok'. It is a fairly common drop from a Sarnak adherant in the Sarnak fort area of Lake of Ill Omen.
The second requires a multi-step subquest.

You need to kill Overseer Dlubish in Nurga or Droga and get the Dai Nozok skull canopic. You also need to get the two keys of Dai. The first drops as a complete Ton Warrior Totem off Froglok Ton Warriors. Froglok Ton Warriors also drop three distinct Piece of Totem items, each of which identifies as a different portion of the Dai key. Combine these three pieces with some mendglow clay in a pottery wheel (no-fail combine) to get the second Ton Warrior Totem. You then hand the totems/keys and the canopic and 400 gp to Galdon Vok Nir in the Overthere to get an Iksar Skull (identifies as "Skull o…
Turn in both skulls and your Cudgel of the Prophet to Hierophant Zand and you will get Iron Cudgel of the Channeler.

steps: Theron Rolius is located at 238.46, -147.80 in the Hall of Truth.

You say, 'I will join the crusade.'
You say, 'I will assist in other areas.'

The shark skin required can be from any shark. Place two Shark Skin into the bag and combined it to crate a Sack of Sharkskins. Hand him the Sack of Sharkskins.

steps: Gallin Woodwind is located at 327, 274, 77 outside the Emerald Warriors Guild Hall.

Hand Gallin Woodwind the Pack of Meat.
10% xp every turn-in for a level 3 Halfling Druid (5% at level 4)

quests.name: Shestar's Scaled Coif Quest
steps: Trooper Shestar, inside the gates to the Field of Bone, wants 5 gp and three Loose Scales. In return, he gives you Shestar's Unfinished Coif. The unfinished coif grants no AC, but he tells you that you can fix it up if you are a blacksmith and use 3 more loose scales. So run out and get three more loose scales, combine them in a forge with the unfinished coif (no water needed), and you will get the Shestar's Scaled Coif for your troubles.
You say, 'Hail, Trooper Shestar'
You say, 'What is the Shestar scaled coif?'
You give Trooper Shestar 3 scaled wolf scales and 5 gold.
(No faction or experience is awarded.)
In any forge combine 1x Shestar's Unfinished Coif + 3x Loose Scales to create Shestar's Scaled Coif. This completes the quest.
Giving the coif to Shestar after crafting it causes you to lose the coif with no dialog.

quests.name: Shield of the Devout Quest
steps: You need the ingot and icon of Devout and 2 Vulcanized Platinum Bars (give enchanted platinum to Vilissia for this).
The Icon of the Devout is looted from a Minotaur Sentry in the Minotaur caves found in Steamfont.
The Ingot of the Devout is found on a Glacier Bear in the caves under the river in Everfrost peaks.
Give all four items to Gavel to receive your shield. (Multiquestable confirmed 8/11/2020)

quests.name: Shiny Rings
steps: This quest will result in the three rings required for the Paw of Opolla Quest. Melixis is a merchant that sells supplies for shaman-made potions.
When you hail her she claims to have three [shiny tings] that she found all over the world. These shiny things are [a dull ring] a [kinda shiny ring] and a [really shiny ring].
For the 'dull ring' (Copper Ring (Ring of Opolla)) she wants a Guk Bracket Mildew.
For the 'kinda shiny ring' (Silver Ring (Ring of Opolla)) she wants Faerix Spores.
For the 'really shiny ring' (Gold Ring (Ring of Opolla)) she wants some Degenerated Guk Weed.
All of these items drop off the A Fungus Mutant in Upper Guk.
You say, 'Hail Melixis'
You say, 'what shiny tings'
You say, 'what dull ring'
You say, 'what kinda shiny ring'
You say, 'what really shiny ring'
Need all dialogues, /loc of quest mobs, faction hits if any.

quests.name: Shiny Robe of the Underfoot Quest
quests.page: Shiny Robe of the Underfoot Quest
steps: Kejar the Mighty, a named imp found deep in The Hole (#9 on the map) asks you to bring him a Shining Metallic Robe. Kejar is scowls with benevolence and in elemental illusion. Blue to lvl 43 enchanter. Must be charmed to turn in? Ate SMR when mezzed.
The Shining Metallic Robes is dropped rarely off the ghoul arch magi on the dead side of Lower Guk.
In exchange for the SMR, you'll either receive either a Shiny Hunk of Metal or a Shiny Robe of the Underfoot. The former is the more common of the two.
02/10/2024: Eight turn ins yielded two Robes.

Hand in all four items

quests.name: Sifaye Abominations

Travel now to Lavastorm Mountains and find Sir Lindeal.

You receive 3 gold from Lumi Stergnon.

quests.name: Skunk Hunting

You say, 'Hail, Nultal Malfoot'
You say, 'I am here to return skunk glands'

quests.name: Slave Keys
steps: When you kill an Orc Slaver, sometimes they will drop keys. The keys always are the same for the particular race/sex combo of a slave, but different slaves can spawn in the same places. Each key has a number to go to a lock on the slaves. When you match the key with the lock (slave) you will get xp and some cash. The number/lock combinations are as follows (except for Retlon, you can give a slave one copper and they'll tell you which key unlocks them):
Shackle Key 15 goes to Retlon Brenclog.
Shackle Key 16 goes to a dwarven slave (male).
Shackle Key 17 goes to a dwarven slave (female).
Shackle Key 18 goes to a Male Wood Elf Slave.
Shackle Key 19 goes to a Female Wood Elf Slave.
Shackle Key 20 goes to a Male High Elf Slave.
Shackle Key 21 goes to a Female High Elf Slave
Keys # 22-24 appear to have no use (not used to free prisoners in the minotaur caves in Steamfont).
Faction Note: Must be debiously or better.
I received no reward while: an elven slave glares at you threateningly
I received reward while: an elven slave glowers at you dubiously (killed orc to increase faction)
Key 15:
You say, 'Hail, Retlon Brenclog'
Hand Retlon Brenclog Shackle Key 15.
You receive 2 gold, 3 silver from Retlon Brenclog.
Key 16:
You say, 'Hail, a dwarven slave'
Hand Shackle Key 16 to a dwarven slave (Male).
a dwarven slave: says 'Good work!! I shall be on my way. Farewell my friend!!'

Also frees Rondo Dunfire, Named Dwarf Slave under the keep.
Key 17:
Hand Shackle Key 17 to a dwarven slave (Female).
You receive 11 silver from a dwarven slave.
Key 18:
You say, 'Hail, an elven slave'
Hand Shackle Key 18 to an elven slave (Male Wood Elf).
You receive 4 silver from an elven slave.
Key 19:
Hand Shackle Key 19 to an elven slave (Female Wood Elf).
You receive 6 silver from an elven slave.
Key 20:
Hand Shackle Key 20 to an elven slave (Male High Elf).
You receive 3 gold from an elven slave.
Key 21:
Hand Shackle Key 21 to an elven slave (Female High Elf).
You receive 2 Platinum, 2Gold, 2 silver from an elven slave.

quests.name: Snake Fang Necklace Quest
steps: Menkes Tabolet roams between 141.26, -163.01 near Lala Lenard and Byjan Timbokker (Tent #12 on Wiki map), the dock at -51.42, -17.95 near Mermaid's Lure, -11.50, -266.47 near the Grounds of Fate building (Warriors training hall), and behind the Fish's Ale building by the barrel at -221.75, -310.39.

quests.name: Sneed's Rat Infestation
steps: Sneed may be found inside Sneed Galliway's Trading Post, at +135, +240.
You say, 'Hail, Sneed Galliway'
You say, 'What problem?'
a mangy rat spawns periodically upstairs. Kill it and loot a Rat Head. Give the head to Sneed.

You also receive a minor item (a Water Flask is among known rewards).

quests.name: Soil of Underfoot
steps: Priestess Ghalea may be found at 790, 135.
You say, 'Hail, Priestess Ghalea'
You say, 'What Soil of Underfoot?'
You will need to be high amiable (failed at 403, worked tat 453) with Clerics of Underfoot before turning in. Upon giving her four Fairy Dust:
You receive 4 gold from Priestess Ghalea.
You receive 1 platinum from Priestess Ghalea.

quests.name: Soil of Underfoot Quest
steps: Priestess Ghalea is located at 788, 134, 3 in the Cleric's guild.
You say, 'Hail, Priestess Ghalea'
You say, 'What Soil of Underfoot'
Hand Priestess Ghalea 4 Fairy Dusts, unstacked
You receive 4 gold pieces.

quests.name: Soldier's Brooch Quest
steps: General Information:

The Soldier's Brooch is a set of Range slot items with a level 30 minimum requirement, but the quest is easy to do at that level. The set of items granted all start with the name "Soldier's Brooch Of", and there are versions for most classes.

quests.name: Solusek's Flower
steps: Ssynthi may be found at -55, +385, in the graveyard behind the mausoleum. He is on Temple of Solusek Ro faction.
You say, 'Hail Ssynthi.'
You say, 'A Warder of Ro?'
You say, 'What service can I do for you?'

The Flower is a ground spawn that looks like a bag atop a coffin inside the tomb in front of Ssynthi, at loc -25, 375, -225. Its respawn time is 1 minute. Take care to not step to either side of the coffin, where there are pit traps that will drop you into the basement of Mistmoore.
Give the flower to Ssynthi.
You receive a Scepter. (Identifies as The Scepter of Sorrow)
Notes: Ssynthi is on Temple Of Sol Ro faction, so he can be used to test your faction if you are doing the quest to raise it.

quests.name: Solvedi Scimitar Quest
steps: Solvedi Aldeberan, in the druid circle, will present you with your very own Solvedi Scimitar, a druid 1HS sword, if you give him:
Giant Laceless Sandal (found on the giant Timbur the Tiny in NK)
Lionhide Backpack (found on Groi Gutblade in SK)

Many will debate if it is worth the trade. **Warning!!** You must hail him and follow the chat dialogue until he talks about offering his weapon as a reward. If you don't and give him one of the items, you will lose the item and no reward.**
Solvedi Aldeberan can be found in Rathe Mountains at /loc (5095, 1727).
You say, 'Hail Solvedi Aldeberan'
You say, 'What defilers?'
Give him a Lionhide Backpack and a Giant Laceless Sandal.

quests.name: Something is Wrrrong
steps: The Kerran Sha`rr is located at 902.55, 347.27, -6.81
You say, 'Hail, The Kerran Sha`rr'

The Kerran Sha`rr says, 'Something is wrrrong. Tigerrrs of late have rrreturrrned from the trrraining pits with a hostility I have neverrrr seen. Strrrange sounds come from that island at night. The keeperrrs of the island do not come home to theirrr families. I must ask you to [explorrre the island]. Deterrrmine what is happening there.'
You say, 'explorrre the island'
You have been assigned the task 'Something is Wrrrong'.

The Kerran Sha`rr says, 'Be on guarrrd. I advise you limit yourrr investigation to the norrrth side of the island until we know morrre. Find some evidence that explains these strrrange happenings. Avoid the tigerrr pits to the south, rrreturn alive.'
Quest Stage 1:
Step 1 - Search the north side of the island for clues.

Text 1 - The Kerran Sha`rr has sensed that something is amiss in Kerra Isle. The trouble seems to stem from the small island south of the village. He has asked you to investigate the situation on the island and report back.
"Locate evidence of the threat to Kerra Village"
kerran `amir has multiple spawns around -315.25, -199.31, 5.19
Kerran `Amir spawns on the northern part of the South Island
Kill one for the Desecrated Kejaar Totem.
Faction from the kill:
Heretics -3
Deepwater Knights +5
Gate Callers +5
Craftkeepers +5
Crimson Hands +5
--You have looted a Desecrated Kejaar Totem from a kerran `amir's corpse.--
Your task 'Something is Wrrrong' has been updated.
Quest Stage 1:
Step 2 - Show the Kerran Sha`rr what you have uncovered.

Text 2 - The Kerran Sha`rr has sensed that something is amiss in Kerra Isle. The trouble seems to stem from the small island south of the village. He has asked you to investigate the situation on the island and report back.
"Locate evidence of the threat to Kerra Village"
You offered 1 Desecrated Kejaar Totem to The Kerran Sha`rr.
Your task 'Something is Wrrrong' has been updated.
You validated the Kerran Sha`rr's concerns about troubling forces working against Kerra Village.
You have been given: Hamed's Ring of Tears
You have been assigned the task 'This Means Warrr'.

The Kerran Sha`rr says, 'Herrresy! No disciple of Kejaarrr would do such a thing! And even the pumas of the isle have turrrned on us, you say? I must ask yourrr aid once again. The danger is grrreat. Make any necessarrry prrreparrrations, and then storrrm the tigerrr trrraining pit on the south end of that once sacrrred island. Do not rrreturrrn until you have rrrouted what evil has taken rrroot. I fearrr anything less could mean the dawn of a new warrr.'
You complete the trade with The Kerran Sha`rr.

quests.name: Souvenir Mugs
steps: Note: It's possible this is only a storyline rather than a quest. If it's a quest, it remains unsolved.
Tobart:
Speak with Tobart Dirkins in the tavern called The Broken Glacier in Thurgadin.
You say, 'Hail, Tobart Dirkins'
Hand him 1 platinum and receive The Broken Glacier Souvenir Mug.
There are five different bars in Thurgadin. You can obtain different mugs from some of them.
Doogle:
Find Doogle McBanick in the tavern called Doogle's Drinks.
You say, 'Hail, Doogle McBanick'
You say, 'What signature mug?'
Hand him 3 gold pieces to receive Doogle's Signature Souvenir Mug.
Adia:
Find Adia Coldbeard in the tavern called The Icy Mug.
You say, 'Hail, Adia Coldbeard'
Hand her 5 gold pieces to receive The Icy Mug Souvenir.
Fronden:
Find Loremaster Fronden in a The Holy Harbinger.
You say, 'Hail, Loremaster Fronden'
Hand him 1 platinum piece to receive The Broken Glacier Souvenir Mug (this would be the wrong mug for the tavern he is in).
A fourth mug is known to exist: The Velium Keg Collectors Mug from the tavern called The Velium Keg, but how to actually obtain this item remains unknown.
These mugs have no known use.

quests.name: Sparring Armor
steps: 1 Talk to Master Bain to obtain Leech Husk Pouch container
1 Obtain 4x Leech Husks by various mobs or vendors
1 Combine husks in the container (to craft Full Pouch of Leech Husks)
1 Give Full Pouch to Klok Mugruk (to receive Training Bag Husk)
1 Side-Quest: Perform the Granite Pebbles Quest to obtain Pile of Granite Pebbles
1 Tailor (with loom or sewing kit) the Training Bag Husk with 3x Pile of Granite Pebbles to craft Monk Training Bag (65% success chance at 0 Tailoring; 95% at 1+)
1 Give Monk Training Bag to Master Bain to receive Sparring Armor pieces

quests.name: Spear Delivery
steps: This quest is the second in a series of three quests, following the Toolset Delivery quest. The third quest, Mechanical Net Delivery, can be started and completed without doing either of the others.
Wenglawks Kkeak regards you indifferently -- You would probably win this fight..it's not certain though.
You say, 'I wish to undertake it'
Take the note to Kellek Felhammer in the next room. He will give you a spear.
Take the spear to Bekerak Coldbones at the Kromrif outpost in Great Divide. Doing so will spawn an angry shardwurm.

Bekerak Coldbones says, 'Well, well, I see Wenglawks finally got around to sending me my new spear. I hope it's not as shoddy as the last one. Your payment? Bahaha, did Wenglawks not tell you? Payment was to be a giant icewurm tooth carved into an amulet. Come now, little one. I will find an ice wurm for us to slay together. Then you can pull one of it's teeth out for me and I will fashion the talisman for that greedy merchant.'

An angry shardwurm spawns where Bekerak is, as a level 55 it seems to con a light blue (green with extra text). Is solo'able for melee with proper gear, has a ton of HP ~6575 and max hits at 101. No faction hits when the wurm dies.
Give the Giant Shard Wurm Tooth to Bekarak.

Bekerak Coldbones pulls out a large knife and begins to carve at the tooth. After a few minutes he pulls out a length of rope and fashions it into a very large necklace. 'Here is his payment. Tell him the spear is fine, and that I might reconsider his last offer to me. He will know what I mean.'
You receive a Giant Icewurm Talisman.
Give Wenglawks Kkeak the Giant Icewurm Talisman.

Wenglawks Kkeak says, 'He has reconsidered the offer you say? This is most excellent! I hope this will be acceptable payment for your troubles. My cash situation is not the best at this point in time. I do have a [third client] who needs delivery...'
You receive Bracer of Midnight.

quests.name: Spider Legs Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Sentry Kale'
You say, 'I wish to prove myself.'
Go out and kill the four INVISIBLE crystal spiders that spawn in the zone and bring back 4 Velium Spider Leg as proof.

quests.name: Spiderling Silks
steps: Sylia Windlehands is located at -253, 242, 77 in the Songweavers (Bard) Guild Hall.
Requires AMIABLE faction
You say, 'Hail, Sylia Windlehands'
You say, 'I will fetch spiderling silk'
Hand Sylia Windlehands 4 Spiderling Silks, unstacked.
You receive 1 gold pieces.

quests.name: Spirit Aid
requiredItems: Large Brick of High Quality Ore
steps: Travel to the Kejek Village located in Stonebrunt Mountains by going through the Warrens. (not to be confused Steamfont Mtns) and locate Saemey Wirewhisker
Apprehensive is high enough for both hand-ins needed to acquire the soulforge hammer. (Will dubious work?)
You say, 'Hail, Saemey Wirewhisker'
You say, 'What sort of atrocities?'
You say, 'What crystalline shadow substance?'
You say, 'What are soul orbs?'
You say, 'What is kejek spirit powder?'
Approach Emylie in the same fort.
You say, 'Hail, Emylie Steelclaws'
You say, 'What kejek forge?'
You say, 'What about the purification process?'
Give Emylie a Large Brick of High Quality Ore and an Oak Shaft.
You receive a Kejekan Smithy Hammer.

Locate a giant panda by the name of Giang Yin in Stonebrunt Mountains. Unfortunately he also has loot and unrelated quest so is possibly contentested and killed on sight by incentivized players. Advise doing a CampCheck and if called asking them to allow you to do Quest Turn before they kill him.
You say, 'Hail, Giang Yin'
Give him the Kejekan Smithy Hammer.
You receive a Soulforge Hammer.
💡 Do not trust the Allakhazam posting saying that *any* of avatars can be used; tested with Prowler and ate the hammer and Ghostback also ate it. but Giang Yin does work though.
NOTE: The next steps require drops from Velious. The remainder of this quest cannot currently be completed in EQ Legends.

Place the Soulforge Hammer and one Crystallized Shadow or Fading Shadow item into a Forge and combine. There is a Forge located inside the Kejek Village. The trivial for all combines is 15 (no-fail) and the Soulforge Hammer will be returned after each combine just like a regular Smithy Hammer functions
A Faded Shadow weapon results in the Purified weapon and a Fading Soul Orb.
A Crystallized Shadow weapon results in a Purified Crystal weapon and a Soul Orb.
A Crystallized Shadow armor piece results in a Purified Spirit armor piece and a Soul Orb.
This is where remainder of the quest may be broken or incomplete ( Unsolved on Live too--according to discussion on allakaZAM).
You could stop the quest here and just continue using your Soulforge Hammer to purify more Fading/Crystallized weapons and armor as many times as you want.
Note: You will need to complete the Spirit Powder quest to continue to the next step.
Give one Kejek Spirit Powder and a Soul Orb to Saemey Wirewhisker:
You receive a Shattered Soul Orb. ( No known use for this item )
This triggers nearby a heretic apparition who paths out of the town. Gave no faction and no loot.
Giving one Kejek Spirit Powder and the other kind Fading Soul Orb (from purifying the Fading shadow items) to Mrowro Wirewhisker results in:
You receive a Shattered Fading Soul Orb. ( No known use for this item )
This triggers nearby a fading erudite apparition who paths out of the town. Gave no faction and no loot.

quests.name: Spirit Powder
steps: Travel to the Kejek Village located in Stonebrunt Mountains by going through the Warrens. Travel to Kejek village and locate Saemey Wirewhisker
Apprehensive is high enough for hand-ins. (Will dubious work?)
You say, 'Hail, Saemey Wirewhisker'
You say, 'What sort of atrocities?'
You say, 'What crystalline shadow substance?'
You say, 'What are soul orbs?'
You say, 'What is kejek spirit powder?'
Hunt down the three types of 'spiritlings' and collect a stone from each one:
A jungle spiritling (green)
Jungle Spiritling Stone
A mountain spiritling (pink)
Mountain Spiritling Stone
A valley spiritling (yellow)
Mountain Spiritling Stone

The jungle spiritlings mostly spawn in the southern third of the zone, the mountain spiritlings mostly spawn in the northern third of the zone, and the valley spiritlings mostly spawn in the middle third of the zone, though there is some overlap. Tracking helps here a lot.
Turn the three Spiritling Stones in to Saemey:
You receive between 1 - 4 Kejek Spirit Powder.
The Kejek Spirit Powder is required for Spirit Aid.

quests.name: Spirit Wracked Cord Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Queen Velazul Di`zok'
You say, 'What service?'
You say, 'What additional components?'
The Undead Dragon Sinew drops very rarely from Sebilite Juggernauts and Trakanon in Sebilis. Trakanon seems to drop the sinew about one in three kills, occasionally dropping more than one.
The Spirit Wracked Urn drops sometimes by Drusella Sathir in Charasis.
Hand the Undead Dragon Sinew, Spirit Wracked Urn and Regal Band of Bathezid to the Queen in Chardok.
(This turn-in is multi-questable, but the original ring's owner will lose their ring in the process. MQ confirmed done on a level 10 as of today, 2/27/2023)
You'll receive the Ring back as well as the Spirit Wracked Cord. This is an innate (non-triggered) AoB effect.

quests.name: Staff of Temperate Flux Quest
steps: The quest start in Temple of Solusek Ro. Gardern is on a balcony at near the spell vendors.
You say, 'Hail, Gardern'
You say, 'What lore to the staff?'
You say, 'I am interested in the staff.'
He wants four items:
Darkwood Staff obtained by giving Romar Sunto in Temple of Solusek Ro a Lambent Stone
Heart of Fire from inferno goblin wizard in Solusek's Eye (Sol A)
Heart of Frost from a goblin wizard in Permafrost
Rod of Bone from a stone skeleton in Lake Rathetear (note: Rod of Bone, not Heart of Stone)
Hand in the four items:
Note:

The most difficult part of this quest is getting the Rod of Bone in Lake Rathetear. Stone Skeletons spawn in a tower in the southeast corner of the zone. There are two of them, very close to each other. They both have earth pet, who cast Root. So, you will have trouble single pulling them, which makes soloing this part mostly impossible before level 30 (while the skeletons are level 24-26). You might want to look for another wizard in his 20's or get a few partners to help you for this part.

Note: At lvl 29 you can use Bonds of Force (aoe snare) on one of the pets, and then run to zone. At zone root the stone skeleton and zone dance, then root the pet again and quickly burst down stone skeleton. Use leatherskin.

Note: The above method did not work for me. However, I found a method that does, and I was able to solo them at 31 with a Stein of Moggok as my only int gear. Bind yourself at the tower off to the side. Port to WC and grab a sow from a druid, and stock up on bloodstones for Leatherskin, and bat wings for levitate. You will need these buffs up at all times. You can tip a cleric for buffs if you want another safety net. As always, clarity will speed up the process here. Root the stone skeleton you want to kill and then high tail it for Rathe Mountains. After you zone in, gate. Run in and fight…
Multiquestable
The quest may be multiquestable? The helper should be able to hand in all the no-drop items, then the recipient must hand in the staff.

quests.name: Stanos' Head
steps: Obtain Stanos' Pouch
Pickpocketing and Travel
Book of Souls
Renux
General V`Ghera

quests.name: Steel Warrior Initiation
steps: Your Location is 80.40, -588.16, 31.23
Note: you need amiable faction to start this quest.
You say, 'Hail, Brin Stolunger'
You say, 'I am a young steel warrior.'
You receive an Empty Arena Sack. Fill it with 5 x Bat Wing and 5 x Snake Scales.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Full Arena Sack. Give the sack to Brin.
You receive A Sealed Letter (identifies as "Note To Axe Broadsmith"). It reads:
Axe Broadsmith Steel Warrior Qeynos Hills Fellow warrior, here is the help you requested. May he prove himself a true Steel Warrior.
Head to Qeynos Hills. Your Location is 3773.14, 960.97, -19.00
You say, 'Hail, Axe Broadsmith'
Give him the letter.
Kill it (Light Blue con to lvl 10, Scowls ready to attack).
--You have looted a Skull.--
It identifies as "Axe's Skeleton Skull." Give it to Axe.
You receive a Letter of Recommendation (identifies as "Letter of Recommendation From Axe"). It reads:
Brin Stolunger, Steel Warriors of Qeynos This young one has passed the test of undead. He is ready for the final glory.
Return to Brin and give the letter to him.
You receive A Sealed Letter (identifies as "Note To Grahan Rothkar"). It reads:
Grahan, This young warrior has proven himself skillful. Give him the final test of a Steel Warrior. May his sword swing swiftly and surely.
Grahan Rothkar may found in the bottom of the arena. Your Location is -31.67, -466.36, -24.83
You say, 'Hail, Grahan Rothkar'
Give him the letter.
You receive Pen Key # 5 (identifies as "QEY Arena Key 5"). Use it to unlock the pen as directed, then slay "a young lion" (Light Blue con to lvl 10, Scowls ready to attack).
--You have looted a Arena Lion Skin.--
It identifies as "Grahan's Lion Skin." Give it to Grahan.

quests.name: Stein Of Ulissa Quest
steps: Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85. She will give quest dialog and rewards to a level 10 Magician as of 9/29/2019 (perhaps lower).
You say, 'Hail, Vira'
You say, 'What is elemental summoning?'
You say, 'What of the stein of Ulissa?'
You say, 'I am interested in the stein.'
She wants the following four items:
A Sapphire may be purchased from a jewelry merchant.
A Mermaid Scale drops from various mermaids around the world.
A Stein (of Water) drops from magicians in Najena or alligators in Cazic Thule or Lake Rathetear.
Ice Giant Toes drop from various ice giants around the old world (everfrost, permafrost, Gornit in ocean of tears). These are not to be confused with Frost Giant Toes which drop from Velious giants.
Turn in the four items:
You receive the Stein of Ulissa.

quests.name: Storm Giant Toes to Sentry Kcor
quests.page: Storm Giant Toes to Sentry Kcor
steps: Sentry Kcor in Skyshrine requires Storm Giant Toes to be handed in 1 at a time. These drop commonly off storm giants in Kael or Wakening Lands.
Sentry Kcor may be found at +50, -640 in Skyshrine (near the Wakening Lands zonein). Note: This quest lowers faction with Kromzek.
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Kcor'
Sentry Kcor says, 'Halt, who goes there? Hmmm. What manner of strangers are you? Let it be known that the Kin hold no love for outsiders, only those truly worthy may walk amongst the Kin.'
Storm Giant Toes drop from storm giants in Kael Drakkel. Hand one in:
Sentry Kcor says, 'Ahh these will go nicely with the rest of my collection. Here is a small reward for your trouble.'
You receive 2 gold, 1 silver, 4 copper pieces.

quests.name: Strategies of the Ancient Dragons
steps: completed this with dubiously faction on 11/5/2015
This quest begins with Semkak Prophet of Vallon in Kael Drakkel. He is found in the quarters connected to the city's arena.
You say, 'Hail, Semkak Prophet of Vallon'
You say, 'Will you teach me?'
You say, 'I will serve the temple of Tallon Zek'
Bring back either a Golden Tablet of Draconic Strategy or a Scroll of Scaled Tactics (dropped by a dragon constructs in the Dragon Necropolis) in exchange for a reward.

quests.name: Strife to the Coldain
steps: NOTE: Amiable faction is not high enough to do this quest, turn in was eaten.
Clrakk Blackfist is found in the Iceshard Manor of Kael Drakkel.
You say, 'Hail, Clrakk Blackfist'
Clrakk Blackfist looks down at you. 'What is it you want, _____? Why do you speak to the great Knight Clrakk Blackfist?'
You say, 'I want to bring strife'
Deaen spawns in the same hut as Garadain Glacierbane in the Eastern Wastes. Kill him and loot either a Hand of Deaen Greyforge or a Legs of Deaen Greyforge.
Handing Clrakk Blackfists the Hand of Deaen Greyforge results in:
You receive the Mask of Malediction.
Handing Clrakk Blackfists the Legs of Deaen Greyforge results in:
You receive the Dark Spear of Venom.

quests.name: Supplies for the New Sebilisian Expedition
quests.page: Supplies for the New Sebilisian Expedition
requiredItems: Small Piece of High Quality Ore
Small Brick of High Quality Ore
steps: Crusader Iktra is at location 2256, -812 in North Ro on the shoreline closest to Freeport.
You say, 'Hail, Crusader Iktra'
You say, 'What supplies?'
You say, 'What better ore?'

Upon handing Crusader Iktra (4) Metal Bits (made via Blacksmithing 2 Small Pieces of Ore & 1 Water Flask - both available from Klok Rento in the New Sebilis Expedition. If you have poor faction, use the Sneak skill to sneak behind the merchant, right click and purchase.
Crusader Iktra says 'Thank you, [Race]. This will go a ways towards rebuilding our ships.'

Small Piece of High Quality Ore can drop from goblins in zones like Permafrost, Solusek's Eye, and High Keep. Pieces and Small Brick of High Quality Ore can also be obtained via Blacksmithing by breaking down Fine Steel weapons at a forge.

quests.name: Talym Shoontar's Head
steps: You say, 'Hail, Hager Sureshot'
You say, 'I will abide by the laws.'
You say, 'Who is Mammoth?'
You say, 'Who is Talym Shoontar?'
You say, 'I wish to collect the bounty.'
Talym Shoontar spawns in the tunnels at loc 475, -177. Aproximately 7 mins on respawn.
Faction for killing Talym Shoontar:
Hand in the head:
Reward is Hunting Bow.
You receive 11 silver from Hager Sureshot.
You receive 6 gold from Hager Sureshot.
Need /loc of quest mobs, list of quest rewards.

quests.name: Tarton's Wheel
steps: Obtain the 10 rods and combine them in the TEMPORARY Glowing Chest from Sulgar
Odus
Azia from Erud's Crossing
Antonica
Heda from Qeynos Aqueducts
Beza from Everfrost Peaks

Ena from Lower Guk

Faydwer

quests.name: Taskmaster Earring
steps: If you kill the orc taskmaster, he sometimes drops a Brass Earring. You can turn it in to any of the different slaves:
Faction Note: Must be debiously or better.
I received no reward while: an elven slave glares at you threateningly
I received reward while: an elven slave glowers at you dubiously (killed orc to increase faction)
Wood Elf, Male:
Hand an elven slave (Male Wood Elf) a Brass Earring.
You receive A Tattered Cloth Note (identifies as "Csb I.O.U. Elf 1"), which reads:
Brother.. Nildar.. I live still.. I will be home soon
Merchant Nildar is located at 882, 202 in Kelethin. Give him the note.
You receive: A piece of Leather Armor.
Wood Elf, Female:
Hand it to the female wood elf version of "an elven slave."
You receive A Faded Wedding Cloth, which reads:
Sister Iludarae, Long have I been held here in this stinking rothole of a camp. If you hold this note then know that I will soon be home
Merchant Iludarae is located at -36, -151, in Kelethin. Hand in the wedding cloth.
You receive: Leather Leggings, Leather Shoulderpads, Leather Boots or Leather Cloak.
Dwarf, Male:
Give this to any male dwarf slave.
You receive A Worn Rune, which reads:
Haldin, me ol' partner. If yer getting a note like this ye know what it means.
Guard Haldin is at location -145, 50 in Butcherblock Mountains. Give him the rune.
You receive either a Bronze Two Handed Battle Axe or a Dwarven Axe.
Dwarf, Female:
Hand it to a dwarven slave (female).
You receive a Small Wood Carving, which reads:
I've had enough o' this 'field research' Kalameky. I'm quittin' and ye can take yer low wage pay and do what ye know what to do with it.
Kalameky Darkfoam is at location 168, 389 inside Tanned Assets in South Kaladim. Hand in the carving.
You receive a Targ Shield.
High Elf, Female:
Give it to any female High Elf Slave and she replies:
She gives you A Torn Drawing, which reads:
Mistress Niola - My research is close to, if not completely, finished. Our suspicions may not have been as well founded as thought. I will be back within our halls soon.
Then take A Torn Drawing to Niola Impholder, located at 795, -599 in the northmost room of the Magicians Guild in Felwithe.
You receive a Gossamer Robe.
High Elf, Male:
Give this to any male high elf slave.
You receive A Ragged Cloth Note (identifies as "Csb I.O.U. Hie 1"), which reads:
Dear Settine. Your inability or reluctance to leave your post in order to even attempt a rescue has shown me the quality of your heart. Hopefully our eyes will never meet again
Guard Settine is located at -10, -171 (near zone in bridge on ground level) in North Felwithe. Hand in the note.
You receive a Silver Amber Ring.

quests.name: Taxes
steps: This quest begins with Vicus Nonad at location 255, -285 (second floor of a small white building to the east of the Lion's Mane Tavern and to the south of Nesiff's Wooden Weapons and the Bag and Barrel.
You say, 'Hail, Vicus Nonad'
You say, 'What's this cough you have?'
You say, 'I'll help with today's collections'
You receive a Tax Collection Box.
You say, 'Tell me about this list'
You receive a List of Debtors. In South Qeynos, you need to see:
Ton Firepride (175, -330, 3)
Mar Sedder (535, -85, 3)
Nesiff Tallaherd (440, -245, 3)
Fhara Semhart (400, -80, 3)
Tasya Huntlan (260, -70, 3)
Captain Rohand (15, -40, 3)
Fish Ranamer (-290, -270, 3)
Voleen Tassen (-190, -265, 3)
In North Qeynos:
Sneed Galliway (130, 240, 3)
Flynn Merrington (35, 330, 3)
In Qeynos Hills:
Mira Sayer (1400, 300, 8)
You say, 'Hail, Ton Firepride'
You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'
You receive Firepride's Tax Payment.
You say, 'Hail, Mar Sedder'
You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'
You receive Sedder's Tax Payment.
You say, 'Hail, Sneed Galliway'
You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'
You receive Galliway's Tax Payment.
You say, 'Hail, Nesiff Tallaherd'
You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'
You receive Tallaherd's Tax Payment.
You say, 'Hail, Mira Sayer'
You say, 'I'm here about your tax collection'
You say, 'why are you crying?'
Back in Qeynos:

You say, 'Did you steal Mira Sayer's taxes?'

quests.name: Tayla Ironforge
steps: Brohan Ironforge tells you that his daughter Tayla is missing and was last seen near Nektulos Forest. Bring him proof that she is safe and he will reward you.

Head to Neriak 3rd Gate and talk to Mare X`Lottl in the basement of Maiden's Fancy. Ask her about Tayla, and she will say: "Why do you seek that little scamp when you have Mare right here? If you really want to know where she is, it will cost you. Did I ever tell you that my heart belongs to Jasper?"
Go next door, buy a jasper and give it to her.
--You receive Klok's Seal--

There is a Half Elf Maiden that spawns in a locked room in Cabilis, that is Tayla. She was won in a game of King's Court, which Carson Mccabe rigged so that the Iksar Haggle Baron Klok would win. She was taken to Cabilis, and is simply called 'Half Elf Maiden'. Find 'Key' as a ground spawn in front of Haggle Baron Klok, and use this key to open the door to the maiden.
--Give 'Klok's Seal' to Half Elf Maiden.--

--Give 'a sealed letter' to Brohan Ironforge--

quests.name: Teir`Dal Courier
steps: Hail Seloxia Punox and she will say that he has a little test for the young warrior. She wants you to deliver a report to Ambassador K`Ryn {sic} in the Ogre city of Oggok. Tell her you will venture to Oggok and she gives you a note.

Take it to K'rynn (yes it is spelled differently) for some xp and change. He spawns near the Shaman's Guild and is not always there. He spawns at 8am right after Bouncer Gronk despawns and stays until 7pm.
He will then give you a report to deliver back to Seloxia. She will reward you with a minor item.
You say, 'Hail, Seloxia Punox'

Seloxia Punox's eyes flare with fury as her beautiful features twist into a snarl of hatred that echoes her hissing voice, 'How dare you address me in such a fashion?! I am the leader of the Indigo Brotherhood! You are lucky I do not strike you down where you stand! You shall address me as 'Mistress.' Many warriors have died so that I might gain this title.'
You say, 'Mistress'

Seloxia Punox maintains her imposing posture as she indifferently eyes _______, 'You stand now in the Cauldron of Hate -- the Indigo Brotherhood. We are an organization of Neriak's finest warriors whom remain dedicated to Neriak, the Dark Father, and our founder -- his majesty, King Naythox Thex. I am Seloxia Punox, second to only his majesty in command of the Brotherhood. From the Cauldron of Hate, we maintain the protection of the city both within our city walls and beyond in the forest of Nektulos. Perhaps you would wish to prove yourself worthy of our ranks and perform a [little test] of…
You say, 'What little test?'
You say, 'I will venture to Oggok'

quests.name: The Bayle List
steps: Note: Warmly faction required.

This a long and involved quest, and can be started in a number of different places, but revolves around Qeynos, Surefall and Freeport. The details I was given are still unclear in spots, but it ultimately results in a high powered shadowknight weapon. It involves getting all three parts of the Bayle List. Each part can also be gotten separately for a different reward, as listed on the separate quests.
List I:

For Part one of the list, talk to Commander Kane in the Shrine of Bertoxxulus in Qeynos Aqueducts and he will ask you to deliver Blackburrow Stout (NO DROP version) to Barn Bloodstone who is outside the Golden Rooster in Highpass. Make sure your faction with Barn is at least indifferent. To raise, do the Note for Janam and Note for Rebby quests in the East Freeport. If Commander Kane doesn't talk to you at first, just Hail him and say, "The disease is spreading." Then he will be much more manageable. Doing so results in Bayle List I, part one of the list.

As an alternative, you can kill Mutt Rootlit, who stands next to Barn Bloodstone, and she will drop the Bayle List I. Doing this will give a serious faction hit for Coalition of TradeFolk III, Coalition of TradeFolk, Carson McCabe, Corrupt Qeynos Guards, and The Freeport Militia.
List II:
For part two of the list, you can choose to kill a named bear or you can do The Regurgitonic quest.

Sidequest background: Talk to Runethar Hamest in the Temple of Thunder, who is investigating corruption among the guards of Qeynos. He asks you to go to Surefall Glade, find Frenway Marthank in the Druids' Guild, and ask him for "The Bayle List." When you do, Frenway is in a state of depression. His son -- who happened to be carrying the very list you're looking for -- was killed and devoured by the great grizzly bear Mammoth, who lives deep in the caves of Surefall Glade. As a Druid, Frenway is forbidden to harm the bears of the Glade, but he wants vengeance.
If you can find and slay the level 20-25 Mammoth behind the waterfall, you will get a the Bayle List II.
As an alternative, you can feed Mammoth a Regurgitonic, which can be obtained from The Regurgitonic quest.
List III:

For part three, talk to Raltur Caliskon in the Dismal Rage in Freeport and he tells you to assist Sir Lucan D`Lere in any task he has. But to return any interesting information to him and not Delere. Ralture will then tell you to kill Lady Shae and get the Bayle List. However, Lady Shae will tell you that Dyllin Starshine was sent from Qeynos to retrieve this list, and that he just left for High Pass Hold/Qeynos with it.

He can be found in the smuggler's camp in Highpass. If you have a high faction or use your influence spell on him, he will give you the list. You can also get the Bayle List III by killing him, but you will take a bad faction hit from that that might cause you to not be able to complete the final part of the quest.
Final:
Take all three parts to Rathmana Allin in South Ro along with 20 gp and he will give you back a translated list.

If you give this to Pietro Zarn, the shadowknight guildmaster in the East Freeport Sewers, he will usually reward you with a Rage War Maul (you may need very high faction with him to get it - thus you shouldn't kill Dyllin unless you started extremely high).
It is possible that this is used to obtain an even better shadowknight weapon. It also seems likely that there is a good person to give the list to to get a good-oriented reward.
Translation:
Translated the list says (substitution cipher: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz => uxbcadfgehzklminpqrsotqwxy)
According to [https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=503&mid=1578172128471733&p=1#msg1578172128471733](Zam Thread)
Which suggests the it's a list of spies working for Antonius Bayle and giving the list to Kane/Zarn will cause their exposure and assassination.
Only known 'Good' variant of this quest is the Bonethunder Staff Quest.

A Dusty Broken Sword - In the mines of North Kaladim in the water. Ground spawn in the water at roughly +761, +291.
A Dusty Broken Shield - On a ledge on right cliffs in Erudin from the docks. Ground spawn at -605, -725. You must swim from the docks to reach the shield.

Dusty Old Finger Bones - Inside Phinigel Autropos's room in Kedge Keep. Beware Swirlspine Seahorse (4 of them, 51 Cleric’s) can see invis! So bring a group! Swim down through the Star which is in the center of the room. There's an alcove on the SOUTH WALL with a large rock, and the bag spawns to the LEFT of the rock. Exact Location is neg 150, pos 127, neg 270.

You say, 'Hail, Simon Aldicott'
You say, 'What funeral service?'
Give him the casket. note: Was able to hand him casket as Iksar/dubious)
