Gretta despawns after turn in, but respawns about a minute later.

quests.name: The Bread Shipment (Kelethin)
steps: Speak to Innkeep Wuleran up the ramp from the newbie lift in the hut on the right marked inn (#17 on Kelethin map.)
The conversation with Innkeep Wuleran:
You say, 'Hail Innkeep Wuleran'
You say, 'short supply?'
You say, 'willing to travel'
(note that responding to 'can bake' gives a different quest)

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)
Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'
Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)
Return and give to Innkeep Wuleran.
You receive 1 platinum - 3 platinum from Innkeep Wuleran.

quests.name: The Bread Shipment (N Karana)
steps: Speak to Innkeep James in his small inn off the path in North Karana.
The conversation with Innkeep James:
You say, 'Hail Innkeep James'
You say, 'I happen to be a baker'
You say, 'I'll pick up a shipment of bread.'
(note that responding to 'muffins' gives a different quest)

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)
Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'
Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)
Return and give to Innkeep James.
You receive 1 platinum - 3 platinum from Innkeep James.
Experience gained was approximately 1.5-2% as a level 19 Druid.

quests.name: The Bread Shipment (Neriak)
steps: Speak to Sal Drana in Dranas Bread and Butcher #4 on the map of Neriak Foreign Quarter.
The conversation with Sal Drana:
You say, 'Hail, Sal Drana'
You say, 'willing to assist'
You say, 'food shipments'
(note that responding to 'baker' gives a different quest)

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)
Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'
Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)
Return and give to Sal Drana.
You receive 1 platinum - 3 platinum from Sal Drana.

quests.name: The Bread Shipment (Qeynos)
steps: The current edition of the Qeynos newspaper suggested speaking with Qeynos Merchants and the Coalition of Tradefolk about how we can help in the current famine.
Speak to Karn or Voleen Tassan in Voleen's Bakery in South Qeynos.
The conversation with Karn:
You say, 'Hail Karn Tassen'
You say, 'I am a baker'
You say, 'I will pick up a shipment of bread'
(note that responding to 'muffin supply' gives a different quest)

Voleen gives almost the same information, and identifies the person as Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)
Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'
Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)
Return and give to Karn (or Voleen)
You receive 1 platinum from Karn Tassen.
Experience was approximately 1.5-2% as a level 20 Druid.

quests.name: The Bread Shipment (W Karana Danin)
steps: Speak to Innkeep Danin in the first set of huts from North Karana, #20 on the map.
The conversation with Innkeep Danin:
You say, 'Hail, Innkeep Danin'
(note that responding to 'know' gives a different quest)
You say, 'be a baker'
You say, 'shipment of bread'

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)
Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'
Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)
Return and give to Innkeep Danin.
You receive 1 platinum - 3 platinum from Innkeep Danin.

quests.name: The Bread Shipment (W Karana Rislarn)
steps: Speak to Innkeep Rislarn at #2 on the map.
The conversation with Innkeep Rislarn:
You say, 'Hail, Innkeep Rislarn'
Innkeep Rislarn says, 'I knew this would happen. Food is becoming so scarce that I'm starting to run out of stock. You wouldn't happen to [be a baker] yourself or maybe you [know] someone who bakes?'
(note that responding to 'know' gives a different quest)
You say, 'be a baker'
You say, 'shipment of bread'

You then head to Jarlen Meadowgreen in South Karana. He is with the group of centaurs that hands out the crafted armor quests and circulates between standing near his brothers and checking his bread rising by the large fire pit (the text while he is checking this is rather amusing.)
Hail him and say, 'I am here to pick up some bread loaves.'
Give him 2 gold and you get a Bag of Bread Loaves (LORE NO DROP.)
Return and give to Innkeep Danin.
You receive 1 platinum - 3 platinum from Innkeep Danin.

quests.name: The Bridge
steps: Weligon Steelherder is located at -1040, -380 in Erudin.
It appears you need better than Indifferent faction, likely Amiable, for final turn-in
You say, 'Hail, Weligon Steelherder'
You say, 'What Deepwater tasks?'
You say, 'What Deepwater harpoon?'
You say, 'I am ready to prove allegiance to Erudin.'
Hansl Bigroon is located at +355, -465 in South Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Hansl Bigroon'
You say, 'I am a traveler of sorts.'
You say, 'I have been to Erudin.'
You say, 'What titanic bridge?'
Hansl Bigroon walks to location +275, -350 and drops A Sealed List (identifies as "List Of Engineers").
Purchin Oddsbot is located at +135, -320 in the High Keep jail area.
You say, 'Hail, Purchin Oddsbot'
Auto attack is on.
Purchin Oddsbot says 'That was not a very intelligent thing to do.'
You have slain Purchin Oddsbot!
You have looted a Human Decapitated Head.
Jogl Doobraugh is located at +110, -850 in Steamfont Mountains.
You say, 'Hail, Jogl Doobraugh'
Charlotte Beep.. Beep.. Beep..
Auto attack is on.
You have slain Jogl Doobraugh!
You have looted a Gnome Decapitated Head.
Charlotte does not assist.
Trantor Everhot is located at +400, -150 in Everhot Forge in North Kaladim.
You say, 'Hail, Trantor Everhot'
You have slain Trantor Everhot!
You have looted a Dwarf Decapitated Head.
Hand Weligon Steelherder the sealed letter, Human Decapitated Head, Gnome Decapitated Head, and Dwarf Decapitated Head.
You say, 'Why is the harpoon no more?'
You receive the Deep Six Cutlass.

quests.name: The Broodling
steps: If you kill Dorn B'Dynn, on occasion a dark elf spy will appear and head towards the zone. Interestingly, Dorn says something along the lines of "I can no longer
hold this form" when he dies and the faction changes are different, so I think you actually killing a Dorn imposter. You should have sow on at this point because he runs pretty fast. Catch

him and kill him and his body will crumble to dust and a spider-like critter will spring forth and head to the zone at a very fast clip. Killing this creature gets you the Charasis Tome. The tome gives you background on the dungeon Charisis (Howling Stones) and some clues on how to get the key to enter. There is little practical reason to do this.
Need all dialogues, faction hits if any, exact in-game name of quest items/rewards, exact in-game names of additional quest mobs.

quests.name: The Burning Dead
steps: At amiable faction:
You say, 'Hail, Opal Darkbriar'
Opal Darkbriar says, 'Greetings! You will have to excuse me. I have no time to talk right now and I prefer to be left alone. Please leave.'
The following text is directly copied from ZAM. [http://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=730]
This ultimately leads to the creation of the Wand of the Burning Dead. My details are still sketchy.
Talk to Opal Darkbriar in the Freeport tunnels and ask her about the wand. She needs three things to help assemble the broken wand.
The first is Marnek's Wand of the Burning Dead, which can be found in the bottom level of Befallen.
The second is the Sapphire of Souls, which can be found in Najena
I am not sure what the third is. A post on Allah's mentions a "Burning Prince's Blessing"
Bring these to Opal and you should get the wand. You need a very high faction to get this quest.

The Sapphire of Souls is speculated to be the Blackened Sapphire, while Marnek's Wand of the Burning Dead is speculated to be the Blackened Wand. Simply returning both items to Opal with kindly faction results in no reward.

quests.name: The Cigar
steps: Dok may be found inside the shop called Dok's Cigars (/loc 213, 274). You say, 'Hail, Dok'
You say, 'What's a cigar?'
You say, 'I will collect the wax.'
You receive an Empty Jar, a 6-slot TINY container that identifies as "Empty Jar for Honeycombs."

Go hunt bixies in various zones and collect their honeycomb. Combine six in the jar to craft a Full Honeycomb Jar, which you should return to Dok. Dok says 'Great work!! Now I can make more candles! Here ye are, me friend. I call this the Everburn Candle. It has a wee bit o' magic in it. I hope ye like it.'
You receive coin and an Everburn Candle.

quests.name: The Clothspinner Sisters (evil)
steps: This quest begins with Rihtur Fullome located at (357, -450) in the Qeynos Aqueducts.
You say, 'Hail, Rihtur Fullome'
You say, 'What soldier?'
You say, 'Who is Nerissa?'
You say, 'What plans?'
From here, you can speak to Nerissa for hints as to her whereabouts.
You may also complete Nerissa's quest to receive the Monogrammed Cloth to turn in.
Milea can be found in East Karana. For the sake of being evil, we choose to kill her.
You loot a Monogrammed Cloth.
You return to Rihtur Fullome and hand him the Monogrammed Cloth.
You also gain a minor item, such as Patchwork armor, Rusty weapons, Cleric spells, with a small chance of a Rat Shaped Ring.
In the Good version of this quest, Rihtur sends Guard Elias to do his dirty work.

quests.name: The Clothspinner Sisters (good)
steps: Astaed Wemor in the Temple of Life asks you to go check on Nerissa Clothspinner who seems down for some reason. You will occasionally see her running around outside the gates. Talk to her and hear her tale of woe.
She will tell you that she misses her warrior sister, and will give you a letter to deliver to her sister somewhere in the Karanas.
You say, 'Hail, Nerissa Clothspinner'
You say, 'sister'
You say, 'i will deliver a note to her'
Receive A Tattered Note
The sister is located in East Karana in a cave. Deliver the note to her, and she will thank you and give you a Monogrammed Cloth veil to take back to her sister.

She will then be rewarded for talking to you by being attacked by a guard named Guard Elias and killed. Bet that makes you feel good. If you kill the guard and the sister lives, you may get an additional reward. When you give the original sister the veil she will send you with a note to the Temple of Life.
If you give her the veil, you get a decent item as well. Delivering the note gets you more experience and faction.
Need all dialogues, /loc of quest mobs, all items used, list of quest rewards, current faction hits.

quests.name: The Crate (evil)
steps: You must be Amiable with Qeynos Guards to get the crate from Guard Weleth.
Guard Weleth may be found wandering near the North Gate.
You say, 'Hail, Guard Weleth'
If you wait long enough, you'll see:
You say, 'What crate?'
You say, 'Who is Nesiff?'
You say, 'arrows in this box'
You receive a Crate of Defective Arrows.
Nesiff Tallaherd may be found in South Qeynos in his shop, "Nesiff's Wooden Weapons," at +440, -245.
You say, 'Hail, Nesiff Tallaherd'
You say, 'Who is Guard Weleth?'
You receive A Slip of Parchment ( ). It reads:
INVOICE - NESIFF'S WOODEN WEAPONS
QEYNOS: 19 CRATES
LONG FLIGHT ARROWS
36 GP CREDIT OF 1 GP AND 9 SP REMAINING DUE TO DEFECTIVE CRATE
CUSTOMER: WELETH, ON BEHALF OF QEYNOS MILITIA
Lieutenant Dagarok wanders near "Crows Pub & Casino" in North Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Lieutenant Dagarok'
Give him the Slip of Parchment.
You receive 2 silver and 6 copper pieces from Lieutenant Dagarok.

quests.name: The Crate (good)
steps: Guard Weleth may be found wandering near the North Gate (/loc?).
You say, 'Hail, Guard Weleth'
If you wait long enough, you'll see:
You say, 'What crate?'
You say, 'Who is Nesiff?'
You say, 'I will take the crate of arrows.'
You receive a Crate of Defective Arrows.
Nesiff Tallaherd may be found in South Qeynos in his shop, "Nesiff's Wooden Weapons," at +440, -245.
You say, 'Hail, Nesiff Tallaherd'
You say, 'Who is Guard Weleth?'
Give the crate to Nesiff.
You receive A Slip of Parchment (identifies as "Invoice-Nesiff's Wooden Weapons"). It reads:
INVOICE - NESIFF'S WOODEN WEAPONS
QEYNOS: 19 CRATES
LONG FLIGHT ARROWS
36 GP CREDIT OF 1 GP AND 9 SP REMAINING DUE TO DEFECTIVE CRATE
CUSTOMER: WELETH, ON BEHALF OF QEYNOS MILITIA
Give the slip of parchment to Guard Weleth.
You receive 4 copper from Guard Weleth.

quests.name: The Donations
steps: Note: This quest requires better than indifferent faction. Keep in mind for low level characters especially, while running around, these donations weigh 10.0 each and you need to collect 6

This is a good faction quest. Daedet Losaren, in the Temple of Thunder, gives you a donation box and asks you to find six residents of Qeynos to donate to the temple. Here's a list of where to get the six donations:
1) Lanhern Firepride - Only at night when she is in Fish's bar. Give her four ogre swills for one (and the following faction changes):
2) Hansl Bigroon - Either at his house, or the office of the people;
3) Kane Bayle - Guard House;
4) Enic Ruklin - Temple of Life;
5) Guard Leopold - Qeynos Hills, wanders;
6) Guard Cheslin - Qeynos Hills, wanders - Frequently dead.

There are other people who respond to "donation", but don't seem to cough one up: The cloth armor salesperson in front of the Lion Mane Inn and Tavern (she says to go away) in South Qeynos. The two gents who make bags in North Qeynos. A bard in the Bard's guild (says he donates to his own cause) in South Qeynos. Also in South Qeynos, a merchant by the Grounds of Fate who only makes three things, axes I believe. He laughs because of the taxes being so high. Oh, so do the bag makers.
Your reward is usually a spell scroll. When you turn in the combined box the following factions change:
Note that the donations weigh 10 each, so prepare to become encumbered during the quest.
Need all dialogues, current faction hits, /loc of quest mobs.

quests.name: The Emissary
steps: This quest begins with Marda in the Shaman guild hall of Oggok, #1 on the map.
You say, 'Hail, Marda'
You say, 'I am one of the smart ogres'
Even though the text leads to Grevak, you do not need to do his quests, you simply need to be level 5 or higher and ask Marda about the secret mission:
You say, 'What secret mission?'
If she does not respond to this key phrase, Emissary Glib will not spawn! In this case, attempt the following respawn command.
You say, 'Where is Emissary Glib?'

After she has spoken these words, Emissary Glib spawns at the top of the guard tower (#10 on the map). Emissary Glib will take in the view from the tower for perhaps two minutes then walk downstairs, saunter to the Feerrott zoneline and despawn. A single /hail him will stop him for approximately a minute and it is possible to /hail-lock him near the zoneline where no guards path. Once a valid player triggers him with Marda, anyone else can /hail him and hand in necklaces as he appears Indifferent to all races and classes.

NOTE: As a wood-elf druid in dark-elf illusion (Guise), I was dubious to Marda (and not kos to any of the other ogres in the vicinity). When I hailed Marda, she did not respond, but when I spoke the words 'Where is Emissary Glib?' she did respond and Glib did spawn.
You say, 'Hail, Emissary Glib'
You say, 'The Greenblood Shaman sent me'

The slayer necklaces are tradeable, not lore and drop off either a troll slayer (rewarded with minor coin only) or Slayer Captain (coin and one of the above listed rewards) in Innothule Swamp. Both versions are called Frog Eye Necklace (but Identify differently.) See Slayer Captain for spawn and placeholder info.
Slayer Necklace:
Upon handing in a Frog Eye Necklace (lore: Troll Slayer Necklace) to Glib:
You receive 7 silver from Emissary Glib.
Captain Necklace:
Upon handing in a Frog Eye Necklace (lore: Troll Slayer Capt. Necklace) to Glib:
You receive 1 silver from Emissary Glib.
You receive a random item, which could include the Forager Bag or Hopper Spear.
Handing in the Captain's necklace leads you into the Marda's Secret Mission quest.

quests.name: The Etched Stone
steps: Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm
White Gold Necklace from a A froglok noble in Lower Guk.
Crystalline Orb from a stone spider in Nagafen's Lair.
Bloodied Piece of Parchment
Obtain a Prickly Pear from a an icy terror, Lady Vox's guardians in Permafrost.
Give the Prickly Pear to Xenyari Lisariel for Bloodied Piece of Parchment at the druid ring (5298, 1765).
Faceted Hyacinth
Give 2,000pp to Kazzel D`Leryt to receive an Uncut Hyacinth.
Give 1,000pp and Uncut Hyacinth to Darfumpel Zirubbel to receive the Faceted Hyacinth.
Turn in White Gold Necklace, Crystalline Orb, Bloodied Piece of Parchment, Faceted Hyacinth to Kazzel D`Leryt and receive Faceted Hyacinth Telesm
Give Faceted Hyacinth Telesm to Xenyari Lisariel for Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm
Spell: Life Leech
Return the Pulsating Hyacinth Telesm to Kazzel D`Leryt to spawn monstrous zombie.
Kill monstrous zombie and loot Monstrous Zombie Heart
Give the Monstrous Zombie Heart to Kazzel D`Leryt for Spell: Life Leech.

quests.name: The Falchion
steps: This quest is offered after you complete the Orc runner quest.

You need will need high faction (kindly is sufficient) to do this quest. Speak with the Paladin guildmaster, Lord Jyleel, in the basement of the Paladin guild. He wants you to prove yourself a faithful Paladin of the court.
You say, 'I am a faithful paladin of this court'
The Black Heart of Ambassador Dvinn (found in Crushbone)
Blue Orc Head (from the Orc Prophet in Crushbone)
A Large Locked Crate (dropped by Brawn in the Ocean of Tears - about 22nd level - on the rocks with the Sirens just as you enter the Ocean of Tears from Antonica).
Bring the items back to Jyleel.

General Jylell says, 'A noble deed has been done and the alliance of evil has been stalled. I present you with the falchion of the Koada’Vie. You are now an honorable member of our order. Hail Felwithe! May you defend her with honor.'
Receive Falchion of the Koada`Vie.

quests.name: The Family Chest Straps
steps: You say, 'hail Bjoskhua Blackfist'
Bjoskhua Blackfist's lips do not move, though your mind is filled with a voice. 'What is it you want, mortal? I have little patience for those who do not come here to study.'
You say, 'i wish to study'
Bjoskhua Blackfist looks you over and his voice invades your mind again. 'What is it you wish to study?'
You say, 'who is clrakk?'
You say, 'what chest straps?'
You say, 'what contests of the fist?'
Bring him back the backbone of Phinigel Autropos from Kedge (yes, the backbone also used in the bard epic):
Need all dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of Bjoskhua Blackfist, info on other quest rewards if any, minimum faction required to get quest, etc.

quests.name: The Fiery Avenger
steps: You'll need Warmly or higher Deepwater Knights faction for the turn ins.
Swords
Obtain a Ghoulbane
Obtain a SoulFire
Tome of Ages
Obtain the Torn, burnt book
Obtain the Torn, Frost covered book
Turn in 1000pp and the books to Rysva To`Biath or Rineval Talyas to obtain Book of Scale
Miragul's Robe and Head
Turn in Book of Scale to Oracle of K`Arnon to obtain Miragul's Phylactery
Hand Miragul's Phylactery to the Lich of Miragul to spawn Miragul
Obtain Miragul's Robe and Miragul's Head by killing Miragul- Only to whoever turned in the Phylactery!
Final hand-in to Inte Akera
Obtain access to Island 4 (Pegasus Island) of Plane of Sky, this requires several keys.
Give Inte Akera the Soulfire ALONE for the Blessing of Nobility. Warmly Faction Needed
Give Inte Akera the Ghoulbane ALONE for the Blessing of Sacrifice. Warmly Faction Needed
Give Inte Akera the head, robe, and both blessings (TOGETHER) for the :Fiery Avenger. Warmly Faction Needed

quests.name: The First Arcane Test
steps: You say, 'Hail, Gozzrem'
You say, 'I seek the arcane.'

quests.name: The Fisherman
steps: Antus Shelbra can be found on the third floor of the Abattoir at (762, 829) in Paineel. Minimum faction is unknown, but kindly is sufficient.
You say, 'Hail, Antus Shelbra'
You say, 'I have much to learn'
Find Aglthin Dasmore at location (370, -1670) in Toxxulia Forest.
You say, 'Hail, Aglthin Dasmore'
You have slain Aglthin Dasmore!
--You have looted a Aglthin's Fishing Pole.--
Return to Antus Shelbra and give him Aglthin's Fishing Pole.
You receive 4 gold, 9 copper pieces.
You receive the Staff of the Abattoir Initiate.

quests.name: The Fishslayers
steps: Marshall Lanena is located at 90, -174 on the second floor of the Rivervale Bank.
You say, 'Hail, Marshal Lanena’
You say, ‘I am a new deputy’
You say, 'What small problem?'

Fiddy Bobick is usually around 19, -428. He runs between his shop and the dock and occasionally jumps into the water and swims around a little. Hailing him causes him to pause briefly. Just stand on the dock to talk to him and it should work.
You say, ‘Hail, Fiddy Bobick.”
You say, ‘Wickystick sent me’
Fiddy wants you to kill the piranha that are eating all the fish in the lake.
Piranha sometimes drop a Piranha Tooth
Turn in to Fiddy (faction, exp):
Fiddy Bobick says, 'Whew!! We are sure on the way to saving this village, pal! They're gonna erect a statue in our names. Fishslayers is what we are! Let's keep up the good work!'
You receive 1 gold, 8 silver pieces.
Turn in to Lanena (for Rapier):
OR take a tooth back to Marshall Lanena and she will give you a Piranha Bag to put 4 of them into:

Marshal Lanena says, What was I thinking?!! Piranha are coming downstream and eating our supply of fish! We have never had a problem like this!! Where are these little beasts coming from? For now we must collect more. Take this bag. Collect enough teeth to fill the bag. Don't worry, if it takes a while I shall reward you with the [Rantho Rapier]. We will need to examine the teeth.'
You say, 'what rantho rapier?'

Marshal Lanena says, 'The Rantho Rapier was crafted by the great blacksmith Rantho Goobler. It was designed for use by the warriors of the wee folk. With its light weight and special two-hand hilt, it becomes a formidable weapon in the hands of our younger deputies. Only a [new deputy] has the right to earn one.'
You receive 1 silver pieces.
Once you have combined the 4 teeth, return them to her and she will give you a Rantho Rapier.
need quest text and final exp hits here

quests.name: The Four Fragments

rewards.name: Chapter III, When Stars Forget Their Light

steps: You say, 'Hail, Windscribe Thaloria'
You say, 'What pages?'
You say, 'Scattered where?'
Kill any Mob on Floor 1 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 1
Kill any Mob on Floor 2 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 2
Kill An Armored Shadow on Floor 3 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 3 (Seems Skeletons can drop Page 1 on this floor)
Kill any Mob on Floor 4 in Tower of Frozen Shadow : Chance to drop Forgotten Page 4
Hand all four pages into Windscribe Thaloria.
You receive Chapter III, When Stars Forget Their Light and a Holiday Gift.

quests.name: The Four Idols
steps: You say, 'Hail Guardian of Takish'
You say, 'I am a templar'
You say, 'I will aid you'
You will need:
Idol of Corruption from Gkrean Prophet of Tallon
Idol of Decay from a cleric of Vallon Zek or a cleric of Tallon Zek
Idol of Disease from Semkak Prophet of Vallon
Idol of Erosion from a priest of Tallon Zek or a priest of Vallon Zek
They drop off the following giants in the Kael Arena: Gkrean Prophet of Tallon, Cleric of Vallon Zek, Semkak Prophet of Vallon and Priest of Tallon Zek.

quests.name: The Frikniller Family
steps: Gren Frikniller is a bodyguard for the rogue guildmaster in East Freeport. Ask him about his sister (they share the same surname):
You say, 'Who is your sister?'
Take the letter to Falia Frikniller in North Freeport. Note she is on Merchants of Rivervale faction and may not deal with you if your faction is too low (dubious works):
You say, 'Hail, Falia Frikniller'
Hand her the letter:
Receive a Broken Heirloom Necklace in return, which you can take to Gren:
You receive ~1 silver from Gren Frikniller.

quests.name: The Geologist's Purloined Tools
steps: At the end of the Kobold Shaman Artifacts quest, Breya says "You may want to ask Gans about his brother"
You say, 'Hail, Gans Paust'
You say, 'What of your brother?'
You say, 'I will check on him for you.'
You receive Gans's note to Yelesom.
The note reads:
Brother, Your report is two weeks late. I fear something has harmed you and have sent this courier to inquire
about your well being. Please send the courier back with message of your health and progress. Regards, Gans.
Travel to Erud's Crossing to find Yelesom Paust in the volcanic crater.
You say, 'Hail, Yelesom Paust'
Hand him Gans's note to Yelesom.
You say, 'I will help you.'
You say, 'Where is your camp?'
Seek out the missing tools:
The Magnifying Glass is a bag sitting on the ground not too far from the shore. The loc is -600, 2000.
The Geologist's Hammer looks like a hammer and is on the ocean floor at the bottom of the big drop off. You will have to swim down the deep drop off here to find it. The loc is -526, 2287.
The frantic kerran is underwater at loc 33, 3158. Avoid the sharks getting to him, and kill him to get the Incomplete Tool Kit. Careful, you end up very far from shore with a 25 stone container.
Combine the Magnifying Glass and the Geologist's Hammer in the Incomplete Tool Kit to create Yelesom's Tools. Turn this in to Yelesom.
You receive Yelesom's Reports.
Return to Erudin and hand Yelesom's Reports to Gans Paust.
No experience is awarded, but you do receive Midnight Sea Mail Sleeves

quests.name: The Gift Box
steps: There are random Mobs in the zone that drop A Library Card. Give one to Posie the Librarian and she will give you a 4-slot container called the Book of Mischief.
Also dropping randomly are four page fragments: top left and right, and bottom left and right. Combine these four pages in the book and you will get a Words of Wealth.
Now talk to Bob the Painter and give him your Words of Wealth and you will get an Empty Pot of Gold (2 slot container). Next, you need to combine:

an item from the Deck of Spontaneous Generation Quest. Only 2-throne combination items work (e.g., Green Wristguard, Crown of Distraction), except for Vambraces of Distraction & Mask of Melodies (1-throne), which also work.
Words of Wealth
Combine these two items in the Pot of Gold, which will give you a Funny Money.

Give 2 Funny Moneys to Peachy D'Vicci and she gives you a colored Gift Box. The box has 5 charges. Occasionally you will receive a Frostmaidens Idol instead of a gift box. As far as I know, the color of the box you will get is completely random. Make sure to hand in the money unstacked and do not multiquest the turn in.
If you click on the box, you will summon a doll. The type of doll depends upon the color of the box:
Black: Twisted Druid Doll (Druid)
Blue: Sly Summoner Doll (Magician)
Green: A Maleficent Necromancer Doll (Necromancer)
Grey: Mad Monkey Doll (Monk)
Purple: Mischievous Dazzler Doll (Enchanter)
Red: A Wily Warlock Doll (Wizard)
Silver: Shamanistic Shenannigan Doll (Shaman)
White: A Crazy Cleric Doll (Cleric)

Each doll has 1-5 charges of Hug, which is a regeneration spell (A Crazy Cleric Doll has 5 charges while A Maleficent Necromancer Doll and A Wily Warlock Doll have only 1). Each doll is named after a specific class; thus there is one colored box per class.

quests.name: The Gnoll Slayer
steps: Marton Sayer may be found in a cottage in Qeynos Hills (/loc 1381, 278).
Note: This quest may be completed at Dubious faction. Since the NPC happens to be a merchant, the worst your faction could possibly be is dubious.
You say, 'Hail, Marton Sayer'
You say, 'What powerful dog?'

Marton Sayer says, 'I have encountered a gnoll who spoke the common tongue. He dared to call himself Lord Elgnub. He swore that some day we would cross paths and he would snatch my infant son Joseph from our home. He would stand no chance against me and the mighty [Gnoll Slayer].'
You say, 'What is Gnoll Slayer?'

Marton Sayer says, 'Gnoll Slayer is the mighty longsword which was passed down unto me through generations of Sayers. My days of battle are over, but I can still wield her with ferocity. The only thing more precious would be my son, Joseph Sayer. I would trade Gnoll Slayer only for him to be safe and sound at home.'
Lord Elgnub can be found in the skull room of Blackburrow. Kill him and loot Baby Joseph Sayer, which you will bring back to Marton.

Marton Sayer says 'Baby Joseph!! Look, Momma!! Baby Joseph has been rescued by this good adventurer!! That evil Lord Elgnub made good on his word and snatched my son from under our noses. You saved the day!! For this you shall wield 'Gnoll Slayer'!!
You receive Gnoll Slayer You receive 2 platinum pieces
You receive Gnoll Slayer (the intermediate version).
You say, 'What true potential?'

Marton Sayer says, 'The true potential of Gnoll Slayer is an enchantment which was once imbedded into a gnoll's eye which was placed into the hilt of the blade. The spell would help you fight off disease and call forth a wolf to fight beside you. Alas, the gnoll eye was stolen from the blade by a great, one-eyed, white gnoll. Along with the eye, the only book which explained how to return the enchantment was also stolen. I know not where this gnoll might be. If you can find the journal and the eye, return them with the Gnoll Slayer to me, for I have been searching for decades.'
Head to Splitpaw Lair
Kill a one eyed gnoll
Loot a Gnoll's Eye
Kill a Lteth Val Scribe
Loot a Journal of Greater Enchantment
Give the eye, journal, and intermediate Gnoll Slayer to Marton.
Marton Sayer says, 'The eye and the journal! What a great day! The Gnoll Slayer shall be returned to full strength because of you. Your service to Qeynos will not soon be forgotten.'
You receive the final version of the Gnoll Slayer.

quests.name: The Gnome Take
steps: This quest follows Rat Patrol, given by Jeet, located at 563, 193, -33 outside the Ratsbone Treasury & Assay Office. You must have Amiable faction to complete this quest.
You say, 'I will run to the gnome city'
You say, 'I will collect the gnome profit'
clockwork scrubbers can be found roaming within Ak'Anon
You say, 'Hail, clockwork scrubber'
The clockwork scrubber does not respond, but will pause in its pathing.
You say, '628'
If you get the prior response, give the clockwork scrubber the key you received from Jeet. You will be given the Gnome Take in return.
Hand Jeet the Gnome Take.
Alternatively, you might see the text

quests.name: The Grammar Manual
classes: WAR CLR PAL RNG SHD BRD ROG
steps: loot Strong Wooden Branch from a holgresh conjurer or a holgresh elementalist
loot Strong Raptor Gut from a tigeraptor or a tigesaurous
Give Branch and Gut to Snowfang fisher (to spawn enraged walrus)
cause enraged walrus to die (you do not have to get the killing blow)
quickly talk to agitated snowfang by hailing and then typing " /say I want the magic thing. "to get Chapter P
give Ami the Chapter P to receive Pirate Grammar Manual
give Pirate Grammar Manual to Chef Nilham (to receive Ice Forged Shackles)

quests.name: The Icestar Dims
steps: You say, 'Hail, Watcher Aenwen.'
You say, 'What cracked places'
Permafrost Resonance Crystal comes from King Thex'Ka IV spawn in Permafrost.
Thurgadin Resonance Crystal comes from Thurgadin at the statue straight across from Icewell Keep entrance. Stand behind the statue at .
Dreadlands Resonance Crystal comes from the Yeti Caves Crossroads in Dreadlands at #1 on the map.
Hand in all three Crystals to Watcher Aenwen.
You receive Chapter I, The Shatter Sky and a Holiday Gift.

quests.name: The Icestar Remembers

rewards.name: Chapter V, Ashes in the Margins

steps: You say, 'Hail, Isolde Winterveil'
You say, 'I will take this shard.'
You say, 'Find who?'
You receive Frosted Memory Shard
You say, 'Hail, Guard Lammel'
You say, 'Who mattered?'
Give Guard Lammel the Frosted Memory Shard.
You receive a Frosted Broach. Return to Eastern Waste and turn in a Frosted Broach to Isolde Winterveil.
Upon turning in Frosted Broach to Isolde Winterviel,
You receive Chapter V, Ashes in the Margins and a Holiday Gift*.
* NOTE: You will only receive the Holiday Gift from this quest the first time you complete it. Due to abuse of the questline, repeatable attempts had the Holiday Gift removed.

quests.name: The Loom
steps: Open the loom in Dionin Needlespin's house and you will find that it opens up into a 12-slot Sewing Kit complete with Combine button.
You say, 'hail Dionin Needlespin'.
You say, 'How do you mend very large items?'
Need all dialogues, faction hits if any, quest reward(s), /loc of quest mobs and objects, details about the rest of the quest.
Notes:
Kaesora has a loom near the Backyard and Reaver of Xalgoz room.

quests.name: The Lorekeeper's Scrolls
steps: Weltria Ostriss can be found on the top floor of the Erudin City Library.
You say, 'Hail, Weltria Ostriss'
You say, "I am capable of obtaining the scrolls"
You receive a Large Scroll Case.
Lorekeeper Roggik is located in The Warrens and drops seven UNIQUE Dusty Kobold Scrolls, which identify as the following:
Rise of King Gkar and Klan Kolbok
The Ascension of Rolfron Zek
The Fall of Kolbok
The Kobold Age of Blood
The Council and the Dwarves
Kobolds in the Age of Scale
The Arrival of Rallos Zek
These scrolls are written in Elder Teir'Dal. Very interesting reading, detailing the history of the Kobolds.
Combine the seven scrolls in the Large Scroll Case to create Kobold History Collection. The Large Scroll Case is not consumed in this combine. Hand the Kobold History Collection in to Weltria.
You receive 50 platinum pieces.

quests.name: The Lost Circle
steps: Brother Balatin is a skeletal monk located on a pyramid in the wizard spires of the Dreadlands at +981, +9057, +1102.
Hail him as any other mob, and you get the following response:
You say, 'Hail, Brother Balatin'

Brother Balatin turns toward you. A transparent human face materializes upon the skull. As he speaks the smells of rotted rat corpses rushes into your face. You must fight the urge to vomit. What discipline do you [follow]?
You say, 'I follow the brotherhood of the Lost Circle.'
You say, 'I am ready for the true drape.'
You need to turn in the following items to Brother Balatin to receive the robe:
Notes on turn in methods:

Sneak You can sneak to turn-in pieces. While in sneak behind him (without hailing him) you can open a trade window and he will not aggro. warning: While in sneak, do not hail him, he will turn and aggro you.
Charming him to do the turn-in does work, need confirmation of this.
Enchanter Pacify may not work, need confirmation of this.
Enchanter Pacify then after the trade window is opened casting Invisibility (not Invisibility versus Undead) may work, need confirmation.
Feign Death turn-in does not work, need confirmation of this.
Brother Balatin holds his arms out and a fine robe materializes before your eyes. You grab it just in time to see the skeleton fade from existence.
Balatin despawns*. You receive Robe of the Whistling Fists.
This quest may be able to be MultiQuested.

quests.name: The Lost Map
requiredItems: First part of an Iceclad Map
Second part of an Iceclad Map
Third part of an Iceclad Map
Fourth part of an Iceclad Map
steps: Find the four parts to the map!
First part of an Iceclad Map can be looted from a dire wolf stalker, a rare spawn in Iceclad Ocean.
Second part of an Iceclad Map can be looted from Stormfeather, a rare spawn in Iceclad Ocean.
Third part of an Iceclad Map is obtained through a mini-quest.
Loot four Yakman Parts from tizmaks in Great Divide

Turn in four Parts to Bloodmaw. You need to be non-KoS with Bloodmaw to turn in--Killing Bloodmaw does not work. You CAN use sneak to do the turn in if you are kos, confirmed 6/20/2023, you CAN turn in on a sneakable character and swap to the questing toon. You CANT use the same turn in to get multiple maps, four parts for one map only. NOTE: If Bloodmaw is up and the bloody gnome captive, too, but will not respond as expected, then you can just turn in the four yakman parts to Bloodmaw to re-spawn the bloody gnome captive. He will then respond properly and will despawn upon handing you the t…
Target bloody gnome captive and say, 'I want the map please' (or, for the impatient, 'map') to receive Third part of an Iceclad Map. NOTE: The pirate will attack you if in wolf form!
Fourth part of an Iceclad Map can be looted from Lodizal, a rare spawn in Iceclad Ocean that will require friends to kill.
Talk to a lost pirate in Iceclad Ocean
Say to him 'I will find the parts' to receive a Map Binding, a four-slot container.
Combine the four pieces in the Map Binding to craft Pieces of the Iceclad Map
Give the Pieces of the Iceclad Map to the a lost pirate to receive the Completed Map of Iceclad in return.
A Rabid_snow_cougar will spawn and kill the lost pirate. Kill or avoid the Rabid snow cougar.
Give the Completed Map of Iceclad to Captain Nalot and receive Eyepatch of Plunder

quests.name: The Lost Pet
steps: MUST BE ABOVE DUBIOUS OR HE WILL EAT THE TURN IN!
Noclin Saah may be found at 981.29, -101.52, just to the left as you enter the Paineel newbie yard.
You say, 'Hail, Noclin Saah'
You say, 'What matters of importance?'
You say, 'What reward?'
Kill Noclin`s Pet and loot his Rotting Femur. Give the Rotting Femur to Noclin Saah.
You receive Noclin's Femur!

quests.name: The Lost Tome
steps: You say, 'Hail, a mosscovered treant'
You say, 'What searching?'
You say, 'What knowledge?'
You say, 'What went wrong?'
You say, 'What answer?'
You say, 'I will look.'
You say, 'What journey?'
Bring the treant four tomes (dropped randomly by named wurms in Skyshrine?):
Tome of Elemental Cognizance (confirmed from Jaelk; Lararith)
Tome of Elemental Contemplation (confirmed from Oglard; Ralgyn; Lararith; Jaelk)
Tome of Elemental Thought (confirmed from Jualicn; Ralgyn; Jaelk; Lararith)
Tome of Elemental Understanding (confirmed from Ralgyn; Jaelk)
In exchange, you receive a Chord of Vines.

quests.name: The Lottery Ticket
steps: This is a sub-quest in the Princess Lenya quest, but is nice in its own right. In East Freeport, go into Hallard's Resales (located on the left at the top of the ramp down to the "bad" part of East Freeport) and talk to Tohsan Hallard (Loc: -85, -456).
You say, 'Hail, Tohsan Hallard'
You say, 'What special offer?'
Upon turning in four Orc Pawn Pick:
You also get some coin, and one of 6 "Lottery Ticket # _____" (you can keep turning in Orc Pawn Picks four at a time until you've got all six tickets).
Possible tickets are:
Lottery Ticket # 14001
Lottery Ticket # 14350
Lottery Ticket # 15600
Lottery Ticket # 15601
Lottery Ticket # 15602
Lottery Ticket # 16568
If you head to High Keep, you can learn about the Highpass Hold Lottery from Jail Clerk Meryl.
You say, 'Hail, Jail Clerk Maryl'
You say, 'What highkeep lottery?'
Treasurer Lynn is found nearby:
You say, 'Hail, Treasurer Lynn'
You say, 'What highkeep lottery?'
You say, 'Who was last season's winner?'
(Little does Tohsan Hallard know...)
Treasurer Lynn is a vendor, and thus at worst will con dubious. The turn-in of lottery tickets can be done with dubious faction.
Upon turning in "Lottery Ticket # 14001", "Lottery Ticket # 14350", "Lottery Ticket # 15601", or "Lottery Ticket # 15602":
Upon turning in "Lottery Ticket # 15600" (the runner-up ticket):
You receive ... gold from Treasurer Lynn.
Upon turning in "Lottery Ticket # 16568" (the winning ticket):
You receive Highkeep Royal Suite, a key.

quests.name: The Luck of Allix
steps: Ajrah Leaf
Locate and Kill a kobold shaman around -990.37, -425.06, -83.46
Return to Allix

quests.name: The Mighty Garou
steps: Note: This can not be MultiQuested, if you turn in the items separately (even the same person one after the other) he will eat the quest items.
Balix Misteyes is at /loc 2917, 3218, 215.29.
You say, 'Hail, Balix Misteyes'
You say, 'What Shaman?'
You say, 'Listening to what?'
You say, 'What dangerous creatures?'

Balix Misteyes growls under his breath. 'Most dangerous is the Garou. Evil spirit of the land. It was made from long dead wolf spirits when the tower spread its dark magics through the islands. It preys on the Snowfang. We have tried to hunt it but always it is too strong.'
You say, 'I will hunt it for you.'

The cougar bone is called Bloody Cougar Bone and drops off a named cougar named Midnight. Midnight is black rather than the white of normal snow cougars and is a pretty common spawn around the Tower of Frozen Shadow.
Skin of the Garou can be found on a named spawn named Garou, who appears to be some sort of gnoll effected by lycanthropy.
After handing Balix Misteyes the Skin of the Garou and Bloody Cougar Bone:
You receive Garou Bone Club. There are no faction adjustments for turning in this quest.

quests.name: The Mighty Snowfang Hero
steps: You say, 'Hail, Keref Spiritspear'
You say, 'What vengeful winter?'
You say, 'What new home?'
You say, 'Who is Groumshak?'
To get the spear Keref Spiritspear wants, you need to talk to Grizlin Bloodfang in the Snow Fang camp.
You say, 'What Harpoon?'
You say, 'What Strong Staff?'
You say, 'What Strong Bone?'
You say, 'What Strong Rope?'
The items Grizlin needs are a Strong Staff (Runed Totem Staff), a Strong Bone (Whale Bone), and a Strong Rope (Tinkered Rope).
The Runed Totem Staff drops off gnolls on Antonica.
The Whale Bone is looted off sharks in Cobalt Scar.
For the Tinkered Rope, you must visit Ritap in Icelcad.
You say, 'Hail Ritap'
You say, 'What tinkered rope?'
Give Frost Giant Scout Beard to Ritap.
You say, 'Hail, Grizlin Bloodfang'

Grizlin Bloodfang says, 'Lo outlander. Grizlin weaponsmaker for tribe. Make mighty blade from bone. Very important now.. need make many spear for hunter. Not make spear, then hunter not bring meat. Now my friend Keref sad, his pack gone north and Keref alone. Want to find way to help Keref but must make weapon for tribe. Maybe you go find what Keref need to make happy?'
Give the rope, bone, and staff to Grizlin Bloodfang.
He may or may not at this point decide to attack you.
Bring the spear to Keref Spiritspear.
You receive an Icy Totem of Protection as your reward. As was the case with Grizlin, Keref may get upset and attack you, so be prepared.

quests.name: The Mudtoes
steps: You say, 'Hail, Furtog Ogrebane'
You say, 'Who are the Mudtoes?'
You say, 'Trondle?'
You say, 'I will go searching for the Mudtoes.'
Find Glorin Binfurr at the end of the docks in Butcherblock (/loc 1360, 3263).
You say, 'What of the Mudtoes?'
The two remaining Mudtoes, Boog and Goob, are in the Ocean of Tears. You will find one named Boog Mudtoe on the island right across from the all girl island of Erollisi (/loc of Boog 1008, -8022).

You kill him and get his head and a note that is to his brother (A tattered note). His brother is on the island with Gornit the Giant (/loc 900, -6573). He is a shaman and casts root a lot, so you have to be careful attacking him.
Take their heads back to Furtog for a decent item (sometimes an Ogre War Maul) and the Trumpy Irontoe quest.
Need missing dialogues, current faction hits if any, /loc of quest mobs, additional rewards if any.

quests.name: The Mystic Cloak
steps: A minimum faction level is required with Keepers of the Art to interact with Linara Parlone and Tolkar Parlone (please confirm what faction is required). Use of charm or sneak might prove useful to bypass this requirement. Otherwise, use the Bat Wings quest to raise the faction.
You say, 'Hail, Tolkar Parlone'
You say, 'Who is your daughter?'
You say, 'Where is she adventuring?'
Go to Unrest and kill the Priest of Najena in the southwest tower on the 3rd floor and get a Tarnished Bronze Key.

In Najena, kill ogres or Moosh for a Guard's Keyring to access Linara Parlone's cell, or drop in through the correct pit trap. If you choose the wrong pit trap, kill Moosh for the key to escape the other cell.
[NOTE: Feign Death turn ins do NOT work.](Can charm Linara for turn-in.).
Additional Note: Was able to turn the key in to Linara at Dubious as a Dark Elf.
Give Tarnished Bronze Key to Linara Parlone in jail cell in Najena, for A Sealed Letter. Then give the A Sealed Letter to her father in Felwithe near the lake.
You hand the letter to Tolkar Parlone:
You receive a Faded Cloak.
Give it to Trilani Parlone in the Enchanter Guild of Erudin:
You receive the Mystic Cloak.

quests.name: The New Worker
steps: Have amiable faction, this can happen either via Puppet Strings, bard, necro, or enchanter charm, or questing Protect the Shipyard to up faction
Buy and bring a Jade
Charm an undead foreman with Puppet Strings, charm spell, etc. or if you're amiable by questing you're good then IMMEDIATELY give him the Jade (the charm may not last long)

quests.name: The Nitrates and the Assassin
steps: Gerael Woodone may be found at -180, -395.
You say, 'Hail, Gerael Woodone'
You say, 'I will deliver a flask.'
You receive a Flask of Nitrates. Linaya Sowlin may be found at -3745, -7655 in Western Karana, in a farmhouse. Give her the flask.
You say, 'What note?'
You say, 'What Unkempt Druids?'
Draze Slashyn spawns outside, probably triggered by the flask turn-in rather than the optional dialogue interactions after:
Need fight info for Draze Slashyn. On his death:
You have slain Draze Slashyn!
--You have looted a A Tattered Cloth Note.--
--You have looted a Rusty Axe.--
--You have looted a Human Blood.--
The note identifies as "Contract on Gash," and reads:
To all Unkempt Druids, Jale Phlintoes calls upon you to seek out the Surefall Ambassador to Qeynos. His name is Gash Flockwalker. Reward upon delivery of his head. Long live the green!!
Give the note to Gerael Woodone.
You receive a different version of A Tattered Cloth Note back, which identifies as "Returned Contract on Gash," and which reads the same as the first note.
You say, 'Who is Jale Phlintoes?'
You say, 'Who are the Unkempt Druids?'
Captain Tillin may be found in South Qeynos overlooking the the arena from the balcony at +40, -510. Give him the note.
You receive 6 platinum, 5 gold, 3 silver, 5 copper pieces.

Gash Flockwalker is inside the inn at +370, -85, inside a room. Go through the main entrance of the inn, turn right, and then left when you see Sissy Huntlan, General Supply vendor. Take another immediate left turn before you enter the hallway and you'll run into the merchant's front desk (Tasla Huntlan, general supply vendor). Take the hallway to your right until you see a wanted poster with a face on it. He is behind the door to the right of that poster (your right if you are looking at the poster).
You may warn Gash as the Captain has instructed, though it is optional:
You say, 'An assassin has been sent to kill you.'
You say, 'What black wood chip?'

Speaking with Gash is not requiired, as Raffel Minnmorn spawns at the North Qeynos zone north of the Bard's guild, The Wind Spirit's Song, after giving Captain Tillin the note. You can run directly to him and kill him, but if you let him proceed, he is seen trying to get information on Gash:
You say, 'Hail, Raffel Minnmorn'
You say, 'Who is Gash Flockwalker?'
You say, 'What special delivery?'
He attacks, casting druid spells.
You have slain Raffel Minnmorn!
Raffel Minnmorn's corpse. Long live the green.
--You have looted a Rusty Dagger.--
--You have looted a Black Wood Chip.--
Give the Black Wood Chip to Gerael Woodone.
You receive 2 gold from Gerael Woodone.
The various steps of this quest have both positive and negative adjustments to QRG Protected Animals, but overall it grants +8 faction.

quests.name: The Orc Impaler
steps: This initiates with Morin in Kithicor after you do the short sword of Morin quest, but most of the quest takes place in Lesser Faydark.
Find Bryn Fynndel (Wood Elf Camp in LFay) and say the following:
You say, 'Morin sent me"
You say, 'How are the shadowed men involved?'

The Shadowman Leader spawns along the north wall in Lesser Faydark around 1800, -400. He's high 30's and has a 25 min placeholder, so it may be a long camp. Kill him and he sometimes drops a Shadowed Code Book, which you need to return to Bryn.
When you give him the book, Glidara Myllar spawns by the undead marker.
Give Glidara Myllar the note from Bryn. She gives you :Glidara's Ring which you will need to return along with the :Ghoul Boss' Log Book
The ghoul boss is a rare spawn at the Undead Marker (43, 2261) in the place of a Skeleton (despite being called a ghoul, he looks like a skeleton). He's mid 30's. Kill him and he drops the book.
Hand Ring and Book to Glidara Myllar
You Receive Sealed Ghoul Boss' Log Book
Give "sealed Ghoul Boss' Log Book" to Morin
You receive Orders for Bryn
Give :Orders for Bryn to Bryn
Receive Orc Impaler

A shortcut to do this is to kill the ghoul boss first, then go after the Shadowman Leader. Then turn in the Leader's Code Book to Bryn, get the ring from Glidara Myllar, and promptly return it with the Ghoul Boss's Logbook.

quests.name: The Package
steps: This quest is initiated by talking to Ghil Starn in the Qeynos Thieves' Guild.
Ghil needs you to deliver a package to Den Magason, who is usually at the docks or in Mermaid's Lure. After giving you the package, he asks that you help Den in anyway possible.
Successfully delivering the package results in the following faction:
Den gives you the task of collecting some items for him. He is in need of:
Snake Scales
High Quality Bear Skin
High Quality Wolf Skin
Bat Fur
When these items are returned, the same factions get hit, and a little gold is received. He then gives you a note to return to Ghil. Returning this note gives the faction:
You get some more cash, and a nice set of gloves (AC 1, +3 dex).

quests.name: The Painting
steps: Danaria Hollin can be found roaming the dock area of South Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Danaria Hollin'
You say, 'What delivery?'
You say, 'I will find him'
Head to East Freeport and find Palatos Kynarn. He's located in the shady part of town.
You say, 'Hail, Palatos Kynarn'
You say, 'Danaria sent me'
The 'captain' he speaks of is an alcoholic beverage, Capt. Orlin's Spiced Ale. This can be purchased from the bartender right next to you, Nesin Tapper.
Upon handing Palatos four drinks:
(This step can be repeated to easily raise Craftkeepers and Erudin city factions. Palatos Kynarn is on Craftkeepers so he can be /considered to test it.)
Receive a Beacon Mount. In his drunkedness, Palatos advises you to seek out Svinal Wyspin, a Gnome merchant in the Emporium in West Freeport, at -250, -30.
You say, 'Hail, Svinal Wyspin'
You say, 'Tell me about the boat beacon'
Buy the Metal Disk and Copper Band. You'll also need a Greater Lightstone. Combine those three items and the Beacon Mount in a Forge (reported trivial 70) to create a Boat Beacon.

You can do one of two things with this Boat Beacon. Turn it in to Palatos Kynarn, or to Lenka Stoutheart (found occasionally in the Grub 'n Grog Tavern at the Freeport dock). Upon turning it into Palatos, the quest is over.

Upon turning it into Lenka Stoutheart, you receive positive Halas faction and a portrait of King Ak'Anon. Note: standing next to Lenka is Bronto Thudfoot, an Ogre on Wolves of the North faction who is KoS to both wolf form and earth elemental illusion. This greatly complicates doing this quest as an evil character looking to improve Barbarian faction.

quests.name: The Penance
steps: This quest lets you get back your newbie robe/weapon in case you lost it so that you can do the quests that require it. Hail your Guild Master to start the quest. Each class starts a little different, but the phrases are pretty obvious ("I do not have my _____"). Once you get to the toilmaster, the path is the same.
Squire Gristle is for shadow knights
Master Niska for monks
Hierophant Zand for shamans
Nihilist Zeegarn for necros
As an example, here is the necromancer version:
You say, 'Hail Nihilist Zeegarn'
You say, I do not have my drape of the brood'
Toilmaster:
This part is the same for everyone.
Then you get Ragged Book. Read it (it is quite interesting). Then go to East Cabilis and find the Toilmaster. Give him A Ragged Book and...
Read the book he gives you titled Rites of Exoneration, it tells you to ask him for the hammer and a bag.
You say, 'Hail The Toilmaster'
You say, 'I need the Hammer of Exoneration'
(The Toilmaster hands you the Hammer of Exoneration, 4/60, effect: Bone Shatter, wt. 25.0. You have to make this thing proc 56 times.)
You say, 'I need the bag'
(Hands you an 8 slot bag, that you will put 7 Bone dusts in, and 1 Flask of Bloodwater.)
Next you go back to West Cabilis, in the building near the necro guild on the wall, there's a mortician. He's a skelly, but he won't hurt you.
You say, 'Hail a mortician'
You say, 'I desire a mortar and pestle'
You receive Grotesque Mortar and Pestle.

This is what you combine the Bone Fragments in that you get. It's an 8 slot container. Here's the part where it gets BORING. I went to LoIO, there's lots of mobs there that you can fight for a long time without causing too much harm. If you get low on life, cast leach or something. Bloodmaw in the Great Divide is the perfect mob to proc on.
Final combine:

When you do get 8 Bone Fragments, you combine them in the mortar and pestle and you get a white Powdered Bone. Put that in the Penance Bag. You need 7 of them. When you have 7 Powdered Bones, put one Flask of Bloodwater in there and press Combine to yield a Filled Penance Bag. Then turn that Bag and the Rites of Exoneration book you have into the Quest Giver.
Necromancer final hand-in:
Shadow Knight final hand-in:
Hand the book and Filled bag to Squire Gristle.
Monk final hand-in:
Hand the book and Filled bag to Master Niska.

quests.name: The Power of the Gatecallers
steps: Vasile Jahnir is located at +720, +900 in the Tower of The Gatecallers[Blue Side] in Erudin Palace.
You say, 'Hail, Vasile Jahnir'

Hand in 2 x Summoned: Dagger and 2 x Summoned: Black Bread.

quests.name: The Rat King
steps: You say, 'Hail, Wolten Grafe'
You say, 'I wish to join the cause'
You say, 'I will seek out the rat king'
You say, 'I will hunt the rat king'

In the aqueducts, you will find an NPC named Beggar Wyllin surrounded by four rats near the smugglers. Kill him and loot his Human Head. He also drops A Tattered Cloth Note for which there is no known use.
You give the human head to Wolten.
Note: Upon handing him the note Wyllin drops, he eats it.
Quest is able to be completed by dubious con.

[https://everquest.allakhazam.com/db/quest.html?quest=1223] [https://web.archive.org/web/20050507011032/http://eqbeastiary.allakhazam.com/search.shtml?id=6613]

quests.name: The Regurgitonic
steps: Kimble Nogflop of Ak'Anon will give you a Regurgitonic, but requires a Flask of Nitrates first.
Find Te`Anara in Surefall Glades at location -202, -423, 5.
You say, 'Hail, Te`Anara'
You say, 'What are the laws of the Jaggedpine?'
You say, 'Who is the great bear?'
You say, 'What is wrong with Mammoth?'
You say, 'I will fetch a special potion'
You receive Flask of Nitrates.
Head to Ak'Anon, and once there find Kimble Nogflop at location 1329, -808, -61 (one floor below the tiger in the zoo). Hand him the Flask of Nitrates.

If you choose to give the regurgitonic to Mammoth and give the Bayle List II to Te'Anara
You receive Spell: Invigor.

quests.name: The Restraining Order
steps: During daytime, inside of the Tink 'N Babble on the second floor will be found a city clerk by the name of Clerk Doval (881, -75, 18).
You say, 'Hail, Clerk Doval'
You say, 'What proposition?'
You say, 'I can deliver the restraining order.'

Once you agree, he hands you a letter (Legion Order) which must be signed by all ten troopers, in alphabetical order. Find each trooper and give them the restraining order. Each will sign the order, and return it to you, though some require sub-tasks to get them to sign. Once you have finished this task, return to the Tink 'N Babble and give the finished order to Doval.
The troopers' names and what they want to sign are (in alphabetical order):
Trooper Frogzin (found at the Lake of Ill Omen, at the city gate -- will just sign it),
Trooper Fryp (found at the entrance to the warriors' guild -- needs a Quill),
Trooper Gummin (Field of Bones in left ruined building -- Needs the order and a Legion Lager brewed)
Trooper Inkin (found at the Swamp of No Hope, at the city gate -- Needs a Skipping Stone from a froglok skipper)
Trooper Nishnish (found at the gate to the Swamp of No Hope, in Cabilis -- Needs two Barracuda Teeth from pygmy barracuda/barracuda in Cabilis waterways)
Trooper Ogmire (found at the gate to the Lake of Ill Omen, in Cabilis -- will just sign it)
Trooper Ozlot (found next to the gate to Warslik's Wood -- Needs two Sabertooth Kitten Canines (not cub) from the Lake of Ill Omen)
Trooper Roklon (found outside gates in Warslik's Woods -- Needs Goblin Scout Beads from the Lake of Ill Omen)
Trooper Selbat (found AT NIGHT in a building in the Lake of Ill Omen, near the city gate -- will just sign it)
Trooper Taer (found wandering the Field of Bone, he stops at the city gate occasionally -- will just sign it).
When you turn in the fully signed order to Clerk Doval:
You receive ~17 silver, 4 copper pieces.
Note that you can also sometimes loot a completely signed legion order from frogloks in the swamp.
Return the list and you get a small amount of experience, some coin, and a random book from his library (the book you get may be specific to your class).
Books given out so far are:
The Code of Combat,
The History of Combat,
The Tome of Combat,
The Book of Knowledge.
Presumably there is more after this.
Need all dialogues, faction hits, rewards, list of quest items, /loc of quest mobs, additional steps, etc.

quests.name: The Rogue Take
steps: Eolorn J`Axx is a Rogue Guildmaster in the Rogue guild in Neriak Third Gate (630,-1308).
You say, 'Hail, Eolorn J`Axx'
You say, 'What foreign take?'
You say, 'I will retrieve the chest.'
You receive a Sealed Letter (identifies as "Letter To Giz") which reads:
Giz Dinree. Freeport. My love, I have sent this young recruit to deliver the shipment to me. I believe he can be trusted. Please allow him to take the chest. E.J. xintldl ii
Eolorn wants you to find Giz Dinree in East Freeport. I found her at -367, -1095. She spawns at night - during the day, an NPC named Bait Masterson occupies her space; he is KOS to evil races.

Once you find Giz, she tells you that the loot is in a strongbox, and that the last courier was killed by sharks before he could deliver it. If you swim off shore a little (mind the shark guarding it) you will find a groundspawn named A Locked Chest (Loc: -406, -1150). Pick the chest up and bring it back to Eolorn for some coin and a minor item.

quests.name: The Seax
steps: Lysbith McNaff may be found at (553, -414) in the Pit o Doom of Halas.
You say, 'Hail, Lysbith McNaff'
You say, 'I serve Halas'
You say, 'What orc troopers?'
You say, 'What Seax?'
After handing in four Wrath Orc Wristbands:
You receive Seax, a piercing weapon usable by Rogues.

quests.name: The Second Arcane Test
steps: You say, 'Hail, Gozzrem'

quests.name: The Spirit of Garzicor
steps: Please read walkthrough below this checklist carefully to prevent mishaps. It is recommended to have 210 Blacksmithing/128 Pottery
Smith Finished Naginata Blade - Be prepared to redo this section if a combine fails
Thurgadin: Hail Loremaster Sarl, start dialogue then meet him in library, and hand him 50pp to receive Worn Coldain Tome
Crystal Caverns: Hand in Worn Coldain Tome to Historian Baenek to spawn the Ghost of Burdael (DESPAWNS IN 5 MINUTES), kill and loot Onyxbrand
Skyshrine: Hail Oglard, hand him Onyxbrand to receive Dragon Crafted Urn (2-slot container) Requires Ally faction.

Dragon Necropolis: Run to exactly, say "Remember, Garzicor", wait 95 seconds, pick up two ground spawns (Dragonwing Skin and Dragonbone Dust TEMPORARY ITEMS), put inside Dragon Crafted Urn (2-slot container) and click combine for a new Dragon Crafted Urn (v1) that fits in bags
Skyshrine: Hail Oglard, hand him Dragon Crafted Urn (v1) to receive a different version of Dragon Crafted Urn (v2)
Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Dragon Crafted Urn (v2) to receive a book (The Blade) and Sanctified bone dust
The Overthere: Kill a Cliff Golem and loot Starmetal Ore
Smith 173: Combine Starmetal Ore into two Portion of Starmetal
Smith 171: Combine Portion of Starmetal + Sanctified bone dust into Dusted Starmetal Block and Remaining Bone dust, then smith Block x5 to create Shaped blade core
Smith 171: Combine Portion of Starmetal + Remaining Bone dust into Dusted Starmetal Block, then smith x10 to create Blade skin-10th fold
Smith 206: Combine Shaped blade core + Blade skin-10th fold to create Complete raw blade
Smith 188: Combine Complete raw blade + Forging Hammer to create Complete shaped blade
Pottery! 128: Combine Complete shaped blade + Clay/water mixture to create Clay coated blade
Frontier Mountains: Run to -260, -300 and pick up ground spawn Gray Colored Ice
Smith 199-200: Combine Clay coated blade + Gray Colored Ice to create Finished Naginata Blade
Obtain Bronzewood Staff
Burning Woods: Kill Carpenter Grundo and loot Bronzewood Staff
Obtain Finished Tsuba
Kael Drakkel: Kill Armor of Zek and loot Chunk of Chronium Ore
Smith: Combine Chunk of Chronium Ore into Chronium Plate (Trivial <157)
Howling Stones: pick up ground spawn Mandala sketch off table in the East Wing (+140,-510)
Paineel: Hail Taralani Rahnta and hand him 1000pp to receive Kejekan Tool Kit
The Warrens: Hail Koajin, hand him Mandala sketch + Kejekan Tool Kit + Chronium Plate to receive Finished Tsuba
Hand in Finished Naginata Blade + Bronzewood Staff + Finished Tsuba
Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Finished Naginata Blade + Bronzewood Staff + Finished Tsuba to receive Assembled Naginata + Vial of Kromzek blood
Raid Garzicor's Wraith
Obtain 2x Flawless Diamond

Dragon Necropolis: Run to +1523, +1109 exactly, say "you are one but two. your vengeance shall find a home." to spawn a Ghostly Presence at +1523, +1109 (Stays up for 60 Seconds and then depops, respawn timer is 1 hour). Make sure to have 2 spaces between those two sentences; if you copy and paste from here you may need to add a space. Use say, not ooc, to trigger the spawn.
Dragon Necropolis: Hail a Ghostly Presence, hand him Vial of Kromzek blood to spawn Garzicor's Corpse at +1523, +1109
Dragon Necropolis: Kill Garzicor's Corpse to spawn Garzicor's Wraith at +1523, +1109

Dragon Necropolis: Kill Garzicor's Wraith (raid target) to spawn translucent dragon (v1) on CoV faction at +1523, +1000 and translucent dragon (v2) on CoV faction at +1500, +800 (Stays up Approx 15 Mins before despawning)
Dragon Necropolis: Hail a translucent dragon (v1), hand him Flawless Diamond to receive Blackened Diamond
Dragon Necropolis: Hail a translucent dragon (v2), hand him Flawless Diamond to receive Gold Tinted Diamond
Final Smithing Combine
Smith 160: Combine Assembled Naginata + Blackened Diamond + Gold Tinted Diamond to receive Ethereal Bladed Naginata
Final Hand-in
THIS IS NOT A ROUND ROBIN TURN IN. IF YOU TURN IN AND YOU MISS YOUR ITEM, MUST COMPLETELY REDO THE QUEST
Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Ethereal Bladed Naginata to receive Ethereal Bladed Naginata back plus faction and experience (WAR PAL RNG SHD)
Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Ethereal Bladed Naginata to receive Sanctum Guardian's Earring (CLR DRU MNK SHM)
Skyshrine: Hail Eldriaks Fe`Dhar, hand him Sanctum Guardian's Earring to receive Pitted Iron Ring (NEC WIZ MAG ENC)

quests.name: The Supply Run - Eastern Wastes
steps: Svekk Fangbinder is a Merchant who can be found in the hall with lesser nobles, diagonally opposite the bank.
You say, 'hail Svekk Fangbinder'
You say, 'what supplies'
You say, 'what giants'
You say, 'what eastern wastes'
Give 500gp to Svekk and you will receive a Giant Sack of Supplies.
Fjloaren (at the Giant Fort loc: -1500, 3000ish) will give you a Velium Torque to return to Svekk, who will rewards you with approximately 100gp and faction for completing the mission.

quests.name: The Supply Run - Great Divide
steps: You say, 'Hail, Svekk Fangbinder'
You say, 'What supplies?'
You say, 'What giants?'
You say, 'What great divide?'
Need all dialogues, faction hits.
50pp will buy a "Giant Sack of Supplies"

Bekerak (at the Giant Fort loc: -3011, -2766ish) gives you a note for Svekk, who gives you a Voucher tells you upon return that he needs a Klezendian Crystal (uncommon drop from random orcs or geonids in the Crystal Caverns). When you return the voucher and crystal, Svekk gives you a Large Supply Sack for Bekerak.
Upon delivery to Bekerak you receive the Kromrif Battle Totem.

quests.name: The Supply Run - Wakening Land
steps: This seems to be a broken quest with no reward.
You say, 'hail Svekk Fangbinder'
You say, 'what supplies'
You say, 'what giants'
You say, 'what wakening land'
Give 500 gold pieces to Svekk Fangbinder.
Svekk Fangbinder regards you as an ally -- looks like quite a gamble.
Svekk Fangbinder heaves a large pack from a pile in the corner and sets it before you. 'I wish you luck in your endeavor, Iksar.'
You receive a Giant Sack of Supplies. Travel to Wakening Land and follow the eastern wall south a bit to a ruined building where you'll find Korzak Stonehammer at (-1377, -4426).
You say, 'Hail, Korzak Stonehammer'
(no response)
Upon handing Korzak a Giant Sack of Supplies:

Korzak Stonehammer says, 'It's about time the supplies got here. Not like it's a long trip from the center of Kael to us out here. Payment? I already paid Wenglawks for the supplies I ordered. Don't give me any trouble, little one. I have enough trouble with the missing helmets.'
No item is returned for this hand-in.
You say, 'what helmets'

Korzak Stonehammer says, 'Recently helmets have been stolen from our workers. One of them reported seeing one of those wreched flying monkey beasts carry one off. Having those helmets back would be very useful. If you come across any of the workers helmets, return them to me and I will bestow a reward totem upon you.'
More information is required. What holgresh need to be killed, and where? What helmets do they drop? What is the reward? Perhaps it's the same reward as another supply quest, Kromrif Battle Totem

quests.name: The Sword of Nobility
steps: OPTIONAL: The Notes (see below)
Talk to Ryshon Hunsti to obtain Note to Kanthuk
Trade the Note to Kanthuk Ogrebane
Talk to Kanthuk to receive A Pendant
Trade the Pendant to Llara
Talk to Llara to receive Note to Ruathey
Trade the Note to Ruathey
Ask Ruathey, "What bag" to receive a Nobleman's Bag
Components
Obtain Amstaf's Scroll from High Keep goblins
Obtain Blade of Nobility from Butcherblock Mountains A crazed goblin (Butcherblock)
Obtain A Ghoul's Heart from Unrest ghouls
Obtain Hilt of the Nobleman from Najena skeletons
Combine Scroll, Blade, Heart, Hilt in Nobleman's Bag to receive Ghoulbane sword

quests.name: The Tattered Pouch
steps: Your Location is -345.80, 36.39, -13.27
Raz The Rat Misk looks your way apprehensively -- You could probably win this fight.
You say, 'Hail, Raz The Rat Misk'
Give him 3 gold.
You say, 'What favor?'
Give him 5 gold.
You receive A Tattered Leather Pouch.
Raz The Rat Misk looks your way apprehensively -- You could probably win this fight.
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered North Qeynos.
Your Location is 91.57, 359.40, 3.75
Crow looks your way apprehensively -- what would you like your tombstone to say?
You say, 'Hail, Crow'
Crow says 'Welcome to Crow's! If you're thirsty, we have a fine selection of brews and ales.'
Give him the pouch.
You receive 3-5 gold from Crow.
You receive Crow's Special Brew, which is not to be confused with Crows Special Brew (without an apostrophe), which may be purchased from Crow.

quests.name: The Telescope
steps: At the observatory past the windmills in the Steamfonts a female gnome name Brona Frugrin is a telescope lens crafter and she believes that if you can get the retina of the beholder named Borxx, who may be found in either Runnyeye or Beholder at certain times, and return it to her, she can create a telescope unlike any other.
Borxx is a L30 Evil Eye-type monster. Bringing back his loot, the evil eye lens, will yield a 2h blunt weapon called the Staff of the Observers.

quests.name: The Test of the Green and Blue
quests.page: The Test of the Green and Blue
steps: Cain Darkmoore is at location 662, -675 in East Freeport.
You say, 'Hail, Cain Darkmoore'
You say, 'What Clan Deathfist?'
You say, 'What is the green and blue?'
You say, 'what bunker battle blade?"

quests.name: The Tome Raider
steps: The tortured librarian can be found in the library in Kaesora. He is on Brood of Kotiz (Iksar Necro) faction.
You say, 'Hail, tortured librarian'
tortured librarian says 'Bring to me that which was taken.'

Go to the Emerald Jungle and clear the northwest area (top side of the cliff) of mobs. You'll eventually find an iksar tomb raider. Spawn point is likely (1914, 2682) without a placeholder. He paths northwest upon spawning. He is approximately 33-35th level and is a rare spawn.

He always drops a book, which can be one of several Iksar history books. The common drops are the same books as sold in Cabilis. His uncommon drop is a TEMPORARY version of Venril the Chief (tradeable). This is similar to the ones sold in stores in that it covers the rise of Venril Sathir and his creation of an Iksar Empire.

Once you have that book, you bring an Emerald to Dom K`Perl in the Dark Elf outpost of The Overthere. Handing it to him will result in a tradeable TEMPORARY book called Before Green. If you are Kill on sight at the outpost and worried about being attacked by guards, you can have someone hand in the Emerald and trade the book back to you.
Take the two TEMPORARY books and head back to Kaesora's library. If the tortured librarian is not there then clear the libary of MOBs until he appears. He will despawn after a while.
Hand him the two books and it will result in:
tortured librarian fades out of existence. The air smells of death. Something has appeared in your hand.
The result is a Large Tassel Bookmark which identifies as a 'Tassel of Flaxen Cord', required for the Necromancer 8th Rank Skullcap Quest in Cabilis West.

quests.name: The Torn Pouch
steps: Note: Indifferent faction required to do this quest.
Toelia Snuckery is located at -37, -197 on the second floor of the Fool's Gold in Rivervale.
You say, 'Hail, Toelia Snuckery'
You say, 'I am the new dishwasher.'
A Torn Old Pouch spawns at 90, -356 at the bottom of the lake in Rivervale.
Hand Toelia Snuckery the Torn Old Pouch.
You receive ~4 copper from Toelia Snuckery.
You say, 'Who is Chomper?'
You have slain Chomper. You have looted a Large Ruby.
Hand Toelia Snuckery the Large Ruby.
You receive ~4 copper from Toelia Snuckery.

quests.name: The Torrid Corruptor
steps: Suggested tasks to complete first:
Obtain a SoulFire via the Zimel's Blades (SoulFire) quest
Obtain a Dark Reaver from A ghoul cavalier in Lower Guk
Get Bloodsabers faction Kindly or higher - there are few ways to do this.
Get Heretics faction Warmly or higher - Kill Kobolds in The Warrens
Get Dismal Rage faction Kindly or higher - Do Assist the Great Xelha quest in East Freeport (requires about 1000 bone chips to turn-ins)
Slay Brother Hayle in Splitpaw Lair prison area - cell doors open via switches !
Loot and right-click on Burning Soul of the Pious
Find Lord Grimrot in Southern Karana - MUST BE LIVING VERSION!
Give Lord Grimrot Dark Reaver and right-clicked Burning Soul of the Pious - requires Bloodsabers Kindly faction !
Right-click the Burning Soul of the Pious he hands you back - make sure it does not have any text in the chat window; if it does, your turn-in did not work (probably due to faction) !
Kill Lord Grimrot
Loot Pestilence Scythe - the one with charges; the other one doesn't matter for this quest .
Find Jotayi Ibupran in Paineel (Necromancer Guild balcony)
Give Jotayi Ibupran Pestilence Scythe (the one with charges) and Burning Soul of the Pestilent - requires Heretics Warmly Faction !
Find Dason Goldblade in Plane of Sky Efreeti Chamber (quest room) - MAKE SURE YOU ARE KEYED UP TO ISLAND 4 BEFORE SEEKING HIM OUT !
Give Dason Goldblade 500pp to spawn Inte Akera inside the Windmill on Island 4 - be quick, he will eventually despawn .
Kill Inte Akera and loot the Burning Soul of the Virtuous. Note: If you are in a group, the soul is linked to whoever turns in the 500 platinum to spawn Inte.
Find Luxio Nulsis in East Freeport (Shadowknight spell vendor basement area)
Give Luxio Nulsis the three Souls and Soulfire - Requires Dismal Rage Kindly faction !

quests.name: The Traitor
steps: Upon giving Sir Lucan D`lere the note during the Message Intercept Quest.
The traitor's name is Guard Alayle, and he is in the Freeport Militia House's backyard, underneath the deck. You may have to kill him several times before he will give you a tunic.
Return the Slashed Militia Tunic to D'Lere. Dubious faction was sufficient for this turn-in.
You receive 7 gold from Sir Lucan D`Lere.

quests.name: The Treant Fists
steps: 1. Say, "I am a monk of great skill to Puab Closk in West Freeport to receive Puab's Token.
2. Give Puab's Token to a banished kerran in Kerra Isle to receive Box With Pawprints.
3. Kill a goblin alchemist that spawns in Misty Thicket for Ribcage Chest Armor.
4. Kill a goblin alchemist to get the Humerus Handled Mace in the Gorge of King Xorbb.
5. Kill A Pickclaw Mindripper to get the Cat Skull Cap in RunnyEye Citadel.
6. Kill A Pickclaw bonemender to get the Fractured Femur in RunnyEye Citadel.
7. Combine the items in the box to get A Box of Cat Bones.
8. Hand A Box of Cat Bones to a banished kerran to receive Tattered Parchment.
9. Bring Tattered Parchment to Puab Closk for your Treant Fists.
In the guild house of the Ashen Order, Puab Closk has a task for you.
He is located in the top of the guild house.
You say, 'Hail, Puab Closk'

Puab Closk says, 'Greetings, I am Puab Closk, Master of the Ashen Order. Our home is your home, friend. Feel free to stay as long as you like. Learn our ways as many have done in the past. To fight like the tiger and strike like the cobra are your goals. Cough- [treant fist] -Cough!'
You say, 'What treant fist'
Puab Closk says, 'I have these items, and will gift them to any [monk of great skill]'
You say, 'I am monk of great skill'

Puab Closk says, 'Then you shall aid our family. My former pupil [Clawfist] has been banished by his people. You will go to him and hand him this token as proof of your origin. He shall be expecting you.'
Puab Closk hands you Puab's Token.
You say, 'Who is Clawfist'
Puab Closk says, 'Clawfist is a Kerran, a catman. He braved the dangers of Norrath to reach the Ashen Order. He sought knowledge of our disiples [sic]. He learned well.'
Clawfist is actually a Kerran named a banished kerran in Kerra Isle. He is in the basement of the temple, (behind the throne and down a ramp.)
You say, 'Hail, a banished kerran'
a banished kerran says, 'Rrrrrr.. Away frrrom this isle of death and.. prrrr.. punishment.'
You say, 'Puab sent me'
a banished kerran says, 'Prrr.. Master Puab? Show me prrroof.'
Hand him your Puab's Token.

a banished kerran says, 'Ashen Order!! Prrr.. My order. I have been expecting one of us. Prrr.. Help me rejoin my native land. Return the [remains of Thipt] to me. This shall aid me in my redemption.'
He hands youa Box With Pawprints (a 4 slot combine box).

a banished kerran says, 'Clawknight Thipt wished to learn the ways of Ashen. Prrr. Together we go into green Goblin's lair to train. Prrr.. We find too many and he is too weak. Seperated and unable to find him, I hear his death cry. Prr.. I cannot make it back, the eyes are upon me. Now I must find one sent by Ashen to aid in the recoverrry of his remains - his Humorous Handled Mace, Ribcage Breastplate, Cat Skullcap and Fractured Femur Bone'

The Humerus Handled Mace is found on a goblin alchemist in the Gorge of King Xorbb. The spawn point (loc 705, -1794) is at the fork in the gorge directly outside the entrance to Runnyeye. The placeholder is a goblin lookout, a goblin sentry, or a goblin veteran. However, there are two identical spawn cycles at this loc with different timers; 72 minutes and 6 minutes. Both spawns can be up at the same time. The alchemist is a random spawn on the 72 minute respawn timer. -- These are the easy but frustrating two to get. Both goblin alchemists seem to be about 18-19th level, and while they can b…

The Ribcage Breastplate is Ribcage Chest Armor, which may be found on a goblin alchemist that spawns in Misty Thicket. The spawn rate varies: he has been hunted for 6 hours and never appeared, and then popped up twice in an hour on another day. The camp he spawns at is the southern goblin camp from the entrance to Runnyeye, and the placeholder spawn seems to be Mooto, a goblin shaman and/or a goblin warrior. Seven-minute respawn time on the placeholder at loc -885.42, 1114.96.
The Cat Skull Cap now drops off A Pickclaw Mindripper in RunnyEye Citadel.
The Fractured Femur now drops off A Pickclaw bonemender in RunnyEye Citadel.
Once you have all 4 items, place them in the Box With Pawprints and combine. You'll be rewarded with A Box of Cat Bones. Take this back to Kerra and hand it into the banished kerran, Clawfist.

a banished kerran says, 'Prrr.. Thank you brother of Ashen. I can now spend my time upon this island in peace, until my penance is serrrved. He dabs his paw into the mud and places it upon a tattered parchment. Take this message to Puab. Farrrwell.'
He hands you a Tattered Parchment.
