quests.name: The Velium Focus
steps: Thurgadin
Deep in the bottom of the mines in Thurgadin resides a Coldain named Normon Stonetooth. Talking to him he offers to tell you a secret but he needs a favor done first.
You say, 'I will do a favor'
You receive Normon's axe from Normon.
Hakon is located at Scar's Edge, a weapon shop.
You say, 'Stonetooth sent me'
You give Hakon the Pick Axe and a Small Piece of Velium:
You receive Pick Axe from Hakon.
Go back into the mines and return the pick axe to Normon:
You receive a Velium Focus from Normon.
Wakening Land

You bring the focus item to Phenocryst, a named geonid in Wakening Land at -3210, -397 inside a maze of caves. You can hail him and such, the geonids conning indifferent to everybody as far as I can tell.

You hail Phenocryst. Phenocryst speaks with a soundless voice, as if you are hearing your own thoughts. 'We sense you are attempting communication with us but do not understand what it is you are trying to convey. We are eager to know more. Perhaps there is one who knows the language of the stone and will speak with us'
Then you give him the Velium Focus.

Phenocryst speaks to you from within your mind, 'You know the stone! This is wonderful! The fullfillment of the prophecy is now one step closer. The most ancient of the stone tells us that one not of stone will come forth and act as our harbringer of asscention. We believe you to be our harbringer. Please help us!'
You reply, "how can I help you?"

Phenocryst speaks from within your mind as well as conveys a sense of joy empathically. 'It is said that the harbringer will find all of our people and unite them. When we join we will know all of our experiences and perhaps then be aware of how to proceed with the next step in our asscention. We implore you to find others like us and make them aware of us. You know the language of the stone and can tell them. We await your return with proof that you have spoken to them."
Crystal Caverns

Now you have to go to Crystal Caverns. If you invis up and head down into the caverns, you'll pass through an orc area, then a dwarf area, then a tentacle terror and spiders area, and finally there's a long stretch of tunnel leading up to a zone out point. That long stretch of tunnel is filled with geonids and they con the same as the ones in Wakening Land. Give one of them the focus (any one, doesn't matter, you don't have to hail them or anything) and you'll get it back with the following message:

A geonid seems as if it doesn't recognize you as anything of importance. You attempt to speak with the geonid through your velium focus but all you are able to hear is the same though over and over.., Eat. You have gained no knowledge from these creatures but you notice your focus has been altered slightly.
The description on the focus doesn't change, but it is altered.
Wakening Land
Take the focus back to Phenocryst in Wakening Land and give it to him. The following will happen:

Phenocryst sends it's thoughts to you, a feeling of disappointment washes over you, 'It seems the others are not aware of themselves yet. We are alone..So many questions yet we can find no answers. We have been given a very special gift but without direction we are lost. We must find who has made us aware of ourselves and why it has done so.'
You say to Phenocryst, "Find what?"

Phenocryst says in the form of thoughts, 'We must call to it. We must make ourselves heard past these rocks though. A menhir must be constructed to amplify our voice. The stones we will need are not found in this area though. We hear whispers of stones far away that have the ability to channel and amplify our thoughts. We ask you to gather these stones for us harbinger."
You say to Phenocryst, "I will gather these stones for you."

Phenocryst's thoughts flood your mind, 'Thank you Harbinger. We need 3 crystals. One of Beryl, one of Stibnite, and one of the purest Iron. These minerals will only be found deep within the earth where the geology is relatively stable. This Focus will aid you in finding the right crystals. Return it to me with the 3 crystals and we will construct our Menhir. Please hurry Harbinger, our prophecy awaits.
Phenocryst gives you an item for telling him you'll gather the stones. It's a magic, lore, no drop Elbaite Focus that has 5 charges of Identify. It looks like a fire emerald.
Gather the Stones

The stibnite crystal is found in The Great Divide. If you enter the wurm caves in the center of that zone from the south, go up to the first right, go in and take the next right, you'll be in a room with two spawn points for wurms and there's a patch of blue crystal at the back of the room. The stibnite is behind the crystals and looks like a bag on the floor. It spawns every 1-2 hours or so I think. The description of the item is "Bent Metallic Crystal". It weights 20.0, is magic, lore, and no drop. When you identify it, it identifies as "Stibnite for the Menhir". To identify an item using t…

The Reddish Crystal can be found in Splitpaw Lair behind one of the stone pillars near the entrance of the underwater tunnel leading to the Ishva area . It weighs 10.0 and is magic, lore, and no drop. It identifies as "Beryl for the Menhir".
The crystal of purest iron is in Burning Woods. It's sitting on the meteor near Slixin Klex. It's item description is "Heavy Metallic Crystal" and is
magic, lore, and no drop. It weighs 14.0.
Wakening Land

Take these three crystals and the Elbaite Focus back to Wakening Lands to Phenocryst and you're ready for the next step. Get 1-2 parties of 50+ players and bring 'em with you. Due to the dragon that spawns in Wakening Land near the dragon portal, you might want to approach from skyshrine. If you're going along the wall from skyshrine towards the caves, you want to gather your troops at the second cave entrance along the wall. Phenocryst is closest to that entrance. Get to know the path between you and him at this point so you're familiar with how to get out in a hurry. At this point, all the…
You submit the items to Phenocryst.

Phenocryst makes no sound but it's voice fills your mind. 'We have always held our memories within the earth and stone but only recently have we become aware of them. We do not know what happened or who gave us this wonderful gift but we can now access those memories and are aware of it's storage. With that knowledge has come questions and desires. When the prophecy comes to be then we will have our answers and fulfill our desires.'

Phenocryst 's familiar thoughts flood into your mind again, 'You truly are the Harbinger, take this Focus as a mark of your friendship with us. Now we can construct the Menhir, we need ..,..,the stones speak.., There is a problem. Ones of flesh are coming, the large ones, 3 of them. They must not disturb us while we construct the Menhir! Please stop them Harbinger! bring us proof of their distruction along with your Focus and then we will begin the calling. Our asscention is at hand!'
You lose the focus and the three crystals and in return gain another focus item with the description "Azurite Focus". It's a magic, lore, no drop item weighing 0.5.

Now head outside and start tracking. After a few minutes, two "accolyte of Zek" giants will show up on track. A minute later or so, a Bloodpriest Loukond will show up on tracker as well. You'll have to run out and pull the accolytes to you once you track them. If they are snared, they still run quite fast. These giants con blue at 52 and are quite magic resistant. Make sure you pull these, they're almost more important than the Bloodpriest. They get attacked by the various mercenaries in the zone sometimes and get killed before you can do the job. If you have to pull mercenaries with the acco…
Possible locs and spawn times after hand-ins (need confirmation, best to bring a tracker)
accolyte of Zek A spawns at after 3.11 minutes. Warrior, level 50, ~13,000 HP, AC 344, summons, hits between 73-200
accolyte of Zek B spawns at after 3.11 minutes. Warrior, level 50, ~13,000 HP, AC 344, summons, hits between 73-200
Bloodpriest Ioukond C spawns at after 3.11 minutes. Cleric, level 50, ~9,000 HP, summons, hits between 73-150, CH's

After killing both accolytes, loot them. Each one has a medalion that has the description, "Holy Symbol of Zek", which is magic, no drop, and weighs 2.0. After the accolytes are done, go out and get the Bloodpriest. Bloodpriest Loukond should eventually walk up to the cave entrance and stand outside it if nobody pulls it. After a minute of standing outside the cave, he depops, which is why you have to do the accolytes first (they pop first) then the bloodpriest (he'll get to the cave probably if you can't find him, the accolytes might not). The bloodpriest cons blue at 52 and is just as magic…
Now. Take your Azurite Focus and the three medalions to Phenocryst. Submit them to Phenocryst.

Phenocryst 's thoughts become your own, a feeling of joy overwhelms you, 'Because of you we can at last speak with our maker. We were once given a gift, and we ask that you accept this gift from us now so that we may come closer to that which we owe our sentience to. Now..,we must construct the Menhir..'
You lose the Azurite Focus and medalions and get Phenocryst's Focus in return, which is, it seems, the reward for this quest.
Then then geonids, led by Phenocryst, start walking around, through the halls and such. When this happens, you see the following message:
"Phenocryst begins to resonate. All the stones about you begin to resonate seemingly at its command. The Geonids all begin moving, all to construct the Menhir."

I'm assuming they get together at this point at make their Menhir and the quest is over. I didn't stick around to watch because we got some tar goo on us and that put a dampener on things real quick. It's very important to note that although geonids con indifferent or amiable, goo does not and if you get any of it on you and a geonid is close by, it'll aggro the geonid. No idea why this is, it doesn't make any sense, but it's the case. Also, enchanters can skip a huge chunk of this quest by casting Collaboration on Phenocryst and starting from the point where to say to him "I will gather thes…

P.S. After killing the giants and turning in the final pieces to Phenocryst, he gathers all the Geonids in the cave to him and walks out. We found it to be a good idea to call a geo train in /shout approximately 3 to 5 minutes prior to doing this final turn in and attempt to warn anyone killing Geonids during this time frame that a train is imminent.

quests.name: The Vengeful Musicians
steps: Thadres Thyme may be found in McQuaid's Dark Stout at +100, -200.
You say, 'Hail, Thadres Thyme'
You say, 'What journey?'
You say, 'Who was your brother?'
You say, 'What about his diary?'
You say, 'What pages?'

Head to Everfrost Peaks and find and kill a "vengeful soloist," "vengeful composer," and "vengeful lyricist," all undead skeletons, all around level 10, and all wandering the newbie area. Loot Delius Thyme's Diary Pg. 74-76. The pages are NO TRADE and TEMPORARY. Page 74 reads:
Oct 2

Today was an especially cold day. Never stay in Halas again. The only bright point was I met a Master Brewer named Garsen who agreed to join our group and help us explore the uncharted depths of Permafrost. He seems to speak only in rhyme which is a bit annoying but his skill with weapons makes up for it. He said he has to keep practicing because he is writing countless books of Brewing Limericks.
Oct 3
Everfrost Mountains must be the coldest place on Norrath, and to make matters worse we were almost killed by a Mammoth that appeared over a peak. Tolan was almost slain but Garsen saved him.
Oct 4
We discovered underground caverns. The only thing more frightening than

monsters is Garsen opening his mouth. I'd say, " I need to sit and rest". He'd follow with; "Do you really think that's best?" Tolan said, "We could really use a Cleric". Garsen replied, "Don't be a hysteric". I can't take it, can't take it.
Page 75 reads:
Oct 5

Garsen was quite offended by Tolan's outburst today. Tolan said that our food tasted like it came from the sewer and Garsen, as usual, replied with a rhyme, "It could taste better with a skewer." Tolan made him realize how irritating his voice is. One more rhyme, ONE more damn rhyme, and I'll kill him myself.
Oct 6
Garsen was quiet all day today and didn't mutter a word even when he was almost killed and needed help.

However, when we stopped to camp we had to sleep right next to each other because of our location. Garsen was murmuring rhymes in his sleep. Every damn word out of his mouth rang in my ears. Each syllable lingered just long enough to drive me crazy. I kept praying that the next word would not rhyme. Satisfaction never came.
Tolan and I talked and decided to help him sleep a bit better.
Oct 7

We rifled through our departed friends things and found the unfinished limericks and component charts on the brewing trade. After destroying many Tolan suggested someone might want to buy the rest. We'll try to sell them in Halas.
Page 76 reads:
Oct 23

Just got out of prison and finally received my possessions back. I arrived back in Halas on the 9th and sold the limericks to a Barbarian who paid a hefty amount of silver for the work. As I was walking down the street a Blacksmith said, "I'll have to charge my usual fee of 12 copper." His patron replied, "If I pay you that much I'll be a pauper." I had no idea if the rhyme was intentional or not but uncontrollable rage swept over me. Slowly, ever so slowly, I turned, grabbed the patron by the throat and squeezed. It took six guards to free him. One guard gave me a strong warning and said, "Y…

Before I could realize it, my hands were wrapped around the guard's throat. Jail wasn't that bad save the rats, bats, mildew, and stench. Unusually, the jail served rat sandwiches everyday. At least no one has said a rhyme to me since. The end to the horror seems far from sight. Rhyming winter nightmares have sadly impaled me. Writhing with nightly havoc, sanity eludes me.
Turn in the three pages to Thadres Thyme.
You receive Garsen's Brewing List, which sells for about 1 sp and reads:
Note: You have to turn in all 3 pages at once. Bringing them one by one, doesn't work.

quests.name: Thex Dagger Quest
steps: You must be Kindly or better with Clerics of Tunare. Anti-Mage is not needed
Vaila's Notes
Part I

Head to High Keep near the entrance next to the guard on your left as you enter the courtyard, Tearon Bleanix spawns. Target and say to him 'I will become a hero'. He will hand you Tearon's Bracer, 5.0Wt no AC.

Head up to the 4th Floor in High Keep and find Princess Lenya (not Lenia). Walk through the painting to a secret area in HK 4th floor. Continue down the hallway past the DE / Guard on the right. Pull a U-Turn around the wall and the room will have the Princess standing alone near a table and chairs. (Note: She despawns after quest turn in, so be prepared to sit and wait ~18 min.) Hand her the bracer, she will hand you back Tearon's Bracer this time with 1.0Wt and 1 AC.
You Say: 'Hail, Princess Lenya'
Princess Lenya: 'Are you not a little short for a Highpass Guard?'
Hand Her the bracer
Princess Lenya: 'So you are a member of the Silent Watch!! They are accepting anyone these days. I shall leave then. Here is your bracer back. Thank you for unlocking the door.'
If you're a caster that can bind, you can gate to Tearon if you're fast enough and do the next step, if not wait about 10ish min. for repop.

Head back to Tearon and zoom out your view so that you can easily and quickly hand in 2 items in succession. First hand in the bracer you have to Tearon, this will cause Lenya to spawn next to him, quickly hand her the amulet you receive. If you're successful you'll get a No Drop sealed letter from her. If you weren't fast enough you have to redo the whole quest up until this part.
Upon Handing in Bracer to Tearon:
Tearon Bleanix: 'King Tearis Thex thanks you my friend. Could you please hand the princess this amulet. It is hers. I pryed it from the hands of some beggar.'
Part II

You need to make your way to Felwithe now to Traveller's Home - Inn. Find Inkeeper Freegraze standing by the entrance door to the inn and say 'Where is Tolon Nurbyte?', this will cause Tolon to spawn on the 2nd Floor in the far back.
Hand Tolon Nurbyte the sealed letter and receive the Thex Dagger.

quests.name: Thex Mallet Quest
steps: Note: This requires amiable faction (+100) with The Dead, the dark elf necromancer and shadow knight guild.

An enchanter can charm Kizdean for the note, however the final turn in NPC cannot be charmed. Raising The Dead faction is possible by killing high elf or gnome casters from Eldritch Collective or Keepers of the Art such as Linara Parlone (highly recommended: +47 faction/kill, faction hits reversible by Bat Wings quest) or Retlon Brenclog. Dark elf form (auto-granted to enchanters at level 10) or Guise of the Deceiver will also help. Faction can potentially be bypassed as both the Thex Mallet and Reaper of the Dead are tradable.
The Messages For Neriak quest can be a simple way to quickly raise The Dead as well.
You say, 'Hail Loveal S`Nez'
You say, 'I am interested in your appointed tasks.'
You say, 'What is the Thex Mallet?'
You say, 'Who is Queen Cristanos Thex?'
You say, 'Who is King Naythox Thex?'
Travel now to the West Commonlands and find Kizdean Gix near the tollbooth.
You say, 'Hail, Kizdean Gix'
You say, 'Utalk Adarev Otcin.' (Only indifferent faction is required for this step)(Did not work with indifferent faction on an agnostic Dark Elf Warrior)
Trivia note: This is "klatu verada nicto" backwards, a reference to "klaatu barada nikto"[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Klaatu_barada_nikto].
You receive A Tattered Cloth Note. This note is Lore/No Trade.
You say, 'Thex Mallet?'
Travel to Befallen. Inside, near the well, you will find Skeleton Lrodd who is a guaranteed spawn and indifferent to all players. Give him the note.
Handing in the note will spawn Cmdr Windstream on level 3. He spawns on the chair/throne just through the invisible wall. Kill him, and he will drop the "Mallet Stem."
You have slain Cmdr Windstream!
Cmdr Windstream and the other Befallen necromancers are on Burning Dead faction.

The An Elf Skeleton is located on the same floor as Cmdr Windstream. Coming from the bottom of the well, the elf skeleton is just on the other side of the fake wall and to the left, next to the spikes near the hanging dwarf torso. If you're coming down from the zone in, it's beyond the second locked door at the bottom of the broken staircase. It will drop the Mallet Head, Mallet Hilt or neither. When you have both, put the Mallet Head and Mallet Hilt inside the Mallet Stem and hit Combine. This will complete the Thex Mallet. An Elf Skeleton has a 6:40 respawn time.
Journey back to Neriak 3rd Gate and give the mallet to Loveal S`Nez.
You receive the Reaper of the Dead.

quests.name: Tiny Skeletons
steps: This quest originates in Ak'Anon with Narron Jenork at the Gemchoppers Guild, but you only have to go there for the final turn in.

There is a rare spawn Gnome Guard named Watchman Dexlin that pops in place of the vendor Bilbis Briar on the second floor of the bridge tower in North Karana. He occasionally spawns at 6 AM game time every couple hours and will stay up until 8 PM game time. Hail him and he says he's in need of a brave fighter. Say "I am a brave fighter" and he tells you he is looking for the remains of tiny skeletons. If you have sufficient faction, he gives you a box with 4 slots and tells you to collect the remains (and for some reason you will take a hit with your Gem Chopper faction). He tells you to retu…

After he gives you the box at least 5 a tiny skeleton will spawn in the zone. They stand at static spawns points in the Northern part of the zone near the East Karana bridge. They are level 15 and always drop a Very Tiny Crumpled Skeleton.
/loc of quest mobs: (Exact Locs Needed)

The tiny skeletons are hard to find, as they're as small as brownies. A Ranger with tracking would be a big help on this quest, or any class with Sense Undead. Kill and collect four Very Tiny Crumpled Skeleton and combine them in the Empty Tin Box to create Box Full Of Tiny Bones. Give the Box Full Of Tiny Bones back to Watchman Dexlin. He will give you back a Box of Undead Brownie Bones and tells you to deliver it to Narron Jenork in Ak'Anon.

Narron Jenork says, 'Wonderful!! Watchman Dexlin sent word that you would be returning these specimens. I shall see that the Eldritch Collective gets them. For you there is a reward. Manik has donated a pair of Watchman Boots!!'
You receive 4 platinum pieces.
You receive Watchman Boots.

steps: Akbaq Salid is in the Erudin Wizard guild. He requires indifferent faction in order to offer you the quest. If you can sneak, that is sufficient. There seem to be three rewards here:
Astral Cloak of the Titans
Giant White Sabertooth Hide (Snowbeast)
Giant Leopard Hide (Prowler of the Jungle)
Astral Leggings of the Titans
Gigantic Gorilla Hide (Old Ghostback)
Gargantuan Panda Pelt (Giang Yin)
Scaled Robe of the Elder Serpent
The Ancient Snake Skin of Slyder the Ancient
1x a piece of Platinum Thread
Snake skin (Robe)
Cat hides (Cloak)
Gorilla and Panda Hides (Leggings)

quests.name: Toko's Head
steps: After returning the Spell Book to Tergon, he tells you about another quest:
The 'defector' is Toko Binlittle, who is located on the Seafury Island near Gornit in the Ocean of Tears.
Kill him and bring back his head (he drops A Teir`Dal Head for some reason) and you will receive an Elemental Grimoire, which is used for magician research.
Excellent work, Menehune. It's unfortunate this had to be done, but we cannot allow our secrets to fall into the hands of others.
Your faction with EldritchCollective got better.

quests.name: Tome of Ages
steps: The Oracle may be found on top of a mountain at -15, -6730, -200 (?).
You say, 'Hail, Oracle of K`Arnon'
You say, 'What about knowledge?'
You say, 'What do you seek?'
You say, 'What is the Tome of Ages?'
You say, 'What about the Dal?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Ages?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Enlightenment?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Scale?'
Giving him the Book of Scale nets you Miragul's Phylactery, used in the Fiery Avenger quest, a subquest for the Paladin epic.
You say, 'What about the Book of Turmoil?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Monuments?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Elders?'
You say, 'What about the Book of Blood?'
You say, 'What about the Lost Book?'

quests.name: Tomer's Rescue
steps: THIS QUEST DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE IN LEGENDS - Tomer Instogle exists and all parts of the quest work up to returning Tomer's backpack. However Seta Bakindo does not exist, so completing the quest is impossible.
This quest is NOT available at Indifferent faction. Tomer will say "Don't take this personally, but I cant trust you with such matters" after returning his backpack.
Tomer Instogle is a monk hurt near the western walls outside of Qeynos city.
You say, 'Hail, Tomer Instogle'
You say, 'What dogs?'
You say, 'Which Clan House?'
You say, 'Seta sent me to find you'
You say, 'I will carry your backpack'
Receive a Ruined Backpack.
You say, 'I will lead you back to Master Seta'

NOTE: The first time I said this line, Tomer responded with his "Leave me alone!" line, despite having Kindly faction. I said the line a second time, and that time he decided to follow, and I was able to complete the quest.
Go to the Silent Fist Clan guildhouse in North Qeynos and talk to Seta Bakindo.
You say, 'Hail, Seta Bakindo'
You say, 'I found Tomer'
Give Tomer the Ruined Backpack.

quests.name: Tonics for Groflah
steps: Apparently Groflah Steadirt has a thirst for tumpy tonics. If you catch him at the Seafarers Roost in East Freeport and speak to him there he will tell you that he likes Tumpy tonics. He spawns at about 9PM if he is going to show at all, and despawns at 9AM. I have been told that he is more likely to spawn at the bar if you give him the Zimels Blades list when he is at his store.
Tumpy Tonics are made with the brewing skill. There is also a quest for them in Kaladim.
Your location is -211, -884.
You say, 'Hail, Groflah Steadirt'
Groflah Steadirt says, 'Greetings, ! Join in the [celebration]! Have a few drinks. Alas, there are no [Tumpy Tonics].'
You say, 'What celebration?'

Groflah Steadirt says, 'The Freeport Militia now has a bar to themselves. Lucky it is not this one. Ah.. I tell you, I just don't feel up to much right now. I have had so much grog my great grandma could best me!'
You say, 'What Tumpy Tonics?'

Groflah Steadirt says, 'Tumpy Tonics are great!! I used to drink them often in a bar in Kaladim. Kind of glad they don't serve it here. I could not stop drinking them and they would always cause me to drain the dragon. I get tired of running to the docks for that reason.'
You give a Tumpy Tonic to Groflah Steadirt.
Groflah Steadirt says, '..glug,glug,glug.. Ahh!! I missed those. I was just telling myself the other.. Uh oh!! I have to use the little dwarves facilities. Excuse me.'

quests.name: Toolset Delivery
steps: This is the first in a series of three quests including Spear Delivery and Mechanical Net Delivery. The player may skip this optional quest and start either of the others.
Wenglawks Kkeak regards you indifferently -- You would probably win this fight..it's not certain though.
You say, 'hail Wenglawks Kkeak'
You say, 'I am a mercenary'
You say, 'I am looking for work'
You say, 'I will deliver package for you'

Give the note to Kellek Felhammer in the next room and he gives you a Coldain Toolset. YOU NEED MORE THAN DUBIOUS FACTION - Take the toolset to Sojan in Iceclad (Gnome Igloos). Fatties will need an Ant Potion in order to enter the igloo or get someone to pull Sojan outside. Sojan will give you a receipt for Wenglawks that when returned will yield the Engraved Bone Pauldrons.
There are no faction effects for this quest.
Sojan the Sleepless /loc 4541 1283
You say, 'Hail, Sojan the Sleepless'
Sojan the Sleepless stares at you through bleary eyes. 'I get enough conversation from my wife. If ya want water or biscuits, buy em! Otherwise, leave me alone!'
Give the toolset and he will fall asleep and drop the receipt on the floor!
Sojan the Sleepless says, 'Uhh, thank you.. Now I can uh... work on fixing some things around.. Sonaj seems to nod off for a moment as he drops a small note on the ground.'
Give the receipt back to Wenglawks Kkeak.

Wenglawks Kkeak says, 'I assume the delivery went well? You can have these as payment. One of my customers just decided he does not wish to buy them. They are rather sturdy! I do have another task available if you wish to [undertake] it.'

quests.name: Torch Of Alna Quest
steps: Vira may be found on the balcony to the left, at +410, +85. She will give quest dialog and rewards to a level 9 Magician (perhaps lower).
You say, 'Hail, Vira'
You say, 'What is elemental summoning?'
You say, 'What of the torch of Alna?'
You say, 'I am interested in the torch.'
She wants the following four items:
Fire Emerald may be purchased from a jewelry merchant
Fire Drake Scale drops from various fire drakes in the Lavastorm Mountains and Solusek's Eye (Sol A)
A Torch (not just "Torch", identifies as "Torch of Fire") drops from the magicians and goblin magicians in Najena or alligators in Cazic_Thule_(Zone) or Lake Rathetear.
Fire Giant Toes drop from various fire giants around the world.
After turn in:
You receive the Torch of Alna.

quests.name: Tormax's Head - Dragons
steps: Lord Yelinak will accept Tormax's head at amiable or better faction.
NOTE: If your faction is not high enough and you turn in the item, he will not give the item back to you.
You say, 'Hail, Lord Yelinak'
You say, 'I wish to prove my worth'
Upon handing him the King Tormax's Head:

Lord Yelinak watches as you drop the colossal head of King Tormax to the ground before him. You sense intense hatred within Yelinak as he stares down at the bloody remains of a descendent of the one who slew his mate. Obviously the death of Tormax has done little to console the ancient snow dragon. Finally Yelinak speaks, 'I look upon this face, and even though he is dead, the hatred burns on. My grief and anger are unchanged even in the face of ultimate fate. His grandfather's act was so despicable and all-encompassing that it instilled an. immortal loathing. Neverttheless, you have complete…
He gives you the Clawed Griffin Sword.
You say, 'What treasure?'
If you give him back the sword:
He gives you White Dragonscale Boots.
If you give him back the boots:
He gives you: White Dragon Helm. If you give him back the helm, he gives you: Clawed Griffin Sword.

quests.name: Tormax's Head - Dwarves
steps: Dain Frostreaver will accept Tormax's head at kindly or better faction.
Upon turning in King Tormax's Head, obtained by killing King Tormax in Kael Drakkel, to Dain Frostreaver IV:

Dain Frostreaver IV shouts 'Let it be know from this day forth that ______ and their companions are Heros of the Coldain Kingdom. King Tormax has been slain, it is a time for celebration. Let no tankard go unfilled!'

quests.name: Totemic Armor Quests
steps: Fashion:
(Needs a better picture, breastplate is missing)
General Quest Info:
The quests are given out by a pair of Barbarian shamans in Lake Rathetear: Vrynn and Kyralynn, at the Barbarian Village (loc 500, 2500).
Vrynn will make:
Totemic Boots
Totemic Gauntlets
Totemic Greaves
Totemic Vambraces
Kyralynn will make:
Totemic Bracers
Totemic Breastplate
Totemic Cloak
Totemic Helm
Note: If you try to turn in the wrong items the game refuses to allow the turn-in.
Recommended Order:
You can reference the list of quests below to decide which items you plan to get and use the regional checklist and zone guides further below to help you find whichever pieces you are after.

If you're also trying to level at the same time, then in terms of difficulty you will probably want to start with Lesser Faydark, Rathe Mountains, then the North and South Karanas camps first - though you will want Tracking for Grizzleknot in South Karana.
Next you can do Everfrost and Ocean of Tears followed by Cazic Thule and Najena.

And you will probably want to end with the Dagnor's Cauldron region (Dagnor's Cauldron, Unrest, Kedge Keep). I recommend doing Permafrost last because it requires clearing lots of the zone and dealing with lots of swarms of mobs, so better off done when you're not trying to get experience - unless you can convince friends to go with you. This may change in the coming months when Permafrost gets its own zone revamp for EQ Legends.
= Vrynn's Quests =
Boots:
Reward: Totemic Boots
Banded Boots
Dufrenite
Terror Spines (Tentacle Terror, Najena) (lvl22)
Chief's Tongue (Orc chief, Lesser Faydark) (lvl18-21)
Gauntlets:
Reward: Totemic Gauntlets
Banded Gauntlets
Crushed Dufrenite
Mammoth Rib Bone (a wooly mammoth, Everfrost Peaks) (lvl22-26)
Griffenne Downfeather (a griffenne, Northern Karana) (lvl23-27)
Sleeves:
Reward: Totemic Vambraces
Banded Sleeves
Ground Dufrenite
Ghoul Carrion (a carrion ghoul, Unrest) (lvl20)
Charger Hoof Chips (centaur charger, Southern Karana) (lvl29)
Leggings:
Reward: Totemic Greaves
Banded Leggings
Powdered Dufrenite
Permafrost Snowball (goblin wizard, Permafrost) (lvl23)
Bone Barbs (a barbed bone skeleton, Unrest) (lvl24)
= Kyralynn's Quests =
Bracer:
Reward: Totemic Bracers
Banded Bracer
Dufrenite
Bull Elephant Tooth (a bull elephant, Southern Karana) (lvl20-24)
Cauldron Shell (aqua goblin tidal lord, Dagnor's Cauldron) (lvl22-24)
Mail:
Reward: Totemic Breastplate
Banded Mail
Crushed Dufrenite
Grizzleknot Bark (Grizzleknot, Southern Karana) (lvl 28)
Lancer Swordfish Fin (A Lancer Swordfish lvl28-lvl32; A Piercer Swordfish lvl35-lvl37; An impaler swordfish lvl39) Kedge Keep
Helm:
Reward: Totemic Helm

quests.name: Toxdil's Poison
steps: Toxdil is a Teir'Dal poison vendor in West Freeport behind the fake wall in the north of the newbie yard.
You say, 'Hail, Toxdil'
You say, 'What deadly liquid?'
He wants 2 Snake Venom Sacs and 20 gp and he'll give you a vial of poison.
Reward is Snake Venom and some experience. Toxdil has no dialogue nor faction hits for his reward.

quests.name: Track, Stalk, Hunt
steps: You say, 'Hail, Vexia D`Ynth'
Vexia D`Ynth says, in Dark Elvish, '[Track].'
You say, 'Track'
Vexia D`Ynth says, in Dark Elvish, '[Stalk].'
You say, 'Stalk'
Vexia D`Ynth says, in Dark Elvish, '[Hunt].'
You say, 'Hunt'
Vexia D`Ynth says, in Dark Elvish, 'Yes. Hunt. Track, stalk, and hunt. Ignore that silly talk about conservation. Protecting nature. Nurturing the forest. [Drivel]. It's all drivel.'
You say, 'Drivel'
Vexia D`Ynth says, in Dark Elvish, 'Yes, drivel. Hunt for the joy of the kill. Hunt for Queen Cristanos and King Naythox Thex. Hunt for the [glory] of Innoruuk.'
You say, 'glory'

Vexia D`Ynth says, in Dark Elvish, 'Yes. You will hunt for the Dread Slayers. You will hunt and you will learn through the doing. You do not have to hunt these all at once. I will accept each as its own task. Bring back four each of Garter Snake Tongue, Spider Venom Sac, Wolf Meat, Bone Chips, and Giant Bat Fur.'

quests.name: Tribunal Healing
steps: Waltor Felligan says, 'Hello, me friend! I'm the resident healer o' Halas. Please inform me when ye've a need fer me talents to [bind wounds], [cure disease] or [cure poison]. Might I add, if ye're a young shaman o' Halas, ye can also [assist in gathering fungus].'
You say, "Please bind wounds"
Waltor Felligan says, 'Before I bind yer wounds, ye must pay tribute to the Tribunal in the amount of ten gold coins.'
After you hand him 10 gold coins:
Waltor Felligan says, 'The scales have been balanced and the Tribunal has spoken. Yer body shall be saved.'
You feel much better.

quests.name: Tribunal Initiate
steps: Jinkus Felligan is located inside the Temple of the Tribunal in Halas (/loc 315, 444). You say, 'Hail, Jinkus Felligan'
Jinkus Felligan says, 'Welcome! Welcome to the Church o' the Tribunal! Do ye require healing or are ye [new to the Shamans o' Justice], then, eh?'
You say, 'I am new to the shamans of justice.'

Jinkus Felligan says, 'Then I welcome ye into our noble order. Ye'll serve us well or spend an eternity in the dungeons o' the Tribunal. Are ye willing to [contribute to our church] or did ye just come to meditate within our walls?'
You say, 'I am ready to contribute to yer church.'

Jinkus Felligan says, 'Ye'll help all o' Halas by doing the bidding o' the church. Go to Holana. Tell her [Jinkus sent] ye to assist her. She'll have worrk for ye. Perhaps, if ye're planning on passing near Qeynos, ye can [make a delivery] as well?'
You say, 'I will make a delivery.'

Jinkus Felligan says, 'The Church of the Tribunal works with the Qeynos Guards to apprehend fugitives. There's a new criminal on the loose, so we must send a wanted poster to Qeynos for them to display on the walls of their bank. Speak with Cindl about a piece o' mammoth hide parchment and with Greta about some ink and I'll prepare the bounty poster.'
Cindl is located behind the counter inside Mac's Kilts (/loc 271, -172). (Note: You can start the quest here, if you so choose.) You say, 'I need a mammoth hide parchment.'

Cindl says, 'Jinkus must've sent ye fer some more mammoth hide parchment fer his posters. Here, take it, free o' charge, as a donation to the church and to the will o' the Tribunal as well.' Cindl hands you a Mammoth Hide Parchment.
Greta Terrilon is located close to the oven outside McDaniels Smokes & Spirits (/loc 280, -327). You say, 'I need some ink.'
Greta Terrilon says, 'On an errand for Jinkus eh? No - no money, consider this a donation to the church.' Greta hands you a Vial of Datura Ink.

Return to Jinkus Felligan and hand him the vial of ink and the parchment. Jinkus Felligan says, 'This is what I needed, thank-you. Your next task is to take this wanted poster to Dun at the bank in Qeynos. Go quickly, this is important'

Next, make the run through Everfrost Peaks, Blackburrow, Qeynos Hills, North Qeynos, and finally, to the bank in South Qeynos. Just outside the bank, you'll meet Dun, a barbarian guard (/loc 320, -453).

Hand Dun the Wanted Poster. Dun says 'Tis good that Jinkus has sent you with this poster. There has been talk of a northman fugitive in the city. Take this list back to Jinkus so that our brethren in Halas are aware of the many criminals that have fled Qeynos and are still at large.' Dun hands you a List of Qeynos Most Wanted.

Finally, return to Jinkus Felligan in Halas and hand him the List of Qeynos Most Wanted. Jinkus Felligan says, 'Great work, Soandso You will be a welcome addition to our rolls. Take this as a token of your new status.'
You receive your Initiate Symbol of the Tribunal.

quests.name: Trooper Scale Armor
steps: General:
Xlixinar Arcut and Drixiv Arcut are on Legion of Cabilis faction, and are located at the of the Overthere chasm. The quests can be completed by anyone given sufficient faction.

With the exception of the vambraces, the note from Xlinar and Drixiv is not required to start these quests. They simply are used to get the other NPCs who give the recommendations to talk about the quest.
=Short Walkthrough=
Drixiv Arcut:
Boots
Acquire 2x Fire Emerald
Kill Snaorf (37) and loot Snaorf's Medallion
Give Master Rixiz the Medallion and 2 fire emeralds (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire Banded Boots
Give Drixiv the Banded Boots and recommendation.
Bracers
Acquire 2x Sapphire
Kill an Iksar prisoner (28) and loot his Traitor's Heart
Give Arch Duke Xog the Traitor's Heart and 2 sapphires (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire Banded Bracer
Give Drixiv the Banded Bracer and recommendation.
Repeat for a second Bracer
Gauntlets
Acquire 2x Star Ruby
Kill Kerosh Blackhand (33) and loot the Head of Blackhand
Give Arch Duke Xog the Head of Blackhand and 2 star rubies (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire Banded Gauntlets
Give Drixiv the Banded Gauntlets and recommendation.
Greaves
Acquire 2x Star Ruby
Kill Advisor Sh'Orok (30-35) and loot his Iron Bound Tome
Give Master Xydoz the Iron Bound Tome and 2 star rubies (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire Banded Leggings
Give Drixiv the Banded Leggings and recommendation.
Xlixinar Arcut:
Breastplate
Acquire 3x Ruby
Kill Sergeant Daelione (26) for Daelione's Implant
Hand Vekis the implant
Kill Commander Streaven (45) for Straeven's Head
Give Grik the Exile Straeven's Head and 3 rubies (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire Banded Mail
Give Xlixinar the Banded Mail and recommendation.
Helm
Acquire 2x Star Ruby
Kill an odd mole for the tiny collar
Give Master Glox the tiny collar and 2 star rubies (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire Banded Helm
Give Xlixinar the Banded Helm and recommendation.
Pauldron
Acquire 2x Fire Emerald
Bake (Trivial 21) the following to receive a Spine Poison Extract:
Gray Colored Ice - Ground spawn - Frontier Mountains
2x Pondfish Spines (unstacked) - Pond Sturgeon (14-18)
Pot (Blacksmithing or Pottery)
Brew (Trivial 21) the following to receive a Grayish Liquid:
Spine Poison Extract
Hopeless Willow Moss - Foraged - The Swamp of No Hope
Water Flask - Purchased
Bottle - Purchased
Give a froglok slave the grayish liquid to receive Froglok Goo (Must be indifferent, see long walkthrough for details)
Give Prime Hierophant Vek the froglok goo and 2 fire emeralds (unstacked) to receive his recommendation.
Acquire a Banded Mantle
Give Xlixinar the Banded Mantle and recommendation.

quests.name: Trueshot Longbow Quest
steps: Introductions:

Maesyn Trueshot may be found in the ranger guild in Kelethin at -451.03, 520.32, 116.28. Note: He will progress through dialogue at indifferent but won't hand you the pack until amiably. You can finish the quest as a non-ranger but you will need the faction.
You say, 'Hail Maesyn Trueshot'
You say, 'What Trueshot longbows?'
You say, 'I will gather materials.'
You receive a Material Pack, a 4-slot MEDIUM container.
Dwarven Wire:
Trantor Everhot may be found wandering around North Kaladim.
You say, 'Hail, Trantor Everhot'
You say, 'What dwarven wire?'
You say, 'What Tumpy Tonics?'

You can get Tumpy Tonics from Tumpy Irontoe or brew them yourself (1 Kiola Nut + 1 Water Flask in a brew barrel, trivial 135). You'll need four Tumpy Tonics for the quest, so make sure you get enough. Give two to Trantor Everhot unstacked.
You receive Dwarven Wire. Give him another two Tumpy Tonics unstacked for the second piece of Dwarven Wire.
Treant Wood:
You say, 'Hail, Jyle Windshot'
You say, 'I am looking for treant wood.'
You can buy a Small Lantern at many vendors, including Innkeep Palola in North Freeport and Innkeep Harold in East Commonlands. Give Jyle the lantern.
Give them one at a time; Jyle will eat extras in the same trade.

You will probably receive Wooden Shards, which identifies as "Treant Wood Shards." Occasionally you instead receive A Wooden Heart, which identifies as "A Treant Heart." This is used in the subsequent Rain Caller Quest.
Spiderling silk:
Spiderling silk drops from spiderlings (and some spiders) around the world.
Micro Servos:
Rogue clockworks in Steamfont drop Micro Servos. You'll need at least two Micro Servos, so make sure to collect spares.
The Finale:
In the Material Pack, combine 1 Dwarven Wire, 1 Wooden Shards, 1 Spiderling Silk, and 1 Micro Servo to craft a Pack of Materials. Give this to Maesyn Trueshot.
You receive 6 gold from Maesyn Trueshot.
You say, 'What correct components?'
You receive a Treant Bow Staff. Combine this in a Fletching Kit with a Micro Servo, a piece of Dwarven Wire, and a Planing Tool to craft a Trueshot Longbow (trivial 235).

quests.name: Trumpy Irontoe
steps: Lead-in upon giving him both heads:
Trumpy hangs out at the Fish's Ale in South Qeynos at (-309, -261).

The secret to killing Trumpy is you have to get him away from Barstomper. In order to do this, you ask him in the bar about Sragg. He then gets all huffy and walks out. If you follow him he will get quite a ways from the bar. You can then safely attack and kill him. Be warned he will run away so a good root spell or snare is a good idea. Also, he is in good with the corrupt guards and they might help him if they see him getting attacked. Do not chase him either; he will come back if you let him and eventually he will run back by Barstomper and then you have a much bigger fight on your hands.
(Who is Barstomper? You can also just wait for Trumpy to leave the bar to, er, drain the dragon.. if ya know what he means.. bwah ha ha ha.)

You must have decent (at least amiable) faction in order to be able to get the hammer. Trumpy's head is now a no trade/no drop item, so you can't give it to a dwarf to get the hammer, but must raise your own faction to get it. If you hail him first, he will ask if you have come here to return goblin beads. If you ask him about the beads, you will know if you have a good faction. He may say that your shifty eyes tell him you are not good, and in that case, you do not. If you do, then you can give him the head:
Your reward for this quest is the Bloodforge Hammer, a very nice 2HB magical weapon.

quests.name: Trumpy's Head
steps: After completing Drosco the Zombie (evil), Kurne Rextula mentions [a new task].
You say, 'What new task?'
You say, 'I will retrieve the commander.'
You say, 'What is the Irontoe Brigade?'
Locate Trumpy Irontoe as specified and kill him.
You may have to kill him more than once to retrieve a Dwarf Head (identifies as "Trumpy's Head").
You take the following faction hits:
The turn-in:

You receive a Dwarf Skull (identifies as "Trumpy's Skull"). Grimrot is located in South Karana, surrounded by some tough and dangerous skeletons. You may have to wait a while for him to show up so be prepared to fight or hide. The delivery of the skull will get you a decent amount of experience and gold, as well as an occasional nice item.
You say, 'Hail, Lord Grimrot'
You say, 'What about your Pestilence?'
Presumably, this is where you give him the skull. (Please confirm)
Lord Grimrot judges you amiably -- what would you like your tombstone to say?
You receive 2 gold from Lord Grimrot.
The following quest regarding Arlena's bones is broken, but is nonetheless documented on Lord Grimlot's Love.

quests.name: Tumpy Tonics
steps: (If you are doing this to unlock the Dwarf Race, it took 805 Tumpy Tonics on an Agnostic Ogre to get to Ally.)

Trantor Everhot paths between three locations: 402, -156, 15 upstairs in the Everhot Forge; 657, -197, 3 outside the Grey Bloom Farms next to the oven; and 507, 314, -33 next to a kiln near the entrance to the mines.
You say, 'Hail, Trantor Everhot'
You say, 'What dwarven wire'
You say, 'What Tumpy Tonics'
Tumpy Irontoe is located at 177, 313, 3 inside Irontoe's Eats in South Kaladim.
You say, 'Make me a Tumpy Tonic'
Kiola Nuts are purchased only from Cleonae Kalen, located just up the dock at 503, -9253, 12 on the Island of the Sisters of Erollisi in the Ocean of Tears, for about 2 gold each.
Hand Tumpy Irontoe 1 Kiola Nut plus 1 Water Flask, and receive a Tumpy Tonic in return.
Return to Trantor Everhot and hand him 2 Tumpy Tonics, unstacked.
Quest Turn in Experience gains

quests.name: Tunare Scouts Dagger
steps: Tylfon is located at -515, -229, 161 in the Scouts of Tunare (Rogue) Guild Hall.
You say, 'Hail, Tylfon'
You say, 'I dare'
Hand Tylfon 2 gold and 2 Rusty Daggers.
You receive 5 silver pieces.

quests.name: Tunare Symbol Quests
steps: Initiate Symbol of Tunare
(Optional) Northern Felwithe: Give Yeolarn Bronzeleaf 4x Bone Chips
Lesser Faydark: Kill A rancorous ghast between 8pm and 6am to collect 4x Putrescent Heart
Northern Felwithe: Give Yeolarn Bronzeleaf 4x Putrescent Heart and receive Initiate Symbol of Tunare.
Note: The hearts can be MQ'd as long as Yeolarn responds positively to "I will be an initiate of Tunare."
Disciple Symbol of Tunare
Lesser Faydark: Kill Larik Z`Vole and loot Larik Z`Vole's Head (He or his placeholder spawns at 8PM, 1AM and at 6AM Game Time)
Lesser Faydark: Quickly head southeast to the dark elf camp and track A dark elf courier (who will approach from the northeast); kill and loot Teir`Dal Courier's Head and Teir`Dal Crate
Northern Felwithe: Give Yeolarn Bronzeleaf the Initiate Symbol of Tunare, Larik Z`Vole's Head, Teir`Dal Courier's Head and Teir`Dal Crate. Receive Disciple Symbol of Tunare
Note: This part is confirmed MQ'able as well. Unknown if lower faction will influence Yeolearn accepting both heads + crate. Both characters were amiable.
Warden Symbol of Tunare
Split Paw: Kill various gnolls and loot White Hellebore (droppable)
Solusek A: Kill various fire goblins and loot Pouch of Red Dust
Unrest: Kill a werebat and loot Thick Caustic Fluid (or from a Dark Offerer in Mistmoore)
Northern Felwithe: Say to Yeolarn Bronzeleaf 'I am ready to become a Warden of Tunare.' Receive Black Stone Candlestick
Erudin Palace: Give Trilani Parlone the Black Stone Candlestick to receive Magical Suspension Fluid
Brew the Magical Suspension Fluid, Thick Caustic Fluid, Pouch of Red Dust, and the White Hellebore in a brew barrel (triv > 188 and apparently no-fail)
Erudin Palace: Give Trilani Parlone the Divinatory concoction. Receive Powder of Unanimation
Northern Felwithe: Give Yeolarn Bronzeleaf the Disciple Symbol of Tunare and Powder of Unanimation. Receive Warden Symbol of Tunare

quests.name: Tunic of Ridossan Quest
steps: This quest is a follow-up to the Cold Iron quest (Leggings of Ridossan).
You say, 'What more important task?'
You say, 'I will be the knight.'
-- You receive a Heavy Locked Chest. --
Take it to Lyris Moonbane in the Qeynos Aqueducts (300, -445).
-- You receive a Thick Glass Jar, a 4-slot container. --
You say, 'What assignment?'
You say, 'What goblin source?'
You say, 'What green river sludge?'
You say, 'What portion of an experimental nature?'
The items you need are:
2 x Vile Substance dropped by Goblin Janitor which roams the 2nd level of RunnyEye Citadel
1 x Green river sludge ground spawn in the river in The Feerrott, near Oggok at (+135, +705)
1 x putrid substance from Driana Poxbourne after you give her 3 x Reagent pouch from Najena mages
You say, 'Hail, Driana Poxsbourne'
Driana Poxsbourne says, 'Hail! _______, You best not be associating yourself with the likes of Najena.'
Hand Driana Poxsbourne 3 Reagent pouches.
After you get all four items, combine them and return the Sealed Jar to Lyris Moonbane in the Qeynos Aquducts.
-- You receive a Harbinger of Bertoxxulous. --
You say, 'I will deliver the substance.'
Travel to The Warrens and trade the Harbinger of Bertoxxulous to the river source at (355, -535).
-- You receive an Empty Jar -- ( ).
Take the Empty Jar back to Royal Guard Sheltuin in Paineel to receive the Tunic of Ridossan.

quests.name: Ulthork Tusks Quest
steps: This quest begins at Chief Kalan in Cobalt Scar (location -330, -1218 on the beach just north by northwest of the druid portal).
It is available at dubious faction.
You say, 'Hail, Chief Kalan'
You say, 'I will aid the warriors'
You say, 'What ulthork?'
Upon handing in the tusks:
For your efforts, you'll receive a random gem or trinket.

quests.name: Unkempt Druids (Quest)
steps: a hermit is found inside the hut in the southern part of South Karana.
a hermit regards you indifferently -- You could probably win this fight.
If you stand near the chimney and use /target a_hermit you may hail him, his house does not block line of sight.
You say, 'Hail, a hermit'
If you were on the Winds of Karana quest, you know he had stolen two music sheets from Vhalen Nostrolo.
You say, 'What sheet'
You say, 'I will help the unkempt druids'
At this point you can perform his subquests related to the alternative route for Winds of Karana.
When you turn in Linaya's heart in regards to that quest, he reportedly remarks:
Factions changed by handing in Linaya's Heart:
Jaggedpine Treefolk got worse.
QRG Protected Animals got better.

Jale Phlintoes can be spawned by a hermit by telling him "I wish to join the Unkempt." or "I wish to join the Unkempt Rangers." If you tell him "I wish to join the Unkempt Druids" he won't actually spawn Jale. Do note that Cathalantru Fleetfoot has been waiting for someone's arrival for a long time...

Jale Phlintoes is the founder and leader of the Unkempt Druids (some background is available from Gerael Woodone in Surefall Glades by asking him "Who is Jale Phlintoes?" He mentions a "high bounty as a reward" for his head.

quests.name: Unsar's Glory
steps: Unsar may be found in the Hall of Sorcery (285, -655). You may get this quest at dubious Order of Three faction.
You say, 'Hail, Unsar Koldhagon'
You say, 'What is Unsar's Glory?'
The items are common drops from the mobs in the newbie yard outside the North Gate. Hand them in.
(Unsar casts a buff on himself.)

quests.name: Unser's Call
steps: Unsar Koldhagon may be found in the Hall of Sorcery (285, -655). You may get this quest at dubious Order of Three faction.
You say, 'Hail, Unsar Koldhagon'
You say, 'What is Unsar's Glory?'
The items are common drops from the mobs in the newbie yard outside the North Gate. Hand them in.
(Unsar casts a buff on himself.)

Note: It only took a single turn in, as a Wood Elf druid, to go from dubious to apprehensive. Very handy as all of the vendors in the caster area are on this faction (Order of Three). As of 4/19/2020 confirmed +5 to Order of Three.
You can also buy all 3 of these items from merchants.
Rat Whiskers from
Bat Wings from
Snake Scales from

quests.name: Urako's Big Mistake
steps: The Baker:
Urako is located in the the back of the Troll Shaman Guild.
You say, 'Hail, Urako'
You say, 'I am shaman Darkone'
You say, 'What big mistake?'
You say, 'I will collect Kaglari skeletons'
You say, 'What Kaglari mana doll?'
This quest dialogue will spawn a skeleton behind the bar of Gunthak's Belch.
You say, 'Hail, a skeleton'
You say, 'Come back to the closet'
To get the Grobb Oven Mittens, give Carver Cagrek 3x (unstacked) Froglok Meat and 10 gold. Hand the Oven Mittens to the skeleton behind the bar.
The Butcher:
Basher Nanrum is located in an alcove around the corner from the Priest of Discord, near the front of the cave.
You say, 'Hail, Basher Nanrum'
You say, "Wheres the skeleton'. (Yes, you have to leave off the apostrophe. If you try to be all grammatically correct about it, he won't respond.)
This dialogue will spawn a skeleton on the same platform where Carver Cagrek can be found.
You say, 'Hail, a skeleton'
You say, 'Come back to the closet'

To get an Ogre Butcher Apron, go to Oggok and give Chef Dooga 3x (unstacked) Pickled Froglok and 10 gold. While you're there, buy a Ship in a Bottle from Clurg, because you'll need it later and this will save you a trip.
Give the apron to the skeleton near Carver Cagrek.
The Captain:
Basher Sklama is one of the guards who protect Troll lowbies. He can be found off to the left as you exit Grobb and enter the Swamp. The other two guards near Grobb will not respond to hails.
You say, 'Hail, Basher Sklama'
You say, 'Have you seen the captain?'
This dialogue will spawn a skeleton somewhat northwest-ish from Basher Sklama, at loc -1640, 800.
You say, 'Hail, a skeleton'
You say, 'Come back to the closet'
You can purchase a Ship in a Bottle from Clurg in Oggok. Hopefully you did that already while you were getting the apron from Chef Dooga. Hand the Ship in a Bottle to the skeleton.
The Minstrel:
Basher Avisk patrols through Grobb, between Da Bashin' Place and Carver Cagrek's platform.
You say, 'Hail, Basher Avisk'
You say, 'What tune?'

This dialogue will spawn a skeleton on the throne at the top of the Shaman guild, back near Urako where this whole business started.It should be noted that this skeleton is slightly difficult to get to without dying if you are a large newbie troll in Grobb. It is possible to fall off the throne into the pool and die!
You say, 'Come back to the closet'
Lizardman Scout Fifes are uncommon drops from lizardman scouts in The Feerrott. Turn in 4 of them to the skeleton on the throne.
Urako:
Go back to Urako and hand him all four skulls you have collected.

quests.name: Vambraces of Avoidance Quest
steps: Vorken Iceshard can be found at #11 on the map of Kael Drakkel, to the left of the throne inside "plate house"
You say, 'Hail, Vorken Iceshard'
You say, 'What allegiances?'
You say, 'What motives?'
You say, 'I seek power and wealth'
You say, 'What story?'
You say, 'Who is Beleveios Thunderstone?'
You say, 'Murder?'
You say, 'What family?'

The son, Ekelng Thunderstone, can be found in the northeast corner of Eastern Wastes, north of the Great Divide zone in. Kill Ekelng and loot Head of Ekelng Thunderstone. Interestingly, Ekelng is KOS to frost giants in the area, so it would appear that his attempts to gain support have failed.
Turning in the Head of Ekelng Thunderstone will result in a reward of Vambraces of Avoidance.

quests.name: Vasty Deep Water
steps: Rarnan Lapice is located at -725, -85 outside the Temple of Divine Light in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Rarnan Lapice'
You say, 'I am a cleric of Quellious.'
Illithi Nollith is located at -1075, -220 in the Erudin City Library in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Illithi Nollith'
You say, 'I need the Testament of Vanear.'
Tol Nicelot wanders around the Erudin City Library in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Tol Nicelot'
You say, 'Did you know Moodoro?'
You say, 'Who is Nolusia?'
Nolusia Finharn Wanders between the entrance to Erudin Palace, and the upper floor during in-game daytime.
You say, 'Hail, Nolusia Finharn'
You say, 'I am a visitor of Erudin.'
Nolusia Finharn is located at -1110, -105 outside The Vasty Deep Inn in Erudin during in-game nighttime
You say, 'Hail, Nolusia Finharn'
You say, 'Who is your brother?' (NOT "Who is Moodoro?")
You say, 'Who is Flynn?'
You say, 'What Vasty Deep?'
You say, 'What business?'
You say, 'What doppelganger?'
You say, 'Yes, I will help.'
Geoard BlueHawk is located at -1170, -315 in BlueHawk's in Erudin.
You say, 'Hail, Geoard BlueHawk'
You say, 'What about a Erud's Tonic?'
You say, 'Can I have some Erud's Tonic?'
You say, 'What about Vasty Deep Water?'
The "KISS" Phloatin mentioned is an Innoruuk's Kiss of Death. Purchase one from Geoard (~5 Silver), then find Sinnkin Highbrow at -1045, -255 in the Erudin City Library.
You say, 'Hail, Sinnkin Highbrow'
You say, 'What about Erud's Tonic?'
Give her Innoruuk's Kiss of Death.
You receive Erud's Tonic (there are two versions, but this is the NO TRADE one).
Return this to Nolusia Finharn (Outside of the Vasty Deep Inn, in Erudin)
You receive the other version of Erud's Tonic back; this one isn't NO TRADE.
Get another NO TRADE Erud's Tonic and then go to Qeynos.
Moodoro Finharn is located at +165, +325 outside Crows Pub & Casino in North Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Moodoro Finharn'
You say, 'What about Erud's Tonic?'
Give him the NO TRADE Erud's Tonic.
You receive 1 copper from Moodoro Finharn.
Flynn Merrington is located at +35, +340 inside Crows Pub & Casino in North Qeynos.
You say, 'Hail, Flynn Merrington'
Give him the regular Erud's Tonic.
You receive a Label of Erud's Tonic.
Return to Nolusia Finharn (at the Vasty Deep Inn) and hand in the Label of Erud's Tonic.
You receive 11 copper from Nolusia Finharn.
You receive a Splintering Club

quests.name: Velious Class Armor
steps: Faction Requirements:
Thurgadin / Coldain: Kindly
Skyshrine / Claws of Veeshan: Ally

Kael Drakkal / Kromzek: Ally - Be very wary of the various Tormax faction mobs that are on the way to the quest room in Kael; Dlammaz Stormslayer is to the left on the other side of the bridge, as well as at least the two throne guards in the throne room. Also keep in mind there is corpse drag aggro in Kael, even for you dragging your own body near mobs you are max ally with.
It should be noted there is no level requirement on the quests.

Plane of Growth armor sets drop from various mobs in Plane of Growth.
