quests.name: Velium Retrieval
steps: This quest begins with Sentry Kale at location 195, -457, 15, in the bakery in Skyshrine.
You say, 'Hail, Sentry Kale'
You say, 'What sentinel?'
You say, 'What problem?'
You say, 'I will deliver the supplies.'
Sentry Kale will hand you a Velium Delivery Note, which you are to take to a Coldain dwarf named Ungdin in Thurgadin.
Head in to the mines:

Go into the mines and take the center tunnel. Continue in that tunnel until you come to the next fork of three tunnels. Take the one on your right. He is at the end of that tunnel. There's a table and bench in the room with him.
You say, 'Hail, Ungdin'
Give him the note
Give him 50pp
You receive a Shipment of Velium Ore. Take that back to Sentry Kale in Skyshrine and he will say the following:
You receive 4 platinum from Sentry Kale.
Platinum reward will vary. You may not get the Bracer of Hammerfal each time, but he will finally give you one.
Follow up with this quest: Friend of the Kin

quests.name: Vengeance for Frenway
steps: Frenway Marthank can be found in the Surefall Glade
You say, 'Hail, Frenway Marthank'
You say, 'what bad news?'
You say, 'Toe needs the Bayle List'
You say, 'What is Mammoth?'
I suppose you'd ask him this if you had killed and looted the list from Mammoth without being sent by Runethar
You say, 'What is the Bayle List?'
You say, 'How do you know Antonius Bayle?'
Mammoth is the bear guilty of murder.
Note: Killing Mammoth will incur a big negative faction hit for the residents of Surefall. Turning the hide in will recover only a tiny fraction of that loss.
Kill Mammoth and loot Mammoth's Hide and Bayle List II
You give the hide to Frenway.
You receive 6 gold, 6 silver pieces.
You give the list to Frenway.
Rewards? Faction?

quests.name: Visceral Dagger
steps: Lord Qyzar is standing on the parapet one level up in the SK guild, at +1005, -150. For the Crusader's Test of the Hero, Lord Qyzar requires you to retrieve the [visceral dagger].
You say, 'What of the visceral dagger?'
Not much to go on, but if you find your way to the Crypt of Dalnir, you can find various scraps of paper called "A Journal Entry" which identify as "Crusader Nodfod 1-6."
Entry 1 reads:
Day 47
Crusader Golin and I have discovered what we
believe to be the crypt of the ancient Haggle
Baron Dalnir. It would seem as though the babble
of the goblin slave we caught and tortured turned
out to be accurate.
Unfortunately we must rest and plan our route
into the depths of this beast. It is filled with
very dangerous creatures. Hopefully we can
overcome the odds and find the final resting
place of the Visceral Dagger and the Grand Forge.
Entry 2 reads:
Day 48
Blast! This IS the Crypt of Dalnir. We found
the entrance which had the ancient Haggle Baron's
name upon it. How foolish of the crypt keepers!
The Crypt is filled with croaks from many races.
They seem to be in some sort of trance and far
more powerful then they appear. We were about to
enter the main tomb when we were assaulted by
the horde. Crusader Golin sustained a major gash
on his shoulder. Before I could cauterize his
wound, blood flowed all over, even this entry.
Tomorrow we shall try to enter the main tomb.
Entry 3 reads:
Day 49
We finally had an opportunity to make a run into
the main tomb, but just as we had the
sarcophagus in our sights, we fell through a
trap door hidden on the floor. We fell into what
appears to be the true Crypt of Dalnir and also
a haven for coerced sarnak! They were upon us in
no time. We ran, but found ourselves in an
unholy church. We fought our way out, but just
as we broke through, Golin's skull was punctured
by what appeared to be a rusted Crusader's
khukri. I am now in hiding, praying to any god.
Entry 4 reads:
Day 49 Eve
The gods were listening. After many hours of
hiding, it appears the beasts have gone to
perform some sort of dark ritual in the church
we found earlier. I could hear the screams of a
sacrifice and the chant of some unknown tongue.
I did a reconnaissance of this level and found
no way out. The walls had tombs built into them
as mortuaries do. None of the doors would open,
but I did find one. I slid the sarcophagus out
with much effort. Before I could attempt to open
it I was scared off by noises within the drawer.
Entry 5 reads:
Day 50
What have I gotten myself into? Soon I shall be
dead. After finding the secret passage through
the drawer, I found myself in a pit of evil. I
crept through the shadows and came upon a locked

quests.name: Vkjor's Major Task
steps: Need /loc of all quest mobs and logs of dialogues for first part of script (these are transcriptions).
You say, 'Hail, Vkjor'
You say, 'Something else.'
You say, 'What do you need taken care of?'
You say, 'I fight like a dragon.'
You say, 'What losses?'
The three dragons are Draazak, Jerigozia, and Veredenia, all found in the Western Wastes. Loot a claw from each and hand them in to Vkjor.

Vkjor looks down at you, shocked. 'I honestly did not expect you to be able to destroy her children, ______. Vkjrog must have guided your hand as you slew those beasts. Nevederia will now know sorrow the like of which she has never felt.' Vkjor drops a shiny pair of gauntlets on the ground before you as he turns his attention to the bloody claws he now holds.

quests.name: Vkjor's Minor Task
steps: You say, 'Hail, Vkjor'
You say, 'there is something else you can help me with'

Do you wish to be a gladiator or something along those lines? I do not allow your kind to fight in the arena, I am sorry to say. It is a sacred place for the children of Zek. If you wish to hone your battle skills, however, I do have several things I need taken care of.
You say, 'what do you need taken care of?'
You say, 'I fight like a ice wurm'
Graktar has moved on from the Eastern Wastes and is to be found in Iceclad Ocean.
Graktar does not respond to hails as normal. Hand in the Large Note to receive Graktar's Signet Ring:
You receive Graktar's Signet Ring. The item he wants in return is a Signet Ring from the Tower of Frozen Shadow wedding.
Return to Graktar Bluehammer. Again he does not respond to hails, so turn in the Signet Ring:

Graktar Bluehammer swipes the ring from your outstretched hand. 'Yes, this is Felkak's ring, a twin of my own. He would never part with this willingly so this is truly a sign of his passing. I thank you for delivering this news to me. Though it saddens me deeply, at least I will know now what has become of him. One day I may return to the arena but for now I must wander these lands to cool the fury of my heart. Please take what little coins I have as thanks in return.'
You receive 5 platinum from Graktar Bluehammer.

Note: There are a few problems with this quest. One, Vkjor says Graktar's brother name is Vkalth. Graktar after turning in the Large Note says his name is Felkak and refers to him that way. Vkjor does not respond to anything about returning to him. What to do with the ring Graktar gives? Graktar refused it.
Need all dialogues (these are transcriptions), current faction hits if any, /loc of quest mobs, quest items, quest rewards, any additional information required to solve the quest, etc.

quests.name: Wage War Upon The Coldain
steps: a kromrif recruiter scowls at you, ready to attack -- You could probably win this fight.
You say, 'Hail, a kromrif recruiter'
a kromrif recruiter says, 'I will do nothing to help beings like you!'
At dubious or higher:
You say, 'Hail, a kromrif recruiter'

a kromrif recruiter says 'Greetings, little thing. You have entered into the great city of Kael Drakkel, home of the Kromzek as well as a few of my kind, the Kromrif. If you are to walk among my people as a peer you must prove yourself as a friend, not a foe.'
You say, 'I will prove myself as a friend'

a kromrif recruiter says 'Leave this place then and return when you have waged war upon the Coldain. Remove their heads from their bodies and return them to me. I will spread the word of your deeds amongst my people if you do so, Lias.'
You say, 'what about the Coldain?'
a kromrif recruiter says 'The Coldain are the ice dwarves who dwell in the city of Thurgadin. They are a blight upon the land known as Velious, speaking the word of their god, Brell.'
On handing in heads you get faction, and...

quests.name: Wall Squad Ring
steps: To Obtain the Ring:
At the end of the "Orc Belts" quest, Deputy Budo told you to find Marshal Ghobber and tell him, "Am I one with the Wall?"
Find Marshal Ghobber at the ground level of the bank in Rivervale. (Your Location is 126.28, -203.77, 7.29)
You say, 'Hail, Marshal Ghobber'
If you have warmly or better faction standing with Marshal Ghobber (he is on Guardians of the Vale), you will see the following in response to this:
You say, 'Am I one with the Wall?'
** Note that you MUST have 2000+ standing to receive the Squad Ring
(This drop in standing appears to be a bug in the quest.)
You receive a Squad Ring. Since your faction has been lowered to warmly at least, you cannot repeat the dialogues with Marshal Ghobber.
To Recharge the Ring:
Find Hendi Mrubble. (Your Location is -230.38, -379.60, -14.71)
You say, 'Hail, Hendi Mrubble'
When you give her the ring, she gives it back.
What faction standing is required with Hendi to recharge the ring, and is there more to the quest?
Does not work at indifferent faction. She takes the ring and keeps it. Amiable faction needed to recharge.

quests.name: Warrior Epic Quest
steps: Jeweled Dragon Head Hilt
Hail Kargek Redblade and Wenden Blackhammer in East Freeport
Retrieve Unjeweled Dragon Head Hilt from the bottom of Lake Rathetear
Give the Unjeweled Dragon Head Hilt, a Diamond, a Jacinth, and a Black Sapphire to Wenden Blackhammer
Receive the Jeweled Dragon Head Hilt
Finely Crafted Dragon Head Hilt
Retrieve Severely Damaged Dragon Head Hilt from the chessboard in Timorous Deep
Get a Giant Sized Monocle from A mountain giant patriarch in Dreadlands
Give the Giant Sized Monocle to Mentrax Mountainbone in Frontier Mountains and receive Rejesiam Ore.
Kill Fright, Dread, or Terror and loot Ball of Everliving Golem in Plane of Fear
Give Severely Damaged Dragon Head Hilt, Rejesiam Ore, and Ball of Everliving Golem to Wenden Blackhammer (MQable)
Receive Finely Crafted Dragon Head Hilt
The Blades
Purchase A Keg of Vox Tail Ale from various merchants across Norrath.
Purchase two(2) Rebreathers from other players, or craft as a Gnome with Tinkering Skill, Trivial 175.
Kill Ice Giants and Loot Block of Permafrost in Permafrost
Give Block of Permafrost, A Keg of Vox Tail Ale, and the two(2) Rebreathers to Denken Strongpick in Ocean of Tears.
Receive Ancient Sword Blade
Kill Queen Velazul Di`zok in Chardok and loot Ancient Blade
The Red Scabbard
Hail Kargek Redblade and get Wax Sealed Note by saying "what favor"
Give Wax Sealed Note to Oknoggin Stonesmacker in Feerrott and receive Tiny Lute
Give Tiny Lute to Kargek Redblade and receive the book Redblade's Legacy
Give book to Tenal Redblade in East Karana and receive Totem of the Freezing War
Kill goblin wizards in Permafrost, loot Heart of Frost
Give Totem of the Freezing War and Heart of Frost to Tenal Redblade and receive Totem of Fiery War
Kill Lord Nagafen or Ragefire in Nagafen's Lair, Nortlav the Scalekeeper in The Hole or Talendor in Skyfire Mountains and loot Red Dragon Scales
Kill Severilous in Emerald Jungle or Hoshkar in Veeshan's Peak and loot Green Dragon Scales
Give Totem of Fiery War, Red Dragon Scales, and Green Dragon Scales to Tenal Redblade and receive Mark of the Sword
Kill Maestro in Plane of Hate and loot Hand of the Maestro
Give Mark of the Sword and Hand of the Maestro to Tenal Redblade and receive Tenal`s note to Kargek
Kill Spiroc Lord in Plane of Air and Loot Spiroc Wingblade
Give Tenal`s note to Kargek and Spiroc Wingblade to Kargek Redblade and receive Red Scabbard
Jagged Blade of War/Blades of Strategy and Tactics
Combine both hilts and both blades in Red Scabbard to receive the Jagged Blade of War.
Note: Combine Jagged Blade of War in the Red Scabbard to receive the Blade of Strategy and the Blade of Tactics.
Note: Combine Blade of Strategy and Blade of Tactics in the Red Scabbard to receive Jagged Blade of War again.

quests.name: Warrior Kael Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Kragek Thunderforge in Kael Drakkal.
Warlord's Crown
Warlord's Breastplate
Warlord's Vambraces
Warlord's Bracer
Warlord's Gauntlets
Warlord's Greaves
Warlord's Boots

quests.name: Warrior Pike Quests
steps: Partisan's Pike (#0):
Hand in your note to Drill Master Vygan.
Militia's Pike (#1):
You say, 'Hail, Drill Master Vygan'
You say, 'What militia pike?'
You say, 'I desire to upgrade the partisan pike'

Drill Master Vygan wants you to find the traitor who is helping the froglok slaves escape, along with his froglok accomplice. You'll need to head to the Swamp of No Hope first, and look for "a froglok escort" or Froglok Escort and kill it. They can be found near the newbie area, usually on the first island South of the city along the road.
You have slain a froglok escort!
a froglok escort's corpse says 'Gcroooakk.. I have failed.. Unghhh.'
--You have looted a Bixie Berry Pie.--
--You have looted a Froglok Escort Fife.--

You now have the whistle that the Drill Master speaks of, and a new clue: a Bixie Berry Pie. If you go to the bakers near the bank in East Cabilis, you'll find a Klok that mentions pies. Talk to him about it.
You say, 'What bixie berry pie?'
Just outside the Klok's shop Bugrin the Gatherer will spawn. You must get outside and kill him fast, as he will try to run away (very quickly).
You have slain Bugrin the Gatherer!
--You have looted a An Iksar Head.--
Now that you've looted his head, you have what the Drill Master wants. Take the "An Iksar Head", "Froglok Escort Fife", and your Partisan Pike to Drill Master Vygan and turn them in.
Congratulations, you have your Militia Pike!

quests.name: Warrior Skyshrine Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Jendavudd Fe`Dhar in Skyshrine.
Crown of the Myrmidon
Breastplate of the Myrmidon
Vambraces of the Myrmidon
Bracer of the Myrmidon
Gauntlets of the Myrmidon
Greaves of the Myrmidon
Boots of the Myrmidon

quests.name: Warrior Thurgadin Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Captain Njall in Thurgadin.
Champion's Crown
Champion's Breastplate
Champion's Vambraces
Champion's Bracer
Champion's Gauntlets
Champion's Greaves
Champion's Boots

quests.name: Watcher Torches
steps: You say, 'Hail, Captain Gideen'
You say, 'What goblin watchers?'
Hand in three Watcher Signal Torch:
You receive 7 silver from Captain Gideen.

quests.name: Weapons Delivery
steps: This quest begins with Larn Brugal (Warrior GM) who is located in West Freeport Behind the Arena at -317.92, 58.29, -10.25
You say, 'Hail, Larn Brugal'
You say, 'What war is that?'
You say, 'Who are Clan Deathfist?'
You say, 'I will get your shipment!'
You receive a Sealed Letter which reads:
GROFLAH'S FORGE 4 - Raw Short Swords for stock
For The Bunker - Larn Brugal
Travel to North Freeport and find Groflah Steadirt on the second floor of Groflah's Forge at location -15.33, 523.04, 17.75
You say, 'Hail, Groflah Steadirt!'
Give him the Sealed Letter.
Travel to the East Commonlands to the first Orc camp.
Three of the blades are found on the ground in the tents at Orc 1. The fourth is a rare drop from a Orc Weaponsmith also found at camp 1.
For killing any of the Death Fist orcs in the commonlands, you receive the following faction hits:
Once you have all four raw swords, return to Larn Brugal and give him the blades.
You receive 4 gold from Larn Brugal.
You receive Reward Raw Short Sword.
Return to Groflah's Forge with Reward Raw Short Sword and give it to Groflah.
You receive Groflah's Stoutbite.

quests.name: Weeping Wand Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Gardern'
You say, 'Lore to what wand?'
You say, 'I am interested in the wand'
Gardern needs:
A Silver Wand (from a silvered guard in Cazic)
A Bloodblack Wand (from giant skeletons in Mount Rathe)
Twice-Woven Silk (from fairies)
Scepter (from the Tomb in Castle Mistmoore - see the Solusek's Flower quest for more details)

quests.name: Wenbie's Muffins
steps: Guard Wenbie can be found patrolling South Qeynos during the day time. He follows the typical guard patrol path, so sometimes it will be difficult to find him. A good place to stand and wait for him is in the general vicinity of 117.43, -158.50, 3.75. Make sure it is day time - he is not around during the night.

The changing of the "night time guards" to "day time guards" happens at 6 a.m. game time. Personally witnessed Guard Wenbie spawn at point 76.7, -19.37, 3.75 in South Qeynos. (spawn points of roaming guards randomized?)
You say, 'Where is Voleen's Bakery?'
Muffins can be purchased from Voleen Tassen or Karn Tassen in the shop (or elsewhere around the world). Give him 1-4 individual (not stacked) Muffins. (Will crafted muffins work?)
You receive 3-5 copper from Guard Wenbie. Occasionally you will receive a Brass Ring.

quests.name: Wenglawks The Traitor
steps: Fjokar Frozenshard can be found in Kael, in the halls behind King Tormax.
You say, 'Hail, Fjokar Frozenshard'
You say, 'Tell me about Wenglawks'
You say, 'Who are the Iceshard brothers?'
You say, 'What about the Kromrif?'
You say, 'What about courier?'
Fjokar is seeking a Sealed Letter dropped by a Shardwing Courier in the Western Wastelands. On handing in the letter:
You receive a Frozen Shard.

Note: This quest appears to give approximately 1.1 million experience, or about 1.5% of level 59/5% of level 45. It can be turned in by a KOS rogue using sneak at level 59; possibly earlier, but hide does need to be removed while in a position that may be in front of lower level giants in the room, so this may be level dependent.

quests.name: Werewolf Hunters
steps: You say, 'Hail, Fixxin Followig'
You say, 'What are Fangbreakers?'
You say, 'What werewolves?'
You say, 'What enchanted blade?'
Give him a Silver Bar. (Stacks of bars works)
You receive a LORE book called Fixxin Followigs Silvery Blades, which contains information about how to craft silver weapons. The chief reward is all the positive faction hits, though.

quests.name: Werewolf Skin Cloak Quest
steps: Karg IceBear is a barbarian that wanders Everfrost Peaks.
You say, 'Hail, Karg IceBear'
You say, 'I have slain a werewolf.'
You say, 'What skin?'
Hand in the following to receive the cloak:
Werewolf Pelt (from werewolves in WC, MM, SK, NK or WK)
100 platinum
*IMPORTANT: You MUST hand in 100p along with your Werewolf Pelt in the same trade, or your item will be STOLEN and without reward!*
There are no faction hits one way or the other, though you do gain experience.

quests.name: White Dragonscale Cloak Quest
steps: Karam wants the following items:
White Dragon Hide - from Lady Vox
Platinum Diamond Wedding Ring - Jewelcrafting
Black Sapphire Platinum Necklace - Jewelcrafting
Note: These need to be the magical version, not the regular ones.

quests.name: Winds of Karana
steps: This quest starts with Vhalen Nostrolo. Completed by an Agnostic Dark Elf Wizard with apprehensive faction.
You say, 'Hail, Vhalen'
You say, 'I would like to hear a tune.'
You say, 'It is a sad tune.'
You say, 'What new composition?'

Now, head southeast till you see a cottage. It has a hexagonal wall of stone surrounding it, so it's not hard to find. Inside the walls is a hermit. A very unfriendly sort. The door to the hermits house is either locked, or broken and won't open. So it's hard to get to him.

The easiest way to get him out is to stand behind the hut and say "I'm here to kill you." You can also try to target him and attack him. After he is dead, his body will contain the Cracked Flute, Winds of Karana sheet 1 or just one or the other.
Kill the hermit until you loot a flute, and a sheet music page.
The second piece is in the hands of Cordelia Minster.
You say, 'Hail, Cordelia'
You say, 'How can I help?'
When you hand her the flute from the hermit...
You receive 1 silver
You receive Winds of Karana sheet 2.
Now that you have both pages of sheet music, go back to Vhalen and give them both to him.
You receive Song: Selo's Accelerando.

quests.name: Wino
steps: a drunkard can be found wandering between three Kelethin platforms, starting at location 577, 388, 161, with a brief pause at location 429, 392, 161.
You say, 'Hail, a drunkard'
Hand a drunkard an Elven Wine, purchased from most any barkeep in Kelethin.
You say, 'What shocking experience?'
The quest then progresses from this same point in Bandit Sisters.

quests.name: Wisdom - The Long Battle
steps: You say, 'Hail, Gozzrem'
You say, 'I seek wisdom'
You say, 'I seek the long battle'

quests.name: Wisdom - The Short Battle
steps: You say, 'Hail, Gozzrem'
You say, 'I seek wisdom'
You say, 'I seek the short battle'

quests.name: Wislen Mamluk's Catfish
steps: You can find Wislen Mamluk on a dock in the wharf, fishing. He wants a Kerra Catfish, which you can get via fishing on either Kerra Isle or Tox Forest. I got it in about 10 minutes.
Your reward for this is a Kerran Fishing Pole. This is a no-drop, non magic item with no stats, not to be confused with the Kerran Fishingpole given by Feren.
Wislen - loc is (-204, -87, 10) - Kerra Isle
You say, 'Hail, Wislen Mamluk'
Wislen Mamluk says, 'Why you bother Wislen? Wislen trying to get fishies. Leave Wislen alone to get [fish], please.'
You say, 'What about fish'

Wislen Mamluk says, 'Fish. Wislen fish. Wislen is mamluk, not just fisher. Mamluk is warrior, but they also helps provide for all [Kerran]. This is hadi place in life. We happy doing this. Please. let Wislen fish now.'
You say, 'What Kerran'
Wislen Mamluk says, 'Mostly they like [catfish], but Wislen not have any luck today.'
You say, 'What about catfish'
Wislen Mamluk says, 'Kerra Catfish is what Wislen want.'
Upon giving Wislen Mamluk a Fresh Fish:
Wislen Mamluk says, 'Fish! Fish! Not again Fish! Take it back, I have too many.'
Upon giving Wislen Mamluk a Kerra Catfish:
Wislen Mamluk says, 'You caught catfish? Errr. Wislen thanks you. Here. Take this. It's one of my best fishing poles.'
You receive a Kerran Fishing Pole.

quests.name: Wizard Epic Quest
steps: (IMPORTANT NOTE: With Ornate Velium Pendant, you can skip straight to receiving the Golem Sprocket - IF YOU DO THIS, you MUST use the OVP on ALL turn in mobs thereafter, lest your turn ins be eaten).
(IMPORTANT NOTE for evil wizards and Dark Elves: you have 3 options:

1. wolf form and avoid guards. The Halas guards are KOS to wolf form, however, the shaman guild masters are not. If you do the turn-in in wolf form, be wary of patrolling guards (perhaps your druid friend can harmony these but its not necessary).
2. harmony. Just harmony the NPCs around Dargon.
3. Having someone pull Dargon to the zone in area of Halas, snare, then they zone.
Consider binding at the zone line as well. Unfortunately, succor/abscond will drop you at the main guard post which can make for a grisly death.
Talk to Solomen in the Temple of Solusek Ro, receive a note. [OPTIONAL if using Ornate Velium Pendant

Hand the note to Camin at the Vasty Deep Inn in Erudin. Hail him, then hand him 1000pp. [OPTIONAL if using Ornate Velium Pendant][NOTE: Doing this part twice is NOT enough faction to get you to indifferent.]
Buy the potion called Ro's Breath from Dargon in Halas, outside the shaman guild (900-1100pp).
Take the potion to Camin, receive potion back with the charge missing.
Hand the used potion to Dargon, who turns into Arantir Karondor. Hail him and receive the ring (note more than one wizard can hail Arantir after he has been triggered and each receive a ring).
Hand Challice the ring in the basement of the Paladin Guild in Felwithe, receive another ring back.
Hand the ring to Dargon/Arantir Karondor. Talk to him of the other wizards and receive Note from Arantir. (Say 'Who is the gnome?' to skip to the end of the conversation)
Talk to Kandin Firepot in Butcherblock. Hand him Note from Arantir, say "what oil?" to receive Golem Sprocket.
Kill Phinigel Autropos in Kedge Keep. Loot the Blue Crystal Staff.
Kill Venril Sathir in Karnors's Castle, loot Gnarled Staff.
Give the Golem Sprocket to a broken golem in Fear. This spawns an enraged golem. Kill him and loot Green Oil.
Give the oil to Kandin Firepot. Receive the Staff of Gabstik and Note to Arantir.
Give Note to Arantir to Dargon to spawn Arantir Karondor, then hail him. Give him the Blue Crystal Staff, Gnarled Staff, and Staff of Gabstik. Receive a bag.
Give the bag to Solomen, receive the Staff of the Four

quests.name: Wizard Kael Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Ulkar Jollkarek in Kael Drakkal.
Circlet of the Invoker
Robe of the Invoker
Sleeves of the Invoker
Bangle of the Invoker
Gloves of the Invoker
Pants of the Invoker
Boots of the Invoker

quests.name: Wizard Skyshrine Armor Quests
steps: Turn-ins to Elaend Fe`Dhar in Skyshrine.
Icicle Circlet

Icicle Sleeves

Icicle Gloves
Icicle Pantaloons
Icicle Boots

quests.name: Wizard Spells (Evil)
steps: Utandar Rizndown may be found in The Overthere. He wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Atol's Spectral Shackles
Inferno of Al'Kabor
Pillar of Frost
Tears of Druzzil
The reward is a random selection from the four listed spell scrolls.

quests.name: Wizard Spells (Good)
steps: Barnal Flamehand may be found in Firiona Vie (loc -3268, 3076). He wants any of the following spell scrolls:
Atol's Spectral Shackles
Inferno of Al'Kabor
Pillar of Frost
Tears of Druzzil
The reward is a random spell scroll from the list in the "Reward" section above.

steps: Turn-ins to Mauren Frostbeard in Thurgadin.
Sage's Crown
Sage's Robe
Sage's Sleeves
Sage's Bracelet
Sage's Gloves
Sage's Pantaloons
Sage's Boots

quests.name: Wizard's First Assignment
steps: You say, 'Hail, Raskena Djor'
You say, 'Ghanlin sent me.'
You say, 'What should I gather?'
Hand in two Fire Beetle Leg and two Fire Beetle Eye.
(~1% at Level 3)
You receive a random low-level spell.
There are no faction changes.

quests.name: Wolf Hide Armor
steps: Baobob Miller will make you Wolfhide Armor if you bring him pelts and pay him some gold.
You say, 'Hail, Baobob Miller
You say, "Who is your sister?
You say, 'What garment?'
You say, 'What boots?'
You say, 'What cloaks?
You say, 'What belts?

quests.name: Wolfskin Gloves Quest
steps: There is an NPC named Ged Twigborn who wanders the forest. He can usually be spotted in one of two places: Either along the same wall as the zone to the Commonlands, or by turning on the path off the main road from the sign pointing towards Freeport.
Ged will make you some Wolfskin Gloves if you give him 13 gold and a high quality wolf pelt.

quests.name: Wooly Fungus Quest
steps: Waltor Felligan is located just outside the Temple of Justice, the shaman guild hall in Halas (/loc 288, 374). You must be amiable or higher with Shamen of Justice to obtain this quest. You say, 'Hail, Waltor Felligan'
You say, 'I will assist in gathering fungus'
If your faction is indifferent or lower...
If your faction is high enough...

Combine 8x (1 per container slot) Wooly Fungus (dropped from a wooly spiderling in Everfrost Peaks) in the Empty Jar to produce a Jar of Fungus and hand it over to Waltor. Waltor Felligan says 'Aye! Ye've filled the jar. I'll see to it that Holana locks this away. Tis difficult to obtain and we can only spare the talents of our young shamans. Allow me to give ye a reward. Thank ye kindly fer yer service.'
You'll receive 8-9 gold and one low level shaman spell.

quests.name: Words of Darkness Quest
steps: (I was able to turn this in as an Iksar with the starting faction to Temple of Sol Ro.)
You say, 'Hail, Vurgo'
You say, 'What Words of Darkness?
You say, 'What word components?'
Hand Vurgo the Shadowed Book.
Vurgo gives you a Note.
Hand Vurgo the following items:
Note from turning in the Shadowed Book
Book of Darkness from Cyanelle in Lake Rathetear
Book of Frost from an icy goblin in Permafrost
300 gold coins

quests.name: Xelha's Cyclops Eye
steps: Xelha Nevagon is located in the East Freeport tunnels at -168, -235
After bringing Xelha Nevagon four spiderling silks,
Xelha will tell you to bring her a cyclops eye.
You receive 7 gold 12 silver from Xelha Nevagon.

quests.name: Yegek's Test, Part 1
steps: Yegek B'Larin is located inside the arena at the Indigo Brotherhood guild hall (-49.27, -1214.76, -24.87).
You say, 'Hail, Yegek B`Larin'
You say, 'Seloxia Punox sent me'
Fill the Empty Bag with 3 fire beetle eye and 3 Bone Chips as instructed, combine, and hand in the Bag of Eyes n Bones.
You receive 4 silver pieces.

quests.name: Yegek's Test, Part 2
steps: When Part 1 has been completed, Yegek may ask if you are ready for the [second test]:
You say, 'I am ready for the second test'
Give Yegek your starting No Drop shortsword (you DID keep it, right?), and a Teir`Dal Coward appears in the arena. You have to kill the Coward and turn his Teir`Dal Head into Yegek.

quests.name: Yelinak's Head Quest
steps: Faction Required: King Tormax (Min: Dubious)
You say, 'Hail, King Tormax'
You say, 'What tasks?'
You say, 'What powers?'
Lord Yelinak is a very tough dragon in Skyshrine. Kill him and bring back his head (Yelinak's Head) for your gauntlets.
(Confirmed to have turn in at 53. So minimum level posted on this page isn't correct. Actual minimum unknown)

quests.name: Yuio's Illness
steps: You say, 'Hail, Jali Kaliio'
You say, 'I have peaceful intentions.'
You say, 'I would like to help.'
You say, 'Who is Khonza Ayssla?'
Go to Khonza and tell her, 'Jali sent me.'
Tell Khonza , 'I will fetch them for you.'
2x Panda Claws can be found from pandas in Stonebrunt.
2x Tiger Skins drop from Kejek Tigers (orange ones)- The tigers on the island in south Kerra Island have a very high drop rate and fast spawn time.
2x Asp Poison Sac drop from Asps and Cistern Asps, most common in Oasis of Marr and the Southern Desert of Ro.
1x Kejekan Palm Fruit are foraged in Stonebrunt
1x Bamboo Shoot are foraged in Stonebrunt and can also drop Bamboo Shoot from pandas.
Combine into a Full Gathering Satchel.

When you return the bag to Khonza, Khonza Ayssla says 'I thought the kobolds would have you for dinner, but you made it back.' Ayssla takes the satchel and begins to pour different vials of foul smelling liquid into it. She then takes the entire contents of the bag and dumps it into a large kettle and begins to chant in an unknown language. After a few minutes, she takes a small amount of the now boiling liquid and puts it in a vial. 'Take this vial back to Jali. I pray to the Titan Spirits that it works.'
You receive a Vial of Healing Liquid (NO TRADE, Tiny, weight 0.2) in return.
Giving this to Jali gets the following:
You receive the Wakizashi of the Frozen Skies.

quests.name: Zimel's Blades (SoulFire)
steps: A Sealed Note
Brew/obtain Bog Juice
Brew/obtain Edible Goo
Turn in 4x Drom's Champagne to Tykar Renlin in Seafarer's Roost bar in East Freeport (to receive Bunker Cell #1)
Turn in Juice, Goo, and Bunker Cell #1 to a prisoner in West Freeport Arena prison (to receive H. K. 102)
Turn in H. K. 102 to Assistant Kiolna in Highpass Keep bank (to receive A Sealed Note)
The Testimony
Obtain A Spider Venom Sac
Obtain Cloth Shirt
Turn in Cloth Shirt to Altunic Jartin (requires Amiable) in East Commons (to receive Token of Generosity)
Turn in Venom Sac to Merko Quetalis in the North Freeport Hall of Truth (to receive Token of Bravery)
Turn in both Tokens to Merko to spawn Guard Willia
Kill Guard Willia (to loot Token of Truth)
Turn in Truth Token to Merko (to receive Testimony)
The Hilt
Kill Xicotl in Mistmoore Castle (to loot Glowing Sword Hilt)
The Sword of Faith
Kill Sir Lucan D'Lere (both GM and undead spawn) in West Freeport (to loot Testimony of Truth)
Obtain warmly faction with Knights of Truth (soon as you hit Warmly you can safely turn in the Testimony of Truth in the next step - Verified on EQL 8/8/2026) (see Fabian's Strings)
Turn in Testimony of Truth to Valeron Dushire in the North Freeport Hall of Truth (to receive Brilliant Sword of Faith)
Note
Obtain warmly faction with Priests of Life (see Bone Chips Qeynos or Werewolf Hunters)
Turn in A Sealed Note to Brother Hayle in Splitpaw (to receive Note)
Final Turn-ins
Turn in Note, Testimony, Glowing Sword Hilt, Brilliant Sword of Faith to Brother Hayle (to receive Soulfire)

quests.name: Zombie Flesh Quest
steps: You say, 'Hail, Dleria Mausrel'
You say, 'I am a new priest.'
You say, 'I will protect the depths.'

You receive an Empty Bag (identifies as "Zombie Flesh Bag"). Despite the quest text, you need to obtain four Zombie Skins, not zombie flesh. You can use zombie skins from anywhere, not just Erud's Crossing. Combine four in the bag to craft a Bag of Zombie Flesh, and hand this to Dleria.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new!
You receive 12 silver from Dleria Mausrel.
You receive 4 gold from Dleria Mausrel.
You also receive a minor item.
